chapters.title: Chapter 3901: Feng Jixing
paragraphs: Chapter 3901: Feng Jixing

With a thought from Ling Han, he made some changes to his appearance. Then, he used the Soul Awakening Technique to change the wave of his soul. In this way, there should be no one here that could see through to his true appearance.
He put away the Void Beast hide, then boldly stood with the others.

A large number of Core Formation Tier cultivators entered. The Cauldron ForgingTier cultivators all stepped aside. No matter how prodigious you were, with a gap of a major tier of cultivation level, who would dare to be impudent?

These Core Formation Tier cultivators originally wanted to clear the area, but most of the outsiders who could come here had trump cards in their possession. Though they may not be able to overthrow the Core Formation Tier cultivators, if the Core Formation Tier cultivators wanted to kill them, they would have to pay a corresponding price.
Thus, the outsiders obediently retreated to the side, and the Core Formation cultivators didn’t push them too far either.

Ling Han took a look around. In truth, there was no shortage of cultivators in the Core Formation Tier that had entered into the White Lotus Mystery Realm. However, in this place, aside from the Di Clan, he did not see any other cultivators in the Core Formation Tier.
It was as if after entering this place, they had been filtered through. Foundation Building Tier, Cauldron Forging Tier, Core Formation Tier would each enter into a specific area.
-Unless there was an Ancestral King-level intervention.
Gradually, more and more people appeared.

The Buddhist Race’s Holy Daughter, Prosperous Heaven, was elegant and unearthly. Though she was a monk, she still had her hair. She was incomparably beautiful, and with the blessing of Buddhist Race, she seemed to have a special advantage here.

Song Lan had also arrived. With two of the top ten beauties of the galaxy standing side by side, they instantly attracted the attention of countless people. With them at the centre, theis attention was filled with adoration.
Aside from the two great beauties, there was naturally also prodigies.
“Feng Jixing!”
“Ranked 12th in the Galaxy Network, the top elite of our North Heavenly Realm!”
“What twelfth place? If he left the Mystery Realm now, he would definitely be able to charge into the top ten.”
“Why do you say that?”
“I heard that he obtained a great fortune here, and formed Nine Cauldrons!”
“What!”
Everyone was stunned. A Nine Cauldrons prodigy had actually appeared in the North Heavenly Realm?

“Hehe, not only that, but Feng Jixing’s luck is heaven-defying, and he even obtained a large amount of divine substance, evolving the Celestial Cauldron into the Nine Colored Glass Cauldron. In the end, even the divine substance was no longer effective. Don’t you think that’s awesome?”
“Hiss!”
Everyone inhaled sharply again. This was too terrifying. Even the divine substance was ineffective. Just how high was the quality of this Celestial Cauldron?
“Great, now our North Heavenly Realm is also going to produce an elite that can be in the top ten of the Galaxy Network.”
“Who knows, it may not be the top ten, but the top five, top three, or even in fact… number one!”

A great many people were excited. Though this wasn’t because they were strong, as a member of the North Heavenly Realm, they had been discriminated against on the Galaxy Network for a long time, and now that a supreme elite was finally about to appear, they naturally felt proud and elated.

Ling Han also looked over, and saw that Feng Jixing looked to be in his early twenties. He was tall and slender, and his hair was thick and black. Each strand looked like tt was carved from black jade, exuding a faint halo of light.

This person was also extremely handsome, and had an intimidating bearing. His aura was astonishing. Merely standing there, he had become the center of the heaven and earth, causing everyone’s eyes to involuntarily focus on him.

Now, he was standing together with the the two great beauties, the Holy Daughter of the Buddhist Race and Song Lan. It was unknown what they were talking about, but the two women were both smiling faintly. The atmosphere was really too harmonious.

This made many people envious. This brat was really too detestable, wasn’t he? He actually had two women beside him, and they were both seductive beauties ranked in the top ten of the Exquisite Leaderboard.
However, who dared to provoke him?
Nine Cauldrons, and added with the Nine Coloured Glass Cauldron, battle prowess was probably enough to oppose Core Formation Tier elites.

Ling Han didn’t have any designs on Song Lan or Prosperous Heaven, so he naturally wouldn’t be jealous. What he cared about was where the light of death was, whether it was a celestial light, and whether it could be retrieved.
After resting for two days, the Core Formation Tier cultivators started to challenge the Bronze Statue Formation.

During this time, a great many local Core Formation Tier cultivators arrived, and altogether, there were close to three hundred of them. However, in front of the Bronze Statue Formation, three hundred was not all that much better than a drop in the ocean.
Thankfully, the bronze statues couldn’t move, so they each stood in their respective positions. Thus, this was easy to deal with.
The army of three hundred Core Formation Tier cultivators began to advance, advancing with great difficulty, forcibly carving out a path.
After spending a whole ten days, they finally passed through the Bronze Statue Formation. The outsiders wanted to pass through as well, yet they were all stopped.

It was fine if one wanted to pass, but he had to take out some benefits to show his respect. -This path had been created by the 300 Core Formation Tier cultivators after paying an exorbitant price. How could they allow you to pass through for nothing?
The outsiders didn’t try to be brave either. They all took out treasures and handed them over.

They had more or less gained something before entering into the Demonic Origin Region. Even if they hadn’t, they would definitely have brought some treasures with them when they entered, so it wasn’t difficult for them to pass through.
Ling Han didn’t force his way through. What he gave was alchemical pills. To him, this was no
big deal.
For the time being, outsiders and locals had formed an alliance.

Ling Han saw that the three members of the Tong Clan had been searching all this while, and were even asking around among the outsiders about his whereabouts. However, these three people would never have dreamed that there would be a secret technique like the Soul Awakening Technique in this world that could cause even his spiritual waves to change.
It couldn’t be helped. The overall level of cultivation here was too low.
These three old geezers!
Ling Han thought internally. They were clearly the ones who had bullied for no reason first, and now they were still biting at him. They really deserved to die.
Unfortunately, there was no way to set up the Three Elements Treasure Bottle Formation here. Otherwise, it would have refined them forcefully.
There would eventually be a chance.

Ling Han thought to himself that he wasn’t far from Core Formation Tier, and as long as he advanced into the Core Formation Tier, he believed that it wouldn’t be too difficult for him to kill a late stage Core Formation Tier.
He suppressed his killing intent and simply followed the crowd.
After passing through the plaza, there were even more black figures here. All of them pounced
towards them.

These black shadows were all Yin souls and didn’t have a physical body, so they weren’t afraid of power attacks either. If one wanted to cause damage to them, they would have to draw on high-level energy, or directly use their spiritual power to attack.
Battling like this consumed too much energy, and even those at the Core Formation Tier found it extremely straining. They had to spend a long time before they could take another
step forward.
The problem was that there seemed to be an inexhaustible supply of Yin souls. They continued to surge out, and this was a huge blow to their morale.
“I have a technique that can expiate the dead.” Prosperous Heaven stepped out, “However, I can’t cast the technique alone, so I need help.”

This astonished even the Core Formation Tier elites. They couldn’t do anything about it, yet a measly Cauldron Forging Tier cultivator was actually able to do what they couldn’t? They couldn’t help but feel yearning. They had heard that the outside world was incredibly vast, and in comparison, the Demonic Origin Realm was only a small place. Furthermore, in the outside world, a Core Formation Tier cultivator could live for four thousand years, and this fact alone was enough to drive them crazy.
-In comparison, the lifespan increase of a hundred years from the Divine Tree Heart was
practically negligible.
However, they had not entered here merely for the sake of the Divine Tree Heart, but also for the inheritance of this place.

Thus, these Core Formation Tier cultivators were still willing to continue on. Prosperous Heaven drew out a wooden fish, and had the Core Formation Tiers endlessly pour mystical power into it. Meanwhile, she would use the Buddhist Race secret technique to expiate the dead souls.

chapters.title: Chapter 3902: Expiating the dead
paragraphs: Chapter 3902: Expiating the dead
There were many people in the Core Formation Tier here, so they weren’t afraid of Prosperous Heaven’s tricks.
Immediately, ten cultivators of the Core Formation Tier walked over and injected mystical
power into the wooden fish. Countless veined patterns instantly lit up on the seemingly ordinary wooden fish.
Prosperous Heaven gave a light tap, and there was a crisp ‘airy’ sound. Then, she shouted lightly, “An!”

Instantly, the “An” character lit up, as if it had been boosted by some kind of power. Buddhist light overflowed, continuously enlarging. When everyone came into contact with it, they felt that Buddhist teachings were vast and mighty, capable of cleansing the hearts of others, and their hearts of strife declined sharply.
And to the dead souls, this Buddhist chant was no less than poison. As the ‘An’ character swept past, masses of dead souls turned into bits of light.
“An… Ma… Ni… Ba… Mi… Gu…”
She chanted word by word, and it was as if everyone had been baptized. Their minds were clear, and the dead souls had suffered a calamity, turning into light and dissipating.

Everyone praised. Exorcising the dead was indeed the specialty of the Buddhist Race. Even the many Core Formation Tiers felt a headache coming on, but in front of Prosperous Heaven, it was easily resolved.
Moreover, this Six Characters Bright King Curse was thought-provoking. If one could listen to it day and night, would it help one comprehend Dao?
Instantly, a great many people had the thought of joining the Buddhist Race.
As Ling Han watched, he couldn’t help but feel alert.

This Buddhist Race’s reformation was really pervasive, and though the teachings of the Buddhist Race were to enlighten all living beings, he kept feeling that this was a kind of brainwashing, which made him feel conflicted.
Yi?
Ling Han saw multiple streaks of auspicious red clouds descend from above Prosperous Heaven, making her seem as if she had transformed into a female Bodhisattva, becoming more and more sacred.
This image was really out of the ordinary. If ordinary people saw it, they would probably have to bow down in worship.
Ling Han activated his ocular technique, and immediately saw even more.
-These auspicious clouds were not created by Prosperous Heaven, but had rather been blessed on her by the heaven and earth. This was a kind of approval, and a kind of praise.
That was an incredibly pure energy that could improve one’s physique and cultivation level in all aspects.
A thought flashed through Ling Han’s mind. Could it be that she would be rewarded by heaven and earth for expiating the dead souls?
If that was really the case, then this Buddhist Race’s Holy Daughter was really too two-faced.
She was clearly able to obtain great benefits, yet she acted as if she was doing everything for them. It was as if everyone owed her a favor.
Ling Han moved quietly, and left the main troops.
At present, he was just a nameless pawn. Naturally, no one would pay attention to him. He charged into the ranks of Yin souls, then circled around to the back of a great hall.
‘Come!’
He immediately channeled the Destructive Energy. With a wave of his fist, those dead souls melted one after another like snow.

This efficiency was far from being as high as that of Prosperous Heaven. However, Ling Han was only one person, and did not need the help of others. Going by that calculation, the efficiency of Ling Han destroying the Yin soul was not inferior to that of Prosperous Heaven. In fact, it had even surpassed that.
However, Ling Han didn’t discover any change. The heaven and earth seemed to have completely ignored him.
He did not stop, but rather continued.
-Prosperous Heaven had not been boosted with auspicious clouds from the very beginning either.
He continued to attack, using the terrifying power of Destructive Energy. In any case, destroying Yin souls was a piece of cake.
This killing lasted for half an hour.
‘Hmm?’

Ling Han suddenly faltered. He discovered that a strange energy was surging into his body. This was something that he had never come into contact with before. It was astonishingly high in level, nourishing his body, allowing him to clearly sense that the hidden injuries that had been left behind in the process of cultivation were presently disappearing.
Hiss, this was comparable to Saintly medicine.

For example, a Cauldron Forging Tier possessed a theoretical lifespan of 2000 years, while a Core Formation Tier possessed a lifespan of 4000 years. However, there was basically no one who could live this long. This was because cultivating and battling would definitely leave one with hidden injuries. This would injure one’s life force.
Unless he ingested Saintly medicine, this hidden injury could not possibly be erased. However, this energy could actually dispel hidden injuries. How could this not be shocking?
Ling Han looked at himself with his divine sense, and saw an auspicious red cloud descend from above his head. It was this that had boosted his unique energy.
A reward from the heaven and earth!
Sure enough, killing Yin souls could obtain heaven and earth’s rewards.

Ling Han’s fighting spirit instantly increased a hundredfold. He let out a battle cry, and as his right hand attacked, he even shot out the light of lightning. This did not consume his own power, so it would be a waste not to use it.

But even so, he couldn’t compare to the efficiency of Prosperous Heaven in expiating dead souls. After all, she had a treasure in her hands, and there were also ten Core Formation Tier cultivators working together to help her.
From a certain aspect, Prosperous Heaven was robbing others of their fortune.
-The rewards of heaven and earth should have been distributed among the ten Core Formation Tier cultivators, yet now, she had taken all of them.
Don’t worry about this for now, kill!

Ling Han unleashed his full battle prowess, unleashing the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower. Although Destructive Energy was most effective against Yin souls, other celestial techniques were also effective. If they could be used, then he would try his best to use them
all.
This massacre lasted for over a day and night.

If it were any other Cauldron Forging Tier cultivator, they wouldn’t have been able to battle with such intensity for so long. However, Ling Han’s mystical power was almost limitless, so what would battling for one day and one night count as?
The problem was, as the battle continued, the number of Yin souls was rapidly decreasing,
and there was not enough to kill.
Sigh!
Ling Han sighed. Though he had also killed a considerable number of Yin souls, this was still far inferior to Prosperous Heaven.
If he obtained a single point of benefit, then Prosperous Heaven would have obtained at least
a hundred points.
Now, the surroundings had become empty, and there were no longer any black figures
floating around.
Ling Han returned, only to see that Prosperous Heaven had also finished herwork. There was a
haggard look on her face.
‘F*ck! Keep pretending!’

Ling Han knew what he was doing. After being boosted with a special power by heaven and earth, though he had expended a little of his mystical power, his vitality had gone up another level, and he was in a very good state.

The internal injuries in his body had completely disappeared, and his life force was even more vigorous. To say nothing of the fact that his life force was flawless, he would probably be able to live for a few more years.
Then, since Prosperous Heaven had received at least a hundred times more rewards from the heaven and earth than him, how could she possibly look haggard?
Hence, this woman was too good at acting. She had clearly gained all the benefits, yet acted as if she had sacrificed greatly for everyone. She was practically like a Bodhisattva.

As expected, seeing how hard it was on Prosperous Heaven, everyone was touched and impressed. They all delivered Celestial medicines. Those cultivators in the Core Formation Tier even guaranteed that they would definitely ensure her safety in the following expedition. If there were any gains, she would definitely be included.
With this one move, Prosperous Heaven had firmly established her position, and no one could
move her.
Everyone began to advance, and there was another great hall ahead of them. They entered,
and there was still an oil lamp inside. Under the light, everyone felt that their physique was
improving.
However, everyone was also afraid. This was extremely inauspicious, and the slightest move
could cause damage to one’s life force.
“Look, what’s that?” someone suddenly asked, pointing into the hall.
A figure was faintly discernible, presently performing a palm technique.
“Hiss, this is Buddhist Sect’s divine art, Great Sun Soaring Palm!” someone recognized.
“Venerable Tier secret technique!”
Instantly, many people’s eyes burned with desire.

This massacre lasted for over a day and night.
If it were any other Cauldron Forging Tier cultivator, they wouldn’t have been able to battle with such intensity for so long.
However, Ling Han’s mystical power was almost limitless, so what would battling for one day and one night count as?
The problem was, as the battle continued, the number of Yin souls was rapidly decreasing,
and there was not enough to kill.
Sigh!
Ling Han sighed.
Though he had also killed a considerable number of Yin souls, this was still far inferior to Prosperous Heaven.
If he obtained a single point of benefit, then Prosperous Heaven would have obtained at least
a hundred points.
Now, the surroundings had become empty, and there were no longer any black figures
floating around.
Ling Han returned, only to see that Prosperous Heaven had also finished herwork.
There was a
haggard look on her face.
‘F*ck!
Keep pretending!’
Ling Han knew what he was doing.
After being boosted with a special power by heaven and earth, though he had expended a little of his mystical power, his vitality had gone up another level, and he was in a very good state.
The internal injuries in his body had completely disappeared, and his life force was even more vigorous.
To say nothing of the fact that his life force was flawless, he would probably be able to live for a few more years.
Then, since Prosperous Heaven had received at least a hundred times more rewards from the heaven and earth than him, how could she possibly look haggard?
Hence, this woman was too good at acting.
She had clearly gained all the benefits, yet acted as if she had sacrificed greatly for everyone.
She was practically like a Bodhisattva.
As expected, seeing how hard it was on Prosperous Heaven, everyone was touched and impressed.
They all delivered Celestial medicines.
Those cultivators in the Core Formation Tier even guaranteed that they would definitely ensure her safety in the following expedition.
If there were any gains, she would definitely be included.
With this one move, Prosperous Heaven had firmly established her position, and no one could
move her.
Everyone began to advance, and there was another great hall ahead of them.
They entered,
and there was still an oil lamp inside.
Under the light, everyone felt that their physique was
improving.
However, everyone was also afraid.
This was extremely inauspicious, and the slightest move
could cause damage to one’s life force.
“Look, what’s that?” someone suddenly asked, pointing into the hall.
A figure was faintly discernible, presently performing a palm technique.
“Hiss, this is Buddhist Sect’s divine art, Great Sun Soaring Palm!” someone recognized.
“Venerable Tier secret technique!”
Instantly, many people’s eyes burned with desire.

chapters.title: Chapter 3903: Buddhist Race Secret Technique
paragraphs: Chapter 3903: Buddhist Race Secret Technique
Even among the Imperial Clans, Imperial Techniques and Saint Techniques were core secrets. Only a very limited number of clansmen or heirs could cultivate them.

If even the Imperial Clan was like this, then in the Holy Land, Venerate Tier-level Techniques were naturally precious treasures, and could only be cultivated if one had performed a great service or was the heir of the main branch.
Thus, even though there were a great many people here that had come from the Holy Land, they would still be envious when they saw a Venerate Tier-level technique.
Moreover, a great many people had come from Venerate Tier-level forces, so they naturally were moved by the Great Sun Soaring Palm.
That was because that figure was performing the Great Sun Soaring Palm, like he was a teacher that was teaching.
Prosperous Heaven’s expression was a little ugly.

She had even learnt the Imperial Technique, so she naturally wouldn’t take a Venerate Tier- level technique to heart. However, this was the secret technique of the Buddhist Sect, yet it was being displayed now, allowing everyone to cultivate the secret technique. This naturally made her unhappy.
In front of such a great opportunity, no one would be reserved. They all began to study it calmly.
But only after a while, hu, a cold wind blew past, and the oil lamp was extinguished.
“Run!” Everyone shouted loudly, fighting to squeeze out.
Though everyone was running at the first instant, there would be those that ran in the lead and those that trailed behind, and there were still a great many people that stayed inside.

In a short while, these people appeared. All of them had dazed gazes, as if they had lost their true nature. Whether it was Foundation Building Tier, Cauldron Forging Tier, or Core Formation Tier, they were all no exception.
It could be clearly seen that their faces were covered with dark green palm imprints, and the slender fingers of these imprints were completely inhuman.

“Holy Daughter, do you have a way to expiate the souls of the dead in this place?” A Core Formation Tier cultivator asked Prosperous Heaven very politely, completely not treating the latter as a junior that was a level below him.
Prosperous Heaven shook her head, indicating that there was nothing she could do.
Even if there was, she would deny it, because this hall contained the secret technique of the Buddhist Race, so she was naturally unwilling to have others learn it.
Originally, with the lights out, everyone should have gone to walk around in other great halls, but there was a Venerate Tier-level precious technique here, so who would be willing to leave?
After a while, the oil lamp in the great hall lit up again.
Everyone entered again, and continued to observe.
Good times didn’t last long. Not long after, a cold wind blew again, and the oil lamp was extinguished.
Just like before, everyone once again ran out of the great hall.

Continuing in this manner, those with high natural talent had more or less grasped this precious technique, but those with weak natural talent, especially those locals, their comprehension ability was far inferior to the prodigies of the outside world, and they were unable to comprehend it even after a long time.
There was nothing they could do about this. They could only enter into the great hall time and time again.

Ling Han was naturally one of the first to grasp the precious technique. Furthermore, he was possibly the first to learn the Great Sun Soaring Palm, aside from Prosperous Heaven. After all, she was the Buddhist Race’s Holy Daughter, and this cultivation technique was of a similar breath.
However, he did not show it. He went back and forth two more times, and only then did he sit cross-legged outside, and begin to comprehend.
Just now, he had only memorized all the key points of the technique, but to turn it into his own understanding, how could it possibly be so simple?
Not only him, but there was also a group of people sitting cross-legged outside the large hall. They were all prodigies among outsiders, ranked in the top 200 of the Galaxy Network.
A few hours later, Ling Han felt that he had completely mastered this precious technique, so he closed his eyes to rest out of boredom.
Another hour passed.
“Hahaha!” A loud laugh rang out. Feng Jixing stood, and began to practice on the empty ground. It was the Great Sun Soaring Palm.

Ling Han took a few looks, and couldn’t help but nod internally. This guy really lived up to Galaxy Network’s ranking of 12th. His comprehension ability was frighteningly strong, and he had already grasped the essence of Great Sun Soaring Palm. There was only a slight shortcoming, but he believed that with a bit more smoothening, he would soon be able to mend it.

To be honest, with Feng Jixing’s cultivation level of Nine Cauldrons, added with the Nine Coloured Glass Cauldron, Ling Han did not have full confidence that he could defeat him. Perhaps, Feng Jixing’s battle prowess had already leaped into the early stage of the Core Formation Tier, and was even stronger than Ling Han.
“He has succeeded!”
“Such terrifying comprehension ability!”
“I need at least a few more days to be able to grasp the gist of it. In comparison, the gap is practically immeasurable.”
All the prodigies felt rueful. They were already prodigies among prodigies, and there was still a massive gap between them and Feng Jixing.
Ling Han smiled inwardly. If he said that he had already comprehended the Great Sun Soaring Palm an hour ago, who knew how shocked these people would be?
Er, it was more likely that they would not believe his words.
After another few hours, the top prodigies gradually grasped this precious technique. They could begin channelling it, but to reach a proficient level, that was not something that could
be done overnight.
In fact, if one didn’t fully comprehend the unique Intent Realm, it would be useless no matter how many hundred years one cultivated.
How could a Venerate Tier-level precious technique be so easily mastered?
However, a few of them gave a terrible cry, and died suddenly.
They had not been attacked by anyone, but had been repeatedly ensnared by Yin souls,
exhausted of their life force, and died without any illness.
In fact, there was even a Core Formation Tier cultivator among them.
In this strange place, the Core Formation Tier elites didn’t seem to have much of an
advantage over the Foundation Building Tiers and Cauldron Forging Tiers.
This time, even those Core Formation Tier cultivators were afraid.
They did not dare to stay any longer, fearing that they would be met with misfortune, and
continue onwards.
After walking through this great hall, there was a wall, but after entering through the arched doorway, an extremely strange scene appeared ahead of them.
What temple was there? It was shockingly a desert.
Had they seen a ghost?
Even Ling Han was startled, not daring to believe his eyes.
Had he suddenly been teleported back to the desert from before?
No, though this was a desert, there was a blood moon hanging in the skies, which had an
indescribable harshness to it.
This was too strange. Where exactly was this place?
“Why have we suddenly come to the desert?”
“Have we been teleported?”
“Or… an illusion?”
Everyone was stunned. Some people even lowered their bodies, scooping up sand, wanting to
confirm if this was an illusion.
Ling Han also released his divine sense, yet shockingly discovered that this really was sand, as
real as could be.
Unless this technique far surpassed his level, only then would he be unable to distinguish the
truth from falsehood.
“Yi, Ling Han!” Song Lan looked over, revealing a hint of surprise.
That was because she had clearly not seen him before, yet he had suddenly appeared, which
gave her a shock.
Ling Han was astonished. How had she recognized him?
He had clearly changed his appearance, and even the fluctuation of his soul had changed.
Unless the other’s cultivation level was several major tiers higher than him, it would be impossible for anyone to see through his disguise.
He condensed water vapour, turning it into an ice mirror. With a look, wasn’t the person in the
mirror his original appearance?
How was this possible?
He clearly had not withdrawn the Soul Awakening Technique, nor had he changed back to his original appearance. Why had he suddenly returned to his original appearance?
Ling Han was extremely surprised. What was going on?
“Junior, so you are here!” Amidst a cold laugh, the Tong Clan’s three Core Formation Tiers
simultaneously glared at Ling Han.
F***, they could also see his true appearance now.
No, there was something off about all of this.
Boom, Tong Xiao had already charged over. The battle prowess of the Core Formation Tier
was unleashed to its fullest, and was boundlessly terrifying.

chapters.title: Chapter 3904: Truth and Illusion
paragraphs: Chapter 3904: Truth and Illusion
How could Ling Han block the attack of a late stage Core Formation Tier cultivator?
Obviously, fighting head-on was courting death.
Ling Han used Imminent Skyline, and xiu, his speed was extremely fast.
Since the three members of the Tong Clan had discovered him, how could they possibly let him off the hook? They all set out in pursuit.
What surprised Ling Han was that he actually couldn’t throw these three people off his tail.
He had clearly flown on his Tool and thrown these three people off his tail, but when his figure landed, these three people suddenly appeared again.
F***, what the hell was this?

Ling Han felt like everything was far too strange. He had unknowingly revealed his true appearance, yet the three members of the Tong Clan couldn’t be shaken off no matter what. This didn’t make sense.
What exactly was off?
Could it be that what hesaw was an illusion?
With a thought from Ling Han, he suddenly stopped, and charged towards the three members of the Tong Clan.
Demonic Monkey Fists?
Boom, Ling Han’s punch was extraordinarily heavy and fast.
Peng, he exchanged a blow with Tong Yongning, but a powerful force assailed him, and he was instantly sent flying. He did not even have the chance to use the second style.
“Pu!” He spluttered out a mouthful of blood, feeling as if his internal organs were trembling, which was extremely terrible.
On the other hand, though Tong Yongning was also sent backwards by him, he did not throw up blood. Immediately, he charged back.
Ling Han channeled the Imperial Technique. Although he just barely possessed the battle prowess of an early stage Core Formation Tier cultivator, his defenses were far inferior.
At this moment, Tong Shuhua and Tong Xiao had already charged over.
Ling Han couldn’t care less about the boiling in his internal organs, and hurriedly flew into the sky on his Tool.
Shua, a ray of light slashed over at an incredibly fast speed.
What a terrifying light. There were mysterious seals flickering within, as if even Divine Metal could be severed.

Thankfully, the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower exuded Primal Chaos Qi, forming a solid defense. Peng, when this ray of light slashed over, the Primal Chaos Qi was forcibly destroyed, and he had also been hit by the slash. Immediately, he felt a sharp pain in his chest. Mystical power overflowed chaotically, and he could no longer control the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower to fly. Immediately, he dropped down from the skies.
Peng, he fell onto the sand, and felt as if all his internal organs had been shattered. This was an indescribably horrible feeling.
He had not even managed to catch his breath, when he saw the three Core Formation Tiers of the Tong Clan had already appeared on the horizon, and were rapidly charging towards him. ‘F*ck! Again?’
Ling Han hurriedly got back to his feet and started to run again.
This time, he did not fly on his Tool. There was great killing intent in the skies.

However, the ground was not peaceful either. Occasionally, there would be bursts of underground flames gushing out. There was no need for him to be burnt directly. Even from afar, he could feel the scorching heat that was capable of burning his soul.
If it came into contact with him, he would probably die.

Ling Han had no choice but to be extremely alert. His divine sense circulated, paying attention to every single detail that changed on the ground, so that he could make a judgement in advance, and see if there would be any earth flames gushing out from there.
No matter how he fled, he was unable to throw off the pursuers behind him, and dangers appeared endlessly in the desert. Even with his iron willpower, he still felt weary.
Yi, had he overlooked something?
A thought flashed through Ling Han’s mind, but he couldn’t grasp it no matter what. It was too dangerous here, and he couldn’t divert his attention to think about other things at all.
No, no.
Ling Han was a supreme prodigy, after all. He was a freak that could cultivate every cultivation level to the true pinnacle level, so his willpower was naturally extraordinary as
well.
‘Oh, right.’
Realization suddenly dawned on Ling Han. Why hadn’t he thought of using the Heavenly Dao Flames?
This was his deadly weapon, and he could still use it five times.

Additionally, his mystical power was like a vast ocean, capable of matching mystical power of Sect Master-level, but even he felt weary. Why were the three Core Formation Tiers of the Tong Clan still able to follow closely behind him?
They weren’t made of iron, and their mystical power wasn’t inexhaustible.

Additionally, the other party could continue to hang behind him, and could not be shaken off no matter what. Added with his appearance, and the wave of his soul, he had strangely recovered his true identity.
“An!” Ling Han immediately shouted in his mind, and the scene before him instantly
trembled slightly.
Though this was only an instant, for Ling Han, this was already enough.
He was 100% sure that this was an illusion.
But since he was in the illusion, why was he no match for the three Core Formation Tiers of the Tong Clan? Why had he been wounded?
This was because this illusion was far too realistic, so much so that it affected his divine
sense.
If his divine sense thought that he had been injured, or even in fact died, he would also fall into an eternal dead silence, right until his life was exhausted.
He suddenly recalled the legend of the Black Heaven Temple. The light of death enshrouded
them, and all living creatures died.
Could it be that it was because of this?
He suddenly stopped. Boom! Earth flames surged out, their might boundless.

If this was directly burnt, then Ling Han would definitely “die”. It would not be his body, but rather his soul. Even if he was sure that this was an illusion, because it was too real, his mind would still think that he had been burnt to death.
He couldn’t change this illusion, but he could change himself.
“I am the Ancestral King, the invincible Saint Emperor, the Great Emperor that ruled over an era,” Ling Han said calmly, then sent out a palm strike.
Boom, the whole desert was destroyed. He sent out a palm strike, and all existences were
destroyed.
Ahead of him, the three Core Formation Tiers of the Tong Clan instantly evaporated, no
longer existing.
In front of Ling Han, only a void was left. He gave a loud shout, and struck out with his palms again. Pa, pa, pa!. Every palm strike was capable of tearing apart the universe.
The might of a Great Emperor was invincible in this world.
Boom! The Void couldn’t withstand the attacks of an Ancestral King either, and shattered
again. The scene in front of them turned into pieces.
Ling Han’s body trembled, and when he opened his eyes, he had already returned to the Black𝒇𝙧𝙚𝓮𝔀𝓮𝒃𝙣𝓸𝒗𝒆𝒍.𝙘𝒐𝒎
Heaven Temple.
He was in the middle of the crowd. Everyone had closed their eyes, but their eyes were rapidly twitching. The expressions on their faces were either nervous or terrified. In short, not one of
them was in a relaxed state.
Clearly, these people were the same as he had been previously. They were in an incredibly real illusion, and could not extricate themselves.
Ling Han looked up, only to see a streak of light pulsating before him. It was as black as ink.
So this was the legendary light of death?
Ling Han strode forwards. He had not taken too many steps, when the scene in front of his eyes immediately changed. He had entered into a desolate mountain, and there were large
rocks rolling down.
Humph!
Ling Han imagined himself as an Ancestral King. This was not difficult at all, because he had
previously seen many battle scenes of Ancestral King Pan Shi, and did not lack understanding
of the battle prowess of an Ancestral King.
Boom! Mountains collapsed, the heavens collapsed, and the Void was destroyed. He immediately returned to reality.
In comparison, he had only just advanced a single step.
Hiss, what a powerful illusion. He clearly knew that this was an illusion, and kept walking
forwards, but he had only taken one step, which was proof enough of how quickly he was affected by the illusion.
Ling Han continued to advance, and the scenery changed again. He was in a world of ice and snow. The cold wind whistled, and he was about to freeze in an instant.
Break.
Ling Han casually threw a punch, and heaven and earth crumbled. He once again exited the
illusion.
He walked again, walked again, and walked again.
Even though Ling Han had already found a solution, his progress was still slow.
However, he was determined that nothing could stop him.
Finally, he arrived in front of that streak of light. He stretched out a hand to grab it, and a
smile appeared on his face.

No matter how he fled, he was unable to throw off the pursuers behind him, and dangers appeared endlessly in the desert.
Even with his iron willpower, he still felt weary.
Yi, had he overlooked something?
A thought flashed through Ling Han’s mind, but he couldn’t grasp it no matter what.
It was too dangerous here, and he couldn’t divert his attention to think about other things at all.
No, no.
Ling Han was a supreme prodigy, after all.
He was a freak that could cultivate every cultivation level to the true pinnacle level, so his willpower was naturally extraordinary as
well.
‘Oh, right.’
Realization suddenly dawned on Ling Han.
Why hadn’t he thought of using the Heavenly Dao Flames?
This was his deadly weapon, and he could still use it five times.
Additionally, his mystical power was like a vast ocean, capable of matching mystical power of Sect Master-level, but even he felt weary.
Why were the three Core Formation Tiers of the Tong Clan still able to follow closely behind him?
They weren’t made of iron, and their mystical power wasn’t inexhaustible.
Additionally, the other party could continue to hang behind him, and could not be shaken off no matter what.
Added with his appearance, and the wave of his soul, he had strangely recovered his true identity.
“An!” Ling Han immediately shouted in his mind, and the scene before him instantly
trembled slightly.
Though this was only an instant, for Ling Han, this was already enough.
He was 100% sure that this was an illusion.
But since he was in the illusion, why was he no match for the three Core Formation Tiers of the Tong Clan?
Why had he been wounded?
This was because this illusion was far too realistic, so much so that it affected his divine
sense.
If his divine sense thought that he had been injured, or even in fact died, he would also fall into an eternal dead silence, right until his life was exhausted.
He suddenly recalled the legend of the Black Heaven Temple.
The light of death enshrouded
them, and all living creatures died.
Could it be that it was because of this?
He suddenly stopped.
Boom!
Earth flames surged out, their might boundless.
If this was directly burnt, then Ling Han would definitely “die”.
It would not be his body, but rather his soul.
Even if he was sure that this was an illusion, because it was too real, his mind would still think that he had been burnt to death.
He couldn’t change this illusion, but he could change himself.
“I am the Ancestral King, the invincible Saint Emperor, the Great Emperor that ruled over an era,” Ling Han said calmly, then sent out a palm strike.
Boom, the whole desert was destroyed.
He sent out a palm strike, and all existences were
destroyed.
Ahead of him, the three Core Formation Tiers of the Tong Clan instantly evaporated, no
longer existing.
In front of Ling Han, only a void was left.
He gave a loud shout, and struck out with his palms again.
Pa, pa, pa!.
Every palm strike was capable of tearing apart the universe.
The might of a Great Emperor was invincible in this world.
Boom!
The Void couldn’t withstand the attacks of an Ancestral King either, and shattered
again.
The scene in front of them turned into pieces.
Ling Han’s body trembled, and when he opened his eyes, he had already returned to the Black𝒇𝙧𝙚𝓮𝔀𝓮𝒃𝙣𝓸𝒗𝒆𝒍.𝙘𝒐𝒎
Heaven Temple.
He was in the middle of the crowd.
Everyone had closed their eyes, but their eyes were rapidly twitching.
The expressions on their faces were either nervous or terrified.
In short, not one of
them was in a relaxed state.
Clearly, these people were the same as he had been previously.
They were in an incredibly real illusion, and could not extricate themselves.
Ling Han looked up, only to see a streak of light pulsating before him.
It was as black as ink.
So this was the legendary light of death?
Ling Han strode forwards.
He had not taken too many steps, when the scene in front of his eyes immediately changed.
He had entered into a desolate mountain, and there were large
rocks rolling down.
Humph!
Ling Han imagined himself as an Ancestral King.
This was not difficult at all, because he had
previously seen many battle scenes of Ancestral King Pan Shi, and did not lack understanding
of the battle prowess of an Ancestral King.
Boom!
Mountains collapsed, the heavens collapsed, and the Void was destroyed.
He immediately returned to reality.
In comparison, he had only just advanced a single step.
Hiss, what a powerful illusion.
He clearly knew that this was an illusion, and kept walking
forwards, but he had only taken one step, which was proof enough of how quickly he was affected by the illusion.
Ling Han continued to advance, and the scenery changed again.
He was in a world of ice and snow.
The cold wind whistled, and he was about to freeze in an instant.
Break.
Ling Han casually threw a punch, and heaven and earth crumbled.
He once again exited the
illusion.
He walked again, walked again, and walked again.
Even though Ling Han had already found a solution, his progress was still slow.
However, he was determined that nothing could stop him.
Finally, he arrived in front of that streak of light.
He stretched out a hand to grab it, and a
smile appeared on his face.

chapters.title: Chapter 3905: Illusionary Black Light
paragraphs: Chapter 3905: Illusionary Black Light
Ling Han immediately began to refine the ray of light. This was very smooth, as it fused into the second Celestial Cauldron.
In this way, he should also have the ability to create illusions from this light.
Hold on, wasn’t everything going too smoothly?
Ling Han was startled, and immediately imagined himself as the Ancestral King. Then, he launched an attack. Peng, heaven and earth crumbled.

The scene in front of him changed slightly. He was still in the Black Heaven Temple, but that black light had not been refined by him at all. In fact, he was still more than thirty meters away from that light.
It was really impressive, creating such an illusion, that he almost fell for it.
If he really thought that he had broken through the illusion, he would be trapped in the illusion from before, right until the end of his lifespan.
Impressive.
A smile appeared on Ling Han’s face. The more powerful this streak of light was, the more astonishing the boost to his strength would be when he absorbed and refined this streak of light.

He continued to advance, and naturally fell into illusions time and time again. Reality and illusion intertwined endlessly. If it was not for the fact that Ling Han had an iron willpower like this, it was probably possible that he would be driven mad.
What was real, and what was fake?
Ling Han couldn’t help but ask himself, as long as he thought it was real, it was real.
He strengthened his willpower and strode forward.
Finally, he walked in front of that black light.
This time, it was real, and not an illusion.

Ling Han stretched out a hand to grab the black light, but the moment he touched it, it was as if his mind was about to explode. Countless scenes appeared, one after another. There were endless scenes of battle, and there were terrifying scenes of heaven and earth collapsing.
This amount of information was far too great, so much so that even Ling Han was unable to process it. He wanted nothing more than to grab his head.
Was this a counterattack from the celestial light?
Ling Han forcibly condensed his divine sense to refine the streak of black light. Only in this way would these images dissipate, allowing him to return to a state of peace.
This was incredibly difficult. Ling Han couldn’t even focus, so how could he refine the celestial light?
‘Come!’
He stimulated the power of living beings in the dimensions in his body to help him share the burden of these images.
In this way, the pressure was gone.

This streak of light had existed for heaven knows how many years, and had absorbed countless images of history. However, compared to the millions and millions of living beings in the dimensions inside Ling Han’s body, it had become a piece of cake.
Each person only needed to share one scene, and that was enough to deal with the problem.
Ling Han broke into a grin. Using a Celestial Cauldron, he enveloped the black light with the Celestial Cauldron, and began to refine and fuse it.

The black light counterattacked as much as it could, but it was not like the light of lightning. By itself, it possessed terrifying destructive power. Its strength lay in its illusions, but against a freak like Ling Han, there were millions and millions of living beings in the dimensions inside its body, so its advantage could not be displayed at all.
Weng, the black light was naturally unwilling to be refined. Ripples surged out, and visible to the naked eye, these ripples were formed from countless images.
“Ah!” “En!” “Wu!”

Those in the surroundings all showed expressions of pain. They had fallen into their own illusions, and were affected by the black light. Immediately, they encountered endless danger. In fact, they were severely injured, causing them to suffer immense pain.
However, right at this moment, someone actually opened her eyes.
Prosperous Heaven!

This Buddhist Race’s Holy Daughter was skilled in spiritual influence in the first place, and she was actually able to break free from the illusion on her own volition, which could be considered extremely extraordinary.
Strange, with such high talent, why had she not left her name on the leaderboard?
-With her strength, squeezing into the top hundred would definitely not be a problem.
Could it be that she was too low-key, and had concealed her own name, or had not participated in the ranking battles at all?
Prosperous Heaven stood up. There was sweat on her forehead, and her spirit was also a little haggard. Clearly, she had expended a lot of energy in the illusion.
She looked around, and a puzzled expression appeared on her face.
Because the black light had already been absorbed into Ling Han’s mind, she naturally
couldn’t see it.
She was very puzzled. Why had she suddenly entered into an illusion, and what had affected the people around her?
Ling Han didn’t move at all, pretending that he was also in an illusion. He didn’t want anyone to know that he had obtained this celestial light.
Wealth should not be revealed for nothing.
“Wu!” Another person awoke, and it was Feng Jixing.

He really couldn’t underestimate this guy. Ranked 12th on the Galaxy Network, and now he had even formed Nine Cauldrons and Nine Colored Glass Cauldron. Whether it was abilities or comprehension ability, he was shockingly powerful in both.
At first, Prosperous Heaven might have wanted to do something else, but once Feng Jixing woke up, no matter what thoughts she had, she had to put them away.
Not long after, three more people awoke at the same time, and one of them was Song Lan.
Ling Han ignored them, and continued to refine the black light. This was his main purpose for coming here.
Bit by bit, the progress was slow, but when he thought of the might of this black light, he could accept it even if it was slower.
However, it was a shame that after he refined this, it would definitely be limited by his cultivation level. The illusion created by him should have a much weaker effect on Core
Formation Tier.
However, when he advanced to the Core Formation Tier, and True Self Tier, the might of the black light would surpass the present, and in the future, it would be able to affect Sect Masters
or even Venerate Tiers.

Because the black light had been absorbed by Ling Han, the illusion would no longer continue to be created. Gradually, people broke free. There were both outsiders and natives, but there were also some people who had long since been “killed” in the illusion. Their consciousness thought that they had already died, and could not wake up again.
-Unless a great elite moved, and repaired their consciousness, but that would have to be the level of Sect Master, at least.
Thus, those who thought that they had been killed would spend the rest of their lives like this. When their bodies dried up, that would be true death.
When everyone woke up, they were all baffled. Why had they suddenly fallen into an illusion?
There had to be a reason.
They couldn’t find it.
Everyone searched around, but naturally couldn’t find a single clue, so they could only give up𝙛𝓻𝒆𝒆𝒘𝙚𝓫𝙣𝙤𝒗𝙚𝓵.𝙘𝙤𝙢
helplessly and continue forward.
In any case, Ling Han was silently making a fortune, and pretended that he was still trapped in
the illusion. Meanwhile, he happily refined the black light.
Everyone left. They couldn’t stay here forever, right?
Three days later, Ling Han finally opened his eyes.
He had successfully refined the black light, allowing him to possess a second divine light.
En, let’s come up with a name.
The first was called the divine light of lightning, and the second was called the black light of
illusion.
Ling Han was eager to give it a try. There were three Core Formation Tier elites left behind here to protect those who were still yet to awaken.
Could he affect these three Core Formation Tier cultivators?
Ling Han remained calm and collected, activating the black light of illusion in the Celestial
Cauldron in his body. After trying it out, he could split it into three, which shot towards the three Core Formation Tier cultivators.
This was different from the divine light of lightning. There was no need for him to raise his
hand to attack. Instead, with a single thought, he would attack. That was because this was on the level of divine sense, so there was no trace of it, and he could completely ignore distance.
Immediately, the three Core Formation Tier elites all looked dazed. After a while, they suddenly came back to their senses, breaking out in a cold sweat.
They entered into the illusion again.
Hiss, what the hell was going on here?
The three Core Formation Tier cultivators were all scared out of their wits. Although they had
only entered the illusion for a very short time, they had already become frightened. After
exchanging a look, they stood up at the same time.
Let’s go. This place was too dangerous.

chapters.title: Chapter 3906: Saint Technique
paragraphs: Chapter 3906: Saint Technique
Ling Han’s eyes swept over the surroundings, wanting to see if the three members of the Tong Clan were here. If they still hadn’t broken free from the illusion, he would “help” them.
Unfortunately, the luck of these three people was actually not too bad. They had all broken free from the trap of the illusion.

Sigh, now that he thought about it, these three people should have been saved by him. That was because he had refined the black light, causing the illusion to be unable to continue channelling, which allowed those with strong willpower to escape.
That was good too. Dying in the illusion would be letting them off too lightly. He had to kill them with his own hands.
There was no animosity between him and the others, so Ling Han naturally wouldn’t kill randomly. Thus, he strode forwards and continued to advance.
It wasn’t long before he caught up to the main troops.
As it turned out, in a large hall here, another figure was performing the secret technique of the Buddhist Race.
Eighteen Arhat Palm, still a Venerate Tier-level technique.

Ling Han also went to learn it. There was no burden in having too many techniques. Furthermore, Saint Techniques and Imperial Techniques were too high-level techniques for him. In a short period of time, he could only deliver one attack, and could only use it as a powerful move. For normal channelling, it was still a Venerate Tier-level Technique that was best.
Because he had come too late, after comprehending for less than half a day, someone was the first to grasp the rough outline of the precious technique.
It was Feng Jixing again.
The name of a supreme prodigy was not just for show. He had indeed displayed powerful natural talent in all aspects.
This tempted even the natives, and they wanted to betroth an unmarried woman of their clan to him, so that they could become in-laws.

-They yearned for the outside world. When the outsiders left, they would definitely leave with them. Hence, if they could form a relationship with the heir of such a supreme prodigy and heir of a great sect, it would be beneficial to their future development.
After all, in this place, they could claim to be rulers, but in the outside world, they could only be considered minor characters, and could just barely be called elites.
It was not just Feng Jixing. Some prodigies with seven or eight cauldrons had also gained favor.
Unfortunately, the local cultivators valued these prodigies, but how could these prodigies give them any consideration?
However, this was the territory of others, after all. These prodigies weren’t idiots, and wouldn’t refuse directly. Otherwise, it was still a question of whether they could leave or not.
At least, the atmosphere in this alliance was still relatively harmonious.
Gradually, more and more people grasped the Eighteen Arhat Palm, and ran outside the hall to continue comprehension, grasping the essence of it.
Ling Han spent a day’s time to finally begin comprehending this secret technique. Then, he also ran out to comprehend it outside.
This time, there was no need for him to deliberately drag things out. In any case, there was already someone ahead of him.
However, when he sat down in a cross-legged position outside, he immediately felt two pairs of eyes shoot towards him. One was Song Lan, while the other was Prosperous Heaven.
Could it be that it was because they had seen through him?
Ling Han muttered internally. F***, these two women’s instincts and observation skills were really too frightening, weren’t they?
Forget it.
Ling Han sat down in a cross-legged position, comprehending the Eighteen Arhat Palm. This was a fist technique, and when one had cultivated it to the highest level, it could unleash supreme might.
After spending two days, he finally grasped the basics of this fist technique. If he cast it now, he could probably unleash 30% of its might.
This time, he wasn’t in a hurry to stand up. Instead, he continued to sit down and comprehend the might of the fist technique. He would strive to increase its might of 30% to 40% or 50%.

Another two days later, those that should learn had more or less learnt it, and those that had not grasped it yet did not dare to enter into the great hall, because they had been entangled by that wraith too many times. If they continued any further, they would have the might of their lives.
This made a great many people extremely dissatisfied. This was a Venerate Tier-level precious technique!
However, the one who was most displeased was definitely Prosperous Heaven.
It could be said that because of her, the ultimate technique of the Buddhist Sect was
repeatedly taught to outsiders. Otherwise, if she did not go and clean out the Yin souls, even if there were people who could enter, how could she possibly stay here leisurely to
comprehend?
This was karma, the karma that she had planted, that had formed the present.
The main troops once again advanced, and after a few steps into the great hall, they discovered another precious technique.
The Fiery Sun Subduing Demon Staff Technique.
When they saw this precious technique, everyone was so excited that their scalps went numb.𝑓𝘳𝘦𝑒𝑤𝑒𝘣𝘯ℴ𝘷𝘦𝓁.𝑐𝑜𝑚
Because this was a Saint Technique!
This was a Saint Technique. Even among the Imperial Clans, Saint Techniques were also strictly regulated. Only the core disciples or clansmen were qualified to study it.
But in this place, this precious technique was laid out so boldly, that anyone could
comprehend it. Who would not be incredibly excited?
There was nothing much to say. Everyone swarmed into the hall, and began to observe.
Everyone’s eyes widened. This was a supreme opportunity.
However, what was a Saint Technique?
That was a secret technique that only Saints could truly master. Its might was boundless, and
the difficulty level of comprehension was also overwhelmingly high.
Though everyone was watching, they did not have the slightest idea.
F***, it was as if a supreme cultivation technique was clearly placed in front of them yet they gloomily discovered that they were f****** illiterate.
This was truly driving them crazy.
Ling Han also couldn’t take his eyes off it. He could see it extremely clearly. This was a real Saint Technique, and in fact, it had even surpassed the Three Styles of the God of War.
On the other side, Prosperous Heaven had no time to feel gloomy, and was also watching with full concentration.

Even in the Buddhist Race, this Saint Technique had already been lost. Furthermore, even if she was the Holy Daughter, Saint Techniques were not completely open to her, that she could learn it whenever she wanted. Thus, she was more overjoyed now, and not disappointed because the secret technique of the Buddhist Race had leaked out.
However, in a short while, the oil lamp was extinguished, and the yin soul came back.

Everyone hurriedly fled, but there were also those who were greedy for a Saint Technique, and did not move at the first instant. As a result, they became muddleheaded. To say nothing of cultivating Saint Techniques, even their life force was severely injured.
When the oil lamp lit up again, everyone once again entered into the great hall, and continued
their comprehension.
However, Saint Techniques were too difficult to master, and they would be disturbed time
and time again. How were they supposed to learn it?
Even Ling Han could only grasp a little bit more each time.
Seven days later, most people could no longer bear it. They had too much contact with Yin
souls, and had injured their life force. They could not continue, or they would only die a
sudden death.
Thus, the majority could only reluctantly give up and continue onwards, while a minority stayed behind, still determined to persevere.

Of course, Ling Han was among them. There was also Prosperous Heaven, Song Lan, Feng Jixing, as well as a few super geniuses who had formed seven or eight cauldrons. However, Ling Han didn’t know their names, because he didn’t care.
Ling Han felt that his life force had also been wounded. Thankfully, he had previously received a reward from heaven and earth, and his life force had grown to a state beyond
perfection. Thus, he was completely capable of holding on now.
He decided to persist for a while longer, because he was just a sliver away from mastering this
Saint Technique.
Another two days later, Ling Han finally succeeded.

A look of delight appeared on his face, and he immediately stood up. He arrived outside the hall, and sat down in a cross-legged position, digesting the things in his mind. Previously, he had memorized it forcefully, and memorized every change in the Saint
Technique. Now, he naturally had to digest it. Otherwise, with how strong the Saint Technique was, it would slowly fade from his memory.

That was because he had refined the black light, causing the illusion to be unable to continue channelling, which allowed those with strong willpower to escape.
That was good too.
Dying in the illusion would be letting them off too lightly.
He had to kill them with his own hands.
There was no animosity between him and the others, so Ling Han naturally wouldn’t kill randomly.
Thus, he strode forwards and continued to advance.
It wasn’t long before he caught up to the main troops.
As it turned out, in a large hall here, another figure was performing the secret technique of the Buddhist Race.
Eighteen Arhat Palm, still a Venerate Tier-level technique.
Ling Han also went to learn it.
There was no burden in having too many techniques.
Furthermore, Saint Techniques and Imperial Techniques were too high-level techniques for him.
In a short period of time, he could only deliver one attack, and could only use it as a powerful move.
For normal channelling, it was still a Venerate Tier-level Technique that was best.
Because he had come too late, after comprehending for less than half a day, someone was the first to grasp the rough outline of the precious technique.
It was Feng Jixing again.
The name of a supreme prodigy was not just for show.
He had indeed displayed powerful natural talent in all aspects.
This tempted even the natives, and they wanted to betroth an unmarried woman of their clan to him, so that they could become in-laws.
-They yearned for the outside world.
When the outsiders left, they would definitely leave with them.
Hence, if they could form a relationship with the heir of such a supreme prodigy and heir of a great sect, it would be beneficial to their future development.
After all, in this place, they could claim to be rulers, but in the outside world, they could only be considered minor characters, and could just barely be called elites.
It was not just Feng Jixing.
Some prodigies with seven or eight cauldrons had also gained favor.
Unfortunately, the local cultivators valued these prodigies, but how could these prodigies give them any consideration?
However, this was the territory of others, after all.
These prodigies weren’t idiots, and wouldn’t refuse directly.
Otherwise, it was still a question of whether they could leave or not.
At least, the atmosphere in this alliance was still relatively harmonious.
Gradually, more and more people grasped the Eighteen Arhat Palm, and ran outside the hall to continue comprehension, grasping the essence of it.
Ling Han spent a day’s time to finally begin comprehending this secret technique.
Then, he also ran out to comprehend it outside.
This time, there was no need for him to deliberately drag things out.
In any case, there was already someone ahead of him.
However, when he sat down in a cross-legged position outside, he immediately felt two pairs of eyes shoot towards him.
One was Song Lan, while the other was Prosperous Heaven.
Could it be that it was because they had seen through him?
Ling Han muttered internally.
F***, these two women’s instincts and observation skills were really too frightening, weren’t they?
Forget it.
Ling Han sat down in a cross-legged position, comprehending the Eighteen Arhat Palm.
This was a fist technique, and when one had cultivated it to the highest level, it could unleash supreme might.
After spending two days, he finally grasped the basics of this fist technique.
If he cast it now, he could probably unleash 30% of its might.
This time, he wasn’t in a hurry to stand up.
Instead, he continued to sit down and comprehend the might of the fist technique.
He would strive to increase its might of 30% to 40% or 50%.

Another two days later, those that should learn had more or less learnt it, and those that had not grasped it yet did not dare to enter into the great hall, because they had been entangled by that wraith too many times.
If they continued any further, they would have the might of their lives.
This made a great many people extremely dissatisfied.
This was a Venerate Tier-level precious technique!
However, the one who was most displeased was definitely Prosperous Heaven.
It could be said that because of her, the ultimate technique of the Buddhist Sect was
repeatedly taught to outsiders.
Otherwise, if she did not go and clean out the Yin souls, even if there were people who could enter, how could she possibly stay here leisurely to
comprehend?
This was karma, the karma that she had planted, that had formed the present.
The main troops once again advanced, and after a few steps into the great hall, they discovered another precious technique.
The Fiery Sun Subduing Demon Staff Technique.
When they saw this precious technique, everyone was so excited that their scalps went numb.𝑓𝘳𝘦𝑒𝑤𝑒𝘣𝘯ℴ𝘷𝘦𝓁.𝑐𝑜𝑚
Because this was a Saint Technique!
This was a Saint Technique.
Even among the Imperial Clans, Saint Techniques were also strictly regulated.
Only the core disciples or clansmen were qualified to study it.
But in this place, this precious technique was laid out so boldly, that anyone could
comprehend it.
Who would not be incredibly excited?
There was nothing much to say.
Everyone swarmed into the hall, and began to observe.
Everyone’s eyes widened.
This was a supreme opportunity.
However, what was a Saint Technique?
That was a secret technique that only Saints could truly master.
Its might was boundless, and
the difficulty level of comprehension was also overwhelmingly high.
Though everyone was watching, they did not have the slightest idea.
F***, it was as if a supreme cultivation technique was clearly placed in front of them yet they gloomily discovered that they were f****** illiterate.
This was truly driving them crazy.
Ling Han also couldn’t take his eyes off it.
He could see it extremely clearly.
This was a real Saint Technique, and in fact, it had even surpassed the Three Styles of the God of War.
On the other side, Prosperous Heaven had no time to feel gloomy, and was also watching with full concentration.
Even in the Buddhist Race, this Saint Technique had already been lost.
Furthermore, even if she was the Holy Daughter, Saint Techniques were not completely open to her, that she could learn it whenever she wanted.
Thus, she was more overjoyed now, and not disappointed because the secret technique of the Buddhist Race had leaked out.
However, in a short while, the oil lamp was extinguished, and the yin soul came back.
Everyone hurriedly fled, but there were also those who were greedy for a Saint Technique, and did not move at the first instant.
As a result, they became muddleheaded.
To say nothing of cultivating Saint Techniques, even their life force was severely injured.
When the oil lamp lit up again, everyone once again entered into the great hall, and continued
their comprehension.
However, Saint Techniques were too difficult to master, and they would be disturbed time
and time again.
How were they supposed to learn it?
Even Ling Han could only grasp a little bit more each time.
Seven days later, most people could no longer bear it.
They had too much contact with Yin
souls, and had injured their life force.
They could not continue, or they would only die a
sudden death.
Thus, the majority could only reluctantly give up and continue onwards, while a minority stayed behind, still determined to persevere.
Of course, Ling Han was among them.
There was also Prosperous Heaven, Song Lan, Feng Jixing, as well as a few super geniuses who had formed seven or eight cauldrons.
However, Ling Han didn’t know their names, because he didn’t care.
Ling Han felt that his life force had also been wounded.
Thankfully, he had previously received a reward from heaven and earth, and his life force had grown to a state beyond
perfection.
Thus, he was completely capable of holding on now.
He decided to persist for a while longer, because he was just a sliver away from mastering this
Saint Technique.
Another two days later, Ling Han finally succeeded.
A look of delight appeared on his face, and he immediately stood up.
He arrived outside the hall, and sat down in a cross-legged position, digesting the things in his mind.
Previously, he had memorized it forcefully, and memorized every change in the Saint
Technique.
Now, he naturally had to digest it.
Otherwise, with how strong the Saint Technique was, it would slowly fade from his memory.

chapters.title: Chapter 3907: Interrupted
paragraphs: Chapter 3907: Interrupted
Not long after, Prosperous Heaven and the others all ran out of the great hall.
Obviously, the oil lamp had once again been extinguished.
Seeing Ling Han sitting cross-legged outside by himself, as if he was comprehending something, quite a number of people smirked coldly.
All those present were supreme prodigies, but which one of them had memorized the Saint Technique?
What are you acting for?

Only Prosperous Heaven and Song Lan were moved, and looked meaningfully at Ling Han. With the delicateness that was unique to women, added with their outstanding observation skills, they had previously captured that Ling Han had clearly come extremely late, yet very quickly completed his memorization of the Eighteen Arhat Palm, and began to comprehend it outside.
Calculating the time, it was even much shorter than Feng Jixing.
And now, Ling Han was the first to walk out.
This guy had mastered a Saint Technique first again?
“Stop pretending!” a young man said in disdain. He was a Seven Cauldrons elite, and ranked 67th on the Galaxy Network. His name was Mo Yuanwu.
Ling Han only acted as if he had not heard anything. He was presently at an important juncture in his comprehension.

“Brat, you are very awesome, aren’t you? You actually dare to look down on everyone!” Mo Yuanwu strode towards Ling Han. This person was unknown, but now, he actually dared to put on an act in front of him. Where did he get such courage from?
‘Are you really comprehending? Stop pretending. Even Feng Jixing hasn’t grasped the basics yet, so you’re nothing.’
He walked over, and delivered a palm strike at Ling Han.
This palm wasn’t heavy, because he hadn’t unleashed his killing intent yet.
Boom!
Someone rushed out and exchanged a blow with Mo Yuanwu.
Yi?
When they saw this person’s appearance clearly, everyone was shocked, because this was actually Song Lan, the beauty ranked ninth on the Exquisite Leaderboard.
She actually moved for Ling Han’s sake?
Feng Jixing saw this, and couldn’t help but narrow his eyes slightly.

As the top elite of the Cauldron Forging Tier in the North Heavenly Realm, he was naturally proud and reserved. Thus, even though he was obviously very interested in Song Lan, he didn’t show it—although the appearance and bearing of Prosperous Heaven wasn’t inferior, she was still a Buddhist Race Holy Daughter, after all. It was too difficult to deal with her. Thus, he would definitely be more willing to become closer to Song Lan.
But though Song Lan was very polite towards him, and showed her admiration for him, that was all.
And now, Song Lan actually moved for the sake of a man. This surprised Feng Jixing, and even caused a kind of jealousy to rise up in him.
His woman should only have him in her heart, and could not accommodate another man.
“Fairy Song!” Mo Yuanwu was extremely surprised, “Why do you-”
Without waiting for him to finish, Song Lan said, “This brother is presently at a crucial moment in his comprehension, so it would be best not to disturb him.”

Mo Yuanwu was both shocked and jealous. Who did not like beautiful women, especially an exquisitely beautiful woman like Song Lan? Yet now, Song Lan was actually so protective of Ling Han, which made him extremely displeased.

He was young and rash, and said, “Celestial maiden Song, don’t be deceived by him. Even Brother Feng has not been able to comprehend the Saint Technique, so what right does this brat have to learn it? Thus, he is only putting on an act here.”
Hearing him mention himself, Feng Jixing felt slightly uncomfortable.
What kind of existence was he? Who was qualified to compare to him?
Furthermore, this was not comparing his merits, but rather that he had not grasped the Saint Technique either. This naturally made him even more displeased.
Song Lan shook her head, “He has not trifled with you either, so what need is there for you to be so forceful?”

Mo Yuanwu smiled awkwardly, “Since Fairy Song is interceding on his behalf, then forget it.” They waited, and when the oil lamp in the great hall was once again lit, they all entered into the great hall, and continued to study the Saint Technique.
However, Mo Yuanwu deliberately lagged a few steps behind. When everyone had entered into the great hall, he stopped, then turned around and walked towards Ling Han.
He wouldn’t let Ling Han go so easily.
From beginning to end, this guy did not make a sound. He was acting all high and mighty. “Brat, there’s no one else here, so there’s no need to pretend anymore,” Mo Yuanwu said coldly.
Ling Han ignored him. He was already gradually entering his prime condition.
“All right, let you pretend!” Mo Yuanwu moved, and grabbed out at Ling Han. This time, there was no one to stop him.
However, the palm strike missed its target.
Yi?

Mo Yuanwu was startled. Previously, when the palm strike was about to hit him, Ling Han suddenly stretched out a hand and gave a shove on the ground. His figure moved a bit, just managing to dodge his palm strike.
F*** you.
As expected, this was not comprehension at all. He was clearly paying full attention to him. “Good one, brat, how despicable!” Mo Yuanwu continued to attack, launching an offensive towards Ling Han.
But every time the power of his palm strike or fist was about to reach him, Ling Han would always manage to dodge just right, causing Mo Yuanwu’s fury to burn hotter and hotter.
‘Can’t I deal with you?’

He no longer delivered such a precise attack, but rather expanded the area of his attack. He shot out a strike, and the force condensed, turning into a massive green fist, that was even larger than a house, that bore down on Ling Han.
This way… let’s see how you’re going to dodge.

The larger the attack surface, the weaker the power would definitely be. That was because the power was dispersed, and this was very easy to understand. Thus, the more elite one was, the more he would not use this kind of method of attack. They would similarly be able to defeat their opponents, but this naturally was a waste of power.
However, at present, Mo Yuanwu only wanted Ling Han to parry, and break through the latter’s calm and unhurried show-off demeanor.
Thus, he didn’t care if he would waste power or not, nor did he mind if he could hurt Ling Han.
Boom, a fist smashed over, covering the skies.
Ling Han sighed. He really didn’t want to stop comprehending.
He stood up. ‘Since you are so determined to seek a beating, I will oblige you.’
Peng! He threw a punch, and it collided with the green-colored fist. Although the size of the
two was far inferior, the massive green-colored fist immediately crumbled when the punch landed. It was completely unable to withstand a single blow.
“Haha, you finally stopped pretending!” Yet Mo Yuanwu felt that this was a great victory for
him.
See, you still can’t continue the pretence.
“Pretending your sister!” Ling Han said angrily. His comprehension had been forcefully interrupted, so it could be imagined how terrible his mood was.
Are you f****** crazy? What has my comprehension here got to do with you? Disturbing me once is not enough, and now that you are being stopped, you want to do it again?
He was really asking for a beating.
“Heng, how dare you, to actually dare to speak rudely to me!” Mo Yuanwu also showed a hint
of anger.
Just now, he hadn’t used his full power, and it was also a large-scale attack. Thus, though Ling Han had easily broken through his punch, he still didn’t take Ling Han seriously.
Xiu, Ling Han rushed over.
“Haha, you’re courting-” Mo Yuanwu laughed loudly. However, he had not even said the word ‘death’, when he was knocked over with a single punch from Ling Han.
How could it be so fast?
At this moment, he was completely stupefied.
He was an elite of Seven Cauldrons, a prodigy ranked 67th on Galaxy Network. Why had he𝚏𝗿𝗲𝐞𝐰𝚎𝕓𝐧𝚘𝘃𝗲𝐥.𝐜𝚘𝕞
been defeated just like that without even seeing his opponent’s fist?
He wanted to counterattack with all his might, but peng, peng, peng, a series of punches had already shot over, causing him to scream in pain, and he was completely unable to
counterattack.
Every punch shattered the mystical power that he had just accumulated, so how was he
supposed to counter?
“Ah-” He could only scream in pain. After several hundred punches, he finally passed out
from the pain.
