chapters.title: Chapter 3908: Emperor among Celestial Cauldrons
paragraphs: Chapter 3908: Emperor among Celestial Cauldrons
If Ling Han wanted to kill him, one punch was enough.
However, he was so angry now, so how could he vent his anger with a single punch?
Thus, he controlled his power, and only knocked out Mo Yuanwu after throwing several hundred punches.
Clapping his hands, Ling Han sat down again and continued to comprehend.
After a short while, Feng Jixing and the others were seen fleeing out of the great hall, battered
and exhausted. Every single one of them had a dark green palm print left behind on them, which was extremely harrowing.
However, the moment these people came out, they saw Mo Yuanwu who was lying on the ground.
Yi, what was going on?

After entering into the great hall, they were all focused on grasping the Saint Technique, and did not pay any attention to others at all. Thus, they did not realize that Mo Yuanwu had actually not entered.
Right until this moment.
Obviously, Mo Yuanwu was still not willing to give up, and wanted to make trouble with Ling Han, but the result was that he was thrashed, and now he was like a dead dog.
Hiss, Mo Yuanwu was a prodigy ranked 67th in Galaxy Network. Being able to defeat him in such a short amount of time, Ling Han’s strength had to be in the top fifty, at least.
However, everyone was certain that there was not a single person in the top fifty of the Galaxy Network that could match Ling Han’s description.

However, so what if he was in the top fifty? There was no shortage of prodigies among prodigies here. For example, Feng Jixing even had the ability to charge into the top ten, so there was naturally no need for him to take the top fifty seriously.
“Hehe, so you are also an elite.” Another young man walked out. His name was He Yikuan, ranked 39th on the Galaxy Network, Eight Cauldrons.
Ling Han pondered for a moment before finally standing up.
By the looks of it, defeating one person still wasn’t convincing enough.
Fine, then he would fight to his heart’s content, to avoid people coming to harrass him every time.
“Someone’s asking for a beating again,” he said calmly.

He Yikuan was disdainful, and said, “My name is He Yikuan. Ranked 39th in the Galaxy Network that’s right, now that my Celestial Cauldron has evolved in quality, I can probably break into the top 30.”
He was very proud. The top thirty in the entire universe, even the Holy Lands would fight over them.

Ling Han crooked a finger at him, and said, “Come, see how your grandpa will beat you up.’ ,” He Yikuan’s expression changed involuntarily. Why did this guy have no character at all, to actually take advantage of others like this?
Was this interesting?
He humphed, “To speak so rudely, you would only be asking for your own suffering!”
“Your uncle will always be your uncle.” Ling Han charged over, and shot out a punch. It was the Eighteen Arhat Palm.

He Yikuan couldn’t help but pale. It wasn’t that he hadn’t learnt this secret technique before, and he had already learnt its basics. However, he knew himself well. Compared to Ling Han, his accomplishments in the Eighteen Arhat Palm were far inferior.
He had never imagined that the other party was actually even more prodigious and freakish than him.
It couldn’t be that he had met his match, right?
He thought, but he naturally could not admit defeat just like that. Immediately, he began his counterattack.

Ling Han didn’t unleash his full power, and he simply used him as a sparring partner to test out the might of the Eighteen Arhat Palm. After the eighteen punches were delivered, he used the Great Sun Soaring Palm again, continuing to bombard He Yikuan with attacks.
The others were all watching, their expressions gradually becoming solemn.
Ling Han’s mastery of the two precious techniques had already reached a considerably high level, and he had more or less unleashed 50% of their might.
And as for them?
Most people were 30%, and had just mastered the basics. Fewer prodigies could reach 40%, such as Feng Jixing, Song Lan, and so on, but 50%… was one of a kind.
Thus, how could they not be stunned?
This kind of prodigy was actually unknown, and this was something that they could not accept.
“Could he be a descendant of an Imperial Clan?” someone mumbled.
“Indeed. I’ve heard people say that prodigies from Imperial Clans won’t even participate in ranking battles. In fact, many people don’t even have a Galaxy Network account.”
“It is said that the stronger the force, the more low-key they would be.”
“Could it be that this guy is such a low-key prodigy?”
Everyone looked at each other, and shook their heads.
Just based on what Ling Han had said just now, this guy had nothing to do with keeping a low profile.

Meanwhile, Song Lan cast a second look at Ling Han. She felt that this kind of tone was very familiar to her. Someone was also in need of such a beating, that it would make one gnash their teeth in irritation.
However, the appearances of these two people were very different. More importantly, the soul fluctuations were completely different. This was definitely not the same person.
However, everyone’s expressions quickly changed again.
That was because Ling Han’s accomplishments in the Eighteen Arhat Palm and Great Sun Soaring Palm were rapidly improving, and the might he delivered was becoming greater and
greater.
Everyone thought. Now, it had reached 60%.
Monster, this was too freakish.
It had only been a short while, and he had already increased the might of his precious technique by 10% through actual battle. Was there really such a terrifying prodigy?

If it was not for the fact that they had all obtained the precious technique here, they would have suspected that Ling Han had long since learnt these two secret techniques, and had deliberately done it for them to see.
And as Ling Han’s grasp of the two precious techniques became deeper and deeper, and their might became greater and greater, He Yikuan gradually could no longer bear it.
He wanted to retreat, but how could Ling Han allow him to retreat unscathed just like that? He attacked repeatedly, not giving him the chance to retreat from the battle at all.
He Yikuan was both furious and shocked. The height of his talent could be considered one of the highest in the entire universe, but now, he was being beaten down on. How could he
endure this?

Moreover, he was the one who had provoked Ling Han on his own volition. Thus, it could be said that he was asking for a beating. This naturally made him feel even more humiliated. He was not willing to be defeated so horribly. With a loud roar, he summoned his Celestial
Cauldron.
He had obtained great fortune in the Mystery Realm, and used divine substance to improve the quality of the Celestial Cauldron, and cultivated it to become the Triple Flower Cauldron.

The high-level Celestial Cauldronhad a suppressive effect on the low-level Celestial Cauldron. Thus, in a situation when his battle prowess was inferior to Ling Han, he could only place his hopes on the quality of the Celestial Cauldron.

The quality of the Triple Flower Cauldron was even higher than the Triple Colored Glass
Cauldron.
Weng, Ling Han instantly felt a pressure assault him, wanting him to submit.
What a joke. He had not even used the Celestial Cauldron to suppress others, and they turned around to use their Celestial Cauldron to make him submit?

instantly exploded in unison.

What was going on here?
They had not even finished this thought, when they immediately felt that their Celestial
Cauldron was actually trembling.
That was an instinctive fear, as well as a reverence that came from worshipping an emperor.
How was this possible?

And the person who had released this kind of fluctuation… was Ling Han!

If Ling Han wanted to kill him, one punch was enough.
However, he was so angry now, so how could he vent his anger with a single punch?
Thus, he controlled his power, and only knocked out Mo Yuanwu after throwing several hundred punches.
Clapping his hands, Ling Han sat down again and continued to comprehend.
After a short while, Feng Jixing and the others were seen fleeing out of the great hall, battered
and exhausted.
Every single one of them had a dark green palm print left behind on them, which was extremely harrowing.
However, the moment these people came out, they saw Mo Yuanwu who was lying on the ground.
Yi, what was going on?
After entering into the great hall, they were all focused on grasping the Saint Technique, and did not pay any attention to others at all.
Thus, they did not realize that Mo Yuanwu had actually not entered.
Right until this moment.
Obviously, Mo Yuanwu was still not willing to give up, and wanted to make trouble with Ling Han, but the result was that he was thrashed, and now he was like a dead dog.
Hiss, Mo Yuanwu was a prodigy ranked 67th in Galaxy Network.
Being able to defeat him in such a short amount of time, Ling Han’s strength had to be in the top fifty, at least.
However, everyone was certain that there was not a single person in the top fifty of the Galaxy Network that could match Ling Han’s description.
However, so what if he was in the top fifty?
There was no shortage of prodigies among prodigies here.
For example, Feng Jixing even had the ability to charge into the top ten, so there was naturally no need for him to take the top fifty seriously.
“Hehe, so you are also an elite.” Another young man walked out.
His name was He Yikuan, ranked 39th on the Galaxy Network, Eight Cauldrons.
Ling Han pondered for a moment before finally standing up.
By the looks of it, defeating one person still wasn’t convincing enough.
Fine, then he would fight to his heart’s content, to avoid people coming to harrass him every time.
“Someone’s asking for a beating again,” he said calmly.
He Yikuan was disdainful, and said, “My name is He Yikuan.

Was this interesting?

Compared to Ling Han, his accomplishments in the Eighteen Arhat Palm were far inferior.

Monster, this was too freakish.

chapters.title: Chapter 3909: Battling Feng Jixing
paragraphs: Chapter 3909: Battling Feng Jixing
He Yikuan was both furious and shocked. He hurriedly put the Celestial Cauldron away.

He wanted to cry but had no tears. He had just taken out the Celestial Cauldron and waved it around, and it actually caused his Celestial Flower to suffer a huge blow. The Celestial Flowers withered, and its quality declined drastically.
Even if he had obtained the divine substance, could he still repair the Celestial Cauldron?
It would be difficult!

He looked at Ling Han in shock. The latter’s Celestial Cauldron had not even been summoned, and he had already severely wounded his own Celestial Cauldron, causing its grade to drop. Just what kind of Celestial Cauldron had this guy cultivated?
It was not just him. The eyes of the others were also focused on Ling Han, filled with curiosity, as well as… killing intent.

This kind of suppression was too terrifying. It did not care about one’s cultivation level at all, nor did it care about one’s natural talent. It was completely unreasonable suppression. Who could accept that?
Thus, a great many people were filled with killing intent, wanting to kill Ling Han.
Peng!
Ling Han knocked He Yikuan to the ground with a single punch. He looked at everyone proudly, “Anyone else wants to call me grandpa?”
Everyone’s expressions were ugly. Why was this guy so detestable?
“How arrogant!” Feng Jixing finally stepped out. He stood with his hands clasped behind his back, looking at Ling Han with a disdainful smile, “Tell me your name!”
“Huh? Who do you think you are?” Ling Han didn’t give him any face at all. “Are you stupid? Do you think that you’re the emperor of martial arts, and everyone has to listen to you?”
Feng Jixing was not angered either, and said calmly, “I am Feng Jixing. At present, I am ranked 12th in the Galaxy Network, so how could it be that I am not qualified to ask for your name?”
“Hehe, only 12th? I thought you were 1st!” Ling Han shook his head, and said, “Alright, I’ll give you a chance. When you reach first place, you can ask me who I am.”
“Haha!” Feng Jixing sneered, “You really have an exaggerated opinion of your own abilities, and need to be disciplined!”

Ling Han’s fighting spirit blazed as well. This was the prodigy ranked 12th on the Galaxy Network. In fact, he had even formed Nine Cauldrons, and the quality of his Celestial Cauldron caused even divine substances to lose their effects. His true battle prowess was probably already in the top ten.
Just how powerful could he be?
“Come!” Ling Han crooked a finger at him.
“Can you block ten of my attacks?” Feng Jixing said casually. He casually sent out a palm strike, but it was wildly exaggerated, and strange phenomena appeared one after another.
This kind of prodigy’s casual attack was already so terrifying, as if he had not used an ultimate technique.
In truth, Feng Jixing was not as casual as he looked.

This attack was a deadly move that had been carefully prepared, because he was extremely wary of Ling Han’s Celestial Cauldron. He definitely could not allow Ling Han to develop any kind of influence. Otherwise, it was possible that he would not be able to restrain him.

For this kind of prodigy, he accepted challenges. No matter how high the difficulty level was, he had nothing to fear. However, he was already being suppressed before the battle had even begun. This feeling of being completely out of control was really too bad.
Coupled with the fact that Song Lan had actually made a move for Ling Han previously, this was even more intolerable to him.
With these two factors added together, killing intent rose up in his heart.
Ling Han stepped forward. Boom! The two of them exchanged a blow, and a terrifying power surged, turning into a monstrous wave.
A colossal power surged over, and Ling Han involuntarily retreated. He felt his chest burn, and even his arms were shaking.

Nine Cauldrons was really too strong, especially for a prodigy like Feng Jixing, who had cultivated a Nine Coloured Glass Cauldron and tempered mystical power to an incredibly pure level. A Nine Cauldrons like him was definitely comparable to eleven cauldrons of a fierce beast of course, eleven cauldrons did not exist, but they could be used as an analogy.
“Nothing more than this,” Feng Jixing said disdainfully. With a flip of his palms, he once again charged over.
What was there to be proud of?
Ling Han activated the Celestial Cauldron, releasing a paramount aura.
-Since he had already used it once, and exposed the might of the Celestial Cauldron, he might as well continue using it.

Previously, after the Celestial Cauldron had trembled, it had already calmed down. Now, it was trembling again. An indescribable pressure swept out, enshrouding in all directions. Feng Jixing’s expression changed drastically. He discovered that his cultivation level was rapidly declining.
Even if he was already prepared, he was actually still unable to resist?
“What’s so awesome about it!” Ling Han raised both fists to parry.
Peng!
The two of them clashed head-on again. This time, Ling Han wasn’t at a disadvantage, and he was evenly matched with Feng Jixing.
When everyone saw this, they could not believe their eyes.
Feng Jixing, whose strength could be ranked in the top ten of Galaxy Network, was actually unable to suppress Ling Han and could only fight to a tie?
The Celestial Cauldron that this guy had formed was too freakish, wasn’t it?
It was unknown how many cauldrons this guy had. It would be fine if it was nine cauldrons, as there was already no possibility of advancing further, but what if it was only eight cauldrons?
Then when Ling Han advanced into Nine Cauldrons, wouldn’t he be able to sweep aside all Cauldron Forging Tiers?
Ling Han and Feng Jixing battled fiercely. At present, their power was equal, so what they were competing in was technique and battle experience.
Hong! Hong! Hong!

Feng Jixing was able to rank 12th on the Galaxy Network, so he must have experienced countless battles and was extremely experienced. Furthermore, he also came from a Holy Land, and had grasped a great many high-level secret techniques, his methods endless. Without using his ultimate move, Ling Han was completely unable to gain the upper hand. Of course, there was a gap of two cauldrons between his cultivation level and Ling Han’s. Yet, Ling Han was still able to fight him to a tie. This was a clear sign of just how freakish Ling Han
was.
Seeing the two of them exchange blows, everyone was speechless.

Without a doubt, Ling Han’s strength was definitely in the top ten of Galaxy Network. Of course, there was no such thing as the coercive might of the Celestial Cauldron on the Galaxy Network, so if they really battled on the Galaxy Network, Ling Han would definitely be no
match for Feng Jixing.

Indeed, there were situations where the Galaxy Network’s ranking did not match the real battle prowess, but that was basically within ten ranks. This difference of two cauldrons actually resulted in a tie. If this was told to anyone else, there was definitely no one who
would believe it.
“Guys, we’re currently in the Mystery Realm, so it’s best that we work together,” Song Lan said, stepping forward to mediate the battle.

“Harmony is precious,” Prosperous Heaven said as she recited a Buddhist proclamation. Feng Jixing humphed. He naturally still had powerful moves that he had not used, such as Saint Techniques. As the number one prodigy of the North Heavenly Realm, he was naturally also the most important disciple of the Holy Land, and had been taught Saint Techniques.
At his present cultivation level, the might of a Saint Technique would not be much weaker than an Imperial Technique.
He withdrew from the battle. He still had to give face to Song Lan and Prosperous Heaven.
Ling Han didn’t persist, either. Both sides had powerful moves to unleash, and it was possible that both sides would be severely wounded.

However, the battle with Feng Jixing made him understand that Nine Cauldrons was still not enough to match the early stage of the Core Formation Tier- he had only been sent backwards by Feng Jixing, and not injured. The gap was still quite wide.
“For the sake of Fairy Song and Holy Daughter Prosperous Heaven, I will spare your life.”
Feng Jixing said a line that fit the situation, so he naturally had to announce that in truth, he had always had the initiative.
Ling Han couldn’t be bothered to waste his breath on him. The people here weren’t blind, so
how could they not see the truth?
The commotion temporarily subsided, and everyone continued to enter and exit the great hall, trying as much as possible to memorize that Saint Technique.
However, in the end, only four people succeeded.
Aside from Ling Han, they were Feng Jixing, Prosperous Heaven, and Song Lan respectively.
The others did not enter into the great hall again.
In a short period of time, they had already entered and exited the great hall too many times. If this continued, it would probably be ominous.

chapters.title: Chapter 3910: Karmic Flames
paragraphs: Chapter 3910: Karmic Flames
The others continued to advance, but Ling Han and the others were still sitting in cross- legged positions, comprehendin the Saint Technique.
In the blink of an eye, three days had passed.

Ling Han stood up. He had already truly grasped a Saint Technique, but now, he could only unleash 10% of its might at most. Next, it would be hard cultivation and enlightenment. How much might a Saint Technique could truly unleash would depend on one’s luck.
Sometimes, Saint Techniques and Imperial Techniques still had problems of affinity, and it was not something that could be done just by talent alone.
He did not stop, and strode off.
Feng Jixing opened his eyes and stared at Ling Han’s back, his killing intent flickering.
If it was not for the fact that he did not have the confidence to kill Ling Han, he would definitely make a move.

He had a powerful trump card that could threaten Core Formation Tier, but with how freakish Ling Han was, he believed that the latter would also have a trump card that was not weak. Thus, unless he himself could crush Ling Han, he had no wish to use up his trump card, just like that.
It was fine. When he broke through again and advanced into the Core Formation Tier, he would be able to kill Ling Han with a single hand.
Ling Han caught up with the main force. This time, they weren’t cultivating a precious technique in some great hall, but rather surrounded a massive willow tree.

This willow tree was three hundred meters tall, but its leaves were as black as ink. Its branches drooped, and black Qi diffused, causing the whole willow tree to seem to be exuding a black light, which was incredibly bizarre.
Black Divine Willow!

This was the rare treasure that the Core Formation Tier elites had entered this space to fight over. In truth, it could extend one’s lifespan by a hundred years, and even in the outside world, it could be considered a precious treasure.
-To a person whose lifespan had dried up, to say nothing of a hundred years, even a year or half a year was incredibly precious.

Thus, even if these Core Formation Tier elites decided to leave, they would still snatch the Divine Tree Heart. That way, after a few thousand years, their lifespans would dry up, and this could extend their lifespans by a hundred years.

Of course, now that they were fighting over the Divine Tree Heart, there was not as much urgency as before. It was best if they could snatch it, and even if they couldn’t, there was no need for them to put their lives on the line.
However, there was a corpse beneath the Black Divine Willow, and this caused everyone to not dare approach.

It was unknown how much time had passed, but the clothes on the corpse had long since turned into dust, and only the skeleton was left behind. But even so, it still exuded a terrifying aura, that others would not be able to approach at all.

It wasn’t long before they invited Prosperous Heaven over. It was clear that Prosperous Heaven had a displeased expression on her face. After all, she was presently comprehending a Saint Technique. No one would be happy if they were interrupted at this moment.
However, after Prosperous Heaven looked at this corpse, the displeasure on her face immediately disappeared.

She nodded, “When this person was alive, he was a Venerate Tier elite. Even if he has been dead for millions and millions of years, his powerful aura still did not disperse. Though I can expiate his soul, I would need everyone’s full help.”
“We are willing to lend a helping hand to Holy Daughter,” all the Core Formation Tiers said.
Prosperous Heaven did not take out that wooden fish, but rather a tribute table. There was a small incense burner placed on it, and a stick of incense was inserted.
There was only a quarter of the joss stick left, exuding an incredibly ancient aura. She was extremely careful, as if that was a supreme precious treasure.
This time, it wasn’t ten Core Formation Tiers, but rather all the Core Formation Tiers that were contributing Core Formation Tier towards this tribute table.

What was surprising was that after sustaining the power of so many Core Formation Tier cultivators, the tribute table did not change at all. Instead, it was that incense stick that suddenly lit up, and then began to burn. Immediately, a refreshing fragrance wafted out.

“This is the Buddhist intent of all beings of the Buddhist Race.” Someone who knew what was what, said from the sidelines, “The Buddhist fragrance condensed from Spiritual Power has an astonishing effect in expiating the dead souls.”
“Spiritual Power actually turned into incense?”
“Hehe, this is the power of the Buddhist Race. Furthermore, this is not simply Spiritual
Power. It needs an incredibly sincere belief.”
The Buddhist Race had existed for countless years, so they would naturally be studied by others. Many of their techniques weren’t secrets.

Prosperous Heaven stimulated the Buddhist fragrance, which floated towards that corpse. When the Buddhist fragrance touched the corpse, it was instantly visible that this corpse was actually burning fiercely.
Fear appeared on the faces of all those Core Formation Tiers. They felt that they would definitely die if they were touched by such flames.
“Supreme Karmic Flames!” Another person recognized the origins of these flames.
“One of the strongest killing moves of the Buddhist Race.”

“Us cultivators have fought with the heavens and others all our lives, so it’s inevitable that we’ll commit murder and become criminals. Buddhist Race cultivators have methods to attract the judgment of heaven and earth, burning their sins to form karmic flames.”
“This cannot be snuffed out, nor can it be extinguished. Only when the karma is completely ignited, will the karmic flames stop.”
Even Ling Han was astonished. The Buddhist Race actually had the means to burn their sins? This was truly astonishing.
The path of cultivation for cultivators was the heaven-defying path. The higher one’s cultivation level, the deeper one’s crime would be. Who could withstand this kind of burning?

No, as long as one’s abilities were strong enough, he would be able to suppress his own sins, and there was no way that he would be burnt. Otherwise, there wouldn’t have been need for so many Core Formation Tier cultivators helping Prosperous Heaven, and there wouldn’t have been so much foreplay. There would have been need to use the incense from the power of belief of all living beings. That should have been the key to igniting the flames of karma.

The corpse burned fiercely. At this time, there was no need for Prosperous Heaven to do anything else. She hurriedly extinguished the lingering incense, and carefully stored it away. This burning lasted for three days and three nights. When the karmic flames were extinguished, that corpse had completely turned into ash.
The strange thing was that the willow tree it was leaning against was completely unaffected. There was not a single trace of burn.
“The Karmic Flames will only burn oneself. Others have no karma with you, so how could they be affected?” someone explained.
However, after the corpse disappeared, a hole actually appeared in the place that it had
initially concealed!
Everyone exchanged looks. What was going on here?
There was an excited expression on Prosperous Heaven’s face. She was the first to walk out,
and wormed into the tree hollow.
Even a Cauldron Forging Tier woman dared to pass, so how could the others have the nerve to
show weakness?𝚏𝕣𝕖𝚎𝚠𝚎𝚋𝚗𝐨𝐯𝕖𝕝.𝕔𝐨𝕞

All the Core Formation Tiers followed her into the cave, and there seemed to be an endless space inside. One after another, they walked in, and actually did not say that it was too crowded, and those behind them could not enter.

After waiting for a while, almost everyone outside had entered into the tree hollow. Only then did Ling Han follow them. He was now filled with both confusion and innumerable curiosity. Logically speaking, he had already obtained the celestial light here, so he should have left by now. However, with how curious he was, he still wanted to continue, and get to the bottom of this matter.

chapters.title: Chapter 3911: Deaths of Saints
paragraphs: Chapter 3911: Deaths of Saints
Ling Han followed him into the tree hollow.
All around them, it was pitch-black, and even his fingers could not be seen.

This wasn’t darkness in terms of vision, but also darkness for the divine sense. It was useless even if he released his divine sense. He couldn’t see or sense anything. It was as if he were an ordinary blind person.

Thankfully, this hole was not big, and one could touch the walls on either side with just a stretch of his hand. The ceiling above his head was not high either, and he would have to walk with his waist bent. Thus, as long as he touched the walls on either side, he would have a rough idea of his surroundings.
After walking for a while, light gradually appeared ahead of them.
He walked further, and saw that he had appeared in a basement.
This basement was very big, and it was not the end either. There was still a path ahead of them. However, a great many people had now stopped here.
That was because there were Yin souls here, but there were very few of them, and they floated there.

Some Core Formation Tier cultivators rushed out to fight, but these Yin souls were extraordinarily powerful. One Core Formation Tier cultivator couldn’t fight them at all, and several people had to work together to be a match.

Prosperous Heaven couldn’t do anything about it either. Her soul expiation technique was most effective against large numbers of Yin souls but were weaker than her. However, there weren’t many Yin souls now, but they were strong individually, so her soul expiation technique couldn’t take full effect.
There was nothing else that could be done. They could only advance slowly.

All the Core Formation Tiers moved one after another. Every five or six of them would join forces to deal with a Yin soul. In any case, there were many cultivators of Core Formation Tier here, so there was completely enough of them to deal with them.
After spending a very long time, they finally cleared out this extremely large stone chamber, and then walked into the next room.

The moment they entered, everyone felt their vision blur. They saw mountains of blades and seas of flames, and saw countless living beings being tortured, making them feel as if they were experiencing it themselves.
A great many people cried out on the spot, grabbing their heads and rolling around on the ground, completely lacking the bearing of elites.
Ling Han’s divine sense also wavered slightly. He hurriedly strengthened his willpower and guarded his mind.
Not long after, these images disappeared.
Everyone finally saw the scene here clearly, and all of them inhaled sharply, a chill rising up from the bottom of their hearts.
This was practically Asura Hell!

There were torture devices everywhere, and on every torture tool, there was a person who had been tortured. Naturally, he had long since died, but he was exuding an indestructible resentment that could drive one crazy.

The White Lotus Mystery Realm would only open once every million years, so this place should have been sealed for at least a few million years, or even longer, but looking at these corpses, there was still blood dripping from them.
This was too bizarre. The corpse was dripping blood, and had not dried up even after millions of years?
“These are all Saints!” Prosperous Heaven suddenly spoke up, “Or rather, they were Saints in the past!”
Pu!
Instantly, everyone spluttered.
Though the local natives had limited horizons, they knew the level of cultivation, and knew what kind of concept Saints were. How many were there in this world?
But now?

There were actually so many Saints being held up on torture devices. By the looks of it, they had been tortured to death. All of them had incredibly pained expressions. Who knew what kind of torture they had endured when they had been alive.
That’s right, the oil from the lamp in the great hall previously! That had been refined from the corpse of a Saint. Could it be that it was from the Saints that had been tortured to death here?
The problem was, who was so freakish that they could capture so many Saints and torture them to death?
Ancestral King?
This was a temple, and there was also the secret technique of the Buddhist Race being taught. Could it be… Ancestral Buddha Ah Han?
Everyone looked towards Prosperous Heaven. There was confusion in their eyes, as well as extreme fear.
How many Saints were there here?
He had probably gathered all the Saints of an era. It could definitely be considered as deaths of Saints.
Prosperous Heaven shook her head and said, “Everyone, don’t misunderstand. Ancestral Buddha is benevolent and amiable, so how could he possibly do such a thing?”
“Who in the world is that? They actually captured so many Saints and tortured them to death?” someone murmured.
It should be known that capturing a Saint was even more difficult than killing a Saint, and to be able to capture so many Saints alive, aside from an Ancestral King, who else could it be?

The Buddhist Race had only produced a single Great Emperor, and this place was inextricably linked to the Buddhist Race. Who would believe that this wasn’t the doing of the Buddhist Race’s Great Emperor?
All of a sudden, even more gazes turned towards Prosperous Heaven, filled with wariness and hostility.
Obviously, Prosperous Heaven had concealed a great many things, and in this kind of Mystery Realm, such a secret could possibly kill them.

“If Holy Daughter Prosperous Heaven knows anything, please tell us,” a Core Formation Tier cultivator said smilingly to Prosperous Heaven. Though his voice was gentle, everyone could hear that sliver of coldness.
At this time, who would care what contributions Prosperous Heaven had made? This concerned their own life and wealth, so they were naturally the most important.
Prosperous Heaven hesitated for a moment. This was a huge secret, and she definitely didn’t want to reveal it. However, it seemed like there was nothing she could do at this moment.
Otherwise, if she were ganged up on, she would lose her life here.
Even if she didn’t die, she wouldn’t be able to achieve her goal.

“Everyone knows that Ancestral Buddha created Buddhist Race, but in truth, Ancestral Buddha didn’t appear out of thin air. He also has an inheritance,” Prosperous Heaven said. Everyone held their breath. What Prosperous Heaven was about to reveal was possibly one of
the greatest secrets of the universe.
“Ancestral Buddha was supremely talented in martial arts, and ultimately became the

Ancestral King, invincible for an era. However, no one knew that Ancestral Buddha actually had a Senior Brother. Whether it was talent or being gifted, he was not only not inferior to Ancestral Buddha, but even surpassed him.”
What!
Everyone was shocked. There was actually such a freakish person in this world?
But why had it been Ancestral Buddha that finally achieved Dao?
Hold on, this Black Heaven Temple was created by that Senior Brother from the Buddhist
Race?

“This Senior Brother of Ancestral Buddha is named Doga.” Prosperous Heaven continued, “At that time, Ancestral Buddha and his Senior Brother defeated all the prodigies in the world, and in the end, both of them became Pseudo Emperors.”
Pseudo-Emperor, above Saint Tier, and below Great Emperor,, was a special cultivation level that could overwhelm all Saints, but was still another level away from the invincible Great
Emperor.

Ordinarily, it was only possible for a single Pseudo Emperor to appear in one era, and after several years of cultivation, complete that final leap. If he succeeded, he would become the Invincible Great Emperor, and if he failed, his Dao would be destroyed and he would die.
Thus, Ancestral Buddha and his Senior Brother actually both became pseudo-emperors. This was really too shocking.
Becoming an Emperor not only required natural talent, fated opportunities, and hard cultivation, but also great fortune that was blessed by heaven and earth.
“At the same time, only one person can become an Emperor.”
“In front of the position of Emperor, Ancestral Buddha and his Senior Brother also began a
fierce competition. In the end, the heavens favoured Ancestral Buddha, and he achieved the
supreme great dao.”
“However, Buddha Doga fell into the demonic path from then onwards, wanting to take a different path, and ascend to the position of Emperor.”
“All of this is probably just experiments by Buddha Doga.”
This explanation… was very logical.
When a Pseudo Emperor moved, so what if it was a Saint? He would definitely not be able to

withstand a single blow. Even if a Pseudo Emperor was not a true Great Emperor, as long as he had the word ‘Emperor’ in his name, he would have transcended the level of Saints, and completely overwhelmed Saints.
Thus, the inheritance of the Buddhist Race appeared here, so there were lamps made from the corpse oil of Saints here. Thus, the Saints here were also executed.
Pseudo-Emperor, Doga!

Even if a Pseudo Emperor was not a true Great Emperor, as long as he had the word ‘Emperor’ in his name, he would have transcended the level of Saints, and completely overwhelmed Saints.
Thus, the inheritance of the Buddhist Race appeared here, so there were lamps made from the corpse oil of Saints here.
Thus, the Saints here were also executed.
Pseudo-Emperor, Doga!

chapters.title: Chapter 3912: Coffin
paragraphs: Chapter 3912: Coffin
However, was everything so simple?
Ling Han looked at Prosperous Heaven, and felt that this Holy Daughter of the Buddhist Race was definitely hiding something.
She was clearly searching for something here. Could it be the inheritance of Buddha Doga?
Being able to become a Pseudo Emperor, the inheritance left behind by Buddha Doga was definitely amazing.
It should be known that the Prosperous Heaven was only a Holy Daughter, and not the next leader of the Buddhist Race. There were definitely some secret techniques that she could not cultivate.
He would wait and see.
Ling Han thought to himself. If the situation became dire, he would release the Heavenly Dao Flames and flee.

Everyone believed the words of Prosperous Heaven, or rather, they seemed to have believed her. Thinking that it was very possible that there was the inheritance of a Pseudo-Emperor here, everyone was incredibly excited. Aside from that, there was killing intent.
-If one had obtained the inheritance of a Pseudo-Emperor, but this news was leaked? With how big the world was, did it still have a place for him to hide?
Why didn’t anyone attack an Imperial Clan and seize their inheritance?
It was simple. The Imperial Clan usually had a Saint in their ranks. Furthermore, even if this generation was mediocre, and no Saint appeared, wouldn’t there still be the Imperial Weapon?
However, if a minor character obtained the Imperial Technique, he would definitely be hunted down by all the elites in the world.

Thus, if one obtained this inheritance, he would definitely have to think of a way to silence all witnesses, and kill everyone here. Only then would he be able to enjoy the secrets of the Emperor-level inheritance.
Instantly, everyone looked at the others with a hint of wariness, and a kind of vigilance.

The Saint blood here was indestructible for tens of millions of years, forming a terrifying pressure that no one could withstand. Thus, everyone could only walk in a circle, sticking close to the wall, and arrive at the passageway on the opposite side.
After entering the passageway, everyone breathed a sigh of relief. They felt like they were about to explode.
The might of a Saint was world-shaking.
And they were still dead at that. Furthermore, they had been dead for innumerable years. If it was when they had just died, it was guaranteed that everyone here would be killed by the shockwave.
Even so, there were still half of them that had not managed to make it here. They were trembling under the might of the Saint, and could not even stand up, so how could they talk of going around it?
No one would wait. Those who had circled around all set out, walking towards the depths of the passage.
Next, it was another stone chamber, with mountains of blades and seas of flames, as if it was hell.
Thankfully, there were no corpses of Saints here. It only sent a chill down their spines, and did not cause any other discomfort.
And just like that, as they walked, they finally arrived at the end ahead of them.

This was an incredibly colossal stone chamber. It was three hundred meters tall, and its length and width were even more astonishing. It appeared extremely grand and majestic. “So fragrant!” someone exclaimed.
Indeed, it was very fragrant, refreshing to the heart, and every single pore had opened up.
“This is a supremely valuable medicine!”
“It’s at least seven stars!”
“Or even… the mother tree!”
The mother tree, a planet could only nurture one. It was at least Venerate Tier-level, and this was determined by the quality of the planet itself.

The higher the quality of the planet, the more astonishing the effects of the mother tree would be. It could reach Saint Tier, and in fact, could even be consumed by an Ancestral King to extend his lifespan – to the Ancestral King, he was already invincible in this world. Aside from extending his lifespan, what else could be more valuable?

Everyone’s hearts throbbed wildly. They had initially wanted to contest for the Divine Tree Heart and extend their lifespan by 100 years. However, if they could obtain a mother tree, even if it was only the mother tree with the weakest effects, its value would be 10,000 times, or even 100 million times, the value of the Divine Tree Heart.
“Where is it?”
Everyone recognized the fragrance, and moved forwards. Then, they stopped in the middle of this massive stone chamber.
Ahead of them, there was a massive coffin.

This coffin was made of stone, and there were patterns carved on its four walls. However, they were not ordinary dragons or phoenixes, but rather masses of worshippers. It was as if the person in the coffin was also enjoying the worship of incense after his death.
The medicinal fragrance was precisely exuding from the casket. Even through that thick stone wall, it could be smelled, and could not be blocked at all.
Everyone surveyed it. This stone coffin was about nine meters in length, and about three meters in width. If the size was just right, then the person buried within was really too
massive.
“The Celestial medicine is inside!”
“Open the casket!”
Everyone had no scruples. For the sake of their own strength, it was very normal for cultivators to barge into the tombs of predecessors and search wantonly.
Thus, so what if they had to open the casket?

Everyone went to open the casket. However, the casket lid was as heavy as a mountain, and the combined efforts of the few Core Formation Tier cultivators couldn’t do anything to it at all. Finally, the 30 or so strongest Core Formation Tier cultivators formed a circle around the casket, then worked together to lift the casket.
“One, two, three!”
“Rise!”
They all unleashed their power at the same time, and with a creak, the coffin lid finally
loosened a little.
There was a chance!
Everyone was excited, and hurriedly continued to open the coffin.
Bit by bit, the coffin lid was moved away at a very slow speed, but it was indeed moving.
After a long while, everyone roared loudly. Boom, the coffin lid instantly slid down. This was incredibly heavy, shaking the ground a few times.
Everyone hurriedly came over to take a look. Those who could not get close enough jumped up
and peered down from above.
Ling Han did the same. He was only Cauldron Forging Tier, so he naturally couldn’t squeeze
into the front.
He leaped up and looked at the coffin, but was surprised.
It was not a person that was buried inside, but rather a galaxy!
How was this possible!
“What did I just see? A galaxy?”
“Yi, I thought that it was my misconception. It really is a world!”
“What about you?”
“I also saw a galaxy.”
Everyone exclaimed in shock. There was actually a galaxy hidden within this stone coffin; this
was practically inconceivable.
“Look, the galaxy is disappearing!” someone shouted again.
Hearing this, Ling Han also jumped up to watch again.
As expected, the galaxy was dissipating, and the surroundings were retreating towards the centre. Very soon, the inner walls of the stone coffin were revealed.
However, when the galaxy had retreated completely, another coffin actually appeared in the middle of the stone coffin.
This coffin was much smaller, and was about the size of an ordinary coffin. It was made of black wooden planks. Upon a closer look, this was a complete body, and had not been forged
from the combination of several planks.

Furthermore, there were various Celestial medicines laid out on top of the casket. Even after countless years had passed, every single Celestial medicine was still exuding a refreshing fragrance, causing all the pores on one’s body to open up with a single sniff, as if they were
about to ascend and become immortals.
“It, it’s all Saintly medicine!”
“This is plucked from the mother tree.”
“Purple Origin Saint Fruit, Dragon-containing Grass, Phoenix Blood Root… Heavens!”

The outsiders all exclaimed in shock. There was no shortage of heirs of Holy Lands here. Though they had never seen a real Saintly medicine, they had seen images on the Galaxy Network. With a single glance, they had matched the Saintly medicine on the casket.
As expected of a Pseudo Emperor. In the eyes of others, it was a supremely rare treasure, but here, there were piles of it, and they had even become funerary objects.
“Sigh, you guys were only focused on looking at those Saintly medicines, yet missed out on
the true treasures,” someone said slowly.𝘧𝓇ℯℯ𝑤ℯ𝘣𝓃ℴ𝓋𝑒𝑙.𝑐𝘰𝑚
“Why do you say that?”
“Hehe, take a closer look at this wooden coffin.”
Everyone looked over. The more they looked, the more serious their expressions became, and
the more excited they became.
“This is the Nine Heavens Black Wood!”
“Source of all Woods!”
“Emperor-level mother tree!”

chapters.title: Chapter 3913: Human Skin
paragraphs: Chapter 3913: Human Skin
Instantly, everyone went crazy.

The Nine Heavens Black Wood was the source of all trees. This was an Emperor Tier-level mother tree. The fruits it bore could even allow an Ancestral King to live another life. It could be claimed to be the strongest Celestial medicine in the world.
“What a waste of natural treasures!” Someone instantly pounded his chest and stamped his feet, looking like he was about to commit murder.
“The Emperor Tier-level Celestial Tree has actually been chopped down to become a coffin. Just how wasteful is that?”
“Truly… wasteful!”
Everyone was gritting their teeth. Was this how the mother tree was used?

It could clearly bear the strongest Celestial medicine, and allow a Great Emperor to live a second life, yet now, it had been chopped down and made into a coffin. To say nothing of them, even Saints would be stomping their feet in fury if they came.
“Is Buddha Doga buried here?” someone guessed.
There was an 80% chance that was the case. Otherwise, who would be so extravagant? “Open the casket!”
“Open!”
One after another, voices rang out, and everyone agreed to open the casket.
If Buddha Doga was buried here, it was very likely that his inheritance would also be there. Obtaining it would surpass the resources of the Holy Land.
The Saintly medicines on the casket was first taken down. For the moment, no conflict had erupted, because there was something even more enticing.
Once the inheritance of a Pseudo-Emperor came into being, it would definitely be a bloody battle. There would not be many people here that would be able to leave alive.

The stone coffin outside was extraordinarily heavy, but this wooden coffin was not heavy at all. Only one person exerted force, and the lid of the coffin was lifted. Then, it was lifted, and tossed aside.
Though the Nine Heavens Black Wood was a top grade mother tree, only the fruits it bore would be very useful. In itself, there did not seem to be anything special about it.
Everyone craned their necks to look into the wooden coffin. At this moment, they were all filled with anticipation and curiosity.
“Yi?”
“Ah!”
What had they seen?
What was buried in the casket was not a corpse, but rather a thin sheet of human skin.
This was strange. Logically speaking, even if it had been too long, and the corpse had decomposed, shouldn’t what was left behind be bones?
And now, the bones were gone, and there was only a sheet of human skin left behind. What the hell was this?
All of a sudden, everyone felt a chill run down their spines. They felt a cold chill run up their spines, and a feeling of unease rose up in them.
In truth, this Black Heaven Temple had always given off an incredibly strange feeling.
“Where’s the inheritance? Where’s the Pseudo-Emperor’s inheritance?” Someone couldn’t accept this, and shouted loudly.
They were filled with anticipation, thinking that they could obtain the inheritance of a Pseudo-Emperor here, but in the end, they only saw a sheet of human skin. Who could accept
this?
“Forget it. At least, there’s still a large amount of Saintly medicines. It’s profitable,” someone said.

Indeed, to say nothing of the fact that there were at least twenty to thirty Saintly medicines here, even if only one had appeared, it would be enough to incite a riot from the various Holy Lands, and they would fight over it at all costs.
It could not be helped. Who asked that their expectations previously were too high?
Next, it was time to distribute the Saintly medicines.
How was it to be divided?
Of course, they would fight. Whoever was stronger would be able to get a share of the loot.

However, there were really too many Core Formation Tier elites here. Even if one was the strongest, they could not possibly kill all the others, and take the treasure for themselves. Thus, at most, those who were stronger would get a little more.

“Hehe, I want a Saintly medicine. No one disagrees, right?” an old man in his sixties asked. He was a cultivator at the consummate level of the Core Formation Tier, and his battle prowess was also outstanding. It was because of this that he dared to speak up.
“I want one too,” another powerful Core Formation Tier cultivator said with extreme confidence.
“Then I want one too.”
“Leave one for me.”
Those who were stronger spoke up one after another. There were only close to thirty Saintly medicines, and no one was willing to cut them open and share them with anyone.

Ling Han was thinking about how he was going to snatch the Saintly medicine. Although the Heavenly Dao Flames were incredibly powerful, if they were released just like that, even the Saintly medicines ould be turned into ashes. That would be a double loss.
All of a sudden, an incredibly coldness rose up in his heart, causing him to involuntarily retreat.
Not only him, but the prodigies also had an instinctive reaction to danger. In an instant, they saw a dozen over people moving against the crowd.
Weng, a terrifying aura spread out, causing those who were still fighting over the Saintly medicine, to tremble, and reveal expressions of extreme terror.
Right at this moment, Prosperous Heaven scuttled out, an unconcealable expression of wild
joy and anticipation on her face.
What did this woman want to do?

Ling Han’s instinctive reaction was to follow her out. This Buddhist Race Holy Daughter was far too smart, and she definitely wouldn’t place herself in a perilous situation. However, his instinct told him that this was far too dangerous.
In the end, he still calmed his heart, and did not move.

“Buddha is merciful, and the great sun overflows the heavens, expiating all life!” A ray of light was released from the chest of Prosperous Heaven. Its level far surpassed that of the Core Formation Tier, and even exceeded that of the True Self Tier. A Buddhist circle also formed behind her, making her seem as if she had transformed into a Bodhisattva that could deliver the world from destruction.
Her monk robes fluttered, transcendent above the rest.

This was the opportunity that she had been earnestly waiting for. This was an opportunity that could allow her to leap to become a supreme elite. In fact, there was even a chance that she could advance into the position of Emperor in future, and become the second Ancestral
Buddha.
However, an incredibly strange scene appeared.
A hand suddenly stretched out of the casket. The fingers were long and slender, but they were
a little too white. They pressed down on the edge of the casket, and an incredibly powerful aura also seeped out, filling the entire stone chamber.
Pu!
Prosperous Heaven instantly spat out a mouthful of blood, falling from midair.
She looked at that hand in extreme shock, her face filled with disbelief.
How was this possible?
Pa, at this moment, another hand stretched out of the casket, and pressed down on the edge
of the casket on the other side. Then, a person sat up straight.
Hiss, when they saw this “person”, everyone felt their scalps go numb, and a coldness seeped
directly into the top of their heads.
That was because this was not a person, but rather a sheet of human skin!
The human skin could actually get back to its feet, as if it was still alive. How could this not be
terrifying?
This human skin swept an empty gaze over everyone, then tilted his head slightly, as if he was pondering something. Then, he suddenly swelled up, as if he had gained a body of flesh and
blood.
Multiple streaks of light circulated, and this human skin became plump and real. First, it was
his two eyes. His hair was black like a waterfall, every strand glowing, as if it was carved from
black jade.
Yi, wasn’t Buddha Doga a monk? Why did he have hair?
Ling Han was astonished by his own stupidity. Should he be curious about his hair at this
moment?
This was a man with a sturdy build. He looked dignified, and his aura was astonishing. He was indescribably handsome.
Pa, pa, pa! Everyone knelt down. This person was like an emperor. Anyone would only be qualified to bow down in front of him.

Prodigies like Prosperous Heaven was still barely holding on, but their whole bodies were covered with cold sweat like rain, and their legs were trembling as if they were swaying. Obviously, they could not possibly hold on for too long.
Only Ling Han could stand firmly. The Celestial Cauldron in his body was forged based on the Primitive Celestial Gate, allowing him to have the ability to resist all pressure.
-A cultivator at the Core Formation Tier was enough to kill him, but even the Great Emperor would not be able to make him yield.

Her monk robes fluttered, transcendent above the rest.
This was the opportunity that she had been earnestly waiting for.
This was an opportunity that could allow her to leap to become a supreme elite.
In fact, there was even a chance that she could advance into the position of Emperor in future, and become the second Ancestral
Buddha.
However, an incredibly strange scene appeared.
A hand suddenly stretched out of the casket.
The fingers were long and slender, but they were
a little too white.
They pressed down on the edge of the casket, and an incredibly powerful aura also seeped out, filling the entire stone chamber.
Pu!
Prosperous Heaven instantly spat out a mouthful of blood, falling from midair.
She looked at that hand in extreme shock, her face filled with disbelief.
How was this possible?
Pa, at this moment, another hand stretched out of the casket, and pressed down on the edge
of the casket on the other side.
Then, a person sat up straight.
Hiss, when they saw this “person”, everyone felt their scalps go numb, and a coldness seeped
directly into the top of their heads.
That was because this was not a person, but rather a sheet of human skin!
The human skin could actually get back to its feet, as if it was still alive.
How could this not be
terrifying?
This human skin swept an empty gaze over everyone, then tilted his head slightly, as if he was pondering something.
Then, he suddenly swelled up, as if he had gained a body of flesh and
blood.
Multiple streaks of light circulated, and this human skin became plump and real.
First, it was
his two eyes.
His hair was black like a waterfall, every strand glowing, as if it was carved from
black jade.
Yi, wasn’t Buddha Doga a monk?
Why did he have hair?
Ling Han was astonished by his own stupidity.
Should he be curious about his hair at this
moment?
This was a man with a sturdy build.
He looked dignified, and his aura was astonishing.
He was indescribably handsome.
Pa, pa, pa!
Everyone knelt down.
This person was like an emperor.
Anyone would only be qualified to bow down in front of him.
Prodigies like Prosperous Heaven was still barely holding on, but their whole bodies were covered with cold sweat like rain, and their legs were trembling as if they were swaying.
Obviously, they could not possibly hold on for too long.
Only Ling Han could stand firmly.
The Celestial Cauldron in his body was forged based on the Primitive Celestial Gate, allowing him to have the ability to resist all pressure.
-A cultivator at the Core Formation Tier was enough to kill him, but even the Great Emperor would not be able to make him yield.

chapters.title: Chapter 3914: Pseudo-Emperor Doga
paragraphs: Chapter 3914: Pseudo-Emperor Doga

Pa, pa, pa! More and more prodigies fell to their knees. Even if Prosperous Heaven was the Holy Daughter of the Buddhist Race and her willpower was incredibly strong, so what? In front of such intimidation, she could only be outmatched.
This overflowing might far surpassed that of Saints. It was like the manifestation of heaven and earth, descending into the mortal realm.
This was far too astonishing. He was only a sheet of human skin, yet it was as if he had become an invincible Great Emperor.

Everyone was trembling in fear, cold sweat pouring down their bodies like rain. Without a doubt, this sheet of human skin must be Buddha Doga from before. He was a dignified Pseudo Emperor, and was only a step away from becoming an existence like the Ancestral King.
Imperial might pervaded the air, as if it had blasted through the heavens. Even the heavens would have to bow their heads, and the earth would have to prostrate.
They were too naive. To actually dare to blaspheme the remains of a Pseudo Emperor, this was practically courting death.
Just how violent had this person been in the past?
This was a demon king that had tortured Saints to death, and refined the corpses of Saints into lamp oil!
Everyone bowed, and only Ling Han remained standing.
He clearly knew that this would make him stand out like a swan in a flock of chickens. It would be too special, and too obvious, but with his pride, he could not kneel down no matter what.
He could bend the knee, but only respected those who were virtuous.
Buddha Doga looked over, his eyes focused on Ling Han.

Boom, the great explosion of the universe’s planets instantly appeared in front of Ling Han’s eyes, followed by the rapid orbiting of the endless galaxies, making him feel how insignificant he was. In the long passage of history, he was practically negligible.
Since he was negligible, why didn’t he kneel down?
Ling Han gritted his teeth, and his willpower instantly became as firm as iron.
His head could be severed, and his blood could flow, but his will could not be subdued.
He was indeed a minor character now, but what Great Emperor in history had not started off as a minor character?

“Hahahaha, never would I have thought that I would be able to see someone with quite a bit of backbone.” Buddha Doga laughed loudly. He pinched his fingers like flowers, and moved them lightly. Then, he said to himself, “So I have already slumbered for so long.”
Slumbered?
‘You f*cking died. Have you come back to life now?’

Buddha Doga looked at Prosperous Heaven, and revealed a faint smile, “Come to think of it, you are also my junior. Though there is enmity between me and Ah Han, it is not to the extent that I would take out my anger on a junior.”
He paused for a moment, “You want to fuse with my skin, and let you undergo a complete transformation, right?”
Everyone was shocked. As it turned out, Prosperous Heaven was actually so ambitious.
Merging with the skin of a Pseudo-Emperor, while it may not be obtaining all the good fortune of a Pseudo-Emperor, her future accomplishments would at least be from Saint Tier onwards.

In this world, there was no Ancestral King in this generation. Saints were the most powerful beings, and Prosperous Heaven had fused with the skin of a Pseudo-Emperor. Thus, after becoming a Saint, she would definitely belong to the category of the most powerful Saints. This was really a great ambition. Unfortunately, who would have thought that after millions and millions of years, Buddha Doga would still be able to “revive” with just a sheet of human skin?
What kind of existence was a Pseudo Emperor? He was practically freakishly strong.
Prosperous Heave trembled all over. In front of a Pseudo-Emperor, she was extremely insignificant. A single thought from Buddha Doga could kill her several hundred times over.
“Disciple Prosperous Heaven pays respects to Ancestral Buddha Doga!” She forced herself to kneel upright and respectfully kowtowed.
Buddha Doga didn’t give her another look. Instead, he focused his gaze on Ling Han and strode toward him.

Ling Han could remain unyielding under the Imperial Might, but this did not mean that his physical body could also withstand it. When a Pseudo Emperor approached, the skin all over his body cracked, and blood gushed out like a fountain.
“Hehe, what a little kid.” Buddha Doga stretched out a hand and pressed down. Ling Han’s bleeding immediately stopped.

A Pseudo Emperor was practically the strongest in the world, and had extraordinary means. “Interesting, interesting.” Buddha Doga stared at Ling Han, as if he was admiring a supreme treasure, “I never thought that having actually missed it once, but the heaven and earth are impermanent, and this kind of opportunity would come again in the blink of an eye.”
“In the past, I made a grand vow to enter hell and become a demon, expiating the dead souls, and become Emperor in a different manner.”
“There seems to have been a slight error. I turned into a demon with a thought, and I have indeed done a considerable number of evil deeds.”
Everyone was baffled. Why was Buddha Doga so interested in Ling Han? Furthermore, what was he saying?

Entering hell to become a demon, expiating the souls of the dead, wanting to become an Emperor in a different manner. In the end, he had become a demon with a single thought, and that was why he had captured so many Saints and tortured them to death.
Once this benevolent Buddha became a demon, he would be even more terrifying than anyone else.

There could only be one Emperor in a single era. This was decided by the heaven and earth. Luck could only be bestowed on a single person, but Buddha Doga wanted to become an Emperor in a different manner, what kind of boldness, great intelligence, great comprehension ability was that?
Unfortunately, he did not succeed. Instead, he turned from good into evil, and turned from Buddha into Demon.

“On this path of yours, can you reach the peak?” Buddha Doga asked Ling Han. It was as if he were asking Ling Han a question, but in truth, Ling Han was not qualified to answer him at all. The gap between the two of them was definitely miles apart.
However, Buddha Doga had no intention of getting an answer from Ling Han either. Instead, he was answering his own questions.
“Hehe, I really want to see what kind of result would be produced if a rock was thrown into
this muddy water.”
“Come!” He beckoned with his hand, and gave a light shout.
The Pseudo-Emperor spoke, and his words were law.
Xiu, xiu, xiu! In an instant, three streaks of light descended from above the stone chamber,
and began to revolve around Buddha Doga.
“Celestial light!” Quite a number of people called out mentally, but with a Pseudo Emperor in front of them, even if there was only a sheet of human skin left, who would dare make a
sound?

The outsiders all revealed heated gazes. Though there were many precious treasures in the White Lotus Mystery Realm, in terms of the most precious, it was definitely the celestial light. And now, three streaks of celestial light had actually flown over in a single stroke. If he could obtain even one, that would be a supreme fated opportunity.
Unfortunately, in front of a Pseudo Emperor, who dared to move a single finger?
Buddha Doga moved, and a streak of celestial light was forcefully injected into Ling Han’s body, followed by a second streak, and then a third.
Being able to capture a streak of celestial light was already a supreme opportunity, but now, Ling Han had actually been struck by three streaks of celestial light. This was practically
enough to make one die of envy.
How could there be such good luck?
Everyone knew that the crux of the matter lay in the words that Buddha Doga had said to himself before, but no one understood what he meant. What muddy waters?
Even a Pseudo-Emperor called it muddy water, so what kind of major event was that?
“Wu!” Ling Han groaned. He had been instilled with three streaks of celestial light at the same time. This was completely capable of killing him.

Just think, if the divine light of lightning hadn’t been suppressed by the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, how many times would Ling Han have been killed? And if it weren’t for the fact that there were countless living beings in the dimensions inside Ling Han’s body that could share the pressure, his mind would have long since exploded from the illusions seeping out from the divine light.
However, now that three streaks of celestial light had gathered, just how terrifying was this?

The three streaks of celestial light were actually all lightning-aligned, but they were not pure. They were Divine Water Yin Lightning, Second Wood True Lightning, and Third Fire Yang Lightning, respectively. Thus, these three streaks of celestial light were completely different, and wreaked havoc in Ling Han’s body, instantly severing all his vital signs.
However, if Buddha Doga wanted to kill him, there was no need for him to do so.
He delivered a palm strike, and the three streaks of divine lightning were immediately suppressed, unable to cause any further damage to Ling Han.
This Pseudo Emperor waved his hand casually, and Ling Han channeled three Celestial Cauldrons. They each swallowed a divine lightning, and began to fuse together.

chapters.title: Chapter 3915: Three streaks of celestial light
paragraphs: Chapter 3915: Three streaks of celestial light
For Ling Han, obtaining three streaks of celestial light all at once, and being able to cultivate three streaks of supreme divine light, this was an extremely good thing.
However, the feeling of being controlled and having no control over himself was too terrible, making him extremely displeased.
When he advanced into Pseudo Emperor Tier, he would definitely beat up this Buddha Doga.
Er, this Pseudo Emperor had died who knew how long ago, and was only left with a sheet of human skin. How was he supposed to be beaten?
Ling Han could only remain silent, focusing his attention on fusing with the celestial light.
If this was known to others, who knew how much they would hate him.
F***, this was a good thing that could not be obtained even if many people begged, and you are actually so picky?
‘If you don’t want it, just give it to me. I would be very happy.’
Unfortunately, no one here could move, and could only watch as Ling Han was in such pain and happiness at the same time.
Prosperous Heaven felt mixed feelings. This was the Buddhist Race’s once great elite, yet he had bestowed such a great opportunity on an outsider. How could she endure this?
With the help of a Pseudo Emperor, Ling Han quickly fused the three streaks of celestial light, fusing with the Celestial Cauldron and becoming one, becoming his own Mystical Power.

In comparison, the first bolt of lightning that he had obtained should be the Primal Chaos Divine Lightning. Its might was slightly stronger, though its superiority was also limited. Even he felt like he was dreaming. He had obtained three streaks of celestial light all of a sudden, so the number of divine light he possessed had reached five.

“Haha, I’m really looking forward to it now. How lively it will be in the future.” Buddha Doga laughed loudly. He stretched out a hand, and those Saintly medicines all flew towards him, fusing into his body.
“With these Saintly medicines, I can travel around in this world for three more days, and complete some arrangements.”
He took a step forward, and instantly disappeared from sight.

With the passing of the Pseudo Emperor, everyone gradually recovered from that frightening pressure. They could finally sit up, and felt that their whole bodies were covered with cold sweat, drenching their clothes.
“Heavens, what did we just see?”
“A Pseudo Emperor!”
“No, it’s just a sheet of skin shed by a Pseudo Emperor.”
“This is too inconceivable. A Pseudo Emperor has long since died, but the human skin that he sheds can actually revive after millions and millions of years, as if he was still alive.”
Everyone exclaimed in shock. Today’s events were destined to be eternal in their memories, letting them know just how heaven-defying the Ancestral King’s power was.
“Unfortunately, the Saintly medicines are all gone.”

Listening to Buddha Doga’s mutterings, these Saintly medicines could only allow his skin to exist for an additional three days. This was practically a great waste. If it was them, which one of them would not be completely transformed, and live for tens of thousands more years?
“The Saintly medicine is gone, but the celestial light is still in this person’s possession!” Instantly, a great many people turned to look at Ling Han.
One streak of celestial light was enough to drive anyone crazy, then what about three streaks?
No one knew that Ling Han had actually fused with a total of five streaks of celestial light. Otherwise, they would be even more frenzied.
Ling Han smiled calmly, “This was given to me by a Pseudo Emperor, and you guys dare to snatch it?”
When these words fell, everyone frowned.
That’s right. Buddha Doga had already left, but who knew how strong a Pseudo Emperor was? Perhaps he could manifest with a single thought?
Was there anyone in this world that a Pseudo Emperor could not kill?
Thus, even if they wanted to make a move, they would have to wait three days for that Pseudo Emperor to completely die.

However, those Core Formation Tier cultivators stepped forwards to exchange pleasantries with Ling Han. This was an outsider, and furthermore, he had gained the favour of a Pseudo Emperor, so his future prospects would definitely be limitless. Thus, there was no harm in befriending him.

And they had long since advanced into the Core Formation Tier. Even if they obtained the celestial light, the celestial light could not possibly be fused into the Celestial Cauldron, so there was no direct conflict of interest between them and Ling Han.
There were even the three Core Formation Tiers from the Tong Clan among them. All of them were very polite, hoping that Ling Han could pay them a visit.
Ling Han broke into a smile, and said, “All right. I will definitely pay you a visit another day.”
He had long since decided that when he advanced into the Core Formation Tier, he would go to the Tong Clan to call them to account. Hence, there was a hidden meaning behind his words.

How could the three Core Formation Tiers of the Tong Clan know that this person was the enemy that they had sworn to kill? When they heard this, they were naturally overjoyed. They were still thinking about which woman in their clan was still unmarried and beautiful, and could be used to tie Ling Han down.
Boom, the ground shook, and dust fell down.
“This place is about to collapse, let’s go!”
Everyone hurriedly left. There was already nothing good left here, so what was the point of staying any longer?
That casket?

Hehe, that was indeed made from a top tier Celestial Tree. However, it itself was not of much use. Furthermore, it was a coffin, with a sheet of human skin buried within. Who would dare take such an evil thing?
Everyone ran out one after another. This place was like hell, so it was best to leave as soon as
possible.
However, there were still quite a few people who didn’t move-Ling Han, Prosperous Heaven as well as twenty over young prodigies.
Their target… was none other than that coffin.
This was made from the supreme mother tree, and by itself, it was priceless, and why did Buddha Doga not use anything else to build the coffin but chose the mother tree to bury
himself?
There must be a secret hidden within.
Xiu, immediately, someone charged out, and began snatching.
With this move, a battle royale immediately began.

Ling Han naturally joined the battle as well. However, even though he was powerful, there was no shortage of prodigies here. Each of them had their own strengths. If it was a one-on- one battle, Ling Han had a 100% chance of winning.
But if he was ganged up on, then even he would not dare say that he could win.
After all, after all, these super Cauldron Forging Tiers added together were enough to kill even those in the early stage of the Core Formation Tier.
Boom!
In the chaotic battle, the black coffin was instantly shattered, turning into seven large wooden planks and dozens of tiny wooden planks.

Everyone immediately fought over the treasures. Peng, peng, peng! The battle became even more intense, and everyone unleashed their full power, no longer holding anything back. Ling Han humphed as he unleashed his murderous aura. Everyone was instantly affected. He then opened his right hand and unleashed three arcs of lightning. It was as if he had overturned a pool of electricity.
No one could match this kind of sharpness, and they could only retreat.
Ling Han took the opportunity to snatch three large wooden planks. He thought for a moment, then left resolutely.

No matter how greedy he was, he would definitely become the target of everyone, and be ganged up on by everyone. Thus, he had already obtained three large wooden planks, and his gains were astonishing. He might as well quit while he was ahead.
As expected, though they saw Ling Han leave, there were still four large wooden planks here,
and added with a considerable number of small pieces, not one person pursued Ling Han.
Firstly, there were more wooden planks here, and secondly, even if they caught up, they might not be able to defeat him.𝒻𝑟ℯℯ𝑤𝑒𝑏𝑛𝘰𝓋𝑒𝓁.𝒸𝑜𝘮

Not long after, Prosperous Heaven snatched a large wooden plank. She didn’t linger in battle, and she also left gracefully. Next, the remaining three large wooden planks were also snatched, and the remaining people could only snatch those small wooden planks. Ling Han left elegantly. When he came out of the Black Divine Willow, he heard a boom, and
the ground began to sink. One after another, great halls collapsed, sinking into the ground.
He took a glance, and without the slightest bit of hesitation, moved and flew towards the
swamp.
Half a day later, he had already walked out of the great swamp.
He changed his appearance and soul fluctuation again, and entered into a city to search for
clues.
Five streaks of celestial light, four more to go!
