A Pseudo Emperor has long since died, but the human skin that he sheds can actually revive after millions and millions of years, as if he was still alive.”
Everyone exclaimed in shock.
Today’s events were destined to be eternal in their memories, letting them know just how heaven-defying the Ancestral King’s power was.
“Unfortunately, the Saintly medicines are all gone.”
Listening to Buddha Doga’s mutterings, these Saintly medicines could only allow his skin to exist for an additional three days.
This was practically a great waste.
If it was them, which one of them would not be completely transformed, and live for tens of thousands more years?
“The Saintly medicine is gone, but the celestial light is still in this person’s possession!” Instantly, a great many people turned to look at Ling Han.
One streak of celestial light was enough to drive anyone crazy, then what about three streaks?
No one knew that Ling Han had actually fused with a total of five streaks of celestial light.
Otherwise, they would be even more frenzied.
Ling Han smiled calmly, “This was given to me by a Pseudo Emperor, and you guys dare to snatch it?”
When these words fell, everyone frowned.
That’s right.
Buddha Doga had already left, but who knew how strong a Pseudo Emperor was?
Perhaps he could manifest with a single thought?
Was there anyone in this world that a Pseudo Emperor could not kill?
Thus, even if they wanted to make a move, they would have to wait three days for that Pseudo Emperor to completely die.
However, those Core Formation Tier cultivators stepped forwards to exchange pleasantries with Ling Han.
This was an outsider, and furthermore, he had gained the favour of a Pseudo Emperor, so his future prospects would definitely be limitless.
Thus, there was no harm in befriending him.
And they had long since advanced into the Core Formation Tier.
Even if they obtained the celestial light, the celestial light could not possibly be fused into the Celestial Cauldron, so there was no direct conflict of interest between them and Ling Han.
There were even the three Core Formation Tiers from the Tong Clan among them.
All of them were very polite, hoping that Ling Han could pay them a visit.
Ling Han broke into a smile, and said, “All right.
I will definitely pay you a visit another day.”
He had long since decided that when he advanced into the Core Formation Tier, he would go to the Tong Clan to call them to account.
Hence, there was a hidden meaning behind his words.
How could the three Core Formation Tiers of the Tong Clan know that this person was the enemy that they had sworn to kill?
When they heard this, they were naturally overjoyed.
They were still thinking about which woman in their clan was still unmarried and beautiful, and could be used to tie Ling Han down.
Boom, the ground shook, and dust fell down.
“This place is about to collapse, let’s go!”
Everyone hurriedly left.
There was already nothing good left here, so what was the point of staying any longer?
That casket?
Hehe, that was indeed made from a top tier Celestial Tree.
However, it itself was not of much use.
Furthermore, it was a coffin, with a sheet of human skin buried within.
Who would dare take such an evil thing?
Everyone ran out one after another.
This place was like hell, so it was best to leave as soon as
possible.
However, there were still quite a few people who didn’t move-Ling Han, Prosperous Heaven as well as twenty over young prodigies.
Their target… was none other than that coffin.
This was made from the supreme mother tree, and by itself, it was priceless, and why did Buddha Doga not use anything else to build the coffin but chose the mother tree to bury
himself?
There must be a secret hidden within.
Xiu, immediately, someone charged out, and began snatching.
With this move, a battle royale immediately began.
Ling Han naturally joined the battle as well.
However, even though he was powerful, there was no shortage of prodigies here.
Each of them had their own strengths.
If it was a one-on- one battle, Ling Han had a 100% chance of winning.
But if he was ganged up on, then even he would not dare say that he could win.
After all, after all, these super Cauldron Forging Tiers added together were enough to kill even those in the early stage of the Core Formation Tier.
Boom!
In the chaotic battle, the black coffin was instantly shattered, turning into seven large wooden planks and dozens of tiny wooden planks.
Everyone immediately fought over the treasures.
Peng, peng, peng!
The battle became even more intense, and everyone unleashed their full power, no longer holding anything back.
Ling Han humphed as he unleashed his murderous aura.
Everyone was instantly affected.
He then opened his right hand and unleashed three arcs of lightning.
It was as if he had overturned a pool of electricity.
No one could match this kind of sharpness, and they could only retreat.
Ling Han took the opportunity to snatch three large wooden planks.
He thought for a moment, then left resolutely.
No matter how greedy he was, he would definitely become the target of everyone, and be ganged up on by everyone.
Thus, he had already obtained three large wooden planks, and his gains were astonishing.
He might as well quit while he was ahead.
As expected, though they saw Ling Han leave, there were still four large wooden planks here,
and added with a considerable number of small pieces, not one person pursued Ling Han.
Firstly, there were more wooden planks here, and secondly, even if they caught up, they might not be able to defeat him.𝒻𝑟ℯℯ𝑤𝑒𝑏𝑛𝘰𝓋𝑒𝓁.𝒸𝑜𝘮
Not long after, Prosperous Heaven snatched a large wooden plank.
She didn’t linger in battle, and she also left gracefully.
Next, the remaining three large wooden planks were also snatched, and the remaining people could only snatch those small wooden planks.
Ling Han left elegantly.
When he came out of the Black Divine Willow, he heard a boom, and
the ground began to sink.
One after another, great halls collapsed, sinking into the ground.
He took a glance, and without the slightest bit of hesitation, moved and flew towards the
swamp.
Half a day later, he had already walked out of the great swamp.
He changed his appearance and soul fluctuation again, and entered into a city to search for
clues.
Five streaks of celestial light, four more to go!

chapters.title: Chapter 3916: Ten Thousand Beasts Mountains
paragraphs: Chapter 3916: Ten Thousand Beasts Mountains

Ling Han had not even begun to investigate where the strange phenomenon had appeared, when he was already faced with one matter, and that was he had already cultivated to the consummate level of Seven Cauldrons, and could break through.
Being fused with the celestial light by a Pseudo-Emperor naturally increased his cultivation level as well.
For a Pseudo Emperor, this was practically a negligible amount of power, but for Ling Han, it was enough to help him reach consummate level of Seven Cauldrons.
He began to break through to the Eight Cauldrons.
Now, he finally felt the pressure and difficulty.

The other seven Celestial Cauldrons were resisting and repelling the Celestial Cauldron, not allowing the eighth Celestial Cauldron to form. It was just like how he had previously formed the second and third foundation stones of the Celestial Path.
He didn’t stimulate the life force of the dimensions in his body, because he could completely rely on his own power to suppress this repulsive force.
Slowly, the Celestial Cauldron’s core appeared, turning into the embryo of the Celestial Cauldron, and then slowly grew stronger.
Seven days later, Ling Han broke into a smile.
Eight Cauldrons!
With a battle cry, he stood up and moved his limbs. A deep power surged, as if a light punch could shatter the heavens.
“My Eight Cauldrons is at least comparable to the Eleven Cauldrons of vicious beasts, or even stronger.”
“However, I have a feeling that this is still no match for the early stage of the Core Formation Tier.”
“I wonder if I can stand against Core Formation Tier after cultivating to the pinnacle of the Nine Cauldrons.”
Ling Han continued to gather information, looking for more information about the celestial light.

Although the Demonic Origin Realm wasn’t small, it had its own communication system. Thus, the news spread quite quickly. Ling Han spent some time investigating, and already had a complete understanding of the current situation.

-Feng Jixing’s heaven-defying luck allowed him to capture a streak of celestial light. -Song Lan had obtained a great opportunity, and had also broken through to Nine Cauldrons. -There was a new prodigy who had risen up as a new force. His name was Zhao Wuji, and his battle prowess was astonishing. In fact, he had even announced that he wanted to challenge Feng Jixing.

Ling Han only glanced at this kind of information once before throwing it to the back of his mind. He firmly believed in his own strength. No matter how strong you are, so what? I will defeat you with a single punch.
Ten Thousand Beasts Mountains!
He saw a piece of news. Presently, a large number of outsiders were heading there, because there was suspected to be a celestial light there.

It was said that in Ten Thousand Beasts Mountains, there was a golden streak that would occasionally streak across the horizon, accompanied by the thunder and lightning. The phenomenon was astonishing.
It was extremely likely that this was a streak of celestial light.
Unfortunately, there was still no news about the empress, Hu Niu, the large black dog, and the others.
Perhaps, because they were in the Foundation Building Tier, they hadn’t entered the Demonic Origin Realm at all.
Ling Han set out on his own, heading towards the Ten Thousand Beasts Mountains.

If he could cultivate to the level of Nine Cauldrons and obtain nine celestial lights at the same time, that would be perfect. He would directly advance into the Core Formation Tier in his strongest state.
At that time, it would be equivalent to grasping nine Imperial Techniques at the same time, so just how terrifying would his battle prowess be?
He was filled with anticipation.
Two days later, Ling Han arrived at the Ten Thousand Beasts Mountains.

This was an incredibly primitive mountain range, inhabited by large amounts of fierce beasts. In fact, there were even True Self Tier-level beasts. Thus, the local forces of the Demonic Origin Realm did not dare to rashly barge in. This could easily lead to death.
Ten Thousand Beasts Mountains was not a mountain range, but rather an endless stretch of land. Its territory was incredibly vast.
There was no need to enter. Ling Han was still standing in the distance when he heard the roar of a beast, causing his eardrums to hurt slightly.
Ling Han took a deep breath. In order to walk the path of the strongest, so what if it was dangerous? He still had to take this risk.

There was not only celestial light here, but also Celestial medicines, high-level Celestial medicines. Thus, even if there were swarms of wild beasts, there were still people who came here to harvest herbs, including those outsiders, as well as local cultivators.
Ling Han walked slowly into the forest. It was naturally good to have Celestial medicines, but his main goal was still to find the celestial light.
“Ang!”
He was just walking, when he saw a black bear suddenly scuttle out. It was thirty meters tall, and stood on its hind legs, casting a long shadow.
Seven Cauldrons.
Ling Han did not make a move, and merely stared coldly at that black bear.
The black bear roared. Such a tiny little guy actually dared to look it in the eye? However, it immediately discovered that Ling Han’s eyes were frighteningly cold, causing it to shiver all
over.
It released a wail, then suddenly turned around and fled. Hong long long, multiple trees collapsed, and it soon disappeared without a trace.
If anyone saw this, they would definitely exclaim in disbelief.
The reason why Vicious Beasts were called Vicious Beasts was because they were vicious and ruthless. They only had the instincts of slaughter, and had no intelligence.
He had actually been scared off by a single look from Ling Han?
This was practically like a dream!

However, even wild beasts had the instinct to seek fortune and avoid calamity. Ling Han’s gaze was too terrifying, making that wild beast feel the fear of being killed. It was like encountering a beast king whose cultivation level far exceeded its cultivation level, so it naturally had to flee.
Ling Han smiled. He did not use the murderous aura to attack with this glance, nor did he activate the might of the Celestial Cauldron. He merely focused his own essence, qi, and spirit
into this look.
This was the demeanor of an elite.
For example, did Buddha Doga need to deliberately channel aura to suppress others?
Ling Han didn’t give chase, and he continued to advance.
He did not have a clear destination, and merely strode forwards, wandering around.
However, there were far too many vicious beasts here, so Ling Han quickly came across another vicious wolf. However, its abilities were even weaker, and it was only at the Foundation Building Tier.
The moment it saw Ling Han, it slipped away with its tail between its legs.
With a thought from Ling Han, the divine light of illusion shot out, and that fierce beast immediately came to a halt.
It still maintained a running posture, but its body was motionless, appearing very strange. Meanwhile, its eyeballs were rapidly trembling, as it had entered into a nightmare.
The divine light of illusion would cause one to fall into an illusion without even knowing it. Even wild beasts were no exception.
Ling Han smiled, and with a wave of his hand, withdrew the power of illusion. That fierce wolf immediately began to run again, but it had not taken two steps, when it fell headfirst, landing
solidly.
Foundation Building Tier cultivators would also fall to the ground. This was truly rare, and it was clear just how powerful the divine light of illusion was.
Ling Han traversed mountains and ridges, experimenting with the wild beasts on his way, experiencing the amazing use of the divine light of illusion.
Two days later, he walked to the side of a lake.
The sky was high, and the waters were green. Ling Han suddenly came to an enlightenment,
and thus stopped. He sat on a rock by the lake, took off his shoes and socks, and placed his feet in the lake, enjoying the coolness of the lake waters.
“Hehe, what a weirdo. He’s actually playing in the water here.” A woman’s voice sounded.
Ling Han turned his head, only to see four people walking over from the distance. They were two men and two women.

The two men were slender, tall and handsome, and though the two women were beauties, their styles were completely different. One was petite and dainty, while the other had long legs, with a height that was not inferior to even men at all.
The tall beauty smiled, “Whatever he wants to do is his freedom. Don’t laugh at others.”
“Understood, Big Sister Yuan.” The petite beauty nodded.
“Hehe, washing one’s feet as a refresher in the Ten Thousand Beasts Mountains is very showy
in the first place. It’s no wonder that Little Qing would say that about him,” a man said. He was dressed completely in white.
The petite beauty received the white-robed man’s support, and she was instantly all smiles. She looked at the white-robed man lovingly.
Yet the man in white pretended not to notice, and merely turned his eyes on the tall beauty.
Yi, their relations were so chaotic.

chapters.title: Chapter 3917: Hero
paragraphs: Chapter 3917: Hero
To be honest, though these two women were both great beauties, the taller woman was clearly superior. Whether it was in terms of looks or bearing, she was superior in all aspects.𝐟𝚛𝕖𝚎𝕨𝗲𝐛𝚗𝐨𝐯𝐞𝕝.𝐜𝗼𝗺
“Let’s go.” The tall beauty smiled apologetically at Ling Han, then beckoned her companions to continue onwards.
“Ao!”
Right at this moment, a beast’s roar was heard, and a white-coloured fierce tiger charged out. Peng, peng, peng! Behind it, a field of trees collapsed.
“Be careful!”
The two men shouted at the same time, and drew their respective weapons, attacking the fierce tiger.
They both wielded swords, and two flashes of sword light swept past, turning into two dazzling ribbons that sliced towards the fierce tiger.

However, they had clearly underestimated the strength of this fierce tiger. The fierce tiger waved its claws, and pa, pa, the two flashes of sword light shattered at the same time, and the fierce tiger was still pouncing over, its speed not decreasing in the slightest.
“Not good, this fierce tiger is at least Seven Cauldrons!”
“Retreat!”
However, the wild beast had already pounced over, so how could they run?
The tall beauty gritted her teeth, plucked something from around her neck, and tossed it towards the wild beast.
Peng!
A ray of light flickered, turning into a cage that wrapped around the ferocious tiger.

The ferocious tiger jumped up and down, brandishing its claws and biting, wanting to break out of the cage. However, though this cage was made of light, it was like a rope that tightly bound the ferocious tiger, drawing it in tighter and tighter.
“Great!” The two men and the petite beauty cheered. A beast that was at least Seven Cauldrons had been subdued with a single move, so it was naturally something to rejoice about.
Meanwhile, the tall beauty showed an expression of heartache. That was one of her precious treasures for self-defense. She had not thought that it would be used so easily.
However, seeing that her companions were fine, she also smiled, revealing a gratified expression.
“Foolish brat, hurry up and thank Big Sister Yuan!” The petite beauty turned to Ling Han.
“If it wasn’t for Big Sister Yuan, you would have already entered the stomach of a tiger by now,” the white-robed man said.
Meanwhile, the other green-robed man revealed a reserved smile, as if he was conducting himself with dignity, and disdained from speaking with Ling Han.
Ling Han was astonished. Who had he offended?
He just had a sudden enlightenment and was washing his feet by the lake, comprehending the Eighteen Arhat Palm, so why was he repeatedly disturbed?

“I didn’t ask you to save me.” Ling Han spread his hands, looking like he was very detestable. The petite beauty and the others were instantly enraged. This person was really too ungrateful. He had clearly been saved, yet still had such an attitude. It was really infuriating. Even the tall beauty felt a sliver of displeasure. Though she had not wanted Ling Han to thank her when she made her move, you can’t be so ungrateful, right?
Ling Han smiled coldly. Who asked them to trifle with him? Just see if they wouldn’t be angered to death.
“This kind of person deserves to be eaten by a fierce beast!” the petite beauty declared angrily.
“What an ingrate!” The white-robed man shook his head.
The tall beauty shook her head, and said, “Forget it, let’s go.”
“Ao!”
However, right at this moment, another roar was heard. The trees collapsed, and a golden tiger suddenly pounced out.
“Not good!”
The expressions of the four changed drastically. The might of this fierce beast was even more frightening than the previous one, and was definitely not something that they could contend against.
The tall beauty hurriedly pulled out the jade hair clip from her hair. This was another powerful Spirit Tool.
Xiu, before she could even make a move, a figure streaked past, and with a heavy bang, the fierce golden tiger was sent flying.
A figure descended, standing with his hands clasped behind his back, exuding an endless
might.
“Big Brother Feng!”
All of a sudden, the four of them shouted loudly, incredibly overjoyed.
The person who had suddenly stepped out to save him was Feng Jixing. Under the gentle breeze, his hair fluttered slightly, and he had an indescribable air of ease and unrestrainedness.

Especially those two beauties. Their eyes were dazed, as if their hearts were about to melt. “He, this guy’s luck is really good. People have saved him time and time again.” The white- robed man looked towards Ling Han, revealing an expression of disgust.
This kind of guy deserved to be eaten by a fierce beast.
Feng Jixing’s eyes swept over them, and a hint of confusion appeared on his face.

The present Ling Han had already returned to his original appearance, so he didn’t recognize him. However, he kept feeling a sense of familiarity, but it was definitely not an old friend, but the kind that made him feel dislike.
Strange, he had clearly never seen it before, so why did he have such a feeling? Furthermore, what kind of existence was he? Who was qualified to be detested by him?
Ling Han saw Feng Jixing, and instantly, fighting spirit rose up in him. He smiled slightly, “What is it? Don’t recognize me anymore?”
“Brat, don’t flatter yourself. How are you worthy of getting to know Big Brother Feng!” the white-robed man immediately rebuked.
He had really had enough of this person.
“That’s right. Big Brother Feng is the number one prodigy of the North Heavenly Realm, and
is not someone that just any random person can cling to,” the petite beauty chimed in.
With a thought from Ling Han, his appearance immediately changed.
“It’s you!” Feng Jixing immediately revealed a baleful expression. This guy was actually the person that Song Lan had stepped out to protect!
His killing intent rose abruptly. Previously, he did not have the confidence to kill Ling Han, but it was a different case now. He had obtained a celestial light, and cultivated a Mystical
Power, which could match an Imperial Technique.
He would have his power suppressed, but the divine light would not.
Thus, he was absolutely confident that he could kill Ling Han this time.

“I’ve really searched far and wide for you, yet I still managed to find you so easily,” he said calmly. “I heard that you obtained three streaks of celestial light. Heh, your luck is truly heaven-defying!”
What!

The tall beauty and the others were all given a fright. That was celestial light, and that was the precious treasure of precious treasures. Obtaining one of them was enough to make one die of envy, and what kind of concept was obtaining three of them?
Even if he was as strong as Feng Xing, he had only obtained a streak of celestial light.
“What is it? Are you envious?” Ling Han asked with a smile.
Feng Jixing said proudly, “Hehe, only a minor character like you would be so fixated on the

number of celestial lights! Could it be that you don’t know that when breaking through to the Core Formation Tier, there is only one Celestial Cauldron that can nurture the Celestial Core, and the other Celestial Cauldrons will all become fertilizer.”
“Thus, even if you have refined three streaks of celestial light, so what? There is only one that can be preserved, and you would only be able to keep a single Mystical Power.”
“What difference is there between one celestial light and three celestial lights?”
Yi, going by that theory, wouldn’t it be meaningless to fuse nine streaks of celestial lights and refine into nine Mystical Powers?
Indeed, this Mystical Power had been obtained from the celestial light, and when the celestial light was extinguished, the Mystical Power naturally disappeared as well.
Ling Han thought for a moment, then shook his head. Buddha Doga was a Pseudo Emperor, so
why had he inserted three streaks of celestial light into his body?
Would a Pseudo Emperor do something meaningless?

celestial light.

state.

sentences.text: Chapter 3917: Hero
To be honest, though these two women were both great beauties, the taller woman was clearly superior.
Whether it was in terms of looks or bearing, she was superior in all aspects.𝐟𝚛𝕖𝚎𝕨𝗲𝐛𝚗𝐨𝐯𝐞𝕝.𝐜𝗼𝗺
“Let’s go.” The tall beauty smiled apologetically at Ling Han, then beckoned her companions to continue onwards.
“Ao!”
Right at this moment, a beast’s roar was heard, and a white-coloured fierce tiger charged out.
Peng, peng, peng!
Behind it, a field of trees collapsed.
“Be careful!”
The two men shouted at the same time, and drew their respective weapons, attacking the fierce tiger.
They both wielded swords, and two flashes of sword light swept past, turning into two dazzling ribbons that sliced towards the fierce tiger.
However, they had clearly underestimated the strength of this fierce tiger.
The fierce tiger waved its claws, and pa, pa, the two flashes of sword light shattered at the same time, and the fierce tiger was still pouncing over, its speed not decreasing in the slightest.
“Not good, this fierce tiger is at least Seven Cauldrons!”
“Retreat!”
However, the wild beast had already pounced over, so how could they run?
The tall beauty gritted her teeth, plucked something from around her neck, and tossed it towards the wild beast.
Peng!
A ray of light flickered, turning into a cage that wrapped around the ferocious tiger.
The ferocious tiger jumped up and down, brandishing its claws and biting, wanting to break out of the cage.
However, though this cage was made of light, it was like a rope that tightly bound the ferocious tiger, drawing it in tighter and tighter.
“Great!” The two men and the petite beauty cheered.
A beast that was at least Seven Cauldrons had been subdued with a single move, so it was naturally something to rejoice about.
Meanwhile, the tall beauty showed an expression of heartache.
That was one of her precious treasures for self-defense.
She had not thought that it would be used so easily.
However, seeing that her companions were fine, she also smiled, revealing a gratified expression.
“Foolish brat, hurry up and thank Big Sister Yuan!” The petite beauty turned to Ling Han.
“If it wasn’t for Big Sister Yuan, you would have already entered the stomach of a tiger by now,” the white-robed man said.
Meanwhile, the other green-robed man revealed a reserved smile, as if he was conducting himself with dignity, and disdained from speaking with Ling Han.
Ling Han was astonished.
Who had he offended?
He just had a sudden enlightenment and was washing his feet by the lake, comprehending the Eighteen Arhat Palm, so why was he repeatedly disturbed?
“I didn’t ask you to save me.” Ling Han spread his hands, looking like he was very detestable.
The petite beauty and the others were instantly enraged.
This person was really too ungrateful.
He had clearly been saved, yet still had such an attitude.
It was really infuriating.
Even the tall beauty felt a sliver of displeasure.
Though she had not wanted Ling Han to thank her when she made her move, you can’t be so ungrateful, right?
Ling Han smiled coldly.
Who asked them to trifle with him?
Just see if they wouldn’t be angered to death.
“This kind of person deserves to be eaten by a fierce beast!” the petite beauty declared angrily.
“What an ingrate!” The white-robed man shook his head.
The tall beauty shook her head, and said, “Forget it, let’s go.”
“Ao!”
However, right at this moment, another roar was heard.
The trees collapsed, and a golden tiger suddenly pounced out.
“Not good!”
The expressions of the four changed drastically.
The might of this fierce beast was even more frightening than the previous one, and was definitely not something that they could contend against.
The tall beauty hurriedly pulled out the jade hair clip from her hair.
This was another powerful Spirit Tool.
Xiu, before she could even make a move, a figure streaked past, and with a heavy bang, the fierce golden tiger was sent flying.
A figure descended, standing with his hands clasped behind his back, exuding an endless
might.
“Big Brother Feng!”
All of a sudden, the four of them shouted loudly, incredibly overjoyed.
The person who had suddenly stepped out to save him was Feng Jixing.
Under the gentle breeze, his hair fluttered slightly, and he had an indescribable air of ease and unrestrainedness.
Especially those two beauties.
Their eyes were dazed, as if their hearts were about to melt.
“He, this guy’s luck is really good.
People have saved him time and time again.” The white- robed man looked towards Ling Han, revealing an expression of disgust.
This kind of guy deserved to be eaten by a fierce beast.
Feng Jixing’s eyes swept over them, and a hint of confusion appeared on his face.
The present Ling Han had already returned to his original appearance, so he didn’t recognize him.
However, he kept feeling a sense of familiarity, but it was definitely not an old friend, but the kind that made him feel dislike.
Strange, he had clearly never seen it before, so why did he have such a feeling?
Furthermore, what kind of existence was he?
Who was qualified to be detested by him?
Ling Han saw Feng Jixing, and instantly, fighting spirit rose up in him.
He smiled slightly, “What is it?
Don’t recognize me anymore?”
“Brat, don’t flatter yourself.
How are you worthy of getting to know Big Brother Feng!” the white-robed man immediately rebuked.
He had really had enough of this person.
“That’s right.
Big Brother Feng is the number one prodigy of the North Heavenly Realm, and
is not someone that just any random person can cling to,” the petite beauty chimed in.
With a thought from Ling Han, his appearance immediately changed.
“It’s you!” Feng Jixing immediately revealed a baleful expression.
This guy was actually the person that Song Lan had stepped out to protect!
His killing intent rose abruptly.
Previously, he did not have the confidence to kill Ling Han, but it was a different case now.
He had obtained a celestial light, and cultivated a Mystical
Power, which could match an Imperial Technique.
He would have his power suppressed, but the divine light would not.
Thus, he was absolutely confident that he could kill Ling Han this time.
“I’ve really searched far and wide for you, yet I still managed to find you so easily,” he said calmly.
“I heard that you obtained three streaks of celestial light.
Heh, your luck is truly heaven-defying!”
What!
The tall beauty and the others were all given a fright.
That was celestial light, and that was the precious treasure of precious treasures.
Obtaining one of them was enough to make one die of envy, and what kind of concept was obtaining three of them?
Even if he was as strong as Feng Xing, he had only obtained a streak of celestial light.
“What is it?
Are you envious?” Ling Han asked with a smile.
Feng Jixing said proudly, “Hehe, only a minor character like you would be so fixated on the
number of celestial lights!

Could it be that you don’t know that when breaking through to the Core Formation Tier, there is only one Celestial Cauldron that can nurture the Celestial Core, and the other Celestial Cauldrons will all become fertilizer.”
“Thus, even if you have refined three streaks of celestial light, so what?
There is only one that can be preserved, and you would only be able to keep a single Mystical Power.”
“What difference is there between one celestial light and three celestial lights?”
Yi, going by that theory, wouldn’t it be meaningless to fuse nine streaks of celestial lights and refine into nine Mystical Powers?
Indeed, this Mystical Power had been obtained from the celestial light, and when the celestial light was extinguished, the Mystical Power naturally disappeared as well.
Ling Han thought for a moment, then shook his head.
Buddha Doga was a Pseudo Emperor, so
why had he inserted three streaks of celestial light into his body?
Would a Pseudo Emperor do something meaningless?
Thus, there was definitely a way to preserve the celestial lights.
Ling Han smiled faintly and said, “You’re sour because you can’t eat grapes.
I understand.
There’s no need to say anything else.”
Feng Jixing couldn’t help but feel angry.
Are you an idiot?
Didn’t you hear his analysis?
It is indeed a bit strong for you to possess three flashes of celestial light now, but as long as you have advanced into the Core Formation Tier, you would only be able to retain one flash of
celestial light.
“You can only talk tough.
Just see how I will take your life!” He strode towards Ling Han.
Boom, his aura surged without reservations.
He was going to kill Ling Han in his strongest
state.

chapters.title: Chapter 3918: Injured
paragraphs: Chapter 3918: Injured
“Big Brother Feng is about to make his move.”
“Ha, this brat is asking for a beating. It’s time to teach him a good lesson.”
“Hehe, he’s in big trouble now. With Big Brother Feng’s abilities, once he makes a move, that guy can only be beaten.”
The white-robed man and the others said one after another. Only the tall beauty was more reserved, and did not speak.

As he spoke, Feng Jixing had already come close enough. His aura was burning to the extreme, as if he was about to break through the threshold of Cauldron Forging Tier and break through to the Core Formation Tier.
In truth, his battle prowess was indeed only slightly inferior to the Core Formation Tier.
Ling Han remained calm and unruffled. He retracted his legs and stood there, with his pants rolled up to his knees. His feet were bare, and he didn’t look like a supreme prodigy at all.
“You are really arrogant!” Feng Jixing said coldly. He sent out a palm strike, and instantly, winds and clouds surged, great waves crashing onto the coast.
Ling Han did not use the might of the Celestial Cauldron. He was already Eight Cauldrons, so how could it be that it was still not capable of matching Feng Jixing’s strength?
Boom!
The two of them exchanged a blow, and both of them swayed. In terms of power, Feng Jixing was slightly superior, but the gap was already very small.
Pu!
The white-robed man and the others spluttered, their eyes wide with disbelief.

This was really too shocking. This was their Big Brother Feng, ranked 12th in Galaxy Network, and top in Cauldron Forging Tier of North Heavenly Realm, and there was actually someone that could contend against him?
Could it be that… this was Nangong Hao, the number two in Cauldron Forging Tier of North Heavenly Realm?
That’s not right. Nangong Hao was born with white hair, and he had always been a clean freak. How could he be like this person, sitting casually by the lake to wash his feet?
Feng Jixing’s expression involuntarily changed drastically. He had only gained a slight upper hand in this exchange.
It should be known that he was presently in his prime condition, and his abilities had not been weakened in the slightest.
Hiss, there was only one possibility!
The last time Ling Han had battled with him, he had not reached Nine Cauldrons yet. Now that Ling Han’s cultivation level had advanced another level, he was practically capable of matching him.
This was a great calamity!

Feng Jixing thought to himself. Though in terms of pure power, Ling Han was still inferior to him, the Celestial Cauldron of the latter was extremely bizarre, and could weaken his power. When the time came to fight again, he would instead be at a disadvantage in terms of power.
Of course, he thought that Ling Han was definitely Nine Cauldrons, and not Eight Cauldrons. This was his pride.
He charged out again, and the Eighteen Arhat Palm was unleashed, blasting towards Ling Han.

Several days had passed, and he was already able to unleash 50% of the might of this technique. Although Venerate Tier-level techniques were inferior to Saint-level and Imperial Techniques, at the level of Cauldron Forging Tier, such techniques wouldn’t be too far off even if they were inferior.
Hong! Hong! Hong!
Feng Jixing moved aggressively, wanting to defeat Ling Han with thunderous force.
Ling Han didn’t hold back either. He unleashed his Starlight Screen and blocked the attack. He then launched a powerful counterattack.

The Great Overarching Heaven Technique, Wind God Kick, Great Sun Soaring Palm, Eighteen Arhat Palm, Venerate Tier-level techniques were also unleashed, and they were continuously switched, changing according to his will, as if they were not a few independent techniques, but rather a complete set.
Feng Jixing was a little dazed from the beating, and for a moment, he was actually suppressed, appearing battered and exhausted.
No way.
The white-robed man and the others didn’t dare to believe it. The invincible Big Brother Feng in their eyes was actually being beaten down on? Furthermore, this person wasn’t a Core
Formation Tier, but merely a Cauldron Forging Tier.
This was too inconceivable.
“Humph!” Feng Jixing smirked coldly. He finally summoned his Spirit Tool. A flash of sword light swept past, and with a swoosh, the Starlight Screen was immediately shattered.
What terrifying destructive power.
Ling Han was astonished. The grade of this sword wasn’t low.

“This is a replica of the Saint Tool, Star Cloud Sword, but the material used to forge it is seven stars!” Feng Jixing said proudly, “Additionally, I have fused a sliver of my divine sense into it, and it has become my life-bound Spirit Tool, invincible in Cauldron Forging Tier!”
He felt slightly regretful. The Galaxy Level Battles did not include the factor of Spirit Tools. Otherwise, with his strength and the Star Cloud Sword, how could he only be ranked 12th?
Of course, now that he had advanced into Nine Cauldrons, he could definitely enter the top ten without relying on the Star Cloud Sword.
“Come!” Ling Han still hadn’t summoned the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower.
“Arrogant!” Feng Jixing sneered. He had already summoned his precious tool, yet Ling Han was still unarmed. Just how arrogant was he?
However, this was just right. What he wanted was only Ling Han’s life, and not a fair battle.

He moved, sword in hand. As the Star Cloud Sword slashed out, even the air itself was torn apart, revealing multiple whirlpools that looked like black holes. The sword intent soared into the skies, as if it wanted to cut down even the stars in the skies.
This naturally was impossible. It would only be possible if it was the real Star Cloud Sword, and it would have to depend on who was using it.

Ling Han let out a battle cry, and the barrage of murderous aura shot out. Even if it was Feng Jixing, so what? He immediately fell into a momentary daze. When he came back to his senses, he saw that Ling Han’s fist had already smashed over.
If it was another person, they would probably only be able to spread out mystical power on their face and take this attack head-on.
However, how could Feng Jixing be ordinary?
He gave a loud shout, and the space between his brows split open. A strange seal was actually projected, forcibly freezing Ling Han’s fist.
This was completely unreasonable. It was not some astonishing power at all, but merely caused Ling Han to pause.
However, this seal also disappeared in a flash. Ling Han instantly regained his freedom, and
continued to deliver a punch.
Feng Jixing grabbed this instant of opportunity and immediately retreated, dodging Ling
Han’s punch.
After this exchange, both of them looked stunned.
Ling Han had not thought that Feng Jixing would actually have mastered such a secret
technique, and could actually forcefully stop his own attack. That was definitely not an incredibly strong power, which was incredibly bizarre.

Feng Jixing had never imagined that Ling Han’s methods would be so terrifying, to actually cause his thoughts to stagnate for an instant, forcing him to use his ultimate move. The two of them were quite apprehensive. What ultimate technique had the other grasped?
“Since you’ve grasped three flashes of divine light, let me experience it,” Feng Jixing said. He
raised his hand, and pa, a white light shot over at an indescribable speed.
This was the divine light that he had cultivated after fusing with the celestial light.
Ling Han raised his hand and shot out the light of lightning.
Pa!
The divine light clashed with the divine light, and after this exchange, both sides were
instantly destroyed.

However, there was also a difference in celestial lights. For example, the first bolt of lightning that Ling Han had grasped was the most powerful, capable of matching the Imperial Technique, but Divine Water Yin Lightning and Second Wood True Lightning were slightly
inferior.
The might of Feng Jixing’s divine light was about the same as Divine Water Yin Lightning, Second Wood True Lightning, and so on.

He had precisely used the Ice Fire Yang Lightning to dissipate the other’s attack. “Take a strike from me too!” Ling Han snapped his fingers, and zi, the Second Wood True Lightning shot out, turning into a green lightning bolt that struck towards Feng Jixing.
Feng Jixing hurriedly formed a seal with his hands to protect himself.
Peng!
His whole person was sent backwards, and there was smoke rising from his hands. He had suffered a little in this exchange.
The number one Cauldron Forging Tier elite of North Heavenly Realm was actually wounded in a battle of equal cultivation levels!

chapters.title: Chapter 3919: Fleeing in defeat
paragraphs: Chapter 3919: Fleeing in defeat
The white-robed man and the others were all petrified.
They all widened their eyes, completely unable to believe their eyes.
Feng Jixing was actually injured!
How was this possible?
Feng Jixing’s expression was dark, and there was also a hint of anger.

He had not thought that the divine light that Ling Han had grasped would actually be so powerful, and he, the number one elite of Cauldron Forging Tier of the North Heavenly Realm, had actually suffered a loss in a battle of equal cultivation levels. This caused him great humiliation.

He was secretly filled with resentment. If he hadn’t been comprehending the Fiery Sun Subduing Demon Staff Technique, then the person that Buddha Doga had chosen definitely wouldn’t have been Ling Han.
In Feng Jixing’s eyes, it was Ling Han who had stolen his great opportunity.
And now, the more powerful the divine light that Ling Han shot out was, the more displeased he was. He felt like someone had stolen something that belonged to him.
-He had worked so hard, and almost died, and had only managed to capture a streak of celestial light, but what about Ling Han?
Without putting in the slightest effort, he had already obtained three streaks!
Unfair, absolutely unjust!
He roared loudly, and charged towards Ling Han again.
Hong, he channelled out a fist technique, its might fierce, even surpassing Eighteen Arhat Palm.
Ling Han responded calmly. He disdained from using divine light to bully his opponent, and merely used his own battle prowess to his heart’s content, exchanging blows with Feng Jixing.
It had to be admitted that Feng Jixing was indeed strong.
He confronted Ling Han head-on, not falling into a disadvantage at all. Occasionally, he would slash out with his sword, the cold light dazzling, causing even Ling Han to almost be hit.
The two of them seemed to have reached a tacit understanding, and neither of them used any more divine light.
It was naturally Feng Jixing that had the upper hand. Thus, he definitely wouldn’t shatter this agreement first. He would only unleash his own strength.
The more they fought, the more wary Feng Jixing became.

It should be known that Ling Han had not used the might of the Celestial Cauldron. Once he used this move, his battle prowess would drop drastically, and he would be completely outmatched by Ling Han.
How could there be such a freakish Celestial Cauldron? Even the Celestial Cauldron that he could no longer evolve with divine substance could not resist it?
So be it if he couldn’t suppress him, but he couldn’t even resist. Just how wide was the gap between them?
Thus, Ling Han definitely had to die.

Feng Jixing was waiting for a chance to unleash his full power. At that time, he would unleash his most powerful attack together with the divine light, and Ling Han would instantly be condemned to eternal damnation. He wouldn’t even have the chance to use the Celestial Cauldron.
Boom!
The two great prodigies exchanged blows, their battle incredibly intense.
The white-robed man and the others finally accepted the fact that there was another prodigy in the North Heavenly Realm that could match Feng Jixing.

What a joke. Previously, they had actually been provoking and mocking Ling Han. Thankfully, he was magnanimous, and did not lower himself to their level. Otherwise, they would definitely have long since died, with grass already growing on their graves.
It was now!
Feng Jixing suddenly launched an attack. His forehead split open, revealing a seal. This was completely unreasonable, and Ling Han was instantly restrained, unable to move the slightest bit.
“It’s all over!” Feng Jixing humphed. His right hand shot out a Saint Technique, while his left hand shot out a ray of light. It was a divine light.
In such a state, Ling Han couldn’t even move a muscle. How could he still be alive after sustaining two extremely powerful attacks?
At this moment, a smile appeared on Ling Han’s face.
What!
A feeling of foreboding rose up in the depths of Feng Jixing’s heart, yet he could not figure out what was not right.
Boom, a terrifying energy surged past, and exploded on Ling Han’s body, instantly blasting Ling Han into smithereens.
“Hahaha!” Feng Jixing laughed loudly, and he had thought that Ling Han had some powerful move up his sleeve.
This troublesome guy had finally died, killed by his own hands. In future, he would no longer be a match for him.
However, wasn’t this too easy?
Feng Jixing thought for a while, and various details instantly appeared in his mind.
There seemed to be something off.

Realization suddenly dawned on him, and he immediately sent out a palm strike. Instantly, vicious might overflowed, instantly surpassing the Cauldron Forging Tier, reaching the level of Core Formation Tier, and then surpassing, surpassing, surpassing, comparable to the Great
Emperor Tier.
This was… an illusion!𝐟𝗿𝐞𝚎𝚠𝐞𝚋𝕟𝐨𝚟𝐞𝕝.𝕔𝕠𝚖

You are kind?

he was 100% sure that this guy was extremely two-faced, and had absolutely nothing to do

They all widened their eyes, completely unable to believe their eyes.
Feng Jixing was actually injured!
How was this possible?
Feng Jixing’s expression was dark, and there was also a hint of anger.

He had not thought that the divine light that Ling Han had grasped would actually be so powerful, and he, the number one elite of Cauldron Forging Tier of the North Heavenly Realm, had actually suffered a loss in a battle of equal cultivation levels.
This caused him great humiliation.
He was secretly filled with resentment.
If he hadn’t been comprehending the Fiery Sun Subduing Demon Staff Technique, then the person that Buddha Doga had chosen definitely wouldn’t have been Ling Han.
In Feng Jixing’s eyes, it was Ling Han who had stolen his great opportunity.
And now, the more powerful the divine light that Ling Han shot out was, the more displeased he was.
He felt like someone had stolen something that belonged to him.
-He had worked so hard, and almost died, and had only managed to capture a streak of celestial light, but what about Ling Han?
Without putting in the slightest effort, he had already obtained three streaks!
Unfair, absolutely unjust!
He roared loudly, and charged towards Ling Han again.
Hong, he channelled out a fist technique, its might fierce, even surpassing Eighteen Arhat Palm.
Ling Han responded calmly.
He disdained from using divine light to bully his opponent, and merely used his own battle prowess to his heart’s content, exchanging blows with Feng Jixing.
It had to be admitted that Feng Jixing was indeed strong.
He confronted Ling Han head-on, not falling into a disadvantage at all.
Occasionally, he would slash out with his sword, the cold light dazzling, causing even Ling Han to almost be hit.
The two of them seemed to have reached a tacit understanding, and neither of them used any more divine light.
It was naturally Feng Jixing that had the upper hand.
Thus, he definitely wouldn’t shatter this agreement first.
He would only unleash his own strength.
The more they fought, the more wary Feng Jixing became.
It should be known that Ling Han had not used the might of the Celestial Cauldron.
Once he used this move, his battle prowess would drop drastically, and he would be completely outmatched by Ling Han.
How could there be such a freakish Celestial Cauldron?
Even the Celestial Cauldron that he could no longer evolve with divine substance could not resist it?
So be it if he couldn’t suppress him, but he couldn’t even resist.

chapters.title: Chapter 3920: Sixth Celestial Light
paragraphs: Chapter 3920: Sixth Celestial Light
Ling Han walked in the mountains. When he encountered wild beasts, he would sometimes make a move, and at other times, he would find it troublesome, and choose to ignore them.

Of course, whether he found it troublesome or not was completely dependent on whether the wild beast was delicious. If it was delicious, he would definitely not find it troublesome. However, when encountering a vicious beast on the level of Core Formation Tier, he could only take a different path. Even if he was Eight Cauldrons, that would not be enough to deal with the early stage of the Core Formation Tier, what more when there was no shortage of middle stage, late stage, or even consummate stage Core Formation Tiers here.
A few days later, Ling Han saw a streak of golden light streak across the sky at an astonishing speed.
Celestial light!
A thought streaked through his mind, but before he could do anything, that light had already swept past. He could not catch up to it at all.
‘F*ck! It’s so quick! How can I capture it?!’
Another day later, he encountered that celestial light again. He had just moved, when shua, the golden light had already flown past, and there was no way to catch it.
What could he do?
Unless this streak of light stopped, it would be impossible for him to catch up. Then, what was the point of talking about capturing it?
Ling Han frowned upon hearing this. What in the world was he supposed to do?
Yi, could he use that illusory divine light?
The divine light of illusion could allow living beings to enter into an illusion, then could it also do the same to celestial light?
Ling Han’s expression was filled with curiosity. He waited patiently.
However, that celestial light actually did not appear.
Ling Han was helpless, and could only wait for the celestial light to appear, while he searched for Celestial medicine and divine substance.
His luck could be considered both good and bad.

Bad luck was easy to understand. He had not been able to see that streak of light again these few days, and the good luck was that he had found a great many Celestial medicines, and there was even a considerable amount of divine substance, which was enough to drive anyone crazy. Seven days later, he encountered a fierce battle between two fierce beasts. The shockwaves of energy swept over, and he couldn’t help but frown. This had surpassed the level of the Core Formation Tier, and should be the True Self Tier.

His first reaction was naturally to leave. If he was targeted by a True Self Tier elite, he might not even have the chance to flee. He would be forced to crush his token and leave the Mystery Realm to save himself.
However, a streak of light streaked across the skies.
Celestial light!
Ling Han immediately shouted internally. Then, he almost cursed, because this streak of light actually circled above the battle between the two fierce beasts, looking like it wanted to watch a show.
Er, celestial lights would also watch the excitement?
Ling Han hesitated. Should he leave now, or take the risk to capture the celestial light?
This streak of light was too fast. If he missed it this time, who knew when he would encounter it again.
‘Then I’ll take a risk.’

Ling Han wanted to use the Void Beast hide to cover his body, and quietly approach, but when the True Self Tier beasts battled fiercely, the shockwaves created by the battle were also incredibly terrifying, easily beating him out of his disguise.
-The Void Beast hide could only cause him to disappear from the field of vision and divine sense, but could not disappear from the range of even attacks.
Ling Han gritted his teeth, and decided to just go over like this.
The two fierce beasts were battling fiercely, so they probably wouldn’t care about a minor character like him, right?
He advanced very slowly, showing that an ant like him was completely harmless.

As expected, the two True Self Tier fierce beasts were battling fiercely, and had absolutely no time to pay attention to a minor character like him. A casual gust of wind would be enough to kill him, so what need was there for them to be concerned?𝘧𝓇𝑒𝑒𝑤ℯ𝑏𝓃𝘰𝑣ℯ𝘭.𝘤ℴ𝘮
Good.
Ling Han drew closer, and couldn’t help but break out in a cold sweat.

The closer he got, the more terrifying the shockwaves from the battle became. He had no choice but to activate his Starlight Screen to block the shockwaves. However, it was still on the verge of collapse.
There was a gap of two major cultivation levels between them, so even if it was just the aftermath of the battle, he would not be able to bear it.
Ling Han sighed internally. This was the suppression of cultivation level, and there was nothing he could be angry about.
However, he had finally come close enough.
That golden ray of light did not seem to care about him at all, and merely revolved around the
skies.
Very good. With a thought from Ling Han, the divine light of illusion was shot out.
This was divine sense-level, and it surpassed all speed. As long as it was within the range of attack, it could arrive no matter how far it was.
Instantly, the streak of multicolored light in the sky stopped, as if it was dumbfounded.
Ling Han immediately flew on his Tool. Xiu! He soared straight into the sky, then used the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower to store the golden light away.

“Ang!” The roar of a beast rang out from behind him. It was clear that the transmission of sound could not compare to Ling Han’s speed, but this roar, driven by the terrifying power of the ferocious beast, had surpassed supersonic speed.
A fierce beast moved, and spat out a ray of light at Ling Han.
He had to flee quickly.
Ling Han hurriedly ran, while at the same time, Primal Chaos Qi emanated from him. He formed Starlight Screen and entered into his strongest defensive stance.
Obviously, his speed could not possibly be faster than the attack of a True Self Tier, so he could only take it head-on.
Thankfully, that fierce beast was presently in the midst of a great battle. It had only attacked because it was annoyed at a “fly” like him, so it naturally would not go all out.
Peng!

He was hit, and the outer layer of Primal Chaos Qi immediately crumbled. Meanwhile, the Starlight Screen was also instantly shattered. This ray of light continued to attack, striking Ling Han’s body. However, Ling Han was still wearing internal armor, and once again had the
effect of defense.
He had robbed many people, so there was naturally no shortage of such things like armor. Previously, he had worn them all.
Pa, pa, pa! His inner armor shattered layer by layer. Pu! Ling Han’s lower abdomen was
pierced through.
Thankfully, Ling Han thought. Thankfully, he had set up layers of defense, and this light had only pierced through him. Otherwise, if the energy twisted, his whole person would be
shattered.
Even so, his vitality was still severely wounded, and his injuries were extremely severe.
Forget it.
Ling Han flew on his Tool, and descended towards the ground. Then, using the Imminent Skyline, he quickly left.
He was really just a minor character, so after that fierce beast delivered a blow, it did not pay any more attention to him. Instead, it began another intense battle with the other fierce
beast.
After running far enough, Ling Han finally stopped. He hurriedly found a tree hollow to hide in, and began to heal his injuries.
Being pierced through by a True Self Tier vicious beast, this wasn’t something as simple as
having one more hole, but rather leaving a foreign energy inside his body that was wreaking havoc and destroying his vitality.
This was also one of the reasons why the fierce beast didn’t pursue him. It thought that Ling Han would definitely die from this attack.
If it was another person, the pressure would definitely be huge, and he would need a few

months to recover. However, for an alchemist like Ling Han, the thing he lacked the least was medicine. He took out an alchemical pill and ingested it. Then, he channelled Ancient Sun Divine Scroll, expelling the foreign energy in his body.
This was a high-level energy that was filled with destructive power. Furthermore, it was extremely fine, and was extremely difficult to remove.
Ling Han didn’t lack patience. He slowly expelled the foreign energy, allowing his body to
slowly recover.
He had already grasped the celestial light and completed his mission, so there was no rush at
all. He would just take his time.
One day, two days, three days… Eleven days passed, and Ling Han finally expelled all the foreign energy. Then, his wounds began to heal.
His expression was strange, because after eleven days, his cultivation level had increased
greatly. Why?

That was because he had ingested no small number of Celestial medicines in the process of healing his injuries. A portion of the medicinal effects was used for healing, and another portion was used for forging the Celestial Cauldron.
All right, he began to refine the celestial light, forming the sixth divine light.

chapters.title: Chapter 3921: True Self Tier Great Herb
paragraphs: Chapter 3921: True Self Tier Great Herb
Ling Han released the golden light from the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower.
Immediately, he shot out the illusory divine light, causing this golden light to once again sink into an illusion, and be unable to react.
Now, Ling Han was certain that the might of the divine light of illusion was far beyond his imagination.
It could even affect other celestial lights; this was too shocking.
He began to refine the golden celestial light. The Celestial Cauldron opened, swallowing this celestial light and fusing with it.
The speed was very slow, but Ling Han was not in a hurry either.

This celestial light appeared to be dazzlingly golden, and should be of the Metal Element, but in truth, it was a bolt of lightning. It only had the Metal Element, and was the Heptagold Yang Lightning.

Every time the Heptagold Yang Lightning was about to “awaken”, Ling Han would immediately use the divine light of illusion to attack it, causing this celestial light to once again sink into an illusion, completely unable to resist.
It wasn’t difficult at all, aside from being slightly slower.
No matter how slow it was, it would end. Three days later, Ling Han had succeeded.
Six divine lights!

A smile appeared on Ling Han’s face. Aside from the Primal Chaos Divine Lightning, the might of the other four bolts of lightning were slightly inferior, and could only be comparable to a Saint Technique. However, when all five bolts of lightning were used at the same time, it was equivalent to a young Great Emperor leading four young Saints to gang up on his opponent. Who could withstand that?
Moreover, he also had the divine light of illusion, which was even more terrifying, causing people to die inexplicably.
He exited the tree hollow, left the Ten Thousand Beasts Mountains, and returned to the city.

Though there was still a large amount of Celestial medicines here that had not been harvested, that was no longer the main point. Ling Han still needed three streaks of celestial light, so every Celestial Cauldron would fuse with one streak of celestial light. This was the most important thing.
He continued to check to see if there were any other places where the celestial light had appeared.
In truth, there were many legends about celestial light.

It was said that in the Dark Abyss, there were several flashes of light of death. Even a cultivator of the Core Formation Tier would immediately turn into a dried corpse upon coming into contact with them.
There was also the Blazing Flame Valley, where divine light flickered in the sky-burning flames, and there was nothing that could not be burned.
Ling Han conducted a selection process, and very soon, he decided to go to Black Tortoise Island.
This was an island that had just emerged from the seabed. From afar, it looked like a giant turtle that was floating on the water’s surface.
And after some old antiques had flipped through the ancient records, they were very sure that this was where the Divine Beast, the Black Tortoise had died.

The Black Tortoise was the descendant of the Divine Beast, Xuanwu. Thus, its bloodline was naturally slightly inferior as well. It could not be considered a real Divine Beast, but could only be considered a Subsidiary Divine Beast.

It was said that the Black Tortoise had two attributes, Water and Earth. After it died, it would definitely be able to nourish tCelestial medicine. Thus, the Black Tortoise Island was a Medicinal Garden, and its value was so great that it was heaven-defying. Furthermore, since it was a Subsidiary Divine Beast, there was naturally also the cultivation technique of a Divine Beast, and for Demonic Beasts, this was a supreme inheritance.

This island had just risen from the seabed for three days, but countless forces had already left upon hearing the news. There were even a great many old monsters that had moved out, hoping to obtain a Great Herb that could help them break through or extend their lifespan there.
It was also rumored that there was celestial light streaking around the island.
A celestial light had appeared on the island where the Divine Beast had died. The quality of this celestial light should be higher, right?
Thus, Ling Han decided to go to Black Tortoise Island.
He left as he said he would. He set out on his journey, first arriving at the coast, and then flew on his Tool.

There were many fierce beasts on the sea, and there was no shortage of Core Formation Tier elites, True Self Tier great beasts, so it was extremely unsafe to travel by ship or tread on the sea. Thus, Ling Han gave up the idea of using Imminent Skyline to speed up the journey.
If one flew on a Tool, their speed would indeed be slightly slower, but the advantage was that it was safe.
Two days later, an island appeared on the horizon. It gradually enlarged, as if it was a continent.
This island really looked like a turtle. On one side, it stuck out its head, and on the other, there was a tail. It was completely oval in shape.
Xiu, he hadn’t even flown too close, and Ling Han only felt a powerful pressure. Instantly, he fell down from the skies, and plopped into the sea.
Ling Han hurriedly treaded on the waves and arrived near the island.
There was no beach on this island, and there were steep walls all around, as if they had been sliced by a saber.
Ling Han began to climb, and after some effort, he finally reached the top. He saw that this was a dense forest, and there was a majestic mountain ahead of him. Its height was
astonishing.
Yi, so fragrant!
Ling Han took a sniff. He could smell the fragrance of herbs.
As the Alchemy Emperor, he could immediately confirm that this was a Great Herb.

He had not come especially for Celestial medicine, but since they had encountered each other, there was naturally no reason for him to give up. He moved upon smelling the fragrance, heading towards where the Celestial medicine was.
After passing through a small forest, a small clearing appeared in front of him. Then, he saw a tiny deer standing there, scratching its neck with its hind hoof.
Yi, this medicinal fragrance was clearly coming from this tiny deer.
Ling Han activated his ocular technique, and this tiny deer instantly became transparent.
There was no organ or blood in its body. Rather, it was a whole being.
As it turned out, this was the Celestial medicine, which had only taken the form of a deer.𝕗𝚛𝚎𝚎𝐰𝗲𝗯𝗻𝚘𝚟𝚎𝗹.𝕔𝐨𝕞
Ling Han immediately leaped out, but the tiny deer was also extremely alert. It broke into a
run, and as its hooves galloped, its speed was astonishingly fast.
Ling Han hurriedly set off in pursuit, following closely behind.
This tiny deer was extremely slippery as it circled around the large trees and boulders, preventing Ling Han from making full use of his advantage in speed.
Heh, then let’s have a taste of the divine light of illusion.

This was an attack on the level of divine sense. With a mere thought from Ling Han, the divine light of illusion had already shot out, and landed on the tiny deer. Instantly, the tiny deer’s movements came to a halt. Then, with a flash, it turned into a ginseng. It was as thick as a child’s arm, and was completely golden in colour, exuding an alluring fragrance.
This was a Great Herb, True Self Tier-level, at least.

Ling Han swept over, and had just picked up the ginseng. Xiu, he immediately pounced forwards, and saw that there was already a deep pit where he had been standing, and there was presently dense energy seething.

He looked to the side, and saw three young people walk out. They were all men. Two of them were Cauldron Forging Tiers, but one of them was shockingly a Core Formation Tier elite. Furthermore, his aura was still very unstable, so it was obvious that he had not broken
through for very long.
“Put down the Celestial medicine, and I can spare your life,” the young man who was in the Core Formation Tier said calmly. There was a hint of arrogance in his voice.
Ling Han searched through his mind, and suddenly came to a realization. “You’re Li Shiming,
right?”
“That’s right!” The Core Formation Tier cultivator nodded.
Li Shiming, ranked 89th on the list of Cauldron Forging Tiers in the Galaxy Network.
However, he had already broken through to the level of Core Formation Tier.

Being able to rank in the top 100 of the Cauldron Forging Tier, how powerful would he be after advancing into the Core Formation Tier? Even Feng Jixing was far from being a match for him! Thus, he was naturally arrogant, and had enough qualifications.
“Now that you know who I am, why don’t you leave the Celestial medicine and scram!” Li
Shiming shouted.
“Did you hear that? My Brother Li is a busy man. He doesn’t have time to waste on you!” one
of his lackeys said.
“Faster, faster!” The other lackey also said impatiently.
Ling Han cracked a smile, “What if I don’t hand it over?”
“Then your only fate would be death!” Li Shiming attacked without any scruples.
The present him should be invincible among outsiders.
Ling Han hurriedly activated the Imminent Skyline. With a turn of his body, he dodged Li
Shiming’s attack.
This made Li Shiming extremely displeased.

He had just broken through to the Core Formation Tier not too long ago, and now that he had broken through, he was naturally a hundred times more confident. However, now that he had made a move, Ling Han managed to dodge, which was equivalent to slapping him across the
face.

chapters.title: Chapter 3922: Leaving Calmly
paragraphs: Chapter 3922: Leaving Calmly
Li Shiming flew into a thunderous rage, and quickly set off in pursuit of Ling Han, wanting to blast Ling Han into smithereens.

Top-notch prodigies naturally mastered high-level movement techniques. When Li Shiming was Cauldron Forging Tier, his speed was probably only slightly inferior to Ling Han’s. Now that he had advanced into the Core Formation Tier, his speed naturally increased to another level, completely surpassing Ling Han.
He rapidly approached, and delivered a palm strike at Ling Han’s back.
Ling Han humphed as he unleashed his divine light of illusion. Li Shiming was instantly struck, and entered a dazed state.
However, a Core Formation Tier was far too powerful. If Ling Han attacked him at this moment, he would definitely instinctively counterattack. That would be far from good.
The divine light of illusion was not used like this.
Ling Han set his eyes on the other two young men. At present, he was still unable to kill the main culprit, so he would kill these two lackeys first.
What!
The other two young men were shocked. Why had their “Brother Li” suddenly become stupid and stopped attacking?
The two of them looked at each other, and hurriedly ran towards Li Shiming.
Ling Han was far too bizarre, and this caused them to feel a sense of apprehension.
However, when they neared Li Shiming, the fool-like Li Shiming suddenly moved. Shua! His hands shot toward one of them.

How could the two of them have imagined that Li Shiming would make a move on them? They were completely unguarded. Furthermore, Li Shiming was a Core Formation Tier cultivator, so even if they were prepared, so what?
What the f*ck!
Pa, pa! They were all mangled by Li Shiming’s palm strike.
Er, Ling Han rubbed his chin in thought. Why was he snatching away his business?

“You!” At this moment, Li Shiming suddenly came back to his senses. After all, the divine light of illusion had been activated by Ling Han, so its might had been greatly reduced. Thus, it had much less influence on Core Formation Tier cultivators.
Ling Han spread his hands, “This has nothing to do with me. You were the one who killed them.”

Li Shiming was furious. He naturally knew that he had fallen into Ling Han’s illusion, and that was why he had accidentally killed his own people. The problem was, he, a dignified Core Formation Tier, had actually fallen into the illusion of a Cauldron Forging Tier. How could he bring himself to complain?
If word of this got out, he would definitely be laughed at by others!
He suppressed his anger, and a strong killing intent rose up in him.
“Die!”
He charged over, and shot out a palm strike, intending to crush Ling Han into dust.
Ling Han hurriedly ran. At present, he was still no match for a Core Formation Tier cultivator, especially a prodigy like Li Shiming.
Li Shiming gave chase. His speed was even faster than Ling Han’s, and it wasn’t long before he caught up to him.
With a thought from Ling Han, the murderous aura surged out.
Li Shiming paused for a moment before immediately returning to normal. He continued to pursue Ling Han.

As expected, though the barrage of murderous aura was awesome, its effects on high-level cultivators was considerably inferior. This was more suitable for group battles. As long as one’s cultivation level was lower than his, no matter how many of them came, a murderous aura would be shot out, and they would be instantly struck.
“Mere tricks!” Li Shiming sneered. This only made him pause for a moment, and had almost no effect.
Ling Han smiled, and the divine light of illusion shot out once more.
Li Shiming instantly fell into a daze. He was lost in his illusion again.
He would seek this guy out for an accounting in the future.
Ling Han immediately dashed into the distance.

The natural and earthly energy on the island was extremely abundant, so the trees here grew astonishingly tall. Large trees that were several hundred meters tall could be seen everywhere, and even ordinary grass could grow to the height of a few people.
Ling Han searched around the island. There were many people here, and there were even more people rushing over. Battle after bloody battle broke out for the Celestial medicine.
Seven days passed, and Ling Han still did not find any trace of the celestial light. However, he was presently refining the Celestial Ginseng that he had previously plucked.
He did not touch the main ginseng, but merely ate some roots.
It couldn’t be helped. This was a True Self Tier-level Great Herb. If he directly ingested the main ginseng, the only result would be overdoing it and killing himself.
This was really a Great Herb. Even if it was just a few roots, they were extremely nutritious, allowing Ling Han’s cultivation level to advance rapidly.
He had already formed a leg for his eighth cauldron, and how long had it been since he had advanced into Eight Cauldrons?
At this rate, he would be able to reach the consummate level of Eight Cauldrons in a month’s time, at most, and break through to the Nine Cauldrons.

The island was filled with fierce battles. There were many Celestial medicines here, and they were all extremely valuable. They could easily make a Core Formation Tier or even a True Self Tier cultivator battle to the death. Additionally, everyone was also searching for the place where the Black Tortoise died.
A Divine Beast should have left behind quite a lot of good stuff.
Ling Han was in no hurry. It would be best if he could find the place of death of the Black Tortoise only after he advanced into Nine Cauldrons. In that way, his competitiveness would
be much stronger.

Geniuses and prodigies gathered here. Song Lan, Prosperous Heaven, Feng Jixing, and so on all arrived. Furthermore, quite a number of young prodigies had even broken through to the Core Formation Tier. This caused super geniuses like Feng Jixing and the other prodigies to be unable to keep up.
The competition became even more intense, and the outcome to be even more uncertain.

Ling Han kept a very low profile. He was just looking for celestial light, and digging the Celestial medicine here and there. Coincidentally, he also encountered divine substance. As time passed, his cultivation level was also increasing.
Another dozen over days later, a big piece of news came out.
-The place of death of the Black Tortoise had been found!
Instantly, everyone headed in that direction.

The Black Tortoise was the descendant of Xuanwu. Though it was not a real Divine Beast, it must have inherited the bloodline of the Divine Beast, and according to legends, the Black Tortoise Divine Beast had mastered the strongest defensive technique in the world.
Black Tortoise Earth Technique, close to invincible defense.
According to legends, when the creation of heaven and earth began, the Divine Beasts were first born. They were nurtured by the heaven and earth, and they were all Ancestral King-level
beings.

However, the Ancestral King’s lifespan wasn’t unlimited, so these Divine Beasts also died one after another. The heaven and earth weren’t as crazy anymore. Afterward, there was only one Ancestral King in each generation, invincible in the world.
If the Black Tortoise Earth Technique really existed here, then even an Imperial Clan would be moved, and Saints would also move, wanting to learn it.
Ling Han thought for a moment, but did not move out. Instead, he continued to circle around
outside.

At present, there were really too many cultivators of the Core Formation Tier here. Even the old monsters of the True Self Tier had been mobilized. Thus, his cultivation level of =mere Eight Cauldrons was too weak.
He wanted to first cultivate to Nine Cauldrons. This would increase his abilities by an additional bit. Then, if a fight really broke out, his chances of obtaining it would naturally be
much higher.
Of course, this was because he possessed a True Self Tier-level Great Herb, which allowed him
to quickly cultivate and forge the Celestial Cauldron.
If this was known to others, they would definitely scold him for being wasteful. This was a treasure that could greatly improve the cultivation level of a True Self Tier

cultivator. In fact, it could even help one break through the barrier to the next cultivation level. It was indescribably valuable, and now, it was actually used by a Cauldron Forging Tier cultivator to improve his cultivation level. Just how much of a waste was this?
However, how could Ling Han possibly care? His own strength was the true way to go. Everything else was useless.
His luck was not too bad. Though he did not find any more Great Herbs, there was still a considerable amount of divine substance.
Another dozen over days later, Ling Han finally reached the consummate level of Eight
Cauldrons.
Without waiting for him to begin breaking through, the island trembled violently. He
followed the tracks, and saw a large number of people running out of the cave, all of them
battered and exhausted.
Not long after, a colossal White Snake slithered out of the hole. With a twist, a few Core Formation Tier cultivators were instantly crushed into minced meat.
