This caused super geniuses like Feng Jixing and the other prodigies to be unable to keep up.
The competition became even more intense, and the outcome to be even more uncertain.
Ling Han kept a very low profile.
He was just looking for celestial light, and digging the Celestial medicine here and there.
Coincidentally, he also encountered divine substance.
As time passed, his cultivation level was also increasing.
Another dozen over days later, a big piece of news came out.
-The place of death of the Black Tortoise had been found!
Instantly, everyone headed in that direction.
The Black Tortoise was the descendant of Xuanwu.

Though it was not a real Divine Beast, it must have inherited the bloodline of the Divine Beast, and according to legends, the Black Tortoise Divine Beast had mastered the strongest defensive technique in the world.
Black Tortoise Earth Technique, close to invincible defense.
According to legends, when the creation of heaven and earth began, the Divine Beasts were first born.
They were nurtured by the heaven and earth, and they were all Ancestral King-level
beings.
However, the Ancestral King’s lifespan wasn’t unlimited, so these Divine Beasts also died one after another.
The heaven and earth weren’t as crazy anymore.
Afterward, there was only one Ancestral King in each generation, invincible in the world.
If the Black Tortoise Earth Technique really existed here, then even an Imperial Clan would be moved, and Saints would also move, wanting to learn it.
Ling Han thought for a moment, but did not move out.
Instead, he continued to circle around
outside.
At present, there were really too many cultivators of the Core Formation Tier here.
Even the old monsters of the True Self Tier had been mobilized.
Thus, his cultivation level of =mere Eight Cauldrons was too weak.
He wanted to first cultivate to Nine Cauldrons.
This would increase his abilities by an additional bit.
Then, if a fight really broke out, his chances of obtaining it would naturally be
much higher.
Of course, this was because he possessed a True Self Tier-level Great Herb, which allowed him
to quickly cultivate and forge the Celestial Cauldron.
If this was known to others, they would definitely scold him for being wasteful.
This was a treasure that could greatly improve the cultivation level of a True Self Tier
cultivator.
In fact, it could even help one break through the barrier to the next cultivation level.
It was indescribably valuable, and now, it was actually used by a Cauldron Forging Tier cultivator to improve his cultivation level.
Just how much of a waste was this?
However, how could Ling Han possibly care?
His own strength was the true way to go.
Everything else was useless.
His luck was not too bad.
Though he did not find any more Great Herbs, there was still a considerable amount of divine substance.
Another dozen over days later, Ling Han finally reached the consummate level of Eight
Cauldrons.
Without waiting for him to begin breaking through, the island trembled violently.
He
followed the tracks, and saw a large number of people running out of the cave, all of them
battered and exhausted.
Not long after, a colossal White Snake slithered out of the hole.
With a twist, a few Core Formation Tier cultivators were instantly crushed into minced meat.

chapters.title: Chapter 3923: Nine Cauldrons
paragraphs: Chapter 3923: Nine Cauldrons
The White Snake was incredibly powerful, and it started a massacre.

This was a True Self Tier fierce beast, and its strength was incredibly strong. Even if there were a considerable number of True Self Tier old monsters here, they were still not the slightest bit on the upper hand against this White Snake.

Under normal circumstances, encountering this White Snake would naturally mean fleeing, but now, it involved the inheritance of the Divine Beast. That was a different story. None of them were willing to give up, and wanted to fight this powerful White Snake to the death.
Ling Han decided to join in. He shot out a divine light of illusion.

For a True Self Tier cultivator, this kind of illusion could be instantly broken through, but no matter how fast it was broken through, the White Snake was still affected, greatly reducing everyone’s pressure.
“Ha, I’ve found you!” With a cold humph, Feng Jixing silently appeared, approaching Ling
Han.
Ling Han looked over, and couldn’t help but frown.
Core Formation Tier!
This guy actually broke through, and advanced into a new level of being.
Ling Han did not hesitate in the slightest, and shot out a divine light of illusion towards Feng Jixing. Then, he turned and fled.

For a prodigy like Feng Jixing, once he advanced into the Core Formation Tier, his battle prowess would probably be able to match the middle stage of the Core Formation Tier, and he would be completely outmatched.

The divine light of illusion was too awesome. Even if Feng Jixing had advanced into the Core Formation Tier, so what? He had still fallen into an illusion, a smile curling up the corners of his lips, as if he had already killed Ling Han.
He immediately woke up, and with a loud roar, set off in pursuit of Ling Han.
Ling Han activated Imminent Skyline, and the murderous aura barrage and divine light of illusion overlapped, quickly throwing Feng Jixing off his tail.

He felt a strong sense of urgency. By now, Feng Jixing had already advanced into the Core Formation Tier, and his battle prowess completely overwhelmed him. He too had to break through as soon as possible, and only then would he be qualified to resist.
Ling Han retreated far away, found a hidden place, and began to cultivate in seclusion, breaking through to Nine Cauldrons.

In this period of time, everyone was still battling fiercely with the White Snake, and the battle was so intense that even the mountains were shaking and the ground was shaking. However, Ling Han acted as if he had not felt anything, and merely immersed himself in breaking through to Nine Cauldrons.
This was the last barrier in Cauldron Forging Tier.
After calming his mind and spirit for seven days, Ling Han finally reached his prime condition, and began to charge towards Nine Cauldrons.
This time, the pressure was immense.
The eight Celestial Cauldrons released a powerful repulsive force, stopping the formation of the ninth cauldron.

Ling Han didn’t use the power of the living beings in the dimensions inside his body, because even Feng Jixing could cultivate to Nine Cauldrons, so how could it be that he still had to rely on the power of the living beings in the dimensions inside his body?
How could he possibly lose to Feng Jixing?
Ling Han forcibly forged the core of the Celestial Cauldron. At the beginning, he naturally failed repeatedly, but he learned from his failures. Three days later, a smile appeared on his face.
The core of the ninth cauldron, success!
This meant that he had already advanced into Nine Cauldrons, and was standing on the last step of the Cauldron Forging Tier.
Right now, was he qualified to battle against Core Formation Tier?
Ling Han came out of seclusion. He planned to check out the battle situation, and see how the battle with White Snake was going.
He rushed to the cave entrance, and saw that there were many pools of blood left here, as well as pieces of scales. These should have fallen off the body of the White Snake.
The battle had already ended.

There were still people healing their injuries outside, so Ling Han went over to investigate the situation. He found out that the battle between them and the White Snake had continued all the way until the afternoon of the day before yesterday. The White Snake had finally exhausted all its power, and had no choice but to flee from the island. Now, its whereabouts were unknown.
Thus, everyone took this opportunity to once again enter into the cave.
Ling Han also strode into the cave.
This mountain cave was very big, and the top was at least thirty over meters tall. Standing there, Ling Han instantly appeared very insignificant.
After walking for a while, a crossroads appeared, and there were also crossroads further down the crossroads, turning this cave into a labyrinth.
Ling Han soon met others. It was an old man and a young man. They had already walked here for more than a day, and had long lost their way. They were about to return to the exit.
As he walked, he outlined the terrain here in his mind. After three days, this labyrinth was gradually and completely outlined in his mind.
He found the right path, and continued to walk downwards.
After walking for close to two hours, there was no path ahead, but there was a spring. It was very big, big enough for people to squeeze in.
Ling Han didn’t hesitate as he entered the spring and continued to advance.
So cold.
This water was icy cold, and even Ling Han felt a chill. Thankfully, he could still withstand it. Another hour later, Ling Han suddenly broke through the water’s surface.
He was still in the cave, but there was a path ead
again.
Ling Han continued onwards, but as he walked, the path ahead of him suddenly opened up, revealing a valley. Green mountains and clear waters, the scenery as beautiful as a painting.
Yi?
This was clearly still on Black Tortoise Island, but because flight was not possible on the island, this place was cut off from the rest of the world, and could only be reached through an
underwater passage.
Hong! Hong! Hong!
The shockwaves of battle could be felt ahead of him, and it was extremely intense.𝓯𝙧𝓮𝓮𝒘𝓮𝙗𝙣𝒐𝒗𝒆𝓵.𝓬𝓸𝒎
Had the inheritance of the Divine Beast appeared, and caused a great battle?
Ling Han hurriedly quickened his steps. He swept into the valley, and soon saw a large group
of people.
There were outsider prodigies such as Feng Jixing, Song Lan and Prosperous Heaven. There were also native elites who were battling fiercely, and what they were fighting over was
actually a nest of eggs.
What a bunch of gluttons!
Ling Han thought to himself as he continued to dash forward.
Not everyone was fighting, because those who were attacking now were all in the Core Formation Tier. How could Cauldron Forging Tiers have the right to interfere?
It was not just Feng Jixing. Those like Song Lan and Prosperous Heaven had also advanced

into Core Formation Tier. They had probably obtained enough divine substance, and increased the grade of the Celestial Cauldrons to the level of “perfection”. They had also formed nine cauldrons, so what else were they waiting for if they still did not break through
into Nine Cauldrons?
There was no True Self Tier here, and it was unknown whether those old monsters had gone further ahead or were circling around in the labyrinth behind them.
“Isn’t it just a few eggs? Is there any need to fight over them like this?” Ling Han shuffled
over to one of them.
This was a beautiful woman, and she was given a scare by Ling Han.
-Who wouldn’t be shocked to see a person appear soundlessly from the sidelines?
And this was only just to say something. What if he wanted to molest her?
She hurriedly took a few steps back, and looked at Ling Han with a vigilant gaze.
“Who is it that dares to be so rude to Fairy Liu!” She was not alone. There was still an escort by
her side, and he rebuked Ling Han angrily.
The beauty, on the other hand, recovered. Waving her hand, she said, “Forget it.”
Only then did those people drop the matter, but the gazes they directed at Ling Han were still
extremely unfriendly.

“Those are eggs laid by the White Snake. That’s why they’re fighting over it. As long as you drip your own blood before the baby snakes hatch, it’s extremely likely that the baby snakes will recognize you as their master and you would obtain a powerful pet beast,” the beauty
took the initiative to explain.
So that was the case.

The White Snake was indeed strong. It was also a True Self Tier elite, and could match the combined attacks of a considerable number of old monsters of the same cultivation level. Furthermore, the living creatures here grew extremely fast, and could reach the True Self Tier in a few dozen years. Very soon, they would become a source of help. “Thank you.” He nodded at the beauty.
“Humph, so what if you know? Those participating in the competition are Feng Jixing, Zhao Wuji, and Nangong Hao. If you go up, you’ll instantly lose your life,” a young man couldn’t
help but mock.

chapters.title: Chapter 3924: Taking something out of one’s pocket
paragraphs: Chapter 3924: Taking something out of one’s pocket
Yi, Zhao Wuji and Nangong Hao?
Nangong Hao was the number two person of Cauldron Forging Tier in North Heavenly Realm, only inferior to Feng Jixing. Of course, this person had now already advanced into Core Formation Tier.
He was very recognizable, with a head of white hair.
Ling Han soon found the corresponding person. That was a young man. In fact, he was extremely handsome. Coupled with his white hair, he didn’t look old. Instead, he had a unique charm.
There was also Zhao Wuji.
This was a rising star. It was said that he was very powerful, and had been compared to Feng Jixing.
This Ling Han did not recognize, because there were over a dozen men in the battle royale. Aside from Feng Jixing and Nangong Hao, there were still over a dozen.
Ling Han was eager to give it a try. Just how strong was he at Nine Cauldrons?
Xiu, he leaped out.
Those who were watching the battle were all dumbfounded. How could there be such a person who was rushing to his death?

“Hiss, this guy is really too easily provoked, isn’t he? I only said a few words to him, and he really rushed up?” The young man that had previously mocked Ling Han murmured. His words had always been harsh, and he was not deliberately targeting Ling Han, but was doing this to everyone.
“Sigh!” The others all shook their heads. Barging into the battle royale of the Core Formation Tier elites was a suicidal action.𝙛𝓻𝒆𝓮𝒘𝙚𝙗𝒏𝙤𝙫𝓮𝒍.𝓬𝒐𝙢
However, their eyes soon widened in disbelief.
What had they seen?
Ling Han walked like he was walking on flat land in the chaotic battle, and was rapidly approaching that nest of snake eggs.

“How dare you!” Those who were battling fiercely all discovered Ling Han. Feng Jixing immediately revealed blazing killing intent, while Song Lan was surprised. As she saw it, Ling Han had disappeared for a very, very long time, and only appeared suddenly at this moment.
Most people didn’t recognize Ling Han, appearing extremely confused. A mere Cauldron Forging Tier cultivator actually dared to barge in?
However, this Cauldron Forging Tier was truly extraordinary. It was unimaginable that he could remain unscathed even in the chaotic battle between the Core Formation Tier cultivators.
Feng Jixing was extremely wary of Ling Han, and he immediately charged over.
Half a month passed, and he had also completely stabilized his cultivation level. The might of this palm strike had clearly increased.
Ling Han clenched a fist and replied with a punch.
Boom!

The two of them exchanged a blow, and Ling Han was instantly sent flying. However, he immediately turned around and landed on the ground, baring his teeth endlessly. He had suffered a great loss in this blow, and felt like even his bones were about to shatter. However, this scene rendered everyone speechless. F***, this was too freakish, wasn’t it? “Though Feng Jixing has just advanced into the Core Formation Tier, he has cultivated Nine Cauldrons in the Cauldron Forging Tier. Furthermore, the quality of the Celestial Cauldron is astonishing. After stabilizing his cultivation level, his battle prowess is at least at the Third Heaven.”
“To be able to take a blow from him without being injured, this Cauldron Forging Tier’s battle prowess must be First Heaven.”
“Hiss, a Cauldron Forging Tier that has the battle prowess of Core Formation Tier!”

Though the Core Formation Tier only had four stages-the early stage, the middle stage, the late stage, and the consummate stage-how could the battle prowess of two people at the early stage be the same when one broke through from Heaven Cauldron and the other from Nine Cauldrons? Also, could the breakthrough with a Bronze Cauldron, Golden Cauldron, Nine-Coloured Glass Cauldron be the same?

Thus, there would be a reference value for the battle prowess of Core Formation Tier elites, which would be quantified by Heavens. For example, Feng Ji Xing had just advanced into the Core Formation Tier, and once he stabilized his cultivation level, he had reached the battle prowess of Third Heaven. Moreover, the majority of people would have to reach the pinnacle of the early stage of Core Formation Tier, close to the middle stage, and only then would they be able to reach the battle prowess of Third Heaven.
Everyone was discussing spiritedly, and then did not dare believe it.
There should be an insurmountable gulf between Cauldron Forging Tier and Core Formation Tier, which could not be breached no matter what.
This was because the highest limit of Cauldron Forging Tier was Nine Cauldrons, and whichever Nine Cauldrons could not possibly possess the battle prowess of the Core
Formation Tier. No matter how stunning he was.
However, Ling Han broke this iron rule.
What a monster.
Feng Jixing’s expression changed drastically. Of course, it was not because of Ling Han’s strength, but rather the significance behind it.
The current Ling Han should have advanced into Nine Cauldrons.

Hiss, when this guy was in the Eight Cauldrons, he was already capable of matching himself in Nine Cauldrons, and once he advanced into Nine Cauldrons, he even possessed the battle prowess of the Core Formation Tier, even if it was only the weakest First Heaven.
Kill, he definitely had to kill him. If this guy was allowed to advance into the Core Formation Tier, just how terrifying would his battle prowess be?
Fourth Heaven? Fifth Heaven?
Feng Jixing charged towards Ling Han again. His willpower was firm, and his eyes were filled with killing intent.
Ling Han sighed. Though he had the power to match the weakest Core Formation Tier, it was obvious that Feng Jixing was not the weakest Core Formation Tier.
He moved, and headed towards that nest of snake eggs. At the same time, he shot out a murderous aura attack, causing Feng Jixing’s movements to involuntarily slow down.

“Humph! No matter how freakish you are, you’re still nothing more than a Cauldron Forging Tier!” the white-haired Nangong Hao said coldly. With a twist of his right hand, he also launched an attack at Ling Han.

His Galaxy Network ranking was only inferior to Feng Jixing’s, and now that he had advanced into the Core Formation Tier, who was stronger or weaker between him and Feng Jixing would only be discovered after they had battled.
The might of this palm strike was domineering, and had similarly reached Third Heaven.
Ling Han was unmoved. He shot out a murderous aura attack. No matter how freakish you were, so what? You were still hit, and the attack immediately stopped.
Seeing Ling Han continue to pounce, everyone was filled with disbelief.

Two top-notch prodigies were sniping at him separately, and furthermore, they had the advantage of a major cultivation level, and this still allowed Ling Han to break out of the siege calmly. Just what kind of fantasy was this?

However, everyone was fighting over the snake eggs, and seeing that Ling Han was already close enough, how could the others possibly continue to be surprised? They hurriedly moved one after another. Even Song Lan and Prosperous Heaven were no exception.
Ling Han laughed loudly. Divine light of illusion activated, and instantly, everyone was hit, falling into their own illusions.
Though he had succeeded with a single move, Ling Han also stumbled, almost collapsing.
Attacking a dozen or so Core Formation Tier elites in one go, even if he was only activating the divine light of illusion, was still too straining.
But in the next instant, Ling Han rushed out again, and arrived next to the snake eggs. In a single move, he grabbed all the snake eggs.
These were living eggs and couldn’t be stored into a Spatial Spirit Tool. Thus, it could only be
hidden on his body.
However, these snake eggs were all larger than a fist, and Ling Han couldn’t fit them into his robes either, so he could only throw down a few.
This also decreased the aggro, preventing all the Core Formation Tier cultivators from
chasing after him.
“Ling Han!” Song Lan shouted. She had already woken up from the illusion, and she charged over with her sword in hand.
Prosperous Heaven wasn’t far behind either. She was the Buddhist Race’s Holy Daughter and Holy Daughter, and she was skilled at bewitching people’s minds. She had a strong resistance
against illusions.
There was also Feng Jixing and Nangong Hao, who quickly struggled out of the illusion, and
charged towards Ling Han again.
Ling Han couldn’t withstand the combined attacks of so many Core Formation Tier elites. With a battle cry, he used Imminent Skyline and fled.
Some chased after him, while others didn’t. Instead, they were fighting over the remaining snake eggs.
-The division strategy had succeeded.
As they watched Ling Han run off, the Cauldron Forging Tiers who were watching from the sidelines all gaped, completely rendered speechless.
In their eyes, Ling Han was no longer a human, but rather a god.
He was too handsome. Taking treasures from a group of Core Formation Tiers was like taking
something out of one’s pocket; was there any other person in this world that could do it?
He was so handsome, so cool.
It wasn’t long before the pursuers all returned in disappointment. To Ling Han, who possessed the murderous aura and divine light of illusion, breaking free from the pursuit was
completely no big deal.

“Sigh!” The others all shook their heads.
Barging into the battle royale of the Core Formation Tier elites was a suicidal action.𝙛𝓻𝒆𝓮𝒘𝙚𝙗𝒏𝙤𝙫𝓮𝒍.𝓬𝒐𝙢
However, their eyes soon widened in disbelief.
What had they seen?
Ling Han walked like he was walking on flat land in the chaotic battle, and was rapidly approaching that nest of snake eggs.
“How dare you!” Those who were battling fiercely all discovered Ling Han.
Feng Jixing immediately revealed blazing killing intent, while Song Lan was surprised.
As she saw it, Ling Han had disappeared for a very, very long time, and only appeared suddenly at this moment.
Most people didn’t recognize Ling Han, appearing extremely confused.
A mere Cauldron Forging Tier cultivator actually dared to barge in?
However, this Cauldron Forging Tier was truly extraordinary.
It was unimaginable that he could remain unscathed even in the chaotic battle between the Core Formation Tier cultivators.
Feng Jixing was extremely wary of Ling Han, and he immediately charged over.
Half a month passed, and he had also completely stabilized his cultivation level.
The might of this palm strike had clearly increased.
Ling Han clenched a fist and replied with a punch.
Boom!
The two of them exchanged a blow, and Ling Han was instantly sent flying.
However, he immediately turned around and landed on the ground, baring his teeth endlessly.
He had suffered a great loss in this blow, and felt like even his bones were about to shatter.
However, this scene rendered everyone speechless.
F***, this was too freakish, wasn’t it?
“Though Feng Jixing has just advanced into the Core Formation Tier, he has cultivated Nine Cauldrons in the Cauldron Forging Tier.
Furthermore, the quality of the Celestial Cauldron is astonishing.
After stabilizing his cultivation level, his battle prowess is at least at the Third Heaven.”
“To be able to take a blow from him without being injured, this Cauldron Forging Tier’s battle prowess must be First Heaven.”
“Hiss, a Cauldron Forging Tier that has the battle prowess of Core Formation Tier!”

Though the Core Formation Tier only had four stages-the early stage, the middle stage, the late stage, and the consummate stage-how could the battle prowess of two people at the early stage be the same when one broke through from Heaven Cauldron and the other from Nine Cauldrons?
Also, could the breakthrough with a Bronze Cauldron, Golden Cauldron, Nine-Coloured Glass Cauldron be the same?
Thus, there would be a reference value for the battle prowess of Core Formation Tier elites, which would be quantified by Heavens.
For example, Feng Ji Xing had just advanced into the Core Formation Tier, and once he stabilized his cultivation level, he had reached the battle prowess of Third Heaven.

Moreover, the majority of people would have to reach the pinnacle of the early stage of Core Formation Tier, close to the middle stage, and only then would they be able to reach the battle prowess of Third Heaven.
Everyone was discussing spiritedly, and then did not dare believe it.
There should be an insurmountable gulf between Cauldron Forging Tier and Core Formation Tier, which could not be breached no matter what.
This was because the highest limit of Cauldron Forging Tier was Nine Cauldrons, and whichever Nine Cauldrons could not possibly possess the battle prowess of the Core
Formation Tier.
No matter how stunning he was.
However, Ling Han broke this iron rule.
What a monster.
Feng Jixing’s expression changed drastically.
Of course, it was not because of Ling Han’s strength, but rather the significance behind it.
The current Ling Han should have advanced into Nine Cauldrons.

Hiss, when this guy was in the Eight Cauldrons, he was already capable of matching himself in Nine Cauldrons, and once he advanced into Nine Cauldrons, he even possessed the battle prowess of the Core Formation Tier, even if it was only the weakest First Heaven.
Kill, he definitely had to kill him.
If this guy was allowed to advance into the Core Formation Tier, just how terrifying would his battle prowess be?
Fourth Heaven?
Fifth Heaven?
Feng Jixing charged towards Ling Han again.
His willpower was firm, and his eyes were filled with killing intent.
Ling Han sighed.
Though he had the power to match the weakest Core Formation Tier, it was obvious that Feng Jixing was not the weakest Core Formation Tier.
He moved, and headed towards that nest of snake eggs.
At the same time, he shot out a murderous aura attack, causing Feng Jixing’s movements to involuntarily slow down.
“Humph!
No matter how freakish you are, you’re still nothing more than a Cauldron Forging Tier!” the white-haired Nangong Hao said coldly.
With a twist of his right hand, he also launched an attack at Ling Han.

His Galaxy Network ranking was only inferior to Feng Jixing’s, and now that he had advanced into the Core Formation Tier, who was stronger or weaker between him and Feng Jixing would only be discovered after they had battled.
The might of this palm strike was domineering, and had similarly reached Third Heaven.
Ling Han was unmoved.
He shot out a murderous aura attack.
No matter how freakish you were, so what?
You were still hit, and the attack immediately stopped.
Seeing Ling Han continue to pounce, everyone was filled with disbelief.
Two top-notch prodigies were sniping at him separately, and furthermore, they had the advantage of a major cultivation level, and this still allowed Ling Han to break out of the siege calmly.
Just what kind of fantasy was this?
However, everyone was fighting over the snake eggs, and seeing that Ling Han was already close enough, how could the others possibly continue to be surprised?
They hurriedly moved one after another.
Even Song Lan and Prosperous Heaven were no exception.
Ling Han laughed loudly.
Divine light of illusion activated, and instantly, everyone was hit, falling into their own illusions.
Though he had succeeded with a single move, Ling Han also stumbled, almost collapsing.
Attacking a dozen or so Core Formation Tier elites in one go, even if he was only activating the divine light of illusion, was still too straining.
But in the next instant, Ling Han rushed out again, and arrived next to the snake eggs.
In a single move, he grabbed all the snake eggs.
These were living eggs and couldn’t be stored into a Spatial Spirit Tool.
Thus, it could only be
hidden on his body.
However, these snake eggs were all larger than a fist, and Ling Han couldn’t fit them into his robes either, so he could only throw down a few.
This also decreased the aggro, preventing all the Core Formation Tier cultivators from
chasing after him.
“Ling Han!” Song Lan shouted.
She had already woken up from the illusion, and she charged over with her sword in hand.
Prosperous Heaven wasn’t far behind either.
She was the Buddhist Race’s Holy Daughter and Holy Daughter, and she was skilled at bewitching people’s minds.
She had a strong resistance
against illusions.
There was also Feng Jixing and Nangong Hao, who quickly struggled out of the illusion, and
charged towards Ling Han again.
Ling Han couldn’t withstand the combined attacks of so many Core Formation Tier elites.
With a battle cry, he used Imminent Skyline and fled.
Some chased after him, while others didn’t.
Instead, they were fighting over the remaining snake eggs.
-The division strategy had succeeded.
As they watched Ling Han run off, the Cauldron Forging Tiers who were watching from the sidelines all gaped, completely rendered speechless.
In their eyes, Ling Han was no longer a human, but rather a god.
He was too handsome.
Taking treasures from a group of Core Formation Tiers was like taking
something out of one’s pocket; was there any other person in this world that could do it?
He was so handsome, so cool.
It wasn’t long before the pursuers all returned in disappointment.
To Ling Han, who possessed the murderous aura and divine light of illusion, breaking free from the pursuit was
completely no big deal.

chapters.title: Chapter 3925: Battling Tong Yongning
paragraphs: Chapter 3925: Battling Tong Yongning

For Ling Han, collecting these snake eggs was only something he did in passing. His target was not these beast pets, even if they could become the battle prowess of True Self Tier not too many years later.
Ling Han pursued individual strength. For beast pets, he would take them if they came his way, but if they did not, he would not deliberately pursue them.
If Feng Jixing and the others knew about this, they would definitely die of fury.
-If you don’t care, then what are you snatching them for?

Ling Han rubbed his chin. His current battle prowess had indeed reached the early stage of the Core Formation Tier, but Feng Jixing and the other powerful prodigies possessed battle prowess that was close to the middle stage of the Core Formation Tier once they had broken through to the Core Formation Tier. They still left him far behind.
It couldn’t be helped. This was the suppression of the major cultivation level.

Ling Han felt a sense of urgency. He had to gather all nine celestial lights as soon as possible, and then break through to the Core Formation Tier. At that time, with how strong his battle prowess was, would Feng Jixing still be worthy of being his opponent?
“Haha, I’ve finally found you!” A long laugh rang out, filled with pleasure.
‘Hmm?’

Ling Han turned around, and couldn’t help but smile. The visitor was actually Tong Yongning. He wasn’t alone, but had four clansmen with him. Naturally, they were all youngsters in the Foundation Building Tier.
“Brat, you can still smile when you see me?” Tong Yongning asked coldly.
“Why can’t I smile?” Ling Han countered.

“You can’t fly on a Tool here, so you’re dead meat!” Tong Yongning said with a smug smile. The three Core Formation Tier elites chased Ling Han into the Black Heaven Temple, yet they still couldn’t find him. However, they didn’t expect to encounter Ling Han here.
How could a mere Cauldron Forging Tier cultivator that couldn’t fly on a Tool escape from his grasp?
“Where are the other two Core Formation Tier cultivators in your clan?” Ling Han asked. “Despicable villain, Third Uncle alone is enough to deal with you!” A member of the Tong Clan interrupted.
In the eyes of the four of them, Ling Han was naturally already a corpse.

Ling Han shook his head, and said, “When adullts are speaking, why are children interrupting?” He waved his hand, and a burst of power shot out, turning into a green palm that was no different from the size of a human hand. It struck out at that junior from the Tong Clan.
“How dare you!” Tong Yongning humphed coldly, and shot out a palm strike, intercepting that green palm.
Peng!
The two forces clashed, and both were instantly annihilated.
‘What?’
Tong Yongning immediately looked stunned. Although he hadn’t used his full power in this strike, he should have still been able to crush Ling Han. How could both of the attacks have been destroyed?

Previously, though Ling Han had the means to resist the early stage of the Core Formation Tier, that was a bolt of lightning, which was similar to the might of the Spirit Tool. It was definitely not his own battle prowess, but this attack was definitely a collision of mystical power.
Hiss, a Cauldron Forging Tier cultivator actually had the power to oppose a Core Formation Tier cultivator?
What a huge joke!

He was extremely stunned there, but those four clansmen of the Tong Clan were completely unclear about the situation. They only saw that Ling Han’s attack had been easily dispersed by Tong Yongning, but they had no idea how much force Tong Yongning had exerted.
Hence, the four of them sneered repeatedly, looking down on Ling Han completely.
“Third Uncle, this villain is too bold. He still dares to make a move in front of you.”
“That’s right. Please apprehend him, Third Uncle!”
They all called out, wanting nothing more than to personally rush up and fight Ling Han.
Tong Yongning took a deep breath to calm himself down.
Cauldron Forging Tier was only Cauldron Forging Tier, after all. There was absolutely no way they could oppose a Core Formation Tier. That had to be the case.
Ling Han smiled faintly, “Third Brother Tong, are you going to apprehend me?”
“It would be as easy as the turn of a palm!” Tong Yongning moved, and charged towards Ling
Han.
Ling Han used Imminent Skyline to dodge, easily and freely.

“The Tong Clan is truly overbearing!” he said with a shake of his head. “I was perfectly fine as I stood by the side of the road, yet you people actually controlled a large ship to crash into me. You didn’t manage to crash into me, and you even came down to hunt me down.”
“Heh, who gave you people the audacity to do this?”

Being reprimanded by him like this, Tong Yongning’s expression was very ugly. So what if the Tong Clan was overbearing? Who asked you to be a mere Cauldron Forging Tier? However, a Cauldron Forging Tier was actually so hard to kill, and this was what made him feel embarrassed.
“Enough with the nonsense! Die!” he roared. He unleashed a barrage of attacks at Ling Han. Ling Han continued to dodge, and said, “Third Brother Tong, do you believe that karma exists in this world?”
Tong Yongning didn’t speak at all. He only had one thought, and that was to kill Ling Han so that this brat would never be able to speak.

“Evil has its retribution, and this has been proven time and time again.” Ling Han said calmly, “However, it is better to depend on oneself than on others. Today, I will kill you, and collect some interest!”
“Haha!” Tong Yongning sneered. In front of him, Ling Han was completely unable to fight back, and he still dared to speak conceited nonsense?
“Despicable villain, you can only wait to be killed!”
“Close your eyes and accept your death. This can allow you to die a more painless death.”
The four clansmen of the Tong Clan all called out. As they saw it, Ling Han was naturally dead for sure. It was only a matter of time.
Ling Han smiled faintly, and made no further move to dodge. Instead, he clenched his right hand into a fist, and greeted Tong Yongning’s attack.
“Humph, you really don’t know the immensity of heaven and earth!” Tong Yongning smirked coldly. A mere Cauldron Forging Tier cultivator actually wanted to confront him head-on;
where did he get such courage from?
Boom!
Ling Han’s fist greeted Tong Yongning’s left palm. Instantly, power surged, and the remaining power of Core Formation Tier surged out, turning into tumultuous waves.
“Wu!” “Ah!”
The four clansmen of the Tong Clan all released terrible cries, and were sent flying by this
shockwave.
The attack landed, and the energy gradually subsided.
Those four people were only sent flying, but were not injured. They hurriedly got back to their
feet, yet saw a scene that caused their scalps to go numb.
Ling Han stood proudly, his bearing captivating.
How was this possible!
How could a mere Cauldron Forging Tier cultivator be qualified to stand against a Core
Formation Tier cultivator?
The sun had risen from the west?
“How could this be!” Tong Yongning also exclaimed in shock. Previously, he had blocked Ling

Han’s attack. Though he had also sensed how strong Ling Han was, Ling Han had been dodging all this while after that, making him think that it was possible that Ling Han had channeled a secret technique, and that was why he had temporarily exploded with such great power. He could only deliver a single strike.
However, in the exchange of blows with Ling Han just now, he discovered that the latter’s power was surging fiercely, and was not inferior to him at all.
“You’re clearly only at the Cauldron Forging Tier, so how can your power reach the First
Heaven?”
Ling Han smiled faintly, “Because I am a prodigy!”
These words were extremely pretentious. Who would have the nerve to praise themselves like
this?
But no matter who it was, as long as they had witnessed that scene just now, they would not
say that Ling Han was shameless.
-A Cauldron Forging Tier was capable of resisting a Core Formation Tier, and no matter how pretentious he was, it would not be too much.
Tong Yongning frowned deeply. This wasn’t a prodigy; this was clearly a monster.
“Who cares what prodigy or freak you are? The Cauldron Forging Tier is ultimately just the
Cauldron Forging Tier. Just see how I will kill you!” He charged over again, and the battle prowess of the Core Formation Tier was completely unleashed.
Ling Han was unafraid. He used the Eighteen Arhat Palm, and exchanged blows with Tong𝒻𝓇𝑒𝘦𝘸𝑒𝒷𝓃ℴ𝑣𝘦𝑙.𝒸ℴ𝘮
Yongning.
“Yi!”
Tong Yongning was astonished. Why did Ling Han also know this secret technique?
It should be known that he had also entered into the Black Heaven Temple and learnt this fist
technique, but he clearly hadn’t seen Ling Han at that time.
Then how had Ling Han learned this secret technique?
“How did you learn it?” he couldn’t help but ask.
“You guess,” Ling Han said with a smile.
Tong Yongning naturally wouldn’t guess. He sneered and channeled the Eighteen Arhat Palm,
clashing with Ling Han.

chapters.title: Chapter 3926: Killed
paragraphs: Chapter 3926: Killed
“Don’t think that only you can do it!” Tong Yongning shouted loudly.

He also had to use the Eighteen Arhat Palm. He had no choice but to use it, because this fist technique was Venerate Tier-level. If he used an ordinary technique to oppose it, he would definitely be at a great disadvantage.
In a situation when power was equal, the stronger the technique, the greater the advantage, and may even be the deciding factor.
Boom!
The secret techniques of the Buddhist Race clashed. In just a few moves, it was clear who was stronger.
Tong Yongning could only unleash 30% of the might of the Eighteenth Arhat Palm, while Ling Han could unleash 60%.
This was definitely a crushing advantage.
Instantly, Tong Yongning was at a disadvantage, and could only parry.
The four members of the Tong Clan were all watching dumbfounded. What was going on here?
How could there be such a freakish guy?
Ling Han laughed loudly, and moved aggressively, suppressing Tong Yongning to the point that Tong Yongning had no temper at all.
Both of them were using the same technique, so there was nothing much to say. Whoever grasped it more proficiently would naturally have an advantage.

However, Tong Yongning clearly knew that the technique he had mastered was far from being as proficient as Ling Han’s. He was at too much of a disadvantage, yet could only drink poison to quench his thirst. This was because although he could unleash 100% of the might of other techniques, the level of the technique itself was too weak. 100% of the might could not compare to 30% of the Eighteen Arhat Palm.

He released a furious roar of defiance. He was a Core Formation Tier cultivator, and if he lost to a mere Cauldron Forging Tier cultivator, that would practically be an eternal joke, and his name would be infamous for ten thousand years.
But what could he do?
Ling Han smiled calmly, “Do you think that the gap between you and me is only this little bit?”
He raised his hand, and zi, a golden divine light shot out.
This was the Heptagold Lightning Tribulation.
Pa! The attack landed on Tong Yongning, and he was instantly sent flying.

Though the Heptagold Lightning was inferior to the Primal Chaos Divine Lightning, it could match the Saint Technique no matter what. Unleashed from Ling Han’s hands, how could Tong Yongning not be hit?
The mouths of the four clansmen of the Tong Clan were already wide open. They stared blankly at Ling Han, completely unable to believe their eyes.𝗳𝐫𝚎𝗲𝚠𝚎𝗯𝕟𝐨𝘃𝚎𝗹.𝗰𝗼𝗺
“Ah!” Tong Yongning leaped up. There was a long wound on his left rib. That had been caused by the Heptagold Lightning Tribulation, causing him to be severely injured.
“Evil brat!” He charged back. He definitely could not lose to Ling Han, or he would become a laughing stock for all eternity.
Ling Han raised his hand again, Divine Water Yin Lightning.
Zi, lightning flashed past, and Tong Yongning was once again sent flying. This time, his whole body was enshrouded in ice, but there was also a burning smell wafting out, which was extremely bizarre.
“Ah!” Tong Yongning lunged over again.
Ling Han smiled, and an azure lightning bolt shot out. It was Second Wood True Lightning.
Without a doubt, Tong Yongning was sent flying again.
This time, after Tong Yongning got back to his feet, he didn’t dare to make another move.
Now, it was not a matter of not leaving behind an infamous reputation, but rather that it was possible that he would die here.

Compared to fame, Tong Yongning was naturally more concerned about his own life. Not too long after, he would leave this place and go to a wider world where the Core Formation Tier cultivators could live for four thousand years!
Four thousand years, and he was only in his forties now. He hadn’t even lived to a fraction of his life, so how could he be willing to die?
He suddenly turned around and fled!
Hehe, in his dreams.

Ling Han unleashed the black light of illusion, and Tong Yongning’s movements instantly came to an abrupt halt. However, the expressions on his face were extremely varied. At one moment, he was glaring at Ling Han, and at the next, he was smiling. This was an extremely bizarre sight.
Had he been bewitched?
The members of the Tong Clan were all shocked. At such a critical moment, Third Uncle had actually been bewitched. What could they do?

death, and he didn’t want to die.

Clan.

had become corpses, so how could he not be afraid?

chapters.title: Chapter 3927: Black Tortoise Palace
paragraphs: Chapter 3927: Black Tortoise Palace
Leaving alive a man to act as messenger, Ling Han strode off.

This battle allowed him to have a clearer understanding of his own battle prowess. In terms of power, he could already match the early stage of Core Formation Tier, which was about First Heaven. And if he used various techniques, then his battle prowess would be able to advance to the next Heaven.
After walking for a while, Ling Han gradually felt the pressure.
This was a suppression on a higher level, causing him to gradually feel strained, as if he could not move a single step.
Fortunately, he could still hold on for the time being. He continued to advance, but his speed had clearly slowed down.
A day later, a palace actually appeared ahead of him.
This could not be considered luxurious at all. It was very plain, exuding an ancient aura.
That pressure originated from this palace. When he arrived here, he felt a fear that if he took a few more steps, his body would explode.
This was not impossible. Previously, there were a great many corpses of Saints under the Black Heaven Temple, and they could not approach at all. They had to circle around.

And the corpses of those Saints had all been dissected and drained of all of their essence. Their might was completely inferior to real corpses of Saints. Otherwise, they wouldn’t even be able to walk around.

However, this was the lair of a Subsidiary Divine Beast, and after so many years, who knew how much aura that the Subsidiary Divine Beast had left behind. These auras were at least Saint-level, so their might was naturally incomparable.

Outside the palace, Ling Han saw a great many people. There were True Self Tier old monsters, and there were also Cauldron Forging Tier outsiders. They all wanted to enter the palace, but were completely unable to do so.
Who would be able to enter?
Under such a terrifying pressure, even True Self Tier elites could only prostrate.

Anyone could guess that this was the abode of that Black Tortoise all those years ago. Who knows, there may even be its remains inside. It was a Subsidiary Divine Beast, and whether it was its blood, flesh, fur, or bones, they were all supreme precious treasures. Even Saints would be tempted.
But now?
The treasure mountain was right in front of their eyes, yet they were unable to enter. How could they not beat their chests and stamp their feet in frustration?

Ling Han, on the other hand, wasn’t too disappointed. His goal was very clear. He had come for the celestial light, and as for the others, it was good luck to get them, but it was fine even if he couldn’t.
Xiu, a streak of light flew out of the palace, turning into a streak of light that danced in the skies.

“Celestial light!” Quite a number of people exclaimed in shock. Some were even more envious. This naturally was those Cauldron Forging Tiers that had yet to break through into Core Formation Tier. As long as one fused a streak of celestial light, one would be able to cultivate a Mystical Power, and its might would at least be equivalent to a fourth pinnacle level precious technique.
Ling Han activated his eye technique and examined it closely. This streak of light was earthen-yellow in colour, but it itself was a bolt of lightning.
Five Earth Nether Lightning!
A thought suddenly flashed in Ling Han’s head. This was another lightning with elemental alignment, which was the same as the Heptagold Lightning Tribulation and Divine Water Yin Lightning.
How could it be suppressed?
After that streak of light danced in two circles, xiu, it returned to the palace, as if it had gone to rest.

Meanwhile, Ling Han mulled over how he could capture this streak of celestial light. To avoid trouble, he had already modified his appearance and soul fluctuations to prevent others from disturbing him.
The black light of illusion?
No, Ling Han shook his head. This place restricted his ability to fly. Even if he froze that streak
of celestial light, he would not be able to tear through the air and ascend, and take the
celestial light for his own.𝒻𝑟ℯℯ𝑤𝑒𝑏𝑛𝘰𝓋𝑒𝓁.𝒸𝑜𝘮
Then what was he to do?
Ling Han rested his chin on his hand, and fell into deep thought.
A great many people had come, but faced with this great palace, they were completely helpless.
They couldn’t even get close, so how were they supposed to enter?
For them, whose highest cultivation level was only True Self Tier, the might of a Subsidiary Divine Beast was unsolvable. If they tried to forcefully approach it, their only fate would be death.
But the mountain of treasure was right in front of their eyes, so who would be willing to give it up?

One day, two days, three days. Every day, that streak of multicolored light would fly out and circle a few times, as if it was taking a breath of fresh air. Furthermore, Ling Han had also been bitterly waiting. Would that streak of light descend? At that time, he would be able to solve the problem with a flash of the black light of illusion.
But at least, he had not managed to get such a good chance yet.
Boom!
The fourth day arrived, and a loud tremor was heard. A colossal creature suddenly appeared.
That White Snake!
Ling Han couldn’t help but curse internally. That spring previously could only allow one person to pass through. This White Snake was so massive, so how had it squeezed through?
Of course, as powerful as a True Self Tier elite, the White Snake could naturally change its size at will, or there were other passageways that allowed it to enter.
Thinking of this, he couldn’t help but laugh in spite of himself. Was this the time to be curious about this problem?
This White Snake was clearly extremely furious. It had been chased off, and its descendants had all been snatched away, causing its killing intent to soar.

There was no such thing as negotiation among wild beasts. From the very beginning, it had launched a mad offensive. With a sweep of its tail, it was as if a mountain was sweeping over, which was incredibly terrifying.
The True Self Tier great beast unleashed a mad barrage of attacks; who dared to block it head-
on?
Even those True Self Tier old monsters could only give it a wide berth. After their physique reached a certain level, there was absolutely no need for them to cultivate; they were born
strong.
Ling Han also retreated, trying his best to get as close to that palace as possible. This pressure was naturally the same for the White Snake.
As expected, before the White Snake’s snake tail had even lashed out, it was as if it had been electrocuted, and hurriedly shrunk back.

Immediately, there were people who followed suit. Very soon, everyone had retreated to the side of the palace, and used the aura of the Subsidiary Divine Beast to suppress it, so that this White Snake did not dare to attack at all.
The White Snake was enraged. It slithered around in the surroundings, continuously sticking out its tongue, releasing hissing sounds. Its lantern-like eyes continuously swept over
everyone, filled with viciousness.
Xiu, right at this moment, that streak of celestial light flew out of the palace again.
With a thought from Ling Han, he raised his hand, and instantly, five flashes of lightning shot
out at the same time.
-Aside from the black light of illusion, he unleashed all five types of divine light of lightning
that he had grasped.
He didn’t want to destroy the celestial light, but rather lure it.
With this strike from him, the streak of light seemed to have been angered. With a shua, it
slashed towards Ling Han.
Good!
This was the result that Ling Han wanted. He immediately activated the black light of illusion which charged over. This was on the level of divine sense, surpassing all speed.
Then, Ling Han discovered that the streak of earthen-yellow lightning had stopped less than
an inch in front of him. If the speed at which he had shot out the black light of illusion was slightly slower, the result would be that he would be hit.
With how terrifying this bolt of lightning was, even if he didn’t die from this strike, he would
be half-dead.
So close.
Ling Han did not hesitate in the slightest, and used the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower to store away this celestial light.
It was good enough that he had taken it. As for refining it, he would take his time in the future.
Of course, this scene was also witnessed by others, instantly drawing the envious and jealous
gazes of a great many people.
That was celestial light!
Retreat!
Ling Han decided to leave. He had already achieved his goal, and this palace was under the
pressure of the Black Tortoise. He couldn’t even enter, so what was the point of staying?
This pressure had not dissipated for hundreds of millions of years, and it was also not
possible that it would suddenly disappear in a short period of time.
Hence, he knew where to cut his losses and claim his gains.
Ling Han looked at the White Snake. The problem now was, how could he sneak out from under the nose of this ferocious beast?

chapters.title: Chapter 3928: Ancient Palace
paragraphs: Chapter 3928: Ancient Palace
Thankfully, the White Snake didn’t target Ling Han, because he was too weak.

This powerful beast set its eyes on those True Self Tier old monsters. In its eyes, it was definitely them that had snatched its eggs, and if it wanted to snatch back its children, it would have to kill these people.
Ferocious beasts did not have developed intelligence, and were purely acting on instinct.

In fact, White Snake was indeed strong, but it was not strong enough to suppress all the True Self Tier elites. Otherwise, it would not have fled at that time. However, this time, the old monsters of True Self Tier didn’t even have a reason to put their lives on the line.
Previously, it was for the inheritance of the Subsidiary Divine Beast, but now? They could not enter into the palace, so they naturally had lost all desire to battle.
Ling Han retrieved the Void Beast hide and draped it over his body in front of everyone. Then, he boldly walked forward.
‘You can do that?’

Everyone was watching dumbfounded. At the same time, they were very envious of Ling Han’s ability to conceal himself, but now that the White Snake was entrenched ahead of them, which of them would dare make a move to pursue Ling Han?
Moreover, now that they had missed the chance at the beginning, they had long since lost track of Ling Han’s whereabouts. Even if they wanted to pursue him, it would be fruitless.
Ling Han didn’t mind leaking the secret of the Void Beast hide, because this wasn’t his original appearance, and this person wouldn’t appear again in the future.
After arriving at a safe area, Ling Han removed his disguise and left calmly.
He did not leave the island at the first instant, but rather searched around.
There were many Celestial medicines here, so he naturally had to search carefully.
His gains were not small. Not only did he obtain Celestial medicines, he also obtained divine substances, and only after making a fortune did he leave quietly.
After returning to the Demonic Origin Realm, he began to refine the seventh streak of celestial light.
After spending some time, he finally succeeded.

There were still two more to go. As long as he obtained another two streaks of celestial light, and cultivated to the peak stage of Nine Cauldrons, Ling Han would break through to the Core Formation Tier. At that time, he would go to the Tong Clan Residence and make a resolution. He continued to search for useful clues. There were practically treasures everywhere in this place. There were inheritances of elites, celestial light, Celestial medicines, and so on. It was no wonder that after it opened, the entire North Heavenly Realm was in an uproar over it. Yi?
He found a piece of information. This was not “news”, but “old news”.

In the central area of the Demonic Origin Realm, there was an ancient hall. The doors were tightly locked, and it was extremely dilapidated. However, even though it looked dilapidated, as if a larger storm would be able to completely destroy it, after countless years, not a single person could enter.
It did not have the intimidation left behind by an elite. They were just ordinary-looking walls, blocking everyone.
Ling Han was curious, so he decided to take a look.
Several days later, he arrived at the heart of the Demonic Origin Realm, and he effortlessly found that ancient palace.

It was truly ancient. The walls of the palace hall had been corroded by time, and there were marks on them. In many places, the paint had fallen off, revealing the bricks inside. At a glance, one could tell that they were very ordinary.
Ordinarily, to say nothing of True Self Tier cultivators, even minor characters of the mortal level would be able to easily destroy this kind of palace.
But in truth, it had always existed, and no one could enter.
“Yi?” He was surprised, because he saw a familiar face. Song Lan.

This exquisite beauty was like a brilliant star no matter where she was. She was always surrounded by people, and this place was no exception. She was dressed in a long white dress, and did not put on any makeup, yet was incomparably beautiful, causing one’s heart to throb wildly, unable to control himself.
There were a dozen over young men surrounding her, all of them elegant and graceful, possessing an intimidating aura.
Those who were qualified to stay by her side were definitely all supreme prodigies.
Ling Han had already disguised himself, so no one could recognize him. Thus, he confidently walked forwards, and arrived in front of the main doors. He stretched out a hand to push the
doors open.
He pushed hard, yet shockingly discovered that his power was like a clay ox entering the sea, instantly disappearing without a trace.
Interesting.

He retreated a little, and shot out a punch at empty air. Power surged, blasting at the great doors, but when this power landed on the great doors, it was similarly like water that had encountered a sponge, completely absorbed.

No wonder this palace had never been opened before. It was indeed mysterious. However, it had always been here. Perhaps, it had attracted the curiosity of the natives a long time ago, but as time passed, naturally, no one paid any more attention to it. They were no longer surprised by it.
Only outsiders would find it novel. Those like Song Lan and Ling Han had all been drawn over.

“Heh, there’s no need to waste your energy. It’s impossible to blast open this wall,” a young man said. He stroked the wall with his hand, and said, “I can’t help but sigh. Time is the most powerful power.”
“Look, we can’t damage it in the slightest, but time can cause it to decay. One day, these walls will collapse.”
“Unfortunately, at that time, perhaps we would have long since died.”
He deliberately spoke very deeply, as if he wanted to create his own mature bearing.
Ling Han looked at the great doors, and asked with a smile, “Why don’t you think of finding the key to open the great doors?”
That’s right!
A great many people nodded. This was actually the simplest logic, so why had they not thought of it previously?
This was actually a common problem of cultivators. For example, when they explored ancient tombs, which tomb owner would welcome them and leave behind a key when they were alive?
Thus, when they encountered abodes, palaces, and so on, their instinctive reaction was that they had to fight their way in.
“Nonsense, this palace has existed for who knows how long. If we could find the key, would we still need to wait until now?” The young man from before asked in displeasure, and even
glared at Ling Han.
‘I’m pretending to be reserved here and deliberately showing off in front of a beauty, so why are you undermining me?’
Ling Han glanced at him, and said calmly, “I’m only talking about one possibility. Even if you don’t agree, you can still talk nicely. Has no one taught you manners?”
The young man looked humiliated and furious, “Do I, Liang Dongkui, need you to teach me a
lesson?”
“If you can’t control your mouth, I don’t mind teaching you,” Ling Han said calmly.
Liang Dongkui was just about to make a move, when he saw Song Lan raise a hand and stop
him.
He did not dare to be rude to the beauty, and hurriedly withdrew his fist. Meanwhile, Song Lan looked towards Ling Han, a puzzled expression appearing on her face,
“Have we met before?”
A woman’s intuition was really frightening. This disguise of his was completely new.
Ling Han laughed loudly, “Perhaps you have seen me in your dreams.”
“How dare you!”
“Impudence!”𝗳𝚛𝚎𝚎𝘄𝕖𝕓𝕟𝕠𝚟𝚎𝕝.𝗰𝕠𝐦
All the youngsters berated at the same time, all of them raising their brows, unable to restrain
their fury.
This was their goddess, yet Ling Han actually dared to tease her. How could they not be
furious? It was as if they had all been cuckolded.
Song Lan’s pretty face also turned cold. How could this person be so flippant? Though Ling Han had not uttered any obscene words, his intention to take liberties with her was already
very obvious.
“Forget it, don’t drop down to his level.” She turned around and left, not bothering to look at
Ling Han.
As she said this, all the young people hurriedly followed behind her. They could not enter this palace at all, so what was the point of staying here?
Of course, it was to court the goddess’ favour, and see if there was a chance to win the
beauty’s heart.
Seeing these people leave, Ling Han broke into a grin, and took out a bronze key.

chapters.title: Chapter 3929: Notebook
paragraphs: Chapter 3929: Notebook
He had obtained this key when he had been in the outermost circle. He had obtained it through the desert, after the Sand Maidens had recognized him as their Master.
Before this, he had absolutely no idea what this key was used for, but standing in front of the main doors, he suddenly came to a realization.

Just now, he had deliberately teased Song Lan. His purpose was naturally to anger her into leaving, because once she left, the others would definitely leave as well. That way, he would be able to calmly open the door and enter alone.4

Otherwise, those people had basically advanced into the Core Formation Tier by now, and their battle prowess was not inferior to his. In fact, Song Lan was probably even superior to him. Would Ling Han be able to stop these people from entering the palace together with him?
He took a deep breath, took the key, and leaned towards the keyhole.

This key could be said to be extremely far away from this palace. In fact, it was completely unrelated to this palace, yet they were so closely linked that Ling Han couldn’t help but suspect that this was the greatest secret of this Mystery Realm, as the White Lotus Ancestral King had said.
The key was inserted into the lock, and fitted seamlessly.
Ling Han broke into a grin. He turned the key. Ka, ka, ka! One twist, two twists, and right until the ninth twist, the great doors opened.
Without the slightest hesitation, Ling Han pulled out the key, pushed open the doors and entered.
Ahead.
An image from before suddenly flashed through Song Lan’s mind. It was familiar. She was extremely smart, and she immediately stopped in her tracks. Then, she suddenly turned around.
Coincidentally, she saw the scene of Ling Han darting into the palace.
She had been tricked!
With a soft exclamation, she immediately leaped up and charged towards the palace.
However, she saw Ling Han smile at her, yet his right hand pushed the door without hesitation. Peng! The door slammed shut.
She had already charged over, but she was too late. The great doors had already closed, absorbing all the power that she had delivered.
“Ling! Han!” she said through gritted teeth. Ling Han’s last smile was really too familiar to her, and she recognized him with a single look.
This detestable guy!
He had deliberately enraged her, so that she could leave. Then, he would take advantage of the opening to open the great doors. By the time she came back to her senses, it was already too late.
This was too despicable.
The others also chased after her, their faces filled with shock, especially that Liang Dongkui. He had said that it was impossible to find this key, but he was immediately slapped with his own words.
“We were deceived by him!” Everyone naturally came to their senses, but it was a shame that it was too late.
On the other side, Ling Han revealed a faint smile.
Song Lan, this little girl, was really smart. She had almost seen through him.
Ling Han turned around and looked ahead.
It was very simple and crude inside. A few pillars supported the weight of the great hall, and the ground was empty.
Ling Han strode forwards. There was a table at the end of the great hall, and there was a book laid out on the table. Perhaps that was the key.
He walked to the table, and did not easily take the book, because this great hall had gone through too many years, and who knew how much this book had deteriorated.
Thus, he was extremely careful.
The book had no cover, and there was no name on the surface either. Ling Han used his divine sense as a tentacle, and carefully turned a page.
There were words on the second page. After Ling Han glanced at them a few times, he revealed an expression of surprise.
This wasn’t a cultivation technique, nor was it a celestial technique. Instead, it was a notebook that had been left behind by a predecessor.

This person’s battle prowess wasn’t outstanding, and when he died, he was only Sect Master- level, so it couldn’t be considered that amazing. However, this person liked to study theory, especially regarding the limits of martial arts.
Ling Han saw that according to this person’s deduction, the limit of the Foundation Building Tier was forming a second cornerstone of the Celestial Path, or even three!
And this wise man’s deduction of the limits of the Cauldron Forging Tier was ten cauldrons.

Above the Heaven Cauldron, whether it was Four Cauldrons or Five Cauldrons, they had already broken through their limits. However, in the eyes of this predecessor, three cauldrons was only the lowest requirement for breaking through to the Core Formation Tier, and breaking through to Core Formation Tier from three cauldrons, the path of martial arts had basically reached its end.
Unless one ingested some heaven-defying Celestial medicine, they definitely wouldn’t be able to break through to the True Self Tier.
Nine was the heaven and earth extreme, so if the extreme was broken, that was where the true
limit lay.
Ten cauldrons!

Ling Han pondered for a moment. Throughout history, he had never heard of anyone who had cultivated to such a heaven-defying cultivation level. However, hadn’t his three Celestial Foundations also broken through the impossible acknowlegdged throughout eternity?

He secretly estimated that what limited a cultivator from reaching Four Cauldrons, Seven Cauldrons and Nine Cauldrons weren’t heaven and earth, but rather oneself. Because the Celestial Cauldrons repelled each other, after reaching a certain extent, the repulsive force surpassed all else, and that was the limit of an individual.

For him, forming the ninth cauldron was indeed a little stressful, but he had not used the power of living beings in the dimensions in his body, which also meant that there was indeed a possibility that he could further squeeze out his potential.
He looked again, and this predecessor had not simply deduced the limits of each cultivation level, but also had a solution that he thought was feasible.
For example, with regards to the Foundation Building Tier, he had created a technique that could suppress the Celestial Foundation. In this way, it was possible to form a second Celestial Foundation.

It was the same for the Cauldron Forging Tier. He had also developed a technique, which allowed the various Celestial Cauldrons to impede each other, thereby weakening the pressure on the new cauldron.
The more Ling Han saw, the more astonished he became. This predecessor was practically a
genius!

Unfortunately, this wise man had died early, and had only lived for eight thousand years, and the theoretical lifespan of the Sect Master was forty thousand years. Even if the majority could not live to this age, eight thousand years was still too short a life.
Ling Han surmised that it was because this wise man’s research was too heaven-defying, so he had been targeted by the heavens, exerting internal demons on him, causing him to die
young.
This deduction wasn’t without reason. When the predecessor deduced the limits of the Minor Advanced Tier, he was already babbling nonsense. It was clear with a single glance that he wasn’t conscious.

Ling Han closed his notebook. If this thing spread out, it would probably cause a huge commotion. However, Ling Han believed that even if this notebook was known to everyone, how many people could really break the limit?

In fact, even if he didn’t have this kind of notes, Ling Han still had the thought of breaking through to Ten Cauldrons. After all, although there were very, very few people who had reached the level of Nine Cauldronss, counting the number of people in the North Heavenly Realm, there were probably around 10 people who had reached the level of Nine Cauldrons.
Was this still called a limit?

Now, with the notes of this ancient sage, he had developed a technique that could allow the repulsive force of the Celestial Cauldrons to cancel out a portion of each other, greatly increasing the possibility of him forming ten cauldrons.
Fine, he would charge towards this Ten Cauldrons that was possibly unprecedented. Ling Han searched around the large hall again, and discovered a small Transfer Formation.
In any case, there was nothing much to stay here for, so he entered into the Transfer Formation. A streak of light swept past, and he had already appeared in another place.
This was a massive platform, and it was clearly located at an extremely high position, because
there were clouds floating around it.
Ling Han walked to the side, and when he looked outside, he was surprised, because this
platform was actually floating in the skies.
Not only that, but this platform was also in a state of high-speed movement. It was so fast
that even Ling Han couldn’t catch up to it by flying on his Tool.
Thus, Ling Han didn’t dare to fly off the platform and observe the situation as a whole.
He walked slowly towards the centre of the platform.
