However, Ling Han believed that even if this notebook was known to everyone, how many people could really break the limit?
In fact, even if he didn’t have this kind of notes, Ling Han still had the thought of breaking through to Ten Cauldrons.

After all, although there were very, very few people who had reached the level of Nine Cauldronss, counting the number of people in the North Heavenly Realm, there were probably around 10 people who had reached the level of Nine Cauldrons.
Was this still called a limit?

Now, with the notes of this ancient sage, he had developed a technique that could allow the repulsive force of the Celestial Cauldrons to cancel out a portion of each other, greatly increasing the possibility of him forming ten cauldrons.
Fine, he would charge towards this Ten Cauldrons that was possibly unprecedented.
Ling Han searched around the large hall again, and discovered a small Transfer Formation.
In any case, there was nothing much to stay here for, so he entered into the Transfer Formation.
A streak of light swept past, and he had already appeared in another place.
This was a massive platform, and it was clearly located at an extremely high position, because
there were clouds floating around it.
Ling Han walked to the side, and when he looked outside, he was surprised, because this
platform was actually floating in the skies.
Not only that, but this platform was also in a state of high-speed movement.
It was so fast
that even Ling Han couldn’t catch up to it by flying on his Tool.
Thus, Ling Han didn’t dare to fly off the platform and observe the situation as a whole.
He walked slowly towards the centre of the platform.

chapters.title: Chapter 3930: Obtaining another celestial light
paragraphs: Chapter 3930: Obtaining another celestial light
This platform couldn’t be considered big. At most, it could only be considered a garden. Then, someone dug it out forcefully, and used some unknown method to allow it to fly in the air.
Ling Han didn’t walk very fast. There were no competitors here, so there was no need.
However, no matter how slow he walked, this platform was only so big. Not long after, he arrived at the center of the platform.
There was a sacrificial altar-like object that was carved from stone, and above the sacrificial altar was a black box that was sealed tightly. It was unknown what was inside.
Ling Han placed his hand on it. Suddenly, he immediately felt something collide inside. ‘Hmm?’

He thought for a moment, then summoned the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, and shadowed it over the black box. If anything terrifying appeared, he could immediately suppress it with his Imperial Weapon.
Then, he opened the casket.
Xiu, he had just opened a crack in the casket, when he saw a ray of light shoot out. Its speed was ridiculously fast.

Even if he was already prepared, the distance was too close, so he still couldn’t react in time. Pu, this light pierced through Primal Chaos Qi, and shattered the Starlight Screen, landing heavily on him.
Ling Han was instantly sent flying. His vision darkened, and he almost fainted.
However, in this instant, he also caught sight of a bolt of lightning that flew out of the black box!
Celestial light.

Ling Han thought internally. He really had not expected that he would actually unearth a celestial light from within a box. However, he immediately made the correct response. With a thought, the black light of illusion had already been shot out. Then, the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower covered it.
After doing all this, a powerful dizziness assaulted him, and Ling Han fainted.
After an unknown amount of time, Ling Han slowly regained consciousness. He felt an agonizing pain in his chest, and it was indescribably painful.
F***, this time, it was really an unexpected failure.

Ling Han forcibly got back to his feet and retrieved the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower. With a sweep of his divine sense, he discovered that there was a bolt of lightning dancing madly inside, as if it was about to break through and rush out.
Unfortunately, this was forged from Origin Gold, so how could it be an ordinary Two Star Tool? No matter how it attacked, it was useless.
A smile appeared on Ling Han’s face. Though he had been ruthlessly struck, he had still obtained a streak of celestial light. This was not a loss.

He looked down, and saw that there was a deep wound on his lower abdomen, that had almost severed him into two halves. Furthermore, the wound contained both the power of lightning and the air of slaughter, and was still continuously causing destruction in the wound, weakening his vitality.

Ling Han hurriedly used his mystical power to suppress this foreign energy. Thankfully, he did not lack Celestial medicines, and had also cultivated a Saint-level cultivation technique, so it was not difficult for him to expel foreign energy.

Moreover, he still had six flashes of lightning in his body. Although they all had different elemental alignments, they were all lightning after all, and had a certain degree of reference, allowing him to slowly find out what exactly the lightning that had injured him was made of. Seven days later, his injuries were all healed.
However, he did not stand up. Instead, he continued to comprehend, because he discovered that there was a connection between the various bolts of lightning.

Without a doubt, the first bolt of lightning that he had obtained was the strongest. It had the element of Primal Chaos, and was like the first bolt of lightning of heaven and earth, while the other bolts of lightning seemed to have evolved from it.
However, the first bolt of lightning was incomplete, and the other bolts of lightning could be used to replenish it, improving its quality and reaching a stronger level.
Now, Ling Han was deducing this possibility.
Three days later, he stopped.
It was unrealistic to extract attributes from other bolts of lightning and then improve the Primal Chaos Divine Lightning.

That was because Ling Han could not do it at all. Even if it was other lightning, it was comparable to the Saint Technique. Ling Han could refine the lightning, but it did not mean that he could understand the factors that formed the lightning.
Thus, it was an impossible task for him to extract the missing parts of the Primal Chaos Divine Lightning from it and complete the replenishment of the Primal Chaos Divine Lightning.
-Unless he was presently a Saint.
Was there nothing that could be done?
There was!
Ling Han thought of a possibility, and that was to fuse all the lightning together, and with the Primal Chaos Divine Lightning as the core, refine it into a single bolt.

Furthermore, after advancing into the Core Formation Tier, wouldn’t one only be able to retain one divine light? In this way, it would be from choosing one out of ten to choosing one out of two, and making a choice between the Primal Chaos Divine Lightning and the black
light of illusion.

However, it could not be carried out yet. Firstly, he had not thought of a way to fuse the celestial lights together, and secondly, the lightning he had grasped was not complete enough. Judging by what the Primal Chaos Divine Lightning was lacking, there were still two missing.
Ling Han’s eyes lit up. Coincidentally, if he cultivated to Ten Cauldrons, he would still be missing two more celestial lights.

All right, then he would go and find these two streaks of celestial light. By then, when the nine bolts of lightning fused into one, the might of the Primal Chaos Divine Lightning would definitely increase greatly.
He circled around the platform a few more times, wanting to see if there was anything else valuable. However, the platform was only so big, so he couldn’t find anything even after
searching a few more times.
Forget it, he had already profited greatly.
Ling Han flew on his Tool and left the platform. Immediately, he saw the platform disappear from his sight at an astonishing speed.
He flew downwards, passing through layers of clouds. After a long while, he finally landed on
the ground.
And this was still the Demonic Origin Realm. That floating platform didn’t take him to the ends of the world.
Ling Han arrived at a city. He continued to search for clues about celestial light.

There was no shortage of opportunities here. In fact, there were also many celestial lights, and their might was at least comparable to Venerate Tier-level techniques. Thus, among those outsiders that had not obtained the celestial light, there were some that had not broken through even after a long time. It was not that they could not, but rather that they were waiting for the celestial light.

Ling Han entered various danger zones, and experienced many dangers. He exchanged blows with a great many people, and also obtained celestial lights. However, it seemed like his luck had suddenly turned bad. These celestial lights were not of the Lightning Element.

Even if it wasn’t lightning-aligned, he couldn’t waste it. Thus, Ling Han stored the celestial light into the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Towerr. In the future, he could gift it to the empress, Hu Niu, the large black dog, and the others.
In the blink of an eye, half a year had passed.
He did not obtain the Lightning Element celestial light, but Ling Han had almost cultivated Nine Cauldrons to Consummate level.
It could not be helped. He had obtained too many Celestial medicines, and had refined them into alchemical pills. If he ingested one every day, how could his cultivation level not soar
rapidly?
“There’s news of celestial light again.” Ling Han flipped through the information. This time, it was the Forest of Light. There was a divine light dancing, and even in broad daylight, it
could illuminate the skies, which was incredibly bright.
“Let’s go take a look.”
He didn’t know whether the divine light that appeared this time was celestial light, and whether it was lightning-aligned, but since he had gotten the news, he naturally had to go
and take a look.
He set out, heading towards the Forest of Light.
Half a day later, he arrived at his destination.
The reason why the Forest of Light was so named was because there were large areas of
glowing trees growing here. Even in broad daylight, flames of light could be seen soaring
skywards, and at night, this place was even brighter.
Ling Han strolled slowly, neither too fast nor too slow.

Celestial light was too fast. Even if he ran at full speed, he would not be able to catch up to it. Thus, rather than running around randomly and possibly going in opposite directions, it would be better for him to relax and just treat it as a stroll.

chapters.title: Chapter 3931: Zhang Youxuan
paragraphs: Chapter 3931: Zhang Youxuan
Ling Han walked slowly. There were those kind of glowing trees everywhere in this place.
This light came from the leaves, and they were all of the same colour. It was a gentle white light, and appeared very sacred.
Ling Han plucked a leaf, yet discovered that the leaf soon lost its brilliance, and became no different from an ordinary leaf.
This was quite interesting.
He wandered aimlessly. This forest was very big, so who knew where that celestial light was? Who knew where it would suddenly appear from? Thus, Ling Han didn’t mind, and walked casually.

One day, two days, time passed quietly. Ling Han did not gain much. To say nothing of the fact that he had not seen the celestial light, he had not even seen any divine substance or Celestial medicine.

However, he did encounter a considerable number of wild beasts, and there were even True Self Tier great beasts. Thankfully, his divine sense was sensitive, and when he discovered them, he circled around at the first instant. Otherwise, if he had directly crashed into them, he would either have to activate the Heavenly Dao Flames or shatter the token to escape, and there was no third possibility.
He wasn’t in a hurry. If he couldn’t find the celestial light, he would battle with the wild beasts to temper himself.
At noon on this day, he stopped and started a bonfire. He set up a piece of vicious beast meat, preparing to have a good meal.
Not long after, the aroma of meat wafted out, causing Ling Han’s appetite to stir. He mocked himself for being such a glutton.
‘Hmm?’
He listened attentively, because he felt the ground tremble. There was presently someone rapidly approaching in his direction.
Xiu, a figure had already darted out. It was a fatty with a rounded figure, who was only twenty-four or twenty-five years old.
“Brother, I’m sorry. Run quickly, there’s a fierce beast behind us!” the fatty called out to Ling Han through his divine sense.

Ling Han faltered slightly, and developed a favorable impression of this fatty. That was because when he was fleeing, he could still warn passers-by. This kind of person was already very rare. Of course, the ferocious beast behind him had been drawn over by this fatty, so he was the main culprit.
Hong long long, the ground trembled madly. Multiple trees fell, and a colossal creature also rushed out.

This was an Iron Back Bull. It was thirty meters long, and six meters tall. It was completely black in colour, as if it had been forged from Divine Metal. Its whole body was exuding a metallic lustre.
“F***, why aren’t you running?” The fatty had already run a distance away, but when he saw that Ling Han was actually still sitting where he was, he couldn’t help but stop in his tracks.
Seeing that Ling Han still didn’t answer, he stomped his feet and actually ran back.
The Iron Back Bull charged over, its two sharp horns like supreme heavenly blades, crashing towards Ling Han.
The fatty arrived, and shot out a punch to greet the attack of the Iron Back Bull.
Peng!
The fatty was instantly sent flying, but the Iron Back Bull also slowed down and stopped.
“F***, I say, big brother, are you playing with me? Run!” The fatty turned his head, and when he saw that Ling Han was still leisurely barbequing meat, his face involuntarily turned green.

He was no match for this Iron Back Bull. Otherwise, there would have been no need for this fierce beast to chase after him. Furthermore, he did not want to cause others to die because of him, and that was why he had resolutely turned around to face the attack.
But Ling Han was actually still barbequing meat there. His fury was really going to kill him.
At this moment, the Iron Back Bull shook its head, and became even more furious. It dug its hooves, then charged towards the fatty.
“Come chase your Grandpa Fatty!” The fatty crooked a finger, then broke into a run.
In this way, he would be able to lure the Iron Back Bull away, and Ling Han would naturally be safe.
He was a very principled person. He would definitely not allow others to bear the consequences of his own actions.
Peng, a loud bang rang out from behind him, as if something heavy had been sent flying.

However, the fatty did not hear this. His speed had far surpassed the speed of sound, but after he had run a few steps, he realized that the Iron Back Bull had not caught up to him, which caused him to involuntarily stop.
He turned around to look, and his mouth instantly gaped open in shock.
Ling Han was still sitting on the spot and barbequing meat, while the Iron Back Bull was sent flying several hundred meters away, leaving a deep mark on the ground.
This!
Could it be that it was that brat that had moved, and sent the Iron Back Bull flying?

But it should be known that he was already Seven Cauldrons, and his battle prowess could match an Eight Cauldrons fierce beast. Yet he was no match for this Iron Back Bull, but that brat had sent the Iron Back Bull flying with a single punch. What kind of abilities did he have? “F*ck, so you’re a fierce person!” The fatty walked over and clasped his hands in greeting. “Sorry for the disrespect. I’m Zhang Youxuan. How should I address you, brother?”
Ling Han was completely focused on roasting the meat. Without even raising his head, he said calmly, “Ling Han.”
This fatty had a good character, being able to come back to face danger in such a situation, which caused Ling Han to have a favorable impression of him, so he told him his real name.
Zhang Youxuan was very familiar with Ling Han. He sat down beside Ling Han, and said, “I’m hungry. Can I have some?”
Ling Han smiled, and used the saber to split the beast meat into two. Then, he took a piece and handed it to the fatty.
Zhang Youxuan immediately began eating, as he asked, “Brother Fierce Man, have you also come to search for celestial light?”
Ling Han thought for a moment, then replied, “That’s right.”
“Ai, I advise you to give up. That celestial light is practically freakishly fast. It disappeared in
a flash, and there is no way to catch up at all,” the fatty said in a slightly slurred voice as he
ate.
A thought flashed in Ling Han’s head, and he asked, “You’ve seen it before?”
“Yes, quite a few times!” the fatty replied.
“Where did you see it?” Ling Han asked again.

“In a small canyon. Because I was hunted by a fierce beast, I fled in. In the end, that fierce beast actually did not dare to chase me in.” The fatty said, “I walked around in the canyon for a while, and as soon as I came out, I saw that celestial light. To be honest with you, I too wanted to capture that celestial light, but in the end, I failed time and time again.”
“Where is that canyon?”

“Yi, it can’t be that you want to take this celestial light, right?” The fatty shook his head, “Brother fierce man, I don’t mean to pour cold water on you, but that celestial light is really too fast, and is not something that Cauldron Forging Tier can reach at all.”
Ling Han smiled, “It’s all right. You only have to tell me where it is. I will go and try my luck.”
“Alright, I’ll take you there,” the fatty said. Seeing Ling Han look towards him, he shrugged, “That place is not easy to find, so I’ll take you there.”
“All right.” After the two of them finished eating, the fatty set out with Ling Han.
After going around in circles and spending some time, they finally arrived at their destination.
They saw that the entrance was really hidden. If they didn’t search carefully, it would be
extremely difficult to discover.
“I was also in a panic and didn’t know where to go, so I just happened to barge in coincidentally,” the fatty said, slightly embarrassed.
Ling Han couldn’t help but smile, “Why are you always being hunted down by wild beasts?”
“I don’t know either.” Zhang Youxuan shook his head, and thought for a moment, “Could it
be because I have a lot of meat?”
“Possibly.” Ling Han strode into the canyon.
Zhang Youxuan hesitated for a moment before following him.
This was really a very small canyon. It was not more than three hundred meters deep, and the mountain walls on either side were also very low, concealed by the tall trees.

Since they were free now, the two of them began to chat. The fatty was very talkative, and was more so happy to share his embarrassing experiences, which caused Ling Han to laugh loudly from time to time.
Right at this moment, xiu, a ray of multicolored light flew over.

“Sorry for the disrespect.
I’m Zhang Youxuan.
How should I address you, brother?”
Ling Han was completely focused on roasting the meat.
Without even raising his head, he said calmly, “Ling Han.”
This fatty had a good character, being able to come back to face danger in such a situation, which caused Ling Han to have a favorable impression of him, so he told him his real name.
Zhang Youxuan was very familiar with Ling Han.
He sat down beside Ling Han, and said, “I’m hungry.
Can I have some?”
Ling Han smiled, and used the saber to split the beast meat into two.
Then, he took a piece and handed it to the fatty.
Zhang Youxuan immediately began eating, as he asked, “Brother Fierce Man, have you also come to search for celestial light?”
Ling Han thought for a moment, then replied, “That’s right.”
“Ai, I advise you to give up.
That celestial light is practically freakishly fast.
It disappeared in
a flash, and there is no way to catch up at all,” the fatty said in a slightly slurred voice as he
ate.
A thought flashed in Ling Han’s head, and he asked, “You’ve seen it before?”
“Yes, quite a few times!” the fatty replied.
“Where did you see it?” Ling Han asked again.
“In a small canyon.
Because I was hunted by a fierce beast, I fled in.
In the end, that fierce beast actually did not dare to chase me in.” The fatty said, “I walked around in the canyon for a while, and as soon as I came out, I saw that celestial light.
To be honest with you, I too wanted to capture that celestial light, but in the end, I failed time and time again.”
“Where is that canyon?”

“Yi, it can’t be that you want to take this celestial light, right?” The fatty shook his head, “Brother fierce man, I don’t mean to pour cold water on you, but that celestial light is really too fast, and is not something that Cauldron Forging Tier can reach at all.”
Ling Han smiled, “It’s all right.
You only have to tell me where it is.
I will go and try my luck.”
“Alright, I’ll take you there,” the fatty said.
Seeing Ling Han look towards him, he shrugged, “That place is not easy to find, so I’ll take you there.”
“All right.” After the two of them finished eating, the fatty set out with Ling Han.
After going around in circles and spending some time, they finally arrived at their destination.
They saw that the entrance was really hidden.
If they didn’t search carefully, it would be
extremely difficult to discover.
“I was also in a panic and didn’t know where to go, so I just happened to barge in coincidentally,” the fatty said, slightly embarrassed.
Ling Han couldn’t help but smile, “Why are you always being hunted down by wild beasts?”
“I don’t know either.” Zhang Youxuan shook his head, and thought for a moment, “Could it
be because I have a lot of meat?”
“Possibly.” Ling Han strode into the canyon.
Zhang Youxuan hesitated for a moment before following him.
This was really a very small canyon.
It was not more than three hundred meters deep, and the mountain walls on either side were also very low, concealed by the tall trees.
Since they were free now, the two of them began to chat.
The fatty was very talkative, and was more so happy to share his embarrassing experiences, which caused Ling Han to laugh loudly from time to time.
Right at this moment, xiu, a ray of multicolored light flew over.

chapters.title: Chapter 3932: Evil Killing Divine Lightning
paragraphs: Chapter 3932: Evil Killing Divine Lightning
‘It’s here!’
Ling Han raised his head to look. This streak of light was astonishingly fast, circling above the valley.

The eye technique was activated, and he could clearly see that this light was formed from lightning, but there was also a divine light flickering. Clearly, it was another lightning with a special element.
A smile appeared on his face. His wait had finally ended.
“Brother Fierce Man, how do you plan to retrieve this celestial light?” Zhang Youxuan asked. Ling Han smiled faintly, and said, “Like this!”
The black light of illusion shot out, and the multi-colored light in the sky immediately stopped, as if it had been frozen.
Ling Han flew on his Tool, easily drawing the multi-colored light into the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower.
It was extremely simple.
He looked at Zhang Youxuan, only to see that the fatty had already become completely dumbfounded. His mouth was half-gaping, and his eyes were wide open.
Ling Han smiled, turned around and walked out of the canyon.
Only then did Zhang Youxuan come to his senses as if he had just woken up from a dream. He hurriedly set off in pursuit of Ling Han.
“Brother Fierce Man! Brother Fierce Man!” he called out, his expression filled with admiration, “You are really awesome. I concede defeat, I concede defeat completely!”
Ling Han suddenly stopped, thought for a moment, and said, “I will give you an opportunity, but do you dare to take it?”
“Why wouldn’t I dare?!” Zhang Youxuan was brimming with confidence. Who would be afraid of great opportunities?
“All right!” Ling Han drew out a celestial light from the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, and delivered it straight at Zhang Youxuan.
“Aiyo, my goodness!” Zhang Youxuan immediately cried out in pain. The celestial light had already penetrated into his body, causing him so much pain that he wanted to throw up blood.

Though this celestial light was inferior to the Primal Chaos Divine Lightning, Heptagold Yang Lightning and so on, its might was still incredibly powerful. If that was not the case, why would those prodigies want to snatch it?
At the very least, this was equivalent to a Venerate Tier-level technique!

However, Zhang Youxuan also knew that this was a great opportunity. He hurriedly endured the agonizing pain of having his body pierced through by the celestial light, and used the Celestial Cauldron to trap the celestial light, then began to refine it.

The Celestial Cauldron was definitely the sturdiest part inside a Cauldron Forging Tier, because when there was really no other way, he could still use the Celestial Cauldron like a Spirit Tool, and shoot it out.

This was especially the case with the Golden Celestial Cauldron, which was even sturdier than the Two Star Divine Metal. As for the Tricolor Glass Cauldron, Golden Jade Cauldron, and the like, they were even sturdier.

Tong, tong, tong! Inside the Celestial Cauldron, that celestial light streaked out, wanting to break out of the cauldron. Meanwhile, Fatty Zhang gritted his teeth and endured. If he breathed a sigh of relief at this moment, he would miss out on this great opportunity.
After a while, he gradually entered into an optimal state.
Ling Han smiled, and strode off. This canyon was extremely secluded. It was very safe for this guy to refine the celestial light here.

He also found a safe place, then released the lightning-aligned celestial light. Once the black light of illusion shot out, it was immediately covered by the Celestial Cauldron, and he began to refine the celestial light.
To Ling Han, refining the celestial light was already something that he could do proficiently with practice. Three days later, he had succeeded.
This was… the Evil Killing Divine Lightning.
Nine Celestial Cauldrons, nine streaks of celestial light.

Now, he only had to cultivate another Celestial Cauldron, and then capture and refine a streak of celestial light. Then, he would be able to cultivate to the level of Ten Cauldrons that had never been cultivated before.
However, was it true that no one had ever cultivated to Ten Cauldrons before?
Ling Han was suspicious, because he now knew that a great many Imperial Clan prodigies didn’t have rankings in the Galaxy Network. In fact, they didn’t even have Galaxy Network’s account.
There was definitely a supreme prodigy among them!
Thus, some prodigies didn’t even use the Galaxy Network, so what were some supreme prodigies worth if they didn’t leave behind a legend of Ten Cauldrons?

One mustn’t underestimate any Ancestral King. That was an overlord that ruled over an era, the strongest in the world. How could it be that none of them had thought that a Cauldron Forging Tier would be able to form ten cauldrons?
Could it be that none of them had thought of any way to decrease the repulsive power of the Celestial Cauldrons?
He had never heard of it, but that did not mean that it did not exist.
Ling Han didn’t dare to be smug. Just like when he leaped over the Celestial Gate, didn’t he also see a figure arrive at the Primitive Celestial Gate?

“It’s extremely likely that Origin, Myriad Dao and the others have also cultivated the Primitive Celestial Gate. The Celestial Cauldron that they forged must be of the same quality as mine,” he murmured.
“Let’s not worry about this first. I’ll think about it after I finish cultivating to Ten Cauldrons. Otherwise, everything will only be empty words.”

Ling Han kept an eye out for any news of the celestial light. Though he had already obtained a considerable amount, what he needed the most was still the Lightning Element. Unless there was really no other way, he would still try his best to wait.
There was no news of the celestial light. However, there was a considerable amount of information about Feng Jixing, Song Lan and others.

It was said that their battle prowess was unparalleled. Even among the native Core Formation Tier cultivators of Demonic Origin Realm, there were not many that could match them, possessing outstanding reputation. Even those True Self Tier old monsters had a whole new level of respect for them.
Now, Feng Jixing was taking the lead, organizing the local and outsider cultivators to join forces, wanting to launch an assault on the Demon Abyss.

The Demon Abyss was an extremely dangerous place. There were wild beasts everywhere, and what was even more frightening was the Abyssal Earth Ants. Their bodies were as large as bulls, and there were tens of thousands of them in a single nest. Furthermore, their leaders were all at the level of the Core Formation Tier.
If they were ganged up on by such a swarm of ants, then even True Self Tier elites could only
die.
Thus, the Demon Abyss had always been a forbidden area for living beings, and no one dared
to barge in.
However, though the Abyssal Earth Ants were extremely frightening, the ant queen would
produce a mysterious liquid. If it was used to temper one’s body, it would allow the cultivator’s body to undergo a complete transformation, and become incredibly tough.
Ling Han pondered for a moment before deciding to cultivate in seclusion instead of joining in on the excitement.

He was getting closer and closer to the peak stage of Nine Cauldrons. Next, he would have to charge to Ten Cauldrons; where would he find the time to go to the Demon Abyss? Moreover, his physique had already been tempered to a tough enough extent. Perhaps the ant fluid could help him evolve further, and that could only be considered icing on the cake.
Ling Han calmed down and quietly cultivated.
In just a month, he had reached the peak stage of Nine Cauldrons.
Next, it was the most difficult step, breaking through to Ten Cauldrons.
At the very least, Ling Han had never seen a person who could reach such heights. This was the Cauldron Forging Tier’s true peak. Throughout history, perhaps only a few people had
reached such heights.
Where there was absolute height, there would definitely be loneliness. Ling Han did not have any reference, and could only ponder on his own, advancing alone.
He wasn’t in a hurry to break through. Instead, he relaxed completely. Every day, he would
drink tea and flip through his information to see if there was any information about the
empress and the others.
Seven days later, a big piece of news came. Feng Jixing had already joined forces with an army, and was advancing towards the Demon Abyss.𝑓𝑟ℯ𝘦𝓌𝘦𝘣𝑛𝑜𝓋𝑒𝓁.𝑐ℴ𝓂

At this moment, Ling Han also started to attempt breaking through to Ten Cauldrons. He channeled the techniques that he had obtained from that predecessor, and then began to nurture the core of the tenth Celestial Cauldron. Weng, the nine great Celestial Cauldrons immediately released a force of repulsion, but as they collided with each other, it weakened
considerably.

Very good, Ling Han nodded internally. That predecessor was indeed a genius. He clearly had not formed ten cauldrons himself, but the direction of his deduction was correct. However, even if he had this kind of method to reduce the repulsive force of the Celestial Cauldrons, when the nine Celestial Cauldrons unleashed their might at the same time, this was practically a qualitative change. Pa, pa, pa! The Celestial Cauldron core that Ling Han had formed continued to shatter.
Nine was the pinnacle of heaven and earth. It was as if the heavens did not allow the creation of ten cauldrons. This was a suppression that surpassed power.

chapters.title: Chapter 3933: Ten Cauldrons!
paragraphs: Chapter 3933: Ten Cauldrons!
Ling Han frowned. The research direction of that predecessor was correct, but he had still underestimated the resistance of heaven and earth.
After all, after all, that predecessor had not formed ten cauldrons.
Imagining things out of thin air was ultimately only theoretical. There were a great many problems that could only be discovered through practical experimentation.

Weng, weng, weng! The nine Celestial Cauldrons shook together, forming a powerful pressure that was like the myriad manifestations of heaven and earth. Under this kind of pressure, it was impossible to form tenth cauldron. The new core would be crushed the moment it was formed.
Ling Han had no choice but to use the power of living beings in the dimensions inside his body. Otherwise, this was a mission that would never be completed.
Endless fine power surged out, and every single power was negligible, but as a small amount gathered into a large amount, it also became a power that could not be underestimated.
Ling Han cultivated a new core of the Celestial Cauldron. He wrapped it with the power of living beings, forming a barrier that resisted the suppression of the nine Celestial Cauldrons.
It had withstood!

Ling Han revealed an overjoyed expression. Under the effects of the life force of the dimensions inside his body, as well as the methods of his predecessor, the newly born Celestial Cauldron core finally withstood the pressure.
Kuang!
A sudden clap of thunder sounded out of nowhere. Dark clouds rolled out, and there was lightning flashing in the clouds.
Cultivating ten cauldrons was something that even the heavens envied.

Ling Han stayed true to his heart. Though the heaven and earth was raging, it would not directly send supreme lightning to erase him. After all, he had not done any heinous deeds. Thus, the one who would really attack him should be the internal demon.

As expected, after a bolt of lightning struck down, a golden figure immediately formed in Ling Han’s mind. It brandished a large saber and slashed madly, wanting to shatter his mind and turn him into a soulless body.

“An!” Ling Han shouted the Six Characters Bright King Curse. Even if it was only a single word, and even if it wasn’t the Buddhist Race’s true inheritance, it still had the effect of expelling evil and suppressing one’s heart.
With a roar, that golden figure was instantly weakened.
Ling Han laughed loudly, and his divine sense took human form, greeting the golden figure. Peng! Peng! Peng!
They battled fiercely, and Ling Han continued to shout out the Six Characters Bright King Curse, continuously weakening the golden figure.
In just a few minutes, this golden figure was completely killed by Ling Han.

Ling Han was neither pleased nor shocked, and continued to stabilize the core of the tenth cauldron. It had just formed. If it was continuously compressed by the nine great Celestial Cauldrons, it would ultimately shatter.
After another three days and nights, Ling Han finally stopped.
At this moment, the tenth cauldron had already been completely formed. This also meant that Ling Han had stepped into the level of Ten Cauldrons, that had perhaps never been reached before.
“How… strong am I now?”
Ling Han murmured to himself. He was extremely curious about what level his current battle prowess had reached.

“Judging from the increase in power, I should have reached Second Heaven of the Core Formation Tier. Then, added with various secret techniques, I can battle against Third Heaven of the Core Formation Tier, and even win.”
This wasn’t as astonishing as he had imagined. After advancing to Ten Cauldrons, his battle prowess had increased by a few levels.
He could go to the Tong Clan now.

Ling Han thought internally. He had long since announced that he was going to the Tong Clan to call them to an accounting, but in the blink of an eye, more than half a year had passed, and he still had not put it into action.𝚏𝐫𝚎𝗲𝕨𝐞𝐛𝕟𝚘𝐯𝚎𝗹.𝕔𝐨𝗺
Now was the time to realize his grand words.
Ling Han set out on his own, heading towards the Tong Clan Manor.
The Tong Clan was a Core Formation Tier force, and could be considered powerful even in the Demonic Origin Realm. They occupied a city, and were undisputed overlords.
In this city, aside from the Tong Clan, there were no other Cauldron Forging Tier-level forces. There was a blank space.

That was because the Tong Clan did not allow the emergence of such a force. The moment any elite broke through to the Cauldron Forging Tier, the Tong Clan would move. Perhaps, they would recruit him into the Tong Clan through marriage, or they would directly cripple his cultivation level, or even kill him.

Though the Tong Clan was so overbearing, no one dared to resist, because the Tong Clan was really too strong. With three great Core Formation Tier elites standing guard, this was comparable to several hundred Cauldron Forging Tiers, and there were only Foundation Building Tiers here. Even if they attacked together, they would be instantly destroyed.
After Ling Han arrived in this city, he only asked around, and then found the Tong Clan Residence.
The Tong Clan was really too well-known. Furthermore, because Ling Han had asked about them, he was instantly pointed at, as if he was a public enemy.

Ling Han couldn’t help but shake his head in shock. Just what great sins had the Tong Clan committed, that they would actually incur the hatred of others to this extent? As long as they had the slightest contact with them, they would be considered great villains.
He strode forwards, and arrived at the doors of the Tong Clan Manor.

“Hey, who goes there? How dare you barge into the Tong Clan Manor!” There were two guards at the entrance, and they both had a curved saber at their waists. One of their hands was placed on the hilt of their saber. When they saw Ling Han walk over directly, the two of them drew half of their sabers at the same time, and shouted angrily at Ling Han.
Ling Han humphed, “A mere lackey is worthy of asking my name?”
“How dare you!” The two of them hurriedly rushed over, drawing their sabers and slashing.
Ling Han snapped his fingers, and two gusts of wind swept past. The two of them instantly fell to the ground, their foreheads split open, blood gushing out.
As if he had done something negligible, he strode forwards, and walked through the doors.

This scene was naturally seen by the people outside, instantly causing a commotion. They all called their friends over to watch, hoping that Ling Han would be a dragon that crossed the river and destroy the Tong Clan.
However, no one dared to barge into the Tong Clan Residence. They could only watch from the outside.
After Ling Han entered through the main doors, there was a very long passage ahead of him. On either side, there were gardens, and there were peculiar flowers and plants planted there.
He had not taken a few steps, when he saw a considerable number of people rush out from the other end of the passage. All of them looked fierce.
This was natural. Usually, it would only be their Tong Clan that would be bullying others. How could they allow others to trifle with them?
“Charge!” These people brandished their weapons, and slashed towards Ling Han.
Ling Han moved, and shot out a punch, which turned into a terrifying wave that surged towards those people.
“Stop!” At the same time, someone also shouted loudly, but it was already too late. Ling Han shot out a punch. Peng, peng, peng! Those who had charged over were all sent flying, as if
they were straws.

Pa, pa, pa! When these people landed on the ground, all of them had lost their vitality. “Motherf*cker!” Only now did the person who had shouted earlier appear on the walkway. He cursed, then rebuked Ling Han furiously, “Brother Qian, our Tong Clan naturally welcomes your visit, but why did you make a move to kill him?”
At present, Ling Han had already disguised himself as he was in the Black Heaven Temple,
and after the three Core Formation Tiers of the Tong Clan returned, they naturally informed their clansmen of Ling Han’s appearance, and told them to receive Ling Han well when he
came to visit.
Hence, that person “recognized” Ling Han, and opened his mouth to stop him, but he was
still a step too slow.

Because the three elites of the Core Formation Tier had all commanded that Ling Han be well received, the members of the Tong Clan could only swallow their anger and not fly into a rage when they clearly saw Ling Han commit murder.
Ling Han shrugged, and declared proudly, “To dare make a move on me, he deserved to die!”
The member of the Tong Clan was furious, yet he merely clenched his fists tightly. After a while, he finally said, “Lord Clan leader has been waiting for you for a very long time. Please
follow me.”
“Lead the way,” Ling Han said lightly, naturally causing that member of the Tong Clan to suffer another 10,000 points of damage.

Ling Han had no choice but to use the power of living beings in the dimensions inside his body.
Otherwise, this was a mission that would never be completed.
Endless fine power surged out, and every single power was negligible, but as a small amount gathered into a large amount, it also became a power that could not be underestimated.
Ling Han cultivated a new core of the Celestial Cauldron.
He wrapped it with the power of living beings, forming a barrier that resisted the suppression of the nine Celestial Cauldrons.
It had withstood!
Ling Han revealed an overjoyed expression.
Under the effects of the life force of the dimensions inside his body, as well as the methods of his predecessor, the newly born Celestial Cauldron core finally withstood the pressure.
Kuang!
A sudden clap of thunder sounded out of nowhere.
Dark clouds rolled out, and there was lightning flashing in the clouds.
Cultivating ten cauldrons was something that even the heavens envied.
Ling Han stayed true to his heart.
Though the heaven and earth was raging, it would not directly send supreme lightning to erase him.
After all, he had not done any heinous deeds.
Thus, the one who would really attack him should be the internal demon.
As expected, after a bolt of lightning struck down, a golden figure immediately formed in Ling Han’s mind.
It brandished a large saber and slashed madly, wanting to shatter his mind and turn him into a soulless body.
“An!” Ling Han shouted the Six Characters Bright King Curse.
Even if it was only a single word, and even if it wasn’t the Buddhist Race’s true inheritance, it still had the effect of expelling evil and suppressing one’s heart.
With a roar, that golden figure was instantly weakened.
Ling Han laughed loudly, and his divine sense took human form, greeting the golden figure.
Peng!
Peng!
Peng!
They battled fiercely, and Ling Han continued to shout out the Six Characters Bright King Curse, continuously weakening the golden figure.
In just a few minutes, this golden figure was completely killed by Ling Han.
Ling Han was neither pleased nor shocked, and continued to stabilize the core of the tenth cauldron.
It had just formed.
If it was continuously compressed by the nine great Celestial Cauldrons, it would ultimately shatter.
After another three days and nights, Ling Han finally stopped.
At this moment, the tenth cauldron had already been completely formed.
This also meant that Ling Han had stepped into the level of Ten Cauldrons, that had perhaps never been reached before.
“How… strong am I now?”
Ling Han murmured to himself.
He was extremely curious about what level his current battle prowess had reached.
“Judging from the increase in power, I should have reached Second Heaven of the Core Formation Tier.
Then, added with various secret techniques, I can battle against Third Heaven of the Core Formation Tier, and even win.”
This wasn’t as astonishing as he had imagined.
After advancing to Ten Cauldrons, his battle prowess had increased by a few levels.
He could go to the Tong Clan now.
Ling Han thought internally.

He had long since announced that he was going to the Tong Clan to call them to an accounting, but in the blink of an eye, more than half a year had passed, and he still had not put it into action.𝚏𝐫𝚎𝗲𝕨𝐞𝐛𝕟𝚘𝐯𝚎𝗹.𝕔𝐨𝗺
Now was the time to realize his grand words.
Ling Han set out on his own, heading towards the Tong Clan Manor.
The Tong Clan was a Core Formation Tier force, and could be considered powerful even in the Demonic Origin Realm.
They occupied a city, and were undisputed overlords.
In this city, aside from the Tong Clan, there were no other Cauldron Forging Tier-level forces.
There was a blank space.
That was because the Tong Clan did not allow the emergence of such a force.
The moment any elite broke through to the Cauldron Forging Tier, the Tong Clan would move.
Perhaps, they would recruit him into the Tong Clan through marriage, or they would directly cripple his cultivation level, or even kill him.
Though the Tong Clan was so overbearing, no one dared to resist, because the Tong Clan was really too strong.
With three great Core Formation Tier elites standing guard, this was comparable to several hundred Cauldron Forging Tiers, and there were only Foundation Building Tiers here.
Even if they attacked together, they would be instantly destroyed.
After Ling Han arrived in this city, he only asked around, and then found the Tong Clan Residence.
The Tong Clan was really too well-known.
Furthermore, because Ling Han had asked about them, he was instantly pointed at, as if he was a public enemy.
Ling Han couldn’t help but shake his head in shock.
Just what great sins had the Tong Clan committed, that they would actually incur the hatred of others to this extent?
As long as they had the slightest contact with them, they would be considered great villains.
He strode forwards, and arrived at the doors of the Tong Clan Manor.
“Hey, who goes there?
How dare you barge into the Tong Clan Manor!” There were two guards at the entrance, and they both had a curved saber at their waists.
One of their hands was placed on the hilt of their saber.
When they saw Ling Han walk over directly, the two of them drew half of their sabers at the same time, and shouted angrily at Ling Han.
Ling Han humphed, “A mere lackey is worthy of asking my name?”
“How dare you!” The two of them hurriedly rushed over, drawing their sabers and slashing.
Ling Han snapped his fingers, and two gusts of wind swept past.
The two of them instantly fell to the ground, their foreheads split open, blood gushing out.
As if he had done something negligible, he strode forwards, and walked through the doors.
This scene was naturally seen by the people outside, instantly causing a commotion.
They all called their friends over to watch, hoping that Ling Han would be a dragon that crossed the river and destroy the Tong Clan.
However, no one dared to barge into the Tong Clan Residence.
They could only watch from the outside.
After Ling Han entered through the main doors, there was a very long passage ahead of him.
On either side, there were gardens, and there were peculiar flowers and plants planted there.
He had not taken a few steps, when he saw a considerable number of people rush out from the other end of the passage.
All of them looked fierce.
This was natural.
Usually, it would only be their Tong Clan that would be bullying others.
How could they allow others to trifle with them?
“Charge!” These people brandished their weapons, and slashed towards Ling Han.
Ling Han moved, and shot out a punch, which turned into a terrifying wave that surged towards those people.
“Stop!” At the same time, someone also shouted loudly, but it was already too late.
Ling Han shot out a punch.
Peng, peng, peng!
Those who had charged over were all sent flying, as if
they were straws.
Pa, pa, pa!
When these people landed on the ground, all of them had lost their vitality.
“Motherf*cker!” Only now did the person who had shouted earlier appear on the walkway.
He cursed, then rebuked Ling Han furiously, “Brother Qian, our Tong Clan naturally welcomes your visit, but why did you make a move to kill him?”
At present, Ling Han had already disguised himself as he was in the Black Heaven Temple,
and after the three Core Formation Tiers of the Tong Clan returned, they naturally informed their clansmen of Ling Han’s appearance, and told them to receive Ling Han well when he
came to visit.
Hence, that person “recognized” Ling Han, and opened his mouth to stop him, but he was
still a step too slow.

Because the three elites of the Core Formation Tier had all commanded that Ling Han be well received, the members of the Tong Clan could only swallow their anger and not fly into a rage when they clearly saw Ling Han commit murder.
Ling Han shrugged, and declared proudly, “To dare make a move on me, he deserved to die!”
The member of the Tong Clan was furious, yet he merely clenched his fists tightly.
After a while, he finally said, “Lord Clan leader has been waiting for you for a very long time.
Please
follow me.”
“Lead the way,” Ling Han said lightly, naturally causing that member of the Tong Clan to suffer another 10,000 points of damage.

chapters.title: Chapter 3934: Feng Clan
paragraphs: Chapter 3934: Feng Clan
Ling Han was welcomed into the main hall.
He saw that there were other guests in the Tong Clan.
Tong Xiao and Tong Shuhua were sitting on the main seats, and there were two men seated below them. One was a middle-aged man in his forties, while the other was a young man in his twenties.
To be able to stand as equals with the two members of the Tong Clan, the strength of these two naturally had to be on the level of the Core Formation Tier.
Ling Han swept an eye over them with his eye technique, revealing a slightly surprised expression.
The middle-aged man was indeed in the Core Formation Tier, but the young man was actually also in the Core Formation Tier.
Though he had expected this, the twenty-year-old Core Formation Tier cultivator still gave him a shock. This was extremely young.
“Young friend Qian, you have finally arrived!” Tong Xiao laughed loudly, “Quick, please sit, please sit!” He made a gesture of invitation, but he did not move, looking like he was high and mighty.
He still had to put on some airs. After all, he was an elite at the late stage of Core Formation Tier.

Ling Han showed an expression of pride. At present, he was a young prodigy that was proud of his own talent. Naturally, he had to put on enough airs, and used a very arrogant posture to find a seat to sit down.

“Humph, a mere Cauldron Forging Tier cultivator, what right do you have to sit in front of us?” The young man who was the only one seated suddenly spoke up, casting a sideways glance at Ling Han with strong disdain.
“Your surname is Tong?” Ling Han asked.
The young man faltered, and subconsciously shook his head. The surname naturally could not be changed carelessly.
“Since your surname is not Tong, what business is it of yours!” Ling Han retorted.
He had come today to call them to account, so he was naturally here to act all arrogant and haughty.

“You!” The young man immediately stood up, appearing to be unable to restrain his fury. Though he was a Core Formation Tier cultivator, and his abilities could be considered extremely powerful, it was obvious that his mentality had not caught up. After all, he was still too young.
“Lingcheng, sit down!” The middle-aged man sitting beside him took a sip of tea as he called out calmly.

“Fourth Uncle!” The young man was defiant, and turned to look at the middle-aged man. They were also natives, and came from the Feng Clan of the neighboring city. The middle- aged man’s name was Feng Bao, and the young man’s name was Feng Lingcheng.

The Feng Clan originally had four Core Formation Tier elites, and added with the fact that Feng Lingcheng had also broken through recently, they now had five Core Formation Tier elites. These abilities were naturally powerful, and they were also the overlords of the area. This time, the Feng Clan and Tong Clan were just about to form an alliance through marriage, and Feng Lingcheng was one of the parties involved, personally coming to propose marriage. As members of the Feng Clan, they were naturally all haughty and conceited. Meanwhile, Feng Lingcheng had advanced into the Core Formation Tier at such a young age, so he was naturally even prouder. Being rebuked by Ling Han like this, he immediately wanted to commit murder.
Thankfully, he knew that this was the territory of the Tong Clan, and only then did he force himself not to make a move.

Meanwhile, Feng Bao said calmly, “You are about to become a son-in-law of the Tong Clan, and can be considered half a member of the Tong Clan. If anyone speaks disrespectfully to you, I am sure that your Uncle Tong and father-in-law would not just sit by and watch.” Being mocked by him like this, Tong Xiao and Tong Shuhua naturally didn’t look too pleased. “Hehe, don’t worry, son-in-law. I won’t let you suffer a grievance!” Tong Shuhua hurriedly said.
The current Tong Clan was not as strong as it had once been. There was one less Core Formation Tier elite, while the Feng Clan had one more. It was five against two; the gap was too wide.
Thus, the Tong Clan was naturally at a disadvantage before the Feng Clan.
“Second Leader, what do you mean by that?” Ling Han spoke up, his expression cold. Second Leader?

Tong Shuhua’s expression instantly darkened. Logically speaking, this address was indeed very clear about his status in the Tong Clan, but they were not mountain banditsor thieves. This was too vulgar, wasn’t it?

“Young friend Qian, this is Feng Lingcheng. Though he looks to be about the same age as you, he is an elite of Core Formation Tier!” he said solemnly. After all, he still had a very high opinion of Ling Han, because even a Pseudo Emperor had a whole new level of respect for Ling Han.
At present, Ling Han’s cultivation level was still not very high, but there may be a chance for him to become a Saint in future. This was considered a long-term investment.
Ling Han smiled faintly, and said, “So what if he is in the Core Formation Tier? I’ve even seen a Pseudo Emperor before.”
This show-off.

Feng Lingcheng was about to explode in fury. He could no longer hold himself back. Pointing at Ling Han, he said, “Ignorant brat, no matter who tries to persuade me today, it is useless. I am determined to teach you a good lesson.”

The Feng Clan was far more powerful than the Tong Clan, so he had no scruples. Meanwhile, Ling Han looked at Tong Xiao and Tong Shuhua, and said with a smile, “Guys, there’s such a lunatic messing around at home, and you’re not going to interfere?”𝙛𝒓𝓮𝒆𝔀𝒆𝙗𝓷𝒐𝙫𝒆𝙡.𝒄𝓸𝓶

Tong Xiao and Tong Shuhua both wore awkward expressions. They were both a little displeased with Feng Lingcheng for taking matters into his own hands, and also furious at Ling Han for being arrogant and insensitive.

However, they couldn’t afford to offend the Feng Clan. Seeing that Feng Lingcheng was already so furious, and Feng Bao was still drinking tea, it was obvious that he was deliberately indulging him. Thus, they didn’t dare to stop him.
This was good too. He would teach Ling Han a lesson, so that he would restrain himself a
little.
“Humph, now that there is no one to back you up, are you afraid now?” Feng Lingcheng asked calmly, a hint of mockery in his voice.
You can be arrogant because of the two members of the Tong Clan, and now these two people don’t dare to back you up. Won’t you have to cower like a pug?
Meanwhile, Ling Han looked left and right. “Where did this mad dog come from? It’s barking everywhere, so why isn’t anyone chasing it out?”

“You’re courting death!” Feng Lingcheng shouted loudly. At first, he had only wanted to teach Ling Han a lesson. After all, he wanted to leave some face for his future father-in-law, but Ling Han provoked him time and time again, causing his killing intent to rise.
He strode towards Ling Han. Boom, the aura of the Core Formation Tier surged, and swirls appeared in the surrounding air, exuding a terrifying intimidation.
Pa, pa, pa! Teacups, vases, and other items in the hall exploded one after another.
The might of Core Formation Tier was no joke.
Ling Han was calm and unperturbed. He had already advaned into Ten Cauldrons, and his

battle prowess was comparable to the Third Heaven of Core Formation Tier. In fact, he could even kill him with a powerful move. What need was there for him to be concerned about a newly broken through Core Formation Tier?
-How could it be that Feng Lingcheng was as freakish as Feng Jixing, and Song Lan? Once they advanced into the Core Formation Tier, they possessed the battle prowess of Third
Heaven?
“I really don’t know where you get your courage from!” Feng Lingcheng moved, and slowly delivered a palm strike at the top of Ling Han’s head.
“Nephew, please have mercy and spare this brat’s life,” Tong Xiao finally said. He didn’t want Ling Han to die. This was a prodigious young man, and an outsider at that.
In the end, they would still have to leave this place, and once they left, what was a Core
Formation Tier cultivator worth?
Thus, he definitely couldn’t kill these outsiders who had astonishing backgrounds. Otherwise, wouldn’t the Sect Master-level elites charge over to take revenge at the drop of a hat?
Wouldn’t that lead to the destruction of his clan?

Yet Feng Bao spoke up, and said, “Brother Tong, there is no need to have reservations. We have already reached an agreement with Feng Jixing. When we leave the Mystery Realm, we would be able to rely on the Longhua Holy Land.”
On the surface, these words were meant for Tong Xiao, but in truth, they were meant to
support Feng Lingcheng.
So be it if he was killed. In any case, they could rely on the Holy Land, so who did they need to
care about?
Even an Imperial Clan would not trifle with a Holy Land unless there was absolutely need for
it.
After hearing Feng Bao’s words, Feng Lingcheng naturally had no more reservations. He revealed a cold smile, and his attack instantly sped up.
Ling Han shook his head, and only then did he stand up. Then, he delivered a palm strike at
Feng Lingcheng.

chapters.title: Chapter 3935: Defeat Core Formation Tier
paragraphs: Chapter 3935: Defeat Core Formation Tier
Peng!
Everyone saw a figure being sent flying, breaking through the wall at an extraordinarily fast speed, and disappearing from sight.
And what caused their scalps to go numb was the fact that the person who was standing there unscathed was not Fejg Lingcheng, but rather Ling Han!
Hiss, how was this possible?
Whether it was the two Core Formation Tiers of the Tong Clan, or Feng Bao, they were all dumbfounded, as if they had seen a ghost.
A mere Cauldron Forging Tier was actually able to send Feng Lingcheng, a cultivator of the Core Formation Tier, flying with a single slap?

That’s right. Feng Lingcheng had just broken through, and his cultivation level hadn’t even completely stabilized yet. It was difficult for him to reach even First Heaven-level battle prowess, but Core Formation Tier was Core Formation Tier. In terms of level, it was an iron rule of martial arts to crush the Cauldron Forging Tier.
However, it was clear that the iron rule had lost its effect.
Peng!
Feng Lingcheng charged back, his expression filled with fury, as if he could burn even the heavens.

Ling Han couldn’t help but laugh in spite of himself, saying, “Are you stupid? There’s clearly a hole that you crashed through here, yet you insist on ramming a new one in. Are you trying to show off your stubbornness, or are you trying to help the Tong Clan destroy their clan residence?”
Feng Lingcheng was so angry that he could not speak. Why was this person’s mouth so toxic?
“You will die an extremely ugly death!” After a while, he spat out word by word.
Ling Han shrugged and said, “I’m so scared!”

“Die!” Feng Lingcheng charged over. This time, he used a powerful move. As he shot out a punch, a green light shot out, and the light moved, actually turning into a green flood dragon. It could be clearly seen that the green flood dragon was covered with seals. That was condensed from boundless power, and was also imbued with high-level energy. Once it exploded, it would have the might of First Heaven of Core Formation Tier and above.𝒻𝑟𝘦𝘦𝘸ℯ𝒷𝑛𝘰𝓋ℯ𝘭.𝘤𝘰𝘮

Feng Bao couldn’t help but nod and comment, “Lingcheng is indeed worthy of being the prized son of our Feng Clan. This Azure Dragon Fist has already attained the true essence. Even if I use it, the might of my attack at the same cultivation level would only be so-so.”

Though he had lost just now, outsiders all had powerful backgrounds, and had been bestowed with a great many rare treasures. Thus, it would not be strange for that brat to suddenly burst out with battle prowess that surpassed the First Heaven of Core Formation Tier.

The problem was that rare treasures couldn’t be channeled continuously, because for Cauldron Forging Tiers, Core Formation Tier-level rare treasures were like bottomless pits that would suck the Cauldron Forging Tier dry.
Thus, Feng Lingcheng used a powerful move, and there was a high chance that Ling Han’s rare treasure could no longer be used. With this advantage, there was no need to speak of the result.

Boom, that green flood dragon had already arrived, and coiled towards Ling Han. As long as it managed to wrap around him tightly, all the seals would explode, exploding with endless destructive power.
Ling Han stood with his hands clasped behind his back, completely unconcerned.

If the large black dog was here, he would definitely exclaim that Ling Han was showing off again. However, in the eyes of the Tong Clan and Feng Clan, this was not showing off, but rather that his abilities were inferior, and there was absolutely no way for him to resist. The green flood dragon wrapped around him, and immediately exploded. Boom, a terrifying energy surged out, directly shattering the Main Hall of the Tong Clan. And this was still because the power had been concentrated on Ling Han and exploded. Otherwise, the entire Tong Clan Manor would have ceased to exist.
Dust filled the air, and everyone naturally leaped out of the hall in the nick of time. If they were to be hit, wouldn’t they be too battered and exhausted?
“Humph, you have suffered the consequences of your own actions!” Feng Lingcheng declared coldly, a mocking smile on his face.
In everyone’s eyes, sustaining such a blow, even a Core Formation Tier cultivator would be severely wounded, what more a Cauldron Forging Tier cultivator.
However, when the dust gradually dispersed, they saw a person standing proudly among the ruins.
It was Ling Han!
All of a sudden, everyone looked disbelieving, staring dumbly at Ling Han as if they had seen a ghost.
What was going on? Why was this guy completely unscathed?

paragraphs: Chapter 3936: Revealing Identity
Were the people of the outside world all so freakish?
The members of the Tong Clan were all about to go crazy. How could there be such a powerful Cauldron Forging Tier?
Have you been injected with the blood of a Saint?
Ling Han’s hands moved, and shot out multiple flashes of divine light from within the Celestial Cauldrons.

Ordinarily speaking, after one divine light shot out, it would definitely take a while for a second one to be fired out, but how many divine lights did Ling Han have in total? Excluding the black light of illusion, he had a total of eight offensive divine lights.
What kind of concept was this?
At least, it was equivalent to Saint Technique. The Primal Chaos Divine Lightning was even comparable to the Imperial Technique. If eight flashes were used in turn, there would be absolutely no gap.
Of course, using it at the same time was even more frightening. It was equivalent to a young Great Emperor leading his seven lackey Saints to attack at the same time. Who could bear that?
Boom!
It was only a single strike, and Feng Bao was done for. He was severely injured.
How long had it been? Two great Core Formation Tier elites were defeated by Ling Han.
Ling Han walked over and grabbed Feng Bao and Feng Lingcheng together. His expression was calm, but killing intent overflowed from him.
At this time, the members of the Tong Clan finally recovered.
This was too shocking. Two great elites of the Core Formation Tier had been easily defeated by Ling Han. How could they not be dumbfounded with shock?

“Hehe, Young Friend Qian, please calm your anger!” Tong Xiao hurriedly said. He was afraid that Ling Han would kill the two members of the Feng Clan in a fit of anger. In that case, the Tong Clan would definitely be implicated, and the Feng Clan would take their anger out on them.

Meanwhile, the Feng Clan had three other Core Formation Tiers, one in the middle stage of the Core Formation Tier, one in the late stage of the Core Formation Tier, and one in the consummate level of the Core Formation Tier. To say nothing of the three of them attacking at the same time, as long as that Core Formation Tier consummate level cultivator came, it would be difficult for him and Tong Shuhua to resist him even if they joined forces.
Thus, the two members of the Feng Clan definitely couldn’t die.
“Oh, why didn’t you tell them to calm down just now?” Ling Han asked calmly.
Tong Xiao wore an awkward expression. How could he dare to stop the Feng Clan?
He naturally would not say these words, and hurriedly said, “Young friend, in future, we will be a family, so please give me some face!”
“Sure!” Ling Han nodded.
Tong Xiao was instantly delighted. However, to his horror, he discovered that Ling Han had raised his foot and slammed it down. Pa! Feng Bao’s head was smashed into mush.
So what if you were a Core Formation Tier cultivator? If your head was shattered, you would definitely die completely.

“No!” Tong Xiao felt like the whole world was spinning, and his vision almost blacked out. He was dead. Feng Bao was dead. It was over now. Just how furious would the Feng Clan be? “You!” Tong Xiao shouted angrily. He was also so furious that he wanted to kill someone. Ling Han smiled, and placed one foot on Feng Lingcheng’s head. His warning could not be more obvious.
If you dare to come over, I will also stomp on this person’s head.
Tong Xiao instantly stopped in his tracks, not daring to make another move.
“Release him, and everything can be discussed!” Tong Xiao said solemnly.

This was the prized son of the Feng Clan. Although Feng Bao’s death would also enrage the Feng Clan, it wouldn’t drive them crazy. However, if Feng Lingcheng were to die, the Feng Clan would definitely go berserk.
“Sure!” Ling Han smiled, and raised his foot.
Though Ling Han had said yes, Tong Xiao felt an extreme sense of foreboding, because previously, Ling Han had only just said “Okay”, and in the next second, he had stomped Feng Bao to death.
This brat was not playing by the rules at all.
Pa! Ling Han resolutely stomped down, and blood sprayed through the air. Feng Lingcheng, the prized son of the Feng Clan, had also become a corpse.
Zi, his blood was still spraying hotly.
Tong Xiao’s vision darkened again. A thought flashed through his mind. The Tong Clan was finished.

Even if Feng Bao and Feng Lingcheng hadn’t died by the hands of the Tong Clan, Ling Han had been invited by the Tong Clan. Moreover, the Tong Clan hadn’t saved them either, and they were only watching from the sidelines. How could they deny this responsibility?
However, Tong Xiao was a wily old fox, after all. After being the Clan Head of the Tong Clan for so many years, his brain was naturally vibrant.
“Young friend, this isn’t your fault. Rather, it’s the Feng Clan’s people who have gone too far!” Tong Xiao said with a serious expression. He appeared as righteous as could be.
What was going on?
The members of the Tong Clan were all dumbfounded. Why was Tong Xiao suddenly biased in favour of Ling Han?
“Big Brother!” Tong Shuhua couldn’t help but say. Although he had always listened to his Big Brother, the matter today was something that he could not accept.

Tong Xiao communicated through divine sense, and said, “Now that things have come to this, we’re definitely going to become hostile with the Feng Clan. So, why don’t we just make the best of it and cling to this brat tightly? Just think, when this brat was in the Cauldron Forging Tier, he was already able to kill a cultivator in the middle stage of the Core Formation Tier. into the Core Formation Tier, would he still need to fear the Feng
Then, when he a
Clan?”
“This is an outsider, and has an astonishing background in the outside world. As long as we firmly hold onto this line, what fear would we have of not having meteoric success in future?”
That’s right.
Tong Shuhua secretly clapped his hands. His older brother was indeed clever, directly turning
a terrible incident into a situation that was beneficial to the clan.𝘧𝓇ℯ𝑒𝓌𝑒𝑏𝓃𝘰𝘷𝘦𝘭.𝒸ℴ𝓂
He looked at Tong Xiao with undisguised admiration.
“Young friend Qian, please leave with us. As long as I, Tong Xiao, am still alive, I will definitely ensure your safety!” Tong Xiao said resolutely.
Ling Han smiled, “Are you telling the truth?”
“Of course, my word is as good as gold!” Tong Xiao patted his chest and said.
“Even if I kill the Third Brother Tong?” Ling Han asked again.
‘What do you mean?’

The members of the Tong Clan didn’t understand. Third Brother Tong was naturally Tong Yongning. He had died at the hands of that evil criminal, and he had even deliberately sent someone back to report the news. He was extremely detestable.
“Hehe, young friend, don’t joke around,” Tong Xiao said. Although he was smiling, he was suppressing his anger.

Two Core Formation Tiers of the Feng Clan had been killed. He was already having enough of a headache, and now Ling Han had brought up Tong Yongning’s matter in front of him. Wasn’t this adding fuel to the fire?
Ling Han shook his head, and said, “Although I like to joke around, it depends on the person. With you guys? Hehe, I’m not interested.”
“Brat, don’t be too arrogant!” Tong Shuhua shouted harshly. He couldn’t hold himself back
any longer.
“Come, take a look at this young master’s true appearance.” With a thought from Ling Han,
he immediately put on his disguise.
What!
‘Motherf*cker!’
The members of the Tong Clan were instantly enraged. Wasn’t this the culprit who had killed
Tong Yongning?
Realization dawned on everyone. How could there be so many freaks in this world? This was a Cauldron Forging Tier that had the ability to kill a Core Formation Tier elite. As it turned out,
the two were the same person!
“It’s you!” Tong Xiao finally understood why Ling Han didn’t give him any face. He was
clearly here for revenge.
Ling Han laughed loudly, “Are you surprised? Shocked?”
There was no surprise, only shock.
All the members of the Tong Clan glared furiously at Ling Han. This b@stard, not only had he
killed one of their own, he had also laid a huge trap for them, and dragged in a great enemy
like the Feng Clan.
“Good! Good! Good!” Tong Xiao said to the heavens, a baleful expression on his face. “I
swear, if I don’t kill you, I won’t be human!”
Ling Han smiled, “Then you won’t have the chance to be human in future.”
“Die!” Tong Xiao pounced quickly, charging towards Ling Han.
He was in the late stage of the Core Formation Tier, and his battle prowess soared to the Sixth
Heaven, far surpassing Ling Han.
Faced with such an elite, even Ling Han didn’t dare to face him head-on. He used the Imminent Skyline, and that was to bully Tong Xiao who hadn’t grasped a profound movement
technique. As he dodged the other’s attacks, he continued to deliver fatal blows at the members of the Tong Clan.
