Ling Han smiled, “Then you won’t have the chance to be human in future.”
“Die!” Tong Xiao pounced quickly, charging towards Ling Han.
He was in the late stage of the Core Formation Tier, and his battle prowess soared to the Sixth
Heaven, far surpassing Ling Han.
Faced with such an elite, even Ling Han didn’t dare to face him head-on.
He used the Imminent Skyline, and that was to bully Tong Xiao who hadn’t grasped a profound movement
technique.
As he dodged the other’s attacks, he continued to deliver fatal blows at the members of the Tong Clan.

chapters.title: Chapter 3937: Destruction of the Tong Clan
paragraphs: Chapter 3937: Destruction of the Tong Clan
Ling Han didn’t hold back at all.

One only had to look at how much the people in the city hated the Tong Clan, and one would know just how arrogant and domineering the members of the Tong Clan were usually. Thus, there was no need for him to be merciful.
“Stop! Stop!” Tong Xiao roared in fury as he gave chase.
“Evil villain!” Tong Shuhua also joined the battle. In the area, only the two of them were strong enough to stand against Ling Han.

However, Ling Han didn’t dare to face these two people head-on at all. His battle prowess was indeed superior to Tong Shuhua, but Tong Shuhua was a Core Formation Tier elite, after all, so he still had some abilities. He temporarily didn’t want to waste time on Tong Shuhua. He continued to attack. In truth, there was no need for him to directly hit them. The barrage of murderous aura shot out, and the members of the Tong Clan collapsed one after another. “Great!”
Outside, everyone was watching to their heart’s content, wanting nothing more than to clap and cheer.

However, looking at Ling Han’s expression, it was clear that he was no match for Tong Xiao. Thus, in order to avoid being called to an accounting in future, they suppressed their excitement and simply roared in their minds.

There were quite a few clansmen of the Tong Clan, but they could not withstand Ling Han’s killing. Furthermore, because the Tong Clan Manor had previously been blasted into ruins by Feng Lingcheng, there was no place for them to hide now. They were all standing very conspicuously, and were practically living targets.
In just a few minutes, only two members of the Tong Clan were still alive.𝙛𝓻𝒆𝒆𝒘𝙚𝓫𝙣𝙤𝒗𝙚𝓵.𝙘𝙤𝙢
Tong Xiao and Tong Shuhua.
“Ah!” Tong Xiao and Tong Shuhua both roared at the sky. This was practically exterminating their entire clan.
They no longer needed to worry about the Feng Clan, because the Tong Clan was already finished. What need was there for them to care about the fury of the Feng Clan?
Ling Han looked coldly at Tong Shuhua. There was still one more person, and this was someone that he had the ability to kill.
Tears of blood were already streaming from Tong Xiao’s eyes. Previously, he had still been filled with ambition, but now, there were actually only two people left of the massive Tong Clan.
He was filled with hatred, and his fury soared to the heavens. He wanted to kill Ling Han 10,000 times.
“Freeze!” He did not hesitate to expend his mystical power, which he endlessly released from his body, freezing the air in the surroundings.
In this way, it was as if space had become extremely muddy. Movement was filled with obstruction, so speed naturally decreased drastically.
This consumed an exorbitant amount of mystical power, but Tong Xiao only had one thought in his mind at this moment, and that was to kill Ling Han. How could he care about anything else?
Black light of illusion!
Ling Han waved his hand proudly.
Tong Xiao faltered for a moment before falling into an illusion. His expression alternated between anger and delight, and it was unknown what he was experiencing.
With his pause, the mystical power in the air lost his control, and naturally began to dissipate. Ling Han looked at Tong Shuhua with a sharp gaze, as if he could see through people’s hearts.
Tong Shuhua couldn’t help but feel astonished. Why was there suddenly no reaction from Big Brother?

He was only at the early stage of the Core Formation Tier, and his battle prowess was only at the First Heaven. He was no match for Feng Bao at all. However, Feng Bao had already been obliterated by Ling Han, so what was he worth?
“I already said that I would come collect this debt.” Ling Han walked towards Tong Shuhua at a slow pace.
“Big Brother! Big Brother!” Tong Shuhua called out, his voice filled with terror. However, it was as if Tong Xiao had become an idiot, completely ignoring him.
He was extremely terrified. What could he do?
“Hehe, even if you scream your lungs out, no one will come save you,” Ling Han said with a smile.
Why did these words sound so strange?
Tong Shuhua retreated continuously. He did not dare to face Ling Han’s sharpness head-on.
Using the Imminent Skyline, Ling Han took a step forward at an astonishing speed. In an instant, he had already arrived in front of Tong Shuhua.
Tong Shuhua’s expression changed drastically, and he hurriedly threw a punch at Ling Han. Eighteen Arhat Palm!
Ling Han smiled and unleashed the Demonic Monkey Fists.
Peng!
With a single punch, Tong Shuhua was sent flying, and all the bones in his arms were
shattered.
“Ah!” Tong Shuhua roared loudly. He was burning his Celestial Core to forcefully extend his life. Right now, he only had one thought, and that was to hold on until his older brother woke
up.
After combusting the Celestial Core, his injuries immediately recovered, and he returned to his prime condition.
Right at this moment, he heard a roar from Tong Xiao. He had broken free from the illusion. “Damn brat!” He compressed the air again, restricting Ling Han’s speed.
Ling Han smiled faintly, and still shot out a flash of the black light of illusion. After such a short while, the black light of illusion could naturally be used again.
Tong Xiao was hit again, and entered into the illusion again.
‘F*ck you!’

Tong Shuhua was rendered speechless. It wasn’t easy for him to hold on until his older brother came back to his senses. However, with a roar, his older brother had once again become a blockhead. This made him want to vomit blood.
Could he burn his Celestial Core again?
He couldn’t.
“I’ve already told you. Even if you scream your lungs out, you won’t be saved,” Ling Han said
calmly.

Tong Shuhua gritted his teeth, and said, “You can be as proud as you like now, but you killed a member of the Feng Clan, so the Feng Clan will definitely not spare you! You have to know that the Feng Clan has a Core Formation Tier consummate level elite, and you are not a match
at all!”
Ling Han was completely unconcerned. He shrugged and said, “Consummate level of the Core Formation Tier? When I advance into the Core Formation Tier, I’ll be able to suppress him
with one hand.”

If it was another person, Tong Shuhua would definitely reprimand him as a pipe dream, because when the early stage of the Core Formation Tier was compared with the consummate level of the Core Formation Tier, the gap in battle prowess was not just a little bit, but rather
completely one-sided.

However, Ling Han was far too freakish. Right now, he was only at the Cauldron Forging Tier, yet he possessed battle prowess at the Third Heaven or even the Fourth Heaven of Core Formation Tier. That being the case, what would happen after he advanced into Core
Formation Tier?
How much could one increase their battle prowess by advancing a major tier?
Thus, it wasn’t impossible that Ling Han would be able to rival a Core Formation Tier consummate level elite by then.

“Are you in enough despair?” Ling Han asked. “You don’t even have a chance for revenge, so are you filled with so much hatred that you want to destroy the world? However, you can ask the people in the surroundings. Which one of them isn’t filled with so much hatred that they want to devour the flesh and blood of your Tong Clan?”

“In the past, you guys only wanted to have fun, so you used the large ship to crush me. Hehe, as long as you had the slightest bit of restraint, it would not have led to today’s calamity!” Ling Han said calmly, “This evil karma that you have sown is the consequence of your own
actions!”
Tong Shuhua looked around, and though not a single person spoke, there was hope and fury flickering in their eyes.
They hoped that he would die, as well as a fury that would burn him to death.
He had nothing to say. Just like Ling Han had said, as long as the members of the Tong Clan
behaved with the slightest bit of restraint, they would not have trifled with Ling Han in the past, and would not have caused such trouble today.
“I’ll send you on your way!” Ling Han charged over, and delivered a palm strike at Tong
Shuhua.
“I’m going to drag you down with me!” Tong Shuhua roared. He unleashed his full power, completely ignoring Ling Han’s attacks. He was going to drag Ling Han down with him.
In his dreams.

Ling Han raised his hand and shot out a bolt of lightning. Pa, Tong Shuhua was instantly hit, and smoke rose from his chest. He had almost been struck straight through. However, though he had not died, he was already severely injured, and was continuously
throwing up blood from his mouth.
Ling Han sent out another palm strike. Though Tong Shuhua tried his best to block it, it was
like a mantis trying to stop a chariot.
Peng! With a single strike, Tong Shuhua was completely dead.
“Great!”
“Good kill!”
“He should have died long ago!”
Seeing Tong Shuhua die, the people in the surroundings finally couldn’t help but cheer. For a
long time, the Tong Clan was like a great mountain that was pressing down on their heads, deciding their life and death, and they could only be bullied by them.
Now, the originally arrogant Tong Clan only had Tong Xiao left, so how could they not be
overjoyed?

chapters.title: Chapter 3938: The Feng Clan makes a move
paragraphs: Chapter 3938: The Feng Clan makes a move
Ling Han glanced at Tong Xiao, then said to the people around him, “Disperse. This guy won’t die for a while.”

Tong Xiao had only fallen into an illusion, and had not become an idiot. Faced with an attack, he would still instinctively counterattack. Thus, in a situation when there was a very wide gap in battle prowess between the two of them, Ling Han had absolutely no confidence that he could kill Tong Xiao.
However, this didn’t matter. Once he advanced to the Core Formation Tier, Tong Xiao would definitely die.
Ling Han clenched his hand into a fist, and eight flashes of divine light of lightning shot out at the same time, striking towards Tong Xiao.

As expected, Tong Xiao was still in the illusion, but the instincts of a cultivator were still present. In the illusion, this kind of attack had also been manifested. Immediately, he struck out with both palms, greeting those eight streaks of divine light.
Boom!
With a loud bang, the eight streaks of divine light were all dispersed.
Ling Han sighed upon seeing this. The gulf between their cultivation levels was far too great. Even after unleashing eight flashes of divine light, he still couldn’t cause much damage to Tong Xiao.
And after this attack, Tong Xiao also struggled out of the illusion. He glared angrily at Ling Han, his eyes spitting fire.
In the Tong Clan, he was the only one left.
“Tong Xiao, I will leave your life for now. I will return to retrieve it.” Ling Han laughed loudly, and flew away on his Tool.
After Tong Xiao chased for two steps, he soon stopped in his tracks.
Firstly, he couldn’t catch up at all, and secondly, even if he did, so what? The other party could send him into an illusion with a wave of his hand.
He pondered for a moment, then decided to go to the Feng Clan.
Now that he was all alone, he was naturally unafraid of the Feng Clan’s revenge. On the other hand, only the Feng Clan had to guard against him going crazy and going all out against them.
Thus, he could go to the Feng Clan, and have the Feng Clan join forces with him to hunt down Ling Han.
Otherwise, he alone would not be able to do anything against Ling Han.

There were a great many places here that did not allow flight. As long as he entered into that kind of place, then if the Core Formation Tier consummate level elite made a move, and the Core Formation Tier late stage elite intercepted him, Ling Han would definitely be unable to escape.
With this in mind, he immediately leaped up, and did not turn around to take another look.

Ling Han flew away. Although he hadn’t exacted revenge yet, Tong Xiao was the only one left. Moreover, he still had to endure the torture of recalling his clan having been exterminated day and night. These days were naturally torturous. It wouldn’t be an exaggeration to say that he was better off dead than alive.
He arrived at a city, and paid attention to the clues of celestial light.

However, he had already swept through many dangerous places before, so whatever celestial light he could find, he had naturally found long ago. Now, he could only wait for those ancient sites that had been sealed off to open. Who knows, there may still be celestial light.
However, to be so coincidental that he just happened to find a Lightning Element – the difficulty level would be higher.

A dozen over days later, the news came. The army that had swept through the Demon Abyss was actually progressing smoothly, destroying a swarm of ants, and retrieving a great amount of precious ant fluid, Celestial medicine, and Divine Metal. At present, the coalition army was just about to penetrate deeply, to expand the results of their battle.
It was said that someone had seen what was suspected to be celestial light.
A thought flashed in Ling Han’s head, and he decided to take a look.

He set off for the Demon Abyss, and after walking for a few days, a massive abyss appeared ahead of him. Black-colored gas soared into the skies, manifesting into all sorts of shapes and forms, but they were all incredibly hideous, intimidating anyone who saw them.
Ling Han stretched out his head to take a look, and frowned slightly. This abyss was like a valley of death, filled with boiling air of death, which made him instinctively feel disgusted.

Martial artists cultivated and refined the energy of heaven and earth, turning it into their own mystical power to strengthen their life force. Thus, unless one cultivated some kind of evil cultivation technique, they would definitely detest this kind of place to the extreme.
If there was celestial light here, would it be Lightning Element?
Ling Han was doubtful, because lightning was the power of heaven and earth to deliver punishment. It was the strongest and most intense power, so would it appear in such an
abyss?
He hesitated for a moment, but still decided to go down and take a look.
He had already arrived, so it was naturally impossible for him to retreat. Furthermore, as long as it was a celestial light, even if he didn’t want it, he could save it for those close to him.
Ling Han looked for a path to descend into the abyss.

Flying on a Tool was not possible here. The black Qi that was rising was filled with corrosive power, and could also cause great damage to a cultivator of the Core Formation Tier. Thus, there was no need to take it head-on.
Not long after, he found the way down.
“Hmm?”
Ling Han suddenly stopped in his tracks. He felt like he was being stared at, but on second thought, he didn’t take it to heart and continued forwards.

He still had the trump card, the Heavenly Dao Flames, in his hands. Even against a True Self Tier cultivator, it was not that he would not be able to fight back. It was just that he wanted to temper himself, so he had not used it all this while.
-But this did not mean that he did not know how to use it.
After he disappeared, four people walked out from afar.
Tong Xiao was accompanied by three other men. The oldest was already in his sixties, while the other two were also in their fifties.
“As expected, this brat has come here!” Tong Xiao said coldly. Though Ling Han had already disappeared, his gaze as he looked ahead was still filled with killing intent.

The other three were Feng Clan’s three Core Formation Tier elites, and they were Feng Shaolin, Feng Kun, and Feng Jian. Feng Shaolin’s cultivation level was the highest, and he was already at the consummate level of the Core Formation Tier.
“To dare to kill the prized son of our Feng Clan, we must make him pay with his life!” Feng Shaolin declared balefully.
“This brat has entered into the abyss, and there is no way to fly there. Unless he sprouts wings, he would not be able to escape,” Tong Xiao said coldly.
“Chase!”

The four of them turned around, and followed the path that Ling Han had descended. Previously, they had not made a move because they feared that Ling Han would fly away on his Tool, but the moment Ling Han entered into the abyss, he would be trapped.
However, when the four of them followed the steep mountain path all the way into the abyss,
there was still no sign of Ling Han.
“Where is he?” The four of them frowned.
Logically speaking, they had only been left behind for a short while, so it should not have been to the extent that they had lost track of their target.
“Continue the chase.” Feng Shaolin humphed, and took the lead.
Feng Kun and Feng Jian hurriedly followed. Meanwhile, Tong Xiao swept his gaze over the
surroundings before setting off.
When the figures of the four people disappeared, a flash was seen in the air, and Ling Han
appeared.
“So it is Tong Xiao!”
“Those three should be the Feng Clan’s Core Formation Tier elites.”

“Heh, now you guys are hunting me down, but when I capture the last lightning-aligned celestial light and refine it, I’ll begin to charge towards the Core Formation Tier. At that time, we’ll see if you guys will be hunting me down, or if I’ll turn around and hunt you guys down.”
Ling Han chose a different direction and flew away.𝐟𝕣𝗲𝕖𝕨𝗲𝐛𝗻𝗼𝐯𝗲𝚕.𝗰𝚘𝐦
However, not long after he left, Tong Xiao and the three members of the Feng Clan
surprisingly returned.
“That despicable brat was hiding here just now!” Tong Xiao was holding a jade-colored toad
in his hand, and he was facing the direction where Ling Han had just disappeared.
This was a tracking treasure that he had paid an exorbitant price for. He had deliberately obtained it after the destruction of the Tong Clan, and it was finally useful.
“This brat should have some means to hide his tracks. Thus, after chasing for a while, we have
to relocate him.”
“En!”
The four Core Formation Tier elites nodded one after another, and set off in pursuit of where
Ling Han had disappeared.
Their speed was extremely fast, but every once in a while, they would have to stop to confirm
the direction of Ling Han’s location. Sometimes, when Ling Han turned around, they would take a wrong path, and have to circle back, and relocate a few times.
Thus, though they were travelling at full speed, they had not managed to catch up to Ling Han all this while. They merely followed behind him.

It wouldn’t be an exaggeration to say that he was better off dead than alive.
He arrived at a city, and paid attention to the clues of celestial light.
However, he had already swept through many dangerous places before, so whatever celestial light he could find, he had naturally found long ago.
Now, he could only wait for those ancient sites that had been sealed off to open.
Who knows, there may still be celestial light.
However, to be so coincidental that he just happened to find a Lightning Element – the difficulty level would be higher.
A dozen over days later, the news came.

The army that had swept through the Demon Abyss was actually progressing smoothly, destroying a swarm of ants, and retrieving a great amount of precious ant fluid, Celestial medicine, and Divine Metal.
At present, the coalition army was just about to penetrate deeply, to expand the results of their battle.
It was said that someone had seen what was suspected to be celestial light.
A thought flashed in Ling Han’s head, and he decided to take a look.
He set off for the Demon Abyss, and after walking for a few days, a massive abyss appeared ahead of him.
Black-colored gas soared into the skies, manifesting into all sorts of shapes and forms, but they were all incredibly hideous, intimidating anyone who saw them.
Ling Han stretched out his head to take a look, and frowned slightly.
This abyss was like a valley of death, filled with boiling air of death, which made him instinctively feel disgusted.
Martial artists cultivated and refined the energy of heaven and earth, turning it into their own mystical power to strengthen their life force.
Thus, unless one cultivated some kind of evil cultivation technique, they would definitely detest this kind of place to the extreme.
If there was celestial light here, would it be Lightning Element?
Ling Han was doubtful, because lightning was the power of heaven and earth to deliver punishment.
It was the strongest and most intense power, so would it appear in such an
abyss?
He hesitated for a moment, but still decided to go down and take a look.
He had already arrived, so it was naturally impossible for him to retreat.
Furthermore, as long as it was a celestial light, even if he didn’t want it, he could save it for those close to him.
Ling Han looked for a path to descend into the abyss.
Flying on a Tool was not possible here.
The black Qi that was rising was filled with corrosive power, and could also cause great damage to a cultivator of the Core Formation Tier.
Thus, there was no need to take it head-on.
Not long after, he found the way down.
“Hmm?”
Ling Han suddenly stopped in his tracks.
He felt like he was being stared at, but on second thought, he didn’t take it to heart and continued forwards.
He still had the trump card, the Heavenly Dao Flames, in his hands.
Even against a True Self Tier cultivator, it was not that he would not be able to fight back.
It was just that he wanted to temper himself, so he had not used it all this while.
-But this did not mean that he did not know how to use it.
After he disappeared, four people walked out from afar.
Tong Xiao was accompanied by three other men.
The oldest was already in his sixties, while the other two were also in their fifties.
“As expected, this brat has come here!” Tong Xiao said coldly.
Though Ling Han had already disappeared, his gaze as he looked ahead was still filled with killing intent.
The other three were Feng Clan’s three Core Formation Tier elites, and they were Feng Shaolin, Feng Kun, and Feng Jian.
Feng Shaolin’s cultivation level was the highest, and he was already at the consummate level of the Core Formation Tier.
“To dare to kill the prized son of our Feng Clan, we must make him pay with his life!” Feng Shaolin declared balefully.
“This brat has entered into the abyss, and there is no way to fly there.
Unless he sprouts wings, he would not be able to escape,” Tong Xiao said coldly.
“Chase!”
The four of them turned around, and followed the path that Ling Han had descended.
Previously, they had not made a move because they feared that Ling Han would fly away on his Tool, but the moment Ling Han entered into the abyss, he would be trapped.
However, when the four of them followed the steep mountain path all the way into the abyss,
there was still no sign of Ling Han.
“Where is he?” The four of them frowned.
Logically speaking, they had only been left behind for a short while, so it should not have been to the extent that they had lost track of their target.
“Continue the chase.” Feng Shaolin humphed, and took the lead.
Feng Kun and Feng Jian hurriedly followed.
Meanwhile, Tong Xiao swept his gaze over the
surroundings before setting off.
When the figures of the four people disappeared, a flash was seen in the air, and Ling Han
appeared.
“So it is Tong Xiao!”
“Those three should be the Feng Clan’s Core Formation Tier elites.”
“Heh, now you guys are hunting me down, but when I capture the last lightning-aligned celestial light and refine it, I’ll begin to charge towards the Core Formation Tier.
At that time, we’ll see if you guys will be hunting me down, or if I’ll turn around and hunt you guys down.”
Ling Han chose a different direction and flew away.𝐟𝕣𝗲𝕖𝕨𝗲𝐛𝗻𝗼𝐯𝗲𝚕.𝗰𝚘𝐦
However, not long after he left, Tong Xiao and the three members of the Feng Clan
surprisingly returned.
“That despicable brat was hiding here just now!” Tong Xiao was holding a jade-colored toad
in his hand, and he was facing the direction where Ling Han had just disappeared.
This was a tracking treasure that he had paid an exorbitant price for.
He had deliberately obtained it after the destruction of the Tong Clan, and it was finally useful.
“This brat should have some means to hide his tracks.
Thus, after chasing for a while, we have
to relocate him.”
“En!”
The four Core Formation Tier elites nodded one after another, and set off in pursuit of where
Ling Han had disappeared.
Their speed was extremely fast, but every once in a while, they would have to stop to confirm
the direction of Ling Han’s location.
Sometimes, when Ling Han turned around, they would take a wrong path, and have to circle back, and relocate a few times.
Thus, though they were travelling at full speed, they had not managed to catch up to Ling Han all this while.
They merely followed behind him.

chapters.title: Chapter 3939: Hunted down
paragraphs: Chapter 3939: Hunted down
However, Ling Han didn’t know that there were four pursuers behind him. He ran as fast as lightning, and only stopped after running for half a day. He started a fire, planning to eat first.
He sat down as he focused on grilling the food. He had always been very serious when it came to food.
Not long after, the barbequed meat released a fragrance, which made his appetite stir.
‘Hmm?’
Ling Han hadn’t taken a bite yet, but his divine sense sensed that four auras were rapidly approaching at an extremely fast speed.
He had not even finished this thought, when xiu, xiu, xiu, xiu, four figures appeared.
Tong Xiao and the three members of the Feng Clan.
“Brat, I’ve found you!” Tong Xiao immediately shouted harshly, and charged towards Ling
Han.
He was filled with extreme fury towards Ling Han. With this pounce, he was as fast as a streak of light, his might soaring to the heavens.
Ling Han shot out a murderous aura attack, slightly affecting Tong Xiao. Then, with a leap, he calmly dodged.
“En?” The three members of the Feng Clan were all shocked.

They had heard of how strange Ling Han was from Tong Xiao. However, even though the Tong Clan had indeed been killed by Ling Han, they still found it hard to believe that a measly Cauldron Forging Tier cultivator could actually be as powerful as this.
This was illogical, and had broken their understanding.
When it came to things that surpassed one’s own understanding, the first thought of an ordinary person would definitely be to deny it, and think that it was fake.
The three members of the Feng Clan were no exception either. However, when they saw that Tong Xiao had suffered a blow, and seeing was believing, they finally became serious.
Though they had not seen Ling Han’s battle prowess yet, this kind of miracle was enough to shock them.

“Guys, what are you standing around for? Hurry up and attack!” Tong Xiao shouted loudly. In any case, he was all alone right now, so he didn’t care about his attitude toward the three members of the Feng Clan at all.
Feng Shaolin nodded, “Move!”
The three of them leaped out, encircling Ling Han.
“Tsk, so many outside helpers,” Ling Han said calmly, yet broke out of the siege without the slightest hesitation.

Feng Kun and Feng Jian were still fine, but Feng Shaolin was too strong, and the aura he exuded made even him feel a baleful pressure. This should be an old monster that had reached the consummate level of the Core Formation Tier, and his battle prowess was at least Seventh Heaven.

Right now, Ling Han’s battle prowess was only at the Fourth Heaven. In fact, he was even weaker than Tong Xiao, let alone Feng Shaolin, who was an old monster at the consummate level of the Core Formation Tier.
“Do you think you can escape?” Feng Shaolin sneered. He had already made his move, so how could he allow a Cauldron Forging Tier cultivator to escape?
“Then just keep your eyes open and watch me,” Ling Han said earnestly.
Even if Feng Shaolin had a high status, and did not show his emotions on his face, when he heard these words, he could not help but want to curse.
However, what was the point of bickering with a junior?
He delivered a palm strike, intending to blast Ling Han into smithereens.
Black light of illusion!
Ling Han didn’t make any obvious movements at all, and with a single thought, Feng Shaolin was already hit. His body stiffened, as if he was an idiot.
In this way, a gap instantly appeared in the encirclement. Ling Han used his movement technique, and calmly broke out of the siege.

Tong Xiao was both furious and resentful. He had already told these three people quite a few times that Ling Han had two trump cards that allowed him to influence others soundlessly, and they were still f****** unconcerned about this.

-Come to think of it, against the barrage of murderous aura and the black light of illusion, unless one had cultivated a special divine sense secret technique, it was useless whether one was prepared or not.
“Chase!” He took the lead, and set off in pursuit of Ling Han.
Feng Kun and Feng Jian hesitated slightly, then followed closely behind, and after a while, Feng Shaolin also came back to his senses with a fierce roar, and followed behind Feng Kun and Feng Jian.

He was incandescent with rage. As an elite at the consummate level of the Core Formation Tier, he had actually been struck by a Cauldron Forging Tier! This was a great humiliation, and it caused him to fly into a humiliated rage.
Ling Han took the lead, with Tong Xiao and the others behind him. They formed a straight line.
He naturally would not turn around to accept the challenge, and tried his best to make use of the terrain to throw off his pursuers.
The terrain of the abyss was extremely complicated. There were tall, sharp rocks scuttling out of the ground everywhere, blocking the way, and they had to circle around.
Thus, this gave Ling Han a chance to shake off his pursuers.
He circled around and around, and after a long while, he finally managed to throw off his𝒇𝓻𝓮𝓮𝙬𝙚𝒃𝒏𝓸𝙫𝒆𝙡.𝓬𝓸𝒎
pursuers.
However, before he could even catch his breath, Tong Xiao and the others had already returned.
F***, had they developed a dog’s nose?

He hurriedly broke into a run again, and once again used the terrain to throw off his pursuers. This time, he continued to run for a very long time before stopping, but he had not rested for too long, when he saw Tong Xiao and the others appear once more.
Ling Han had no option but to run again.

These four people definitely possessed some kind of tracking Spirit Tool, or else they wouldn’t have caught up so quickly. Moreover, he clearly saw the four people leave and choose the opposite direction, so how could they catch up so quickly?
He had solved a mystery, but this could not solve the problem of his pursuers.
No matter how far Ling Han ran, or how many detours he took, he was still caught up to. The only difference was how long it would take.
“Humph, when I break through to the Core Formation Tier, I’d really like to see who would be hunting whom!”
Ling Han also became ruthless. Come and give chase. His mystical power was endless, and he wanted to see who would be able to last longer.

He calculated the time. Every time, he would run until the sun rose before stopping. In this way, he would be able to calmly cultivate, while Tong Xiao and the others would have to use this time to catch up to him. Otherwise, the distance between them and him would become farther and farther.

In this way, he could continuously replenish the mystical power he had expended, but Tong Xiao and the others could not. They could only depend on the alchemical pills they ingested. At first, Tong Xiao and the others were still very determined, not concerned about recovering their power, and pursued him relentlessly. However, after a few times, they had no choice but to stop to cultivate, replenishing their power. Otherwise, even if they really caught up to Ling Han, it would also be a huge drain on their power, and it was hard to say who would be the one
killed.
In this way, Ling Han was left with a large amount of blank time, and he could take time out to search for celestial light.
However, this Demon Abyss was incredibly dim, and there were even powerful ferocious beasts lurking around, so it was indeed dangerous.
Thankfully, the area he was presently walking in had all been swept by Feng Jixing and the
other extermination troops. The great Vicious Beasts had already been killed, and the occasional few that slipped through the net were not all that strong.
Under this kind of pursuit, Ling Han shockingly discovered that his cultivation level was
improving very quickly.
The greater the pressure, the tougher his willpower would be, and this had instead forced out
all his potential.
Fine, if he could advance into the Core Formation Tier a few months in advance, then before
he killed Tong Xiao and the others, he would first have to thank them.
Ling Han thought internally. Xiu, xiu, xiu! His figure darted around, like a shuttle.
“Who goes there!”

When he scrambled out of a forest of rocks, he saw that there were actually a dozen over people ahead of him. With a glance, he could see that they were all very young handsome men and beautiful women, and a considerable number of them looked familiar to him.
“Ling Han!” A low roar rang out, and Feng Jixing had already charged over. Tsk, what a coincidence. He had actually caught up to Feng Jixing and his army. Of course,
these people were definitely just a small army, and there were no old monsters in the True Self
Tier.
“You damn thief!” Feng Jixing shouted. He threw a punch, and the power of his fist turned into seven treasured swords that shot towards Ling Han.

chapters.title: Chapter 3940: Coward
paragraphs: Chapter 3940: Coward
At that time, Feng Jixing and the other prodigies had battled fiercely over the eggs laid by the White Snake. Unexpectedly, however, Ling Han had managed to obtain seven eggs before them.
In Feng Jixing’s eyes, Ling Han was naturally a thief.

Ling Han frowned upon hearing this. With his current battle prowess, he could already rival Feng Jixing. However, there were still pursuers behind him, and they were about to catch up to him. Thus, how could he have the time to tangle with Feng Jixing?
Hence, he shot out a murderous aura attack, and taking advantage of the moment when Feng Jixing was startled, he had already flown past.
Feng Jixing came back to his senses and immediately roared, “Coward, since you dare to be a thief, why don’t you dare to fight me?”
Not only did he roar, he even used his divine sense to transmit a message into Ling Han’s mind.

F***! Ling Han couldn’t help but curse in his heart. He really wanted to turn around and slap Feng Jixing, but he wouldn’t let his emotions affect him. With a humph, Imminent Skyline unfolded, and his speed was extremely fast.
In any case, there would be plenty of chances to beat this guy up in the future, so there was no need to rush things.
Feng Jixing didn’t give chase. Ling Han had too many tricks up his sleeve, and if he was intent on fleeing, even he wouldn’t be able to catch up.
“Humph, you don’t even dare to fight me!” he declared proudly.
It could be said that this was the proudest time in his many exchanges with Ling Han. Ling Han didn’t even dare to battle him.
“Of course, in front of Brother Feng, it would be strange if Ling Han dared to fight!” Immediately, someone bootlicked.

“That’s right. When Brother Feng was in Cauldron Forging Tier, he was the top elite in North Heavenly Realm, and now that he has just advanced to the level of Core Formation Tier, his pure power has reached the battle prowess of Third Heaven. In future, he too would definitely be the top elites of Core Formation Tier.”
“Though that brat is afraid to battle, it is also a wise move. Otherwise, he would only be courting death!”
Everyone discussed among themselves, all of them feeling that this result was not unexpected. Feng Jixing was really that strong.
Only Song Lan glanced at Prosperous Heaven, and the latter shook her head slightly at her.
The two women were both incredibly intelligent, and had no lack of understanding of Ling Han. Would this man be afraid of a battle?
In the past, when the various Core Formation Tiers battled, he dared to interfere, so how could it be possible that he would cower now?
Xiu, xiu, xiu, xiu! Right at this moment, four figures leaped over from the distance, and then stopped.
One person used his mystical power to condense water vapour, which turned into a mirror. Then, it manifested into the figure of a man, and said to everyone, “Have you guys seen this person before?”
Yi, wasn’t this Ling Han?
“Yes,” someone nodded.
Feng Jixing frowned, and said, “Clan leader Feng, do you have a grudge against Ling Han?” So this person’s name was Ling Han.
It was only now that Tong Xiao and the others found out. They didn’t know what they were feeling. After chasing him for so long, they still didn’t know Ling Han’s name.

Feng Shaolin didn’t dare to put on airs in front of Feng Jixing. Feng Jixing’s talent was already astonishing enough, and he also had a Holy Land behind him. Thus, he nodded, and said, “This brat killed a member of our Feng Clan.”
He didn’t say that Ling Han had actually killed two of their Core Formation Tier cultivators. This was too humiliating.
So that was the case.
Feng Jixing pointed in the direction that Ling Han had fled in, and said, “He ran over there.”
“All right.” Feng Shaolin nodded, and together with Tong Xiao and the others, they set off in pursuit of Ling Han.
With their departure, a momentary silence fell.
“So Ling Han didn’t linger in battle because there were pursuers behind him,” someone whispered after a while.
These words were very soft, but Feng Jixing still heard them.
He looked furious. Wasn’t this equivalent to saying that Ling Han wasn’t afraid of him or cowered before him, and didn’t dare to fight him? Instead, it was because there were pursuers behind him.
Then what did he mean by being smug and arrogant for so long?
This was completely a slap to his own face.
Feng Jixing’s hands involuntarily clenched into fists, and his hatred for Ling Han increased
greatly.
However, even though he hated Ling Han so much, Ling Han didn’t pay any attention to him at all.
-Tong Xiao and the others had caught up again.
They were really like lingering ghosts.
Ling Han racked his brains. How could he get rid of these pursuers?
Now, no matter where he hid, the other party would be able to quickly locate him with the help of a tracking treasure, and from there, quickly find him.
Thus, it was impossible to completely throw off his pursuers by depending on the terrain.
Then what could he do?
Ling Han thought as he ran. Xiu, all of a sudden, he saw a black ant the size of a calf charge out. Its pincers were like blades, slicing out at him.
Abyssal Earth Ant.
Ling Han humphed, and shot out a punch. Eight flashes of divine light burst forth at the same
time.
Peng!
With a single punch, this Abyssal Earth Ant was killed.
He had it!
Ling Han’s eyes lit up. His figure descended, and after walking forward for a while, he saw a cave ahead of him. There were black ants the size of calves entering and exiting.
This was the lair of the Abyssal Earth Ants.
He put on the Void Beast hide, and concealed his tracks completely. Then, he headed towards
the ant nest.
As expected, though some Abyssal Earth Ants stopped when they passed by him, as if they had sensed something, they still continued onwards after stopping for a moment.
Ling Han ventured deep into the ant nest.

This was not just for the sake of avoiding pursuers, but there were also good things in the ant nest, such as Celestial medicine, Divine Metal, and so on. It was just that the divine fluid of the ant queen was not easy to obtain. There would definitely be a large number of soldier ants guarding that place. Once Ling Han was surrounded, it would not be so easy for him to use the Void Beast hide to hide his tracks.
Hence, he circled around, and only searched for those valuable things like Celestial medicine
and Divine Metal.
And outside, Tong Xiao and the others had also caught up.
“This brat… has entered the ant’s nest!” Tong Xiao looked at where the jade toad was pointing, and couldn’t help but frown.

To say nothing of the fact that there was only one Core Formation Tier consummate level cultivator among them, even if there were four True Self Tier cultivators, they would have to be careful. Once they charged into the ant’s nest, it was possible that there would be no return. “This brat has a treasure that can conceal his tracks, so he can sneak into the ant’s nest.”
“What a cunning guy. We can’t give chase at all!”
The four old geezers’ morale dropped drastically. They clearly knew that the brat was in the
ant nest, yet they were completely helpless against him.
Charge in? That would be suicide.
“Stay on guard!” Feng Shaolin said, “Just guard here. I don’t believe that this brat will never
come out!”
“En!”
“In the end, this brat still has to return to the outside world. He can’t hide here forever.” “Hence, just wait for him to come out. I don’t believe that he won’t come out!”
Tong Xiao and the others all agreed, and sat down cross-legged outside.
And in the ant nest, Ling Han roamed around, and obtained a considerable amount of good
stuff. He was not greedy, but rather quietly arrived at the exit.
“The four old guys are still guarding me.”
“Hehe, then they would never have imagined that I would come out so quickly, and return the
way I came. Then, even if they used the tracking item to investigate, they would only think
that there was a mistake with the treasure.”
“You guys just stay here. When I return, just see how I will deal with you guys.”

sentences.text: Chapter 3940: Coward
At that time, Feng Jixing and the other prodigies had battled fiercely over the eggs laid by the White Snake.
Unexpectedly, however, Ling Han had managed to obtain seven eggs before them.
In Feng Jixing’s eyes, Ling Han was naturally a thief.
Ling Han frowned upon hearing this.
With his current battle prowess, he could already rival Feng Jixing.
However, there were still pursuers behind him, and they were about to catch up to him.
Thus, how could he have the time to tangle with Feng Jixing?
Hence, he shot out a murderous aura attack, and taking advantage of the moment when Feng Jixing was startled, he had already flown past.
Feng Jixing came back to his senses and immediately roared, “Coward, since you dare to be a thief, why don’t you dare to fight me?”
Not only did he roar, he even used his divine sense to transmit a message into Ling Han’s mind.
Ling Han couldn’t help but curse in his heart.
He really wanted to turn around and slap Feng Jixing, but he wouldn’t let his emotions affect him.
With a humph, Imminent Skyline unfolded, and his speed was extremely fast.
In any case, there would be plenty of chances to beat this guy up in the future, so there was no need to rush things.
Feng Jixing didn’t give chase.
Ling Han had too many tricks up his sleeve, and if he was intent on fleeing, even he wouldn’t be able to catch up.
“Humph, you don’t even dare to fight me!” he declared proudly.
It could be said that this was the proudest time in his many exchanges with Ling Han.
Ling Han didn’t even dare to battle him.
“Of course, in front of Brother Feng, it would be strange if Ling Han dared to fight!” Immediately, someone bootlicked.
“That’s right.

When Brother Feng was in Cauldron Forging Tier, he was the top elite in North Heavenly Realm, and now that he has just advanced to the level of Core Formation Tier, his pure power has reached the battle prowess of Third Heaven.
In future, he too would definitely be the top elites of Core Formation Tier.”
“Though that brat is afraid to battle, it is also a wise move.
Otherwise, he would only be courting death!”
Everyone discussed among themselves, all of them feeling that this result was not unexpected.
Feng Jixing was really that strong.
Only Song Lan glanced at Prosperous Heaven, and the latter shook her head slightly at her.
The two women were both incredibly intelligent, and had no lack of understanding of Ling Han.
Would this man be afraid of a battle?
In the past, when the various Core Formation Tiers battled, he dared to interfere, so how could it be possible that he would cower now?
Xiu, xiu, xiu, xiu!
Right at this moment, four figures leaped over from the distance, and then stopped.
One person used his mystical power to condense water vapour, which turned into a mirror.
Then, it manifested into the figure of a man, and said to everyone, “Have you guys seen this person before?”
Yi, wasn’t this Ling Han?
“Yes,” someone nodded.
Feng Jixing frowned, and said, “Clan leader Feng, do you have a grudge against Ling Han?” So this person’s name was Ling Han.
It was only now that Tong Xiao and the others found out.
They didn’t know what they were feeling.
After chasing him for so long, they still didn’t know Ling Han’s name.
Feng Shaolin didn’t dare to put on airs in front of Feng Jixing.
Feng Jixing’s talent was already astonishing enough, and he also had a Holy Land behind him.
Thus, he nodded, and said, “This brat killed a member of our Feng Clan.”
He didn’t say that Ling Han had actually killed two of their Core Formation Tier cultivators.
This was too humiliating.
So that was the case.
Feng Jixing pointed in the direction that Ling Han had fled in, and said, “He ran over there.”
“All right.” Feng Shaolin nodded, and together with Tong Xiao and the others, they set off in pursuit of Ling Han.
With their departure, a momentary silence fell.
“So Ling Han didn’t linger in battle because there were pursuers behind him,” someone whispered after a while.
These words were very soft, but Feng Jixing still heard them.
He looked furious.
Wasn’t this equivalent to saying that Ling Han wasn’t afraid of him or cowered before him, and didn’t dare to fight him?
Instead, it was because there were pursuers behind him.
Then what did he mean by being smug and arrogant for so long?
This was completely a slap to his own face.
Feng Jixing’s hands involuntarily clenched into fists, and his hatred for Ling Han increased
greatly.
However, even though he hated Ling Han so much, Ling Han didn’t pay any attention to him at all.
-Tong Xiao and the others had caught up again.
They were really like lingering ghosts.
Ling Han racked his brains.
How could he get rid of these pursuers?
Now, no matter where he hid, the other party would be able to quickly locate him with the help of a tracking treasure, and from there, quickly find him.
Thus, it was impossible to completely throw off his pursuers by depending on the terrain.
Then what could he do?
Ling Han thought as he ran.
Xiu, all of a sudden, he saw a black ant the size of a calf charge out.
Its pincers were like blades, slicing out at him.
Abyssal Earth Ant.
Ling Han humphed, and shot out a punch.
Eight flashes of divine light burst forth at the same
time.
Peng!
With a single punch, this Abyssal Earth Ant was killed.
He had it!
Ling Han’s eyes lit up.
His figure descended, and after walking forward for a while, he saw a cave ahead of him.
There were black ants the size of calves entering and exiting.
This was the lair of the Abyssal Earth Ants.
He put on the Void Beast hide, and concealed his tracks completely.
Then, he headed towards
the ant nest.
As expected, though some Abyssal Earth Ants stopped when they passed by him, as if they had sensed something, they still continued onwards after stopping for a moment.
Ling Han ventured deep into the ant nest.
This was not just for the sake of avoiding pursuers, but there were also good things in the ant nest, such as Celestial medicine, Divine Metal, and so on.
It was just that the divine fluid of the ant queen was not easy to obtain.
There would definitely be a large number of soldier ants guarding that place.
Once Ling Han was surrounded, it would not be so easy for him to use the Void Beast hide to hide his tracks.
Hence, he circled around, and only searched for those valuable things like Celestial medicine
and Divine Metal.
And outside, Tong Xiao and the others had also caught up.
“This brat… has entered the ant’s nest!” Tong Xiao looked at where the jade toad was pointing, and couldn’t help but frown.
To say nothing of the fact that there was only one Core Formation Tier consummate level cultivator among them, even if there were four True Self Tier cultivators, they would have to be careful.
Once they charged into the ant’s nest, it was possible that there would be no return.
“This brat has a treasure that can conceal his tracks, so he can sneak into the ant’s nest.”
“What a cunning guy.
We can’t give chase at all!”
The four old geezers’ morale dropped drastically.
They clearly knew that the brat was in the
ant nest, yet they were completely helpless against him.
Charge in?
That would be suicide.
“Stay on guard!” Feng Shaolin said, “Just guard here.
I don’t believe that this brat will never
come out!”

chapters.title: Chapter 3941: Tenth Celestial Light
paragraphs: Chapter 3941: Tenth Celestial Light
Ling Han started to scour the surroundings for celestial light.
It was rumored that someone had seen a celestial light flickering here, but they could not be sure if it was celestial light.
This was his a last resort. If it wasn’t for the fact that he had no choice, Ling Han wouldn’t have wanted to make do. He would take any random celestial light and refine it.
Thankfully, he had not yet cultivated to the consummate level of Ten Cauldrons yet, so it could not be considered a waste of time.
What made him frown was when this Mystery Realm would close.

After the White Lotus Mystery Realm opened, it would continue for an indefinite period of time. It could be one to two years, or it could be three to five years. Thus, if he encountered a situation where it would close in just over a year, it was possible that as he searched, the token on him would explode on its own, and bring him out.
Hopefully, it would not be so soon.

Ling Han searched around. He ventured deep into various dangerous places. With the cover of the Void Beast hide, he could come and go as he pleased in most places, but if he encountered a True Self Tier great beast, he would not dare to approach at all.

The reaction speed of a wild beast of this level was too sensitive. If they were further away, he could still deceive them for a while, but as long as they were slightly closer, that would be an action of courting death.
After going around in circles, half a month had passed in the blink of an eye.
What worried Ling Han was the fact that Tong Xiao and the others had once again caught up to him.
Obviously, they had discovered that they had fallen into Ling Han’s trap.

Subsequently, Ling Han used the same trick again, using the ant’s nest to shake off these four people. However, Tong Xiao and the others had also learnt their lesson. Every time, not too long after, they would charge back, like sticky candy that could not be shaken off.
Now, every time Ling Han left them behind, he would only have one day of freedom, at most. Otherwise, his pursuers would definitely arrive.

Ling Han walked on the rugged path of the abyss. Even if there were occasional explorers here, their numbers were pitifully few. Thus, it was incredibly primitive everywhere, and there was no fixed path.
Most of the plants here were moss, but there were also dark purple vines that could grow well without sunlight.
Ling Han once again shook off his pursuers, and walked aimlessly.
Xiu, a ray of light streaked over the top of his head, dazzling and bright.
Yi?
Ling Han faltered for a moment before revealing a pleasantly surprised expression. Celestial light, this was celestial light!
He wanted to unleash the black light of illusion, but the chance was fleeting. By now, this streak of light had far surpassed the maximum attack range of the black light of illusion. He gave chase.
Ling Han adjusted his course, and set off in pursuit of the place where the light had disappeared.

The speed of the celestial light was astonishingly fast. Ling Han had long since lost track of the celestial light, so he only had one hope, and that was this streak of light had not taken a turn halfway.
After chasing for half a day, he stopped. Perhaps he had already chased too far. He could no longer run blindly.
He waited. Perhaps that streak of light would appear again.
However, the streak of light didn’t arrive. Instead, Tong Xiao and the others arrived beforehand.
Ling Han had no choice but to continue fleeing.
After a long while, he finally broke away from his pursuers. As he walked, he saw a dilapidated hall ahead of him.
Strange, how could there be a hall in such a dangerous place?
Who built it?
Ling Han was a very curious person. Moreover, he didn’t know where he should go to find the celestial light, so he strode into the hall.
The hall had long since become empty, but there were stone carvings on the surrounding walls, drawn into multiple pictures.
Ling Han looked over, and saw that what was drawn was actually an image of a great
massacre.
This artist was definitely brilliant. That was clearly a static scene, but when Ling Han saw it, it was as if the painting had come to life, and the characters inside were all moving.

A supreme elite unleashed a massacre. Planets and even galaxies were destroyed, and millions and millions of living beings were slaughtered. The scene was enough to make one shudder. Even if it was only a painting, Ling Han still broke out in a cold sweat from watching it. This painting was too realistic, making Ling Han feel the pressure of that supreme elite. He was sure that if such an elite was really standing in front of him, he would definitely be blasted into a shower of blood.
Ling Han composed himself, and looked at the next painting.
This was another elite massacring wantonly, but it was not the same person as the previous one, but was just as powerful and terrifying.
The third painting was like this, the fourth painting was like this, but when it reached the seventh painting, the image was cut off.
That was because this was a dilapidated hall. Now that he had reached this place, the walls were all gone, so it was naturally impossible for stone carvings to be left behind.
Was this a memorial of a certain moment in history?
If that was the case, then it would be too dark. Furthermore, what was the purpose of elites starting such a massacre?
Seeking revenge?
For fun?

The problem was that Ling Han couldn’t see a single person’s appearance even though the images of elites unleashing slaughter were clearly drawn on it. All of them were shrouded in black mist, and he could only distinguish their height and width, to identify that they were
actually different people.
Ling Han sighed. His present strength was too weak. So what if he was curious? What right did he have to investigate the truth of history?
Moreover, this may have been thought out of thin air by someone who had nothing better to
do.
Xiu, right at this moment, a streak of light flew past. Coincidentally, it shot towards Ling Han.
What was going on?

Ling Han instinctively thought that an attack was coming, and that Tong Xiao and the others had caught up to him. However, he immediately sensed that this was a purple lightning bolt. ‘F*ck! It’s the Celestial Light! Moreover, it’s the Lightning Element Celestial Light that I’ve been searching for!’
This was really searching high and low for it, yet it had delivered itself right to his doorstep.
Ling Han directly summoned the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower. It was like a net, allowing that bolt of lightning to shoot in.

The light of lightning hurriedly stopped, wanting to turn around and flee. It was only a flash of light, and it really stopped just like that. Just when it looked like it was about to flee, Ling Han hurriedly shot out the black light of illusion. Instantly, that flash of lightning stopped.
It still wanted to flee?
Ling Han then used the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower to overshadow it. Finally, he managed to capture this lightning element celestial light.
The ninth bolt of lightning!
Ling Han laughed loudly. Now, he was finally satisfied.
Xiu, his figure suddenly leaped. Boom, a deep pit immediately appeared where he had been standing, and there was still terrifying energy bubbling.
Ling Han looked sideways, and saw that Tong Xiao and the others had walked over from four different directions, forming a siege.
“It’s the four of you again!” Ling Han shook his head, “Are you people born in the year of the dog? Your noses are really sharp!”
“Don’t be cheeky!” Tong Xiao charged over, delivering a palm strike. The force turned into a divine weapon that shot towards Ling Han.
Ling Han smiled, and did not linger in battle. Immediately, he began to break out of the siege.

This time, he only had to refine the last bolt of lightning, and he would be able to attempt breaking through to the Core Formation Tier, and once he advanced into the Core Formation Tier, it would definitely be a piece of cake for him to kill these four people.
“Just you wait. When I return to find you, it will be the time of your deaths!”
“In your dreams!”
Tong Xiao and the others attacked together. After such a long time, they gradually developed
a tacit understanding, and their combined power became stronger and stronger. Ling Han was temporarily unable to channel the black light of illusion, but it didn’t matter.
The murderous aura shot out, and added with the eight divine lights of lightning, he paid the price of being hit by a palm strike, and still managed to break out of the siege.

chapters.title: Chapter 3942: Crushed Cauldron
paragraphs: Chapter 3942: Crushed Cauldron
Ling Han spat out a mouthful of blood, and his figure staggered slightly, but his feet did not stop at all.
He had just carved out a path of blood after much difficulty, so how could he give up halfway?
He used the Imminent Skyline, and his speed was extremely fast.
After throwing off his pursuers, Ling Han dove into a nest of ants.
He healed his injuries first, and spent seven days to finally recover completely. Being struck by a peak stage Core Formation Tier elite’s attack, it was already very fortunate that he didn’t die.
Ling Han took a deep breath, and began to refine the last bolt of lightning.
This power of lightning was very strange. There were actually two sub-elements, one of Life and one of Death.
This was the Life and Death Purple Lightning.
Ling Han enveloped it with the Celestial Cauldron and slowly refined it. Three days later, he had succeeded.
At this point, he had refined ten flashes of celestial light, and possessed ten flashes of divine light, reaching his limit.
Ling Han glanced over. He was still a sliver away from reaching the consummate level of Ten Cauldrons.
Then he would cultivate to consummate level and break through to the Core Formation Tier before leaving.
Ling Han roamed around the ant nest, and obtained some more Celestial medicines, Divine Metal, and even some divine substances. It could be said that he had gained a lot.
And just like that, he stayed patiently in the ant nest for three months.
Peak stage of Ten Cauldrons.
The tenth cauldron had already gained all three legs, and had reached the pinnacle. There was no way to improve it any further.
He could break through to the Core Formation Tier.
However, Ling Han hesitated.

This was because he still hadn’t found a way to fuse the nine flashes of divine light of lightning. If he broke through to the Core Formation Tier now, he would only be able to retain a single flash of divine light. The other divine lights would be like the Nine Cauldrons, turning into fertilizer and completely vanishing.

The Core Formation Tier was divided into four stages. The first stage, which was the early stage of the Core Formation Tier, used one of the cauldrons as the core to nurture the Celestial Core, and the other cauldrons as nutrients. Finally, the Celestial Cauldrons all disappeared, forming a Celestial Core.
The second step was the middle stage of the Core Formation Tier, harvesting all the rare treasures in the world to increase the quality of the Celestial Core.

The third step was the late stage of the Core Formation Tier, inscribing patterns on the Celestial Core. The number was indefinite, but according to legends, the limit was Nine Patterns, and it was called the Nine Patterns Celestial Core.

Fourth step, the Core Formation Tier consummate level. In this process, the Celestial Core would slowly liquefy, and after completely liquefying, that would be the end of the entire Core Formation Tier.

Thus, if Ling Han were to break through now, there would only be one celestial light that could be retained from the celestial lights that he had painstakingly captured. Then what would he have sacrificed so much for?
Was there really no other way?
Furthermore, there was only one Celestial Cauldron left behind. With this as its core, the other Nine Cauldrons would only be reduced to nutrition. Wasn’t that too wasteful?
Ling Han sat down cross-legged. He cultivated the path of the strongest, so he was naturally unwilling to accept this.
He thought hard, and after three days, he came up with an extremely bold idea.
Wouldn’t all nine Celestial Cauldrons become nutrients?

Fine then. He would first fuse all ten Celestial Cauldrons together, turning them into a single cauldron, and use this as a core to nurture the Celestial Core. Then, just how strong would the Celestial Core be?
However, Ten Cauldrons was practically unprecedented, and he still wanted ten cauldrons to become one?

Ling Han seriously considered this possibility, because the Celestial Cauldron was the sturdiest thing in his body, especially when he had cultivated the Celestial Cauldron sthat imitated the Primitive Celestial Gate. It was a good many times sturdier than Divine Metal of the same level.
What would allow him to shatter the fusion?
“I have to give it a try!”
Ling Han’s eyes lit up. This was the path of the strongest that he had seen. If he gave up without trying, he would not be satisfied.
He began to experiment, using all the methods that he could think of.
At the beginning, he naturally did not dare to be too aggressive, but a gentle method was completely useless. The Celestial Cauldron was too sturdy.
“I have to take the risk.”
“Without entering the tiger’s den, how can you get anything?”
“If you want to become the strongest, you have to walk the most dangerous path.”
Ling Han gritted his teeth, and decided to “make a move”.

He rammed the Celestial Cauldrons inside his body into each other. Since this was the sturdiest, and neither external power nor his mystical power could damage it, he would just let them collide on their own. He did not believe that they would not break.
‘Come!’
He was a man of action, and immediately put this into action.
If others found out, they would definitely call him a lunatic.
Wasn’t he crazy?

Ten cauldrons was enough to create history. Perhaps, no one had ever reached this level in history. It was already strong enough, but Ling Han actually still wanted to shatter the Celestial Cauldrons and fuse the ten cauldrons into one?
Wasn’t this courting death?
Ling Han’s mind was calm, and he simply controlled his Celestial Cauldrons to collide,
collide, collide.
Weng, every time the Celestial Cauldrons collided, a terrifying wave would be released, causing his physical body to crack.
Ling Han took out the Celestial medicine and ingested it. He only maintained his vitality, and did not care about anything else.
Weng, weng, weng! Ling Han’s body seemed to have become the battlefield for the ten great Celestial Cauldrons. He bore the brunt of it, and was naturally the most unfortunate.

Ling Han was throwing up blood endlessly, and his skin had long since completely cracked open. Blood was gushing out. Not only that, his bones and internal organs had all crumbled under the barrage of power, and his whole person was like a pool of mud, looking extremely
miserable.
However, his willpower was as firm as iron, and he continued to have the ten Celestial Cauldrons crash into each other.

These were all forged from imitations of the Primitive Celestial Gate, so their quality was equal. If they were to shatter, they would definitely shatter at the same time. There was no situation wherein one would shatter, and the other would not.
Nine was the pinnacle of heaven and earth. Thus, forging ten cauldrons had broken the
pinnacle of heaven and earth, and created a miracle. However, the manifestation of heaven and earth was all from one. Ling Han firmly believed that one was the beginning of heaven
and earth.
Thus, fusing the Celestial Cauldrons wasn’t just for the sake of fusing the divine lights. More importantly, he believed that fusing the ten cauldrons into one was the strongest.
Peng!
He rammed the Celestial Cauldrons in his body, as if he was committing suicide.

He was really on the line between life and death. It was all thanks to his incredibly tenacious willpower that he had not died all this while. This was a kind of unwillingness, and also a kind of obsession with becoming stronger. It was close to madness, and close to mania. Ling Han’s physical body was already completely incomplete, but his soul did not release even half a groan of pain. He only had one thought, and that was to shatter all the Celestial Cauldrons and fuse them back into one.

After all, he was only a Cauldron Forging Tier cultivator, so how could he withstand such expense? His life force was declining in a straight line, and he was on the verge of death. As long as his willpower relaxed just the slightest bit, he would definitely be consigned to
eternal damnation.
Right at this moment, boom, it was as if heaven and earth had just opened. With a loud bang,
the ten Celestial Cauldrons all shattered.
Success!
Ling Han immediately focused all his attention, and began to reconstruct the Celestial
Cauldron.
This time, there was no repulsive force released by the other Celestial Cauldrons. The core of
the Celestial Cauldron rapidly formed.
Kuang!

However, a sudden clap of thunder rang out in the heaven and earth. Even if this was the Demon Abyss, so what? Dark clouds gathered densely, and thunder boomed violently, as if it wanted to tear apart the heaven and earth itself.

Previously, Ling Han had formed ten cauldrons, which was already enough to attract the hatred of the heaven and earth. Now that he had advanced further, merging the ten cauldrons into one, this should really be unprecedented. Perhaps, it would never happen again, and he would be targeted even more strongly by the heaven and earth.
A golden figure appeared in Ling Han’s mind. There was a golden saber in his hand, and he immediately slashed out at Ling Han.
“An!” Ling Han shouted the Six Figures of Truth loudly, but he shockingly discovered that after this shout, the golden figure actually did not weaken in the slightest.

Three days later, he had succeeded.

He was still a sliver away from reaching the consummate level of Ten Cauldrons.

The second step was the middle stage of the Core Formation Tier, harvesting all the rare treasures in the world to increase the quality of the Celestial Core.
The third step was the late stage of the Core Formation Tier, inscribing patterns on the Celestial Core.

chapters.title: Chapter 3943: Ten Cauldrons Return to One
paragraphs: Chapter 3943: Ten Cauldrons Return to One
‘F*ck! The power of heaven and earth has increased!’

Previously, Ling Han had also repeatedly broken through his limits, and was targeted by heaven and earth. However, he had yet to encounter a situation where even the Six Figures of Truth could not weaken it.
This Ten Cauldrons fusing into one was too nature-defying. At least, this simplified version of the Six Figures of Truth could not stand against it.
Ling Han condensed his divine sense, and also took human form, greeting the golden figure.
Peng!
Ling Han was sent flying with a single strike. This golden figure was far too powerful.
Thankfully, this was a spiritual manifestation. Even if it was split into two by a slash, it would be fine. It would only weaken a little bit of his Spiritual Power.
Ling Han immediately reformed his body, and continued to charge towards the golden figure. On the other side, he was actively constructing the Celestial Cauldron.

As long as the Celestial Cauldron took form, the heaven and earth would not be able to do anything to him. Otherwise, the shards of the Celestial Cauldron in his mind would gradually lose their vitality, and could no longer be fused.
Fight!
He charged up, battling fiercely with the golden figure to buy time.

The golden figure held a saber in hand, and slashed madly at Ling Han. With a single slash, Ling Han’s soul would be severed into two. In the process of fusing back together, a portion of his soul would be destroyed.
To Ling Han, this was a serious injury. When his soul was weakened to a certain extent, he would become an idiot.
After blocking a few strikes, Ling Han knew that he couldn’t go on like this. Without waiting for the Celestial Cauldron to form, he would first be killed.
Left with no choice, he could only use his trump card.

He mobilized the power of living beings of the dimensions in his body, and with the boost from the Spiritual Power of all these living beings, instantly causing Ling Han’s soul to flicker, as if he was a god.

The golden figure clearly paused for a moment, seeming to be very surprised that the Spiritual Power of all life would appear on Ling Han. However, after a pause, the saber in its hand still slashed over without any mercy.
Ling Han blocked.
Peng! Peng! Peng!

The Spiritual Power of all life turned into a protective barrier, effectively blocking the saber of the golden figure. However, as the saber swept past, Ling Han felt that the Spiritual Power of all life had decreased greatly, forcing him to continuously extract Spiritual Power to maintain this protective barrier.

10 times, 100 times, 1000 times… Ling Han was already numb. He had been slashed tens of thousands of times, and all the dimensional beings in his body were extremely dispirited. They could no longer provide him with Spiritual Power.
Ling Han gritted his teeth. The new Celestial Cauldron was about to take form. It was just a little bit away.
He was determined to hold on!

Pa, the golden figure delivered another strike, and Ling Han’s Spiritual Power shield instantly crumbled. He did not extract the Spiritual Power of the living beings to boost it further. Otherwise, the dimensions in his body would also crumble.
His soul retreated quickly, not wanting to clash head-on with the golden figure.

For Cauldron Forging Tiers, this kind of golden figure was practically invincible. Probably, even Core Formation Tier peak stage elites would be easily killed by it. Ling Han being able to resist for so long was already a miracle.
The golden figure was wooden and expressionless. In fact, it didn’t even have facial features. It only had a human face.
It chased over, neither angered nor shocked, and delivered a swift slash with its saber.
It was too fast. Ling Han couldn’t dodge at all, and could only take it head-on.
With a slash, Ling Han was instantly cut in half. Before he could reform his soul, the golden figure struck again, splitting him into two and four.
Another strike, another strike, another strike.
Ling Han’s soul became more and more pieces, and with every slash, a portion of his soul was consumed.
Was he going to be tortured to death?
Ling Han gritted his teeth. However, normal executions targeted the physical body, while this targeted his soul.
There was still a little bit left!
Hold on!
The golden figure brandished its saber again, but did not slash down.
The Celestial Cauldron… had been forged!

In Ling Han’s mind, there was only one Celestial Cauldron left. It was much larger than the original Celestial Cauldrons. It breathed in and out Celestial Qi, rising and falling with an indescribable majesty.
Pa, the golden figure instantly shattered, turning into a soul fragment.
Great tonic!
A fragment landed in Ling Han’s mind. It was as if a pool of living water had been injected into Ling Han’s soul that was close to drying up, and it immediately gained a little more
vitality.
He was incredibly greedy, and as he digested these shards, his soul was rapidly growing
stronger.
Soon, all the soul shards were absorbed by him, and his soul was mostly recovered.
Though he was still inferior to when he was in his prime, compared to how he had almost died previously, he was much, much better.
A smile appeared on Ling Han’s soul. He had finally succeeded.
The only Celestial Cauldron had been successfully cultivated, and its soul had also grown considerably.
However… Ling Han’s smile quickly turned into a bitter smile. His physical body was
practically a pile of mud now.
Rebuild it!
Weng, the only Celestial Cauldron released a powerful life force, which was injected into Ling Han’s body, allowing him to quickly recover from his injuries.
A month later, Ling Han barely managed to rebuild his skeleton, and could take alchemical
pills. Another month later, his internal organs recovered, and another month later, his blood
and flesh regrew.
At this point, he had finally recovered by more than half.
Ling Han sat down cross-legged. This was the first time he had moved his body in these few
months.
He continued to heal his injuries, and only at this moment did he have the time to seriously observe his only Celestial Cauldron.

This Celestial Cauldron was made of the same material as the Primitive Celestial Gate. However, there were images of dragons, phoenixes, kirins, and other Divine Beasts on the cauldron, and it was as if every single one of them could be revived.
Was this really a Celestial Cauldron, and not a Celestial Tool?
Ling Han was doubtful, because he felt that he really could send out the Celestial Cauldron,
crushing all life.
This was the fusion of ten cauldrons. Needless to say, its sturdiness had definitely surpassed Two Star Divine Metal, or even Three Star Divine Metal.
And within the Celestial Cauldron, there was a streak of light circling around.

The 10 flashes of divine light automatically fused together as the 10 cauldrons fused together. Among the nine flashes of lightning, Primal Chaos Divine Lightning was the most important. The other bolts of lightning were subsidiary, and after completing this divine light, the black light of illusion actually adhered to it, allowing a single flash of divine light to possess two
unique traits.
Damage and illusion.
Just how powerful was this divine light now?
Ling Han was extremely curious. When these ten rays fused into one, there should be a
qualitative change, right?
He would wait a little longer.
Ling Han patiently recuperated from his injuries. Another month later, he finally stood up.
It had been more than four months, and he had been recuperating all this while, but now that
his injuries had healed, he naturally had to leave.
After the ten cauldrons fused into one, the new Celestial Cauldron, had yet to reach Consummate level. He was temporarily unable to break through to the Core Formation Tier,
so there was no need for him to stay here any longer.
Furthermore, he could feel that his battle prowess had greatly increased, and was just about
to seek out Tong Xiao and the others to give it a try.
He exited the ant’s nest, only to find a person sitting cross-legged outside.
It was Feng Clan’s Feng Kun, late stage of the Core Formation Tier. Ling Han removed the Void Beast hide, and strode towards Feng Kun just like that.
Feng Kun sensed it at the first instant. He opened his eyes, and looked towards Ling Han, an
obvious surprise on his face.
This brat actually walked out on his own?
What was it? Did he know that it was useless no matter how he dodged? Had he given up the
thought of fleeing, and wanted to die in battle?
Very good, I will oblige you.
“Finally not dodging anymore?” he asked calmly. As a late stage cultivator of the Core
Formation Tier, he had the absolute initiative.
Ling Han smiled, “A few mad dogs. In the past, I couldn’t be bothered to lower myself to your
level. Since you keep biting at me and won’t let go, I’ll deal with all of you today, to avoid
disturbing me!”
“Junior, where did you get such courage from?” Feng Kun smirked coldly, and strode towards
Ling Han.
