chapters.title: Chapter 3944: Killing a late stage Core Formation Tier
paragraphs: Chapter 3944: Killing a late stage Core Formation Tier
Ling Han crossed his arms behind his back, calm and unhurried, extremely pretentious.
Feng Kun was furious.

He was at the late stage of Core Formation Tier, and his battle prowess could reach the Sixth Heaven. To Ling Han, his battle prowess was one-sided, and Ling Han actually dared to pretend to be unfathomable in front of him?
As expected, he had given up on himself.
Feng Kun sneered, and with a flash, he raised his hand to deliver a palm strike at Ling Han’s head.
Ling Han clenched his hand into a fist, and greeted Feng Kun’s attack.
“You really overestimate yourself!” Feng Kun sneered.
Peng!

The two of them exchanged a blow, and a deep power surged out. Ling Han was sent flying. Meanwhile, Feng Kun’s expression changed drastically, because his brat’s power had f*cking increased further, reaching the Third Heaven of Core Formation Tier.
What kind of concept was this?

Ordinary cultivators at the middle stage of the Core Formation Tier would only have this kind of power. In fact, they would only have this kind of battle prowess. Now, however, he was seeing this kind of power on a Cauldron Forging Tier cultivator? Just how astonishing was this?

A Core Formation Tier had an absolutely one-sided suppression over Cauldron Forging Tier, and the four minor levels of the Core Formation Tier were also clearly separated barriers. Only Feng Jixing and the other supreme prodigies could break through this barrier, but no matter how much they broke through, they would only be able to breach the barrier of one minor level, at most.
As for Ling Han?
This was practically a monster!
However, what shocked him was the fact that Ling Han was completely unscathed even though he had launched an attack with Fifth Heaven-level power.
How was this possible?

Ling Han was indeed freakish. With his Cauldron Forging Tier cultivation level, Ling Han could possess the power of the Third Heaven of Core Formation Tier. However, he was attacking with the power of the Fifth Heaven, and there was a difference of a whole two Heavens. This, at least, could make Ling Han throw up blood.
Now, Ling Han was calm and composed, as if the person who had exchanged a blow with him just now was not him at all.
Had he seen a ghost?

Ling Han smiled faintly. When they had exchanged blows just now, he had not yet channelled out the Starlight Screen, so the Celestial Cauldron inside him channelled itself, completely disintegrating Feng Kun’s power, and could no longer cause the slightest bit of damage to
him.
Unfortunately, though the Celestial Cauldron had the effect of dispersing power, it could not absorb it for his use. Otherwise, it would be even more awesome.
As expected, the only Celestial Cauldron was not just a little bigger. It possessed a unique ability.
This was the greatest cauldron since ancient times!

Feng Kun frowned deeply, then came to a “realization”, “You must have some supreme treasure hidden on you!” He revealed an expression of greed. If that was not the case, how could a mere Cauldron Forging Tier cultivator massacre the Tong Clan?

But looking at how Tong Xiao was still alive, he knew that there was also an upper limit to the might of that treasure of Ling Han’s, or it would not be able to unleash its strongest effects in Ling Han’s hands.
He was also in the late stage of Core Formation Tier, and was completely no weaker than Tong Xiao. Thus, what did he have to fear?
With this in mind, he didn’t send a signal. Instead, he decided to capture Ling Han alone and search for his treasures.

“I will take you down!” Feng Kun charged over. In the past half year or so, Ling Han had been like a rat in front of the four of them. He only knew how to dodge and hide. Thus, he naturally had an extremely strong psychological advantage.
Ling Han charged forwards, using the Great Overarching Heaven Technique to exchange blows with Feng Kun.

This was a Venerate Tier-level celestial technique. It could increase his battle prowess by two Heavens, and added with his power of Third Heaven, his battle prowess had reached Fifth Heaven, and he was qualified to stand against Feng Kun.

“He, so you have mastered this kind of secret technique. No wonder you are so arrogant!” Feng Kun smirked coldly, thinking that this was the basis for Ling Han’s confidence in daring to come out for a battle.
However, his battle prowess was not just limited to Fifth Heaven!
Feng Kun also used a secret technique, and his battle prowess instantly soared to Sixth Heaven. In this way, he naturally had the upper hand.

Ling Han was unconcerned. The power that he could not dissipate naturally had the Celestial Cauldron to help him dissipate. The only Celestial Cauldron was like a bottomless pit. Whatever power blasted towards him, it would absorb it completely, and then dissipate it, returning the power to the heaven and earth.
“Haha, brat, if you hand over the secret you have, I can still leave you with a whole corpse!” Feng Kun said with a laugh, his offensive becoming even more rapid.

“Hehe, I let you have the first few moves, and you think you’re all that impressive?” Ling Han shook his head, crossed his arms, and switched to using the Three Styles of the God of War. Instantly, heaven and earth took him as their core, and endless power surged out.
“What!” Feng Kun was shocked. The other’s aura made even him feel pressured.
Boom!
Ling Han charged out, striking out with both palms.
One Style, two Styles, three Styles.

With every palm strike he delivered, Feng Kun would take a few steps back. Furthermore, the power of Ling Han’s palm strike was more profound than the last. When it came to the third style, Feng Kun suddenly retreated more than a hundred steps, his face flushed so red that it
was almost dripping blood.

However, even if it was a Saint Technique, this could only boost Ling Han’s battle prowess to Sixth Heaven. He was slightly stronger than Feng Kun, and it was still not enough to severely injure this veteran Core Formation Tier cultivator, a late stage elite.

“Hiss!” Feng Kun inhaled sharply. No matter what the reason was, a Cauldron Forging Tier cultivator was actually capable of blasting out a battle prowess of Sixth Heaven of Core Formation Tier. This was definitely terrifying. Who would believe this?

“I really can’t let you live!” he said in a baleful voice. He immediately launched a counterattack. Moreover, he also suppressed his greed and sent a message to his three companions, fearing that something would happen.
This brat was really too freakish.
Ling Han shook his head internally. When he had been in Nine Cauldrons, he had already

possessed the power of the First Heaven of the Core Formation Tier. However, after breaking through to Ten Cauldrons, and then fusing the ten cauldrons into one, he seemed to have taken two steps. Logically speaking, he should have increased the power of two minor levels, but in truth, his power had only reached the Third Heaven.
It couldn’t be helped. Increasing the cultivation level by a minor level in the Cauldron Forging Tier, could it correspond to a minor level of the Core Formation Tier?
Thus, if he wanted to kill Feng Kun, he would have to use his trump card.
Ling Han was also planning to test out the new divine light. When these ten divine lights
fused into one, what level would their might reach?

Just as Feng Kun was about to attack, Ling Han tapped out a finger. Pa, a divine light of lightning shot out. It was like the first bolt of divine lightning when Primal Chaos was first created, representing the supreme lightning that the heaven and earth delivered its
punishment with.
Not only that, but there was also a smear of black in the Primal Chaos Divine Lightning. That was the black light of illusion. It had not disappeared, but had only fused with the lightning,
and its effects were still present.
Feng Kun instantly faltered, falling into an illusion.
This actually did not affect his battle instincts. Thus, he still shot out a punch to greet the
divine light.
Boom!
There was a loud sound, and Feng Kun was instantly sent flying. He was directly severed into
two halves by the terrifying power of lightning.
The might of this divine light had even surpassed Seventh Heaven, and reached Eighth Heaven. Thus, with a single strike, even Feng Kun, who had battle prowess of Sixth Heaven,
was insta-killed!
Was this strange?

It was not strange, because previously, even an incomplete Primal Chaos Divine Lightning was comparable to the Imperial Technique. Then, now that it had been restored, its might had even surpassed the Imperial Technique. Then, wasn’t it very normal for it to blast out Eighth Heaven-level battle prowess?

Ling Han laughed loudly. Previously, though he had almost died, when he saw the current might of the Primal Chaos Divine Lightning, he instantly felt that everything was worth it. Furthermore, he had not completely discovered the might of the only Celestial Cauldron! “No!” In the distance, Feng Shaolin and Feng Jian were rapidly rushing over, and just happened to see the scene of Feng Kun being insta-killed. Instantly, their eyes were about to pop out of their sockets, and Tong Xiao’s eyes were about to pop out of his head. His face was as white as a sheet, as if he had suffered a massive shock.

chapters.title: Chapter 3945: Destroying another person
paragraphs: Chapter 3945: Destroying another person
Ling Han stared at Tong Xiao with killing intent.
Tong Xiao was already flustered to begin with, and with Ling Han’s stare, his heart instantly beat like a drum.

This was quite ridiculous. A Cauldron Forging Tier cultivator could actually make a Core Formation Tier late stage cultivator panic, but the scene of Feng Kun being insta-killed by Ling Han was still vivid in his mind. How could he not be scared out of his wits?
“Evil brat, you deserve to die!” Feng Shaolin roared loudly, and charged towards Ling Han.
In truth, only he would dare charge over like this.

Ling Han had insta-killed a cultivator at the late stage of the Core Formation Tier, so how could Feng Jian, who was only at the middle stage of the Core Formation Tier, dare to charge over to his death?

However, Tong Xiao and Feng Jian were both scared out of their wits. Ling Han’s divine light couldn’t be used continuously either. The more powerful it was, the greater the burden on one’s body. This was a logic that couldn’t be broken.

Feng Shaolin charged over. He was at the consummate level of the Core Formation Tier, and his power alone had already reached the Seventh Heaven or even close to the Eighth Heaven. After channeling a secret technique, his battle prowess had even soared to the height of close to the Ninth Heaven.

Even Ling Han didn’t dare to face this attack head-on. He hurriedly activated his movement technique, only dodging and not attacking. His eyes were focused on Tong Xiao. This was a target that he definitely had to kill.
“What are you waiting for? Attack together!” Feng Shaolin roared in fury.
Tong Xiao and Feng Jian faltered for a moment before hurriedly charging over. Seeing how mighty Feng Shaolin was, their confidence had also recovered quite a bit.

If they were to face Ling Han alone, they naturally wouldn’t dare to do so. However, if they were only assisting from the sidelines, they would naturally dare to do so. After all, they were all in the Core Formation Tier.
Since the divine light could not be used, he would test out the might of the Celestial Cauldron. He would try to the limits of power that it could dispel first.
Boom! Feng Shaolin’s attack arrived. This time, Ling Han didn’t dodge again. Instead, he raised his fist to parry.
In the exchange of blows, Ling Han suddenly felt a massive force assault him, rushing towards his limbs and meridians.

Previously, he had used the Eighteen Arhat Palm, raising his battle prowess to Fifth Heaven. Hence, there was about a gap of four Heavens of power between the two of them. This violent power surged into his body, and was instantly absorbed by the only Celestial Cauldron, rapidly disintegrating.
After that, there was nothing else. Ling Han acted as if nothing had happened.
Impressive, too impressive!
After this attack, even Feng Shaolin and the others were dumbfounded. What was going on?
Ling Han broke into a grin, and once again charged to attack Feng Shaolin. This time, he did not use any technique. It was merely an attack of pure power.
Peng!

After the attack, the majority of the power was absorbed by the only Celestial Cauldron. However, it still left behind a tiny bit of power that surged through Ling Han’s body. However, when the Celestial Cauldron dissipated that portion of power, and with a slight tremor, the remaining bit of power naturally crumbled in an instant.
Ling Han nodded. Now, he could deduce the limit of the power that the Celestial Cauldron could dispel. It was about Sixth Heaven.

After learning of his limits, Ling Han no longer had any reservations. He simply swung his fists to block Feng Shaolin’s attacks. Meanwhile, he focused his attention on Tong Xiao and attacked him madly.
What battle prowess did Tong Xiao have?
He was only in Sixth Heaven.
In other words, faced with his attack, Ling Han could completely ignore it. The only Celestial Cauldron would be able to completely disperse the attack.
Who wouldn’t be troubled by this kind of opponent who only needed to attack and didn’t need to defend?

Tong Xiao was extremely depressed. The attacks he shot towards Ling Han were like clay oxen entering the sea, completely ineffective. Meanwhile, Ling Han’s attacks caused him to tremble in fear, fearing that he would unleash that powerful move that could insta-kill Feng Kun.

“Damn thief!” Feng Shaolin roared in fury. He was really about to go crazy. He had come to hunt Ling Han down for revenge, but he had never imagined that the result would be giving the life of another Core Formation Tier cultivator of the Feng Clan.

Right now, the Feng Clan was only left with two Core Formation Tier elites. Compared to the five Core Formation Tiers they had at the peak of their power, the drop in their power was enough to make him want to cry.
The Primal Chaos Divine Lightning could be used again.

Ling Han felt that the divine light in the Celestial Cauldron had completely recovered. However, he was not in a rush to use it. Instead, he summoned the only Celestial Cauldron. He had not completely grasped the might of this Celestial Cauldron.
Yi?
The three Core Formation Tiers were all dumbfounded. ‘As you f****** fight, you actually summoned the Celestial Cauldron. What do you mean?’
We are not Cauldron Forging Tier, so we would be suppressed by the grade of your Celestial Cauldron.
That’s not right!

When they saw clearly the appearance of the Celestial Cauldron, they couldn’t help but feel stunned, because this was different from all other Celestial Cauldrons. It was branded with True Dragons, Divine Phoenixes, Qilins and other Divine Beasts. They were all born when the heaven and earth first came to being, and had long since passed away. The bloodlines of their children were no longer pure, and it would be difficult for them to reach the height of the
Ancestral King.
But the patterns of a Divine Beast actually appeared on a Celestial Cauldron, this was really too shocking.
Who could leave a mark on the Celestial Cauldron?
This was unheard of!
Ling Han smiled. The Celestial Cauldron shook slightly, and instantly, a True Dragon shot out from the cauldron, pouncing towards Tong Xiao.
What!
The three Core Formation Tiers were once again dumbfounded. There was such a thing?
F***, who had heard that the Celestial Cauldron could be channeled like a Spirit Tool?
Monster, you are definitely a monster.
Boom, the True Dragon flew out, baring its fangs and brandishing its claws, its might
astonishing.
Tong Xiao had no choice but to parry. Peng, peng, peng! He launched 36 consecutive palm strikes before finally destroying the True Dragon Armor.
Hiss, this was only an attack that Ling Han had unleashed with the Celestial Cauldron.

Ling Han was also observing attentively, because he was also filled with curiosity about the only Celestial Cauldron. After the True Dragon was shot out, the True Dragon on the Celestial Cauldron dimmed, and was recovering at a very slow pace.
He nodded. In other words, this kind of attack, like a powerful move, needed to be “cooled
down”.
Again!

With another thought, the Divine Beasts such as the Divine Phoenix, the Qilin, the Black Tortoise, and the White Tiger all shot out from the Celestial Cauldron. There were a total of seven of them, and they blasted towards Tong Xiao.
This was too terrifying. Just now, there was only one True Dragon, and Tong Xiao had already dealt with it with such difficulty. Now, there were seven of them. What was going to happen to
Tong Xiao?

Feng Shaolin released a battle cry, and pounced towards Tong Xiao. He wanted to help the latter disperse this attack. He definitely could not allow Ling Han to defeat them one by one. Ling Han smiled, and suddenly changed his target, charging towards Feng Jian. Feng Jian was only in the middle stage of the Core Formation Tier, and his battle prowess was no more than Fourth Heaven at most, so how could he possibly block Ling Han?
A Wind God Kick shot out, and Feng Jian was instantly hit. Pa, he was kicked in half at the
waist by Ling Han.

The Wind God Kick was an incomplete Saint Technique, and its might was even stronger than Venerate Tier-level techniques. Add to that Ling Han’s current strength, and it was no issue for him to insta-kill a Core Formation Tier.
However, Feng Jian was a Core Formation Tier cultivator, after all. He hurriedly ignited his Celestial Core, intending to forcibly extend his life.
Ling Han humphed coldly, and followed up with another punch.
“How dare you!” Feng Shaolin roared, his black locks standing on end. He was furious to the
extreme.
He had just destroyed the seven Divine Beasts, but Ling Han had already distanced himself from them, so he could not rush over to help at the first instant.
How could Ling Han possibly pay any heed to him? He landed a solid punch on him.
Peng, Feng Jian was immediately blown up, turning into a rain of blood that filled the skies.

Feng Shaolin was so furious that he was trembling. There were tears of blood in his eyes. Now, the Feng Clan was practically done for, and he was the only one left. “Junior, I want you to die a tragic death!”

Ling Han felt that the divine light in the Celestial Cauldron had completely recovered.
However, he was not in a rush to use it.
Instead, he summoned the only Celestial Cauldron.
He had not completely grasped the might of this Celestial Cauldron.
Yi?
The three Core Formation Tiers were all dumbfounded. ‘As you f****** fight, you actually summoned the Celestial Cauldron.
What do you mean?’
We are not Cauldron Forging Tier, so we would be suppressed by the grade of your Celestial Cauldron.
That’s not right!
When they saw clearly the appearance of the Celestial Cauldron, they couldn’t help but feel stunned, because this was different from all other Celestial Cauldrons.
It was branded with True Dragons, Divine Phoenixes, Qilins and other Divine Beasts.
They were all born when the heaven and earth first came to being, and had long since passed away.
The bloodlines of their children were no longer pure, and it would be difficult for them to reach the height of the
Ancestral King.
But the patterns of a Divine Beast actually appeared on a Celestial Cauldron, this was really too shocking.
Who could leave a mark on the Celestial Cauldron?
This was unheard of!
Ling Han smiled.
The Celestial Cauldron shook slightly, and instantly, a True Dragon shot out from the cauldron, pouncing towards Tong Xiao.
What!
The three Core Formation Tiers were once again dumbfounded.
There was such a thing?
F***, who had heard that the Celestial Cauldron could be channeled like a Spirit Tool?
Monster, you are definitely a monster.
Boom, the True Dragon flew out, baring its fangs and brandishing its claws, its might
astonishing.
Tong Xiao had no choice but to parry.
Peng, peng, peng!
He launched 36 consecutive palm strikes before finally destroying the True Dragon Armor.
Hiss, this was only an attack that Ling Han had unleashed with the Celestial Cauldron.
Ling Han was also observing attentively, because he was also filled with curiosity about the only Celestial Cauldron.
After the True Dragon was shot out, the True Dragon on the Celestial Cauldron dimmed, and was recovering at a very slow pace.
He nodded.
In other words, this kind of attack, like a powerful move, needed to be “cooled
down”.
Again!
With another thought, the Divine Beasts such as the Divine Phoenix, the Qilin, the Black Tortoise, and the White Tiger all shot out from the Celestial Cauldron.
There were a total of seven of them, and they blasted towards Tong Xiao.
This was too terrifying.
Just now, there was only one True Dragon, and Tong Xiao had already dealt with it with such difficulty.
Now, there were seven of them.
What was going to happen to
Tong Xiao?
Feng Shaolin released a battle cry, and pounced towards Tong Xiao.
He wanted to help the latter disperse this attack.
He definitely could not allow Ling Han to defeat them one by one.
Ling Han smiled, and suddenly changed his target, charging towards Feng Jian.
Feng Jian was only in the middle stage of the Core Formation Tier, and his battle prowess was no more than Fourth Heaven at most, so how could he possibly block Ling Han?
A Wind God Kick shot out, and Feng Jian was instantly hit.
Pa, he was kicked in half at the
waist by Ling Han.
The Wind God Kick was an incomplete Saint Technique, and its might was even stronger than Venerate Tier-level techniques.
Add to that Ling Han’s current strength, and it was no issue for him to insta-kill a Core Formation Tier.
However, Feng Jian was a Core Formation Tier cultivator, after all.
He hurriedly ignited his Celestial Core, intending to forcibly extend his life.
Ling Han humphed coldly, and followed up with another punch.
“How dare you!” Feng Shaolin roared, his black locks standing on end.
He was furious to the
extreme.
He had just destroyed the seven Divine Beasts, but Ling Han had already distanced himself from them, so he could not rush over to help at the first instant.
How could Ling Han possibly pay any heed to him?
He landed a solid punch on him.
Peng, Feng Jian was immediately blown up, turning into a rain of blood that filled the skies.
Feng Shaolin was so furious that he was trembling.
There were tears of blood in his eyes.
Now, the Feng Clan was practically done for, and he was the only one left.
“Junior, I want you to die a tragic death!”

chapters.title: Chapter 3946: Times change
paragraphs: Chapter 3946: Times change
Ling Han scoffed, “The one who would die a tragic death is this guy, right?”

Feng Kun was blasted into two halves, but fortunately, his corpse was left behind. However, Feng Jian was blasted into a shower of blood. That was definitely impossible to collect and bury, and it could be claimed that he had died a tragic death.
“Damn it! Damn it!” Feng Shaolin charged over without any regard for anything else. His eyes were already red with fury, and he only wanted Ling Han to die.
However, Tong Xiao decided to retreat.
Obviously, Feng Shaolin could do nothing against Ling Han.
Whether Ling Han truly had terrifying abilities, or the rare treasures he possessed were astonishing, in short, the result would not change.
If they continued to battle, he would be in deep trouble.
He wanted revenge, and wanted Ling Han to die, but he wanted to live even more.

Previously, he had gone to seek out the Feng Clan, and joined forces to hunt down Ling Han. That was because his strength was superior to Ling Han, and there was absolutely no need for him to worry that Ling Han would turn around and kill him. Thus, his killing intent blazed.
But now, the situation was different. Instead, he was about to face the danger of being killed by Ling Han. This made him feel uneasy.

Now that Feng Shaolin had started to put his life on the line, just let him stay to restrain Ling Han while he took the chance to leave. When he left this Mystery Realm, he, who was only around 60 years old, could even be considered a young prodigy, unlike here, where he had already lived for more than half his life.
Thus, he could completely start over. Although Core Formation Tiers couldn’t be regarded as elites in the outside world, they weren’t weak either. He could completely have an easy life.
With this in mind, he no longer had any intention of revenge. He suddenly turned around and left.
Ling Han shook his head, and said, “As expected. Those with a weak nature will definitely break their word when faced with danger!”
He raised his hand. Pa, a bolt of lightning shot out, turning into a brilliant divine light.
This was too fast, so fast that Tong Xiao couldn’t even react in time.
It was even stronger than the Imperial Technique, so how was he supposed to dodge?
Pa, the lightning struck, and Tong Xiao was instantly blasted into two halves.
He hadn’t died yet, and the gaze he directed at Ling Han was filled with hatred. If he had killed Ling Han when he was still very weak, would the situation today still exist?

He was unable to burn the Celestial Core to extend his life, because that bolt of lightning was too terrifying. It had directly shattered his Celestial Core, and there was no chance for it to burn at all.

Ling Han humphed, and shot out a flying kick, which just happened to land on Tong Xiao’s head. Peng, the upper half of this guy’s body was instantly sent flying, drawing an arc in the air. The defiant and furious expression on Tong Xiao’s face could still be seen.
So what?
Ling Han only took a glance before withdrawing his gaze. What was there to pay attention to an enemy that he had killed?
This was not the first enemy he had killed, and would not be the last either.
Ling Han turned around to face Feng Shaolin.

Feng Shaolin’s attack involuntarily faltered. The people around him died one after another, and he was actually the only one left. This also caused him to regain some consciousness from his extreme fury.
This person in front of him… could he really kill him?

A feeling of despair rose up in him, because he was already at the consummate level of the Core Formation Tier. He couldn’t take another step further, and even then, he still couldn’t kill Ling Han. Then, what else could he do?
Breaking through to the True Self Tier?
Hehe, if he could break through, what need was there for him to wait until now?

The cultivation levels of the people here progressed too quickly. Basically, whatever cultivation level they reached at fifty years old, that would be the cultivation level that they reach in this lifetime, and it was impossible for them to break through again.

Thus, he probably wouldn’t have the chance to kill Ling Han in this lifetime. On the other hand, this young man was full of energy, and breaking through to the Core Formation Tier definitely wouldn’t be a problem, and once he broke through to the Core Formation Tier, just how strong would he be?
With this in mind, Feng Shaolin’s fighting spirit also fell sharply. What was the point of continuing the battle?
However, Ling Han didn’t want to stop the battle now.
He charged over, wanting to completely deal with future trouble.
“Junior, I don’t believe that there is no end to your mystical power!” When Feng Shaolin saw this, he couldn’t help but become ruthless.

Ling Han was only a Cauldron Forging Tier, after all. No matter how strong your battle prowess was, mystical power reserves were a shortcoming. In such a high-intensity battle, he didn’t believe that Ling Han could persist forever.
Fight, fight, fight.

Ling Han did not mind clashing head-on with Feng Shaolin at all, because he did not need to expend much effort at all. The Celestial Cauldron could automatically disperse Feng Shaolin’s attacks, but it was different for Feng Shaolin. The mystical power that he had expended with every attack was real.

If this continued, the only result would be his mystical power being completely exhausted. The two of them battled fiercely, with one throwing a palm strike and the other throwing a punch at the other. It was incredibly intense.
If anyone was watching the battle here, they would definitely not be able to believe their own
eyes.
What had they seen?
A Cauldron Forging Tier was exchanging blows with a Core Formation Tier consummate level
elite!
This should have been a fantasy story that could only appear in dreams, but now, it was really playing out in real life.
Not long after, all of Ling Han’s powerful moves could be used again.
The murderous aura charged towards him!
Even if Feng Shaolin was a Core Formation Tier consummate level cultivator, so what? He would still fall for it, and be dazed for a short while. Then, Ling Han’s power would explode.
Divine light of lightning!
Zi, a bolt of lightning struck out, as fast as lightning.
Then, all the Divine Beasts on the only Celestial Cauldron also surged out, charging towards
Feng Shaolin.
Finally, Ling Han’s body also charged out, activating the Demonic Monkey Fists.
All of a sudden, the three ultimate moves were unleashed at the same time.
This was too terrifying. Though Feng Shaolin immediately came back to his senses, he was no longer able to channel a powerful move to parry the attack. He could only unleash his own
power.
Hong! Hong! Hong!
Ling Han unleashed his three ultimate moves at the same time, and Feng Shaolin was instantly sent flying, drawing an arc in the air as he violently vomited blood.

Among the three ultimate moves, the Demonic Monkey Fists and the Divine Beasts were all Seventh Heaven-level. Only the Primal Chaos Divine Lightning had surpassed Seventh Heaven and reached Eighth Heaven. With three moves attacking at the same time, its power was naturally boundless, heavily injuring even Feng Shaolin.
However, consummate level Core Formation Tier was still consummate level Core Formation Tier, after all. Feng Shaolin actually didn’t die from this attack.
He turned around and stood still, blood still spurting madly from his mouth. The gaze he directed at Ling Han was filled with hatred.
Ling Han, meanwhile, sighed. He was still a little bit off. He had used all three powerful moves, and he was still unable to kill the a Core Formation Tier consummate level. Elites at
this cultivation level were really hard to kill.

Moreover, Feng Shaolin still couldn’t be considered a prodigy yet. If this Core Formation Tier consummate level elite were Feng Jixing, then Ling Han would definitely turn around and leave without another word. This was like having a Human Cauldron fight Nine Cauldrons; what else could it be but courting death?
Ling Han chased after him, wanting to use this opportunity to completely deal with Feng
Shaolin.

Feng Shaolin did not linger in battle. At present, he had sustained considerable injuries, and who knew when Ling Han would be able to unleash such a great burst again? Most importantly, his attacks had absolutely no effect on Ling Han. This was really too much of a
blow to his fighting spirit.
Let’s go.
He turned around and broke into a run.
Ling Han set off in pursuit.
Feng Shaolin’s heart was filled with desolation at this moment. Just how domineering had he,
Tong Xiao, and the others been back then? They had chased after Ling Han and beaten him up,
but only half a year had passed, and the situation was completely different.
The wheel of fortune really turned.
But no matter how defiant he was, no matter how much he regretted it, so what? At present, he could only scramble madly with his tail between his legs.

chapters.title: Chapter 3947: Battle prowess fully unleashed
paragraphs: Chapter 3947: Battle prowess fully unleashed
Feng Shaolin ran madly, and behind him, Ling Han chased after him at an unhurried pace.
He also had a tracking treasure, so he was completely unconcerned. He slowly chased after him, but did not give Feng Shaolin the chance to heal his injuries.
And just like that, the chase lasted for more than two days.

Feng Shaolin was battered and exhausted. After running for two days, his mystical power was greatly exhausted, and he was still unable to heal his injuries. Not only were his injuries not under control, but they were even worsening, causing him to almost lose all hope.
Xiu, he dashed out of a forest of stone, yet a group of people shockingly appeared ahead of him.
Coincidentally, it was Feng Jixing and his group again.
Compared to the last time, Feng Shaolin was filled with vigor, but now, he was like a stray dog. There was really no comparison.
“Yi, clan leader Feng?” Feng Jixing turned around and looked over, his face filled with surprise. What was going on here?

Feng Shaolin was an elite at the consummate level of the Core Formation Tier, and his battle prowess could reach the Eighth Heaven. He was even more powerful than him, yet he had actually fallen to such a miserable state. Just what kind of powerful opponent had he encountered?

Feng Shaolin breathed a sigh of relief. There were so many people here, so perhaps they could block for him for a while. After all, there was no shortage of heirs of great sects here. They had many rare treasures in their possession, and even he had to be wary of them.
But what should he say? That he was presently being hunted down by a Cauldron Forging Tier?
What kind of joke was this? An elite at the consummate level of the Core Formation Tier was being hunted down by a Cauldron Forging Tier? Who would believe this?
His expression was awkward, and he hesitated for a moment, but could not say anything. Right at this moment, Ling Han had already caught up to him from behind.
“Ling Han!” When he saw Ling Han, Feng Jixing’s eyes immediately sharpened, revealing a baleful killing intent.
He naturally would never have imagined that Ling Han was the one who had caused Feng Shaolin to run for his life.
Ling Han also looked towards Feng Jixing, revealing a faint smile. Just in time, he met this guy again.
Though he had not yet advanced into the Core Formation Tier, there was already no problem for him to suppress Feng Jixing.
“Scram!” he said calmly.

Feng Jixing laughed, his face filled with coldness. This brat had repeatedly gone against him, and had even in fact snatched away the fated opportunity that belonged to him, causing his killing intent to blaze.
“You’re seeking death!”
He moved without any reservations, and shot out a palm strike. Instantly, a dazzling brilliance spread out, and seals spread out, creating an extremely great commotion.
Ling Han was naturally unafraid, and merely tapped out a finger.
This was very simple, but it was a power that could destroy all techniques. The brilliance instantly dispersed, and the seals were destroyed.
‘What?’
Not only was Feng Jixing dumbfounded, but even Song Lan, Prosperous Heaven, and the others wore expressions of disbelief.
This was too much of an exaggeration, wasn’t it? You f****** are only a Cauldron Forging
Tier.

“Feng Jixing, aside from being able to use your slightly higher cultivation level to suppress others, what else can you do?” Ling Han said calmly. “However, even if your cultivation level is higher than mine now, in front of me, you can’t even withstand a single blow.”
“You!” Feng Jixing was furious, but he had to admit that Ling Han was indeed powerful. He had dispersed this attack too easily.
But how was this possible?
How could a Cauldron Forging Tier cultivator be so powerful?

“Don’t be too smug!” With a leap, he once again charged towards Ling Han. This time, he had used a Saint-level technique, and his battle prowess instantly soared, directly rising from Third Heaven to Sixth Heaven.
This was extremely terrifying. Even an ordinary Core Formation Tier late stage cultivator’s battle prowess was only this strong.
Of course, he could only temporarily burst out with such powerful battle prowess. How could a Saint Technique possibly be channelled continuously?
Ling Han replied with a counterattack. The Three Styles of the God of War unleashed its might and clashed with Feng Jixing.
Their raw power was equal, so it would depend on who had the stronger grasp of the technique. Now, it was a clash of two Saint-level techniques.

However, the Three Styles of the God of War was only a very superficial Saint Technique, and could possibly even be a castrated version. It was indeed stronger than a Venerate Tier-level technique, but against Feng Jixing’s Saint Technique, it was not enough.
After the attack, Ling Han couldn’t help but take a few more steps back.
“Haha, nothing more than this!” Feng Jixing sneered.
“I really don’t know what you’re so proud of,” Ling Han said with a shake of his head. “Don’t forget, I’m only a Cauldron Forging Tier.”
You can also be considered a f****** Cauldron Forging Tier?
Feng Jixing wanted to curse. How could there be such a freakish Cauldron Forging Tier?
He launched another Saint Technique, but this time, a divine light also shot out.

Feng Jixing had refined a streak of celestial light and fused it into his Celestial Cauldron. Now that he had advanced into the Core Formation Tier, the might of the celestial light would naturally rise accordingly, possessing astonishing destructive power.
Ling Han smiled and greeted it with a punch.
Peng!
The divine light slashed onto his body, yet its might was easily dispersed by the Celestial
Cauldron.
Pu, what the hell was this?

Feng Jixing couldn’t accept this. The celestial light that he had obtained was extremely high- level, and the might of the divine light after refining the celestial light was comparable to a Saint-level technique. Thus, it was equivalent to him unleashing two Saint Techniques just
now.
But what was the result?
The two Saint Techniques shot out at the same time, and Ling Han actually resolved it easily
with a single punch.
How could he accept this?
-If Feng Shaolin had to say this, this was really very normal. Didn’t you see that even he, an elite with Eighth Heaven battle prowess, was forced to flee in a sorry state? And who do you
think you are?

Ling Han smiled faintly and said, “Feng Jixing, even if your cultivation level is higher than mine, you still won’t be able to suppress me. In fact, you’ll only be trampled on by me. I really don’t know how you have the nerve to call yourself the number one prodigy of the North
Heavenly Realm.”

Feng Jixing almost exploded in fury. He didn’t call himself the number one prodigy. Moreover, he was only the number one prodigy of Cauldron Forging Tier. Of course, there were other top-notch prodigies in the Core Formation Tier.
“You dare to look down on me!” He charged out, his expression twisted.

Ling Han unleashed his murderous aura, immediately causing Feng Jixing to pause. He then launched a powerful offensive, and in a few moments, Feng Jixing was at a disadvantage. This caused Song Lan and the others to watch with dumbfounded shock. Ling Han being able to battle against a superior cultivation level prodigy was already shocking enough, and it was
a supreme prodigy like Feng Jixing at that. This was practically a fantasy story. When Feng Shaolin saw this, he hurriedly prepared to flee again.
Xiu, Ling Han didn’t attack Feng Jixing anymore. Instead, he leaped over to block Feng
Shaolin.𝓯𝙧𝙚𝒆𝙬𝙚𝒃𝙣𝙤𝒗𝓮𝓵.𝙘𝙤𝙢
What!

Everyone was shocked. Was Ling Han seeking death? He actually dared to actively attack an elite at the consummate level of the Core Formation Tier? Was he tired of living? Even Feng Jixing smirked coldly. Ling Han’s power was only on par with his, but against a Core Formation consummate level cultivator, it was more or less an insta-kill.
He was truly seeking death.
However, everyone saw a scene that made their eyes widen in disbelief – Feng Shaolin actually didn’t dare to parry, turning and running.
Feng Jixing: “…” Song Lan: “I
Prosperous Heaven: “…”
Ling Han’s expression was cold as he unleashed his murderous aura. Feng Shaolin’s body instantly faltered, and he immediately charged over, unleashing another three powerful
attacks.
-The Primal Chaos Divine Lightning, the Divine Beasts of the Celestial Cauldron, and the Demonic Monkey Fists.
This was too terrifying. Though Feng Shaolin tried his best to dodge and resist, he was still
blasted left and right, throwing up blood continuously.
‘F*ck!’
Seeing this scene, everyone wanted to curse. As it turned out, the person chasing after Feng Shaolin was none other than Ling Han.
Crazy, he was really about to go crazy. How could a Cauldron Forging Tier cultivator be this
powerful?
Feng Jixing felt as if he had been slapped across the face, feeling a burning pain.
In his eyes, Feng Shaolin was a big shot, yet he was actually being hunted down by Ling Han
and forced to vomit blood. Moreover, he was still looking down on Ling Han?
Hehe, what a joke.

He also had a tracking treasure, so he was completely unconcerned.

And just like that, the chase lasted for more than two days.
Feng Shaolin was battered and exhausted.
After running for two days, his mystical power was greatly exhausted, and he was still unable to heal his injuries.
Not only were his injuries not under control, but they were even worsening, causing him to almost lose all hope.
Xiu, he dashed out of a forest of stone, yet a group of people shockingly appeared ahead of him.
Coincidentally, it was Feng Jixing and his group again.
Compared to the last time, Feng Shaolin was filled with vigor, but now, he was like a stray dog.
There was really no comparison.
“Yi, clan leader Feng?” Feng Jixing turned around and looked over, his face filled with surprise.
What was going on here?
Feng Shaolin was an elite at the consummate level of the Core Formation Tier, and his battle prowess could reach the Eighth Heaven.
He was even more powerful than him, yet he had actually fallen to such a miserable state.
Just what kind of powerful opponent had he encountered?
Feng Shaolin breathed a sigh of relief.
There were so many people here, so perhaps they could block for him for a while.
After all, there was no shortage of heirs of great sects here.
They had many rare treasures in their possession, and even he had to be wary of them.
But what should he say?
That he was presently being hunted down by a Cauldron Forging Tier?
What kind of joke was this?
An elite at the consummate level of the Core Formation Tier was being hunted down by a Cauldron Forging Tier?
Who would believe this?
His expression was awkward, and he hesitated for a moment, but could not say anything.
Right at this moment, Ling Han had already caught up to him from behind.
“Ling Han!” When he saw Ling Han, Feng Jixing’s eyes immediately sharpened, revealing a baleful killing intent.
He naturally would never have imagined that Ling Han was the one who had caused Feng Shaolin to run for his life.
Ling Han also looked towards Feng Jixing, revealing a faint smile.
Just in time, he met this guy again.
Though he had not yet advanced into the Core Formation Tier, there was already no problem for him to suppress Feng Jixing.
“Scram!” he said calmly.
Feng Jixing laughed, his face filled with coldness.
This brat had repeatedly gone against him, and had even in fact snatched away the fated opportunity that belonged to him, causing his killing intent to blaze.
“You’re seeking death!”
He moved without any reservations, and shot out a palm strike.
Instantly, a dazzling brilliance spread out, and seals spread out, creating an extremely great commotion.
Ling Han was naturally unafraid, and merely tapped out a finger.
This was very simple, but it was a power that could destroy all techniques.
The brilliance instantly dispersed, and the seals were destroyed.
‘What?’
Not only was Feng Jixing dumbfounded, but even Song Lan, Prosperous Heaven, and the others wore expressions of disbelief.
This was too much of an exaggeration, wasn’t it?
You f****** are only a Cauldron Forging
Tier.
“Feng Jixing, aside from being able to use your slightly higher cultivation level to suppress others, what else can you do?” Ling Han said calmly.
“However, even if your cultivation level is higher than mine now, in front of me, you can’t even withstand a single blow.”
“You!” Feng Jixing was furious, but he had to admit that Ling Han was indeed powerful.
He had dispersed this attack too easily.
But how was this possible?
How could a Cauldron Forging Tier cultivator be so powerful?
“Don’t be too smug!” With a leap, he once again charged towards Ling Han.
This time, he had used a Saint-level technique, and his battle prowess instantly soared, directly rising from Third Heaven to Sixth Heaven.
This was extremely terrifying.
Even an ordinary Core Formation Tier late stage cultivator’s battle prowess was only this strong.
Of course, he could only temporarily burst out with such powerful battle prowess.
How could a Saint Technique possibly be channelled continuously?
Ling Han replied with a counterattack.
The Three Styles of the God of War unleashed its might and clashed with Feng Jixing.
Their raw power was equal, so it would depend on who had the stronger grasp of the technique.
Now, it was a clash of two Saint-level techniques.
However, the Three Styles of the God of War was only a very superficial Saint Technique, and could possibly even be a castrated version.
It was indeed stronger than a Venerate Tier-level technique, but against Feng Jixing’s Saint Technique, it was not enough.
After the attack, Ling Han couldn’t help but take a few more steps back.
“Haha, nothing more than this!” Feng Jixing sneered.
“I really don’t know what you’re so proud of,” Ling Han said with a shake of his head.
“Don’t forget, I’m only a Cauldron Forging Tier.”
You can also be considered a f****** Cauldron Forging Tier?
Feng Jixing wanted to curse.
How could there be such a freakish Cauldron Forging Tier?
He launched another Saint Technique, but this time, a divine light also shot out.
Feng Jixing had refined a streak of celestial light and fused it into his Celestial Cauldron.
Now that he had advanced into the Core Formation Tier, the might of the celestial light would naturally rise accordingly, possessing astonishing destructive power.
Ling Han smiled and greeted it with a punch.
Peng!
The divine light slashed onto his body, yet its might was easily dispersed by the Celestial
Cauldron.
Pu, what the hell was this?
Feng Jixing couldn’t accept this.
The celestial light that he had obtained was extremely high- level, and the might of the divine light after refining the celestial light was comparable to a Saint-level technique.
Thus, it was equivalent to him unleashing two Saint Techniques just
now.
But what was the result?
The two Saint Techniques shot out at the same time, and Ling Han actually resolved it easily
with a single punch.
How could he accept this?
-If Feng Shaolin had to say this, this was really very normal.
Didn’t you see that even he, an elite with Eighth Heaven battle prowess, was forced to flee in a sorry state?
And who do you
think you are?
Ling Han smiled faintly and said, “Feng Jixing, even if your cultivation level is higher than mine, you still won’t be able to suppress me.
In fact, you’ll only be trampled on by me.
I really don’t know how you have the nerve to call yourself the number one prodigy of the North
Heavenly Realm.”
Feng Jixing almost exploded in fury.
He didn’t call himself the number one prodigy.
Moreover, he was only the number one prodigy of Cauldron Forging Tier.
Of course, there were other top-notch prodigies in the Core Formation Tier.
“You dare to look down on me!” He charged out, his expression twisted.
Ling Han unleashed his murderous aura, immediately causing Feng Jixing to pause.
He then launched a powerful offensive, and in a few moments, Feng Jixing was at a disadvantage.
This caused Song Lan and the others to watch with dumbfounded shock.
Ling Han being able to battle against a superior cultivation level prodigy was already shocking enough, and it was
a supreme prodigy like Feng Jixing at that.
This was practically a fantasy story.
When Feng Shaolin saw this, he hurriedly prepared to flee again.
Xiu, Ling Han didn’t attack Feng Jixing anymore.
Instead, he leaped over to block Feng
Shaolin.𝓯𝙧𝙚𝒆𝙬𝙚𝒃𝙣𝙤𝒗𝓮𝓵.𝙘𝙤𝙢
What!
Everyone was shocked.
Was Ling Han seeking death?
He actually dared to actively attack an elite at the consummate level of the Core Formation Tier?
Was he tired of living?
Even Feng Jixing smirked coldly.
Ling Han’s power was only on par with his, but against a Core Formation consummate level cultivator, it was more or less an insta-kill.
He was truly seeking death.
However, everyone saw a scene that made their eyes widen in disbelief – Feng Shaolin actually didn’t dare to parry, turning and running.
Feng Jixing: “…” Song Lan: “I
Prosperous Heaven: “…”
Ling Han’s expression was cold as he unleashed his murderous aura.
Feng Shaolin’s body instantly faltered, and he immediately charged over, unleashing another three powerful
attacks.
-The Primal Chaos Divine Lightning, the Divine Beasts of the Celestial Cauldron, and the Demonic Monkey Fists.
This was too terrifying.
Though Feng Shaolin tried his best to dodge and resist, he was still
blasted left and right, throwing up blood continuously.
‘F*ck!’
Seeing this scene, everyone wanted to curse.
As it turned out, the person chasing after Feng Shaolin was none other than Ling Han.
Crazy, he was really about to go crazy.
How could a Cauldron Forging Tier cultivator be this
powerful?
Feng Jixing felt as if he had been slapped across the face, feeling a burning pain.
In his eyes, Feng Shaolin was a big shot, yet he was actually being hunted down by Ling Han
and forced to vomit blood.
Moreover, he was still looking down on Ling Han?
Hehe, what a joke.

chapters.title: Chapter 3948: Clash of Trump Cards
paragraphs: Chapter 3948: Clash of Trump Cards
Feng Shaolin was not made of iron either.

He fled for three days, and not only did his injuries not get treated, they instead continued to worsen. After three days, he had almost reached his limit, and now, taking another powerful move, this had broken through his limit.
Peng! Feng Shaolin stumbled and fell to the ground. However, in the next instant, an astonishing aura of life suddenly exploded from his body, and he instantly reached an extremely powerful state.
But when they saw this scene, everyone shook their heads.
This was because Feng Shaolin had ignited his Celestial Core, and forcibly recovered his condition.
This couldn’t be maintained for long, and once he exited this state, his cultivation level would plummet, and he would become a mere mortal.
Oh no, an elite of the consummate level of Core Formation Tier, from now onwards, he would only be able to survive, and would no longer be able to compete for a place on the stage of history.
However, even if Feng Shaolin returned to his strongest state, he still didn’t dare to continue fighting. He simply broke into a run and fled.

Three days ago, hadn’t he also been in his strongest state? However, he had still been almost destroyed by Ling Han. Thus, he no longer had the courage to fight at all now. His only thought was to escape.
Ling Han didn’t give chase.

There was no need for that anymore. From now onwards, Feng Shaolin would no longer be a Core Formation Tier consummate level elite, but a mere mortal, and the Feng Clan had many enemies. When they saw this drowning dog, they would definitely give him a good thrashing. He set his eyes on Feng Jixing, and the killing intent in his eyes was undisguised.
After so many times, he had already tolerated Feng Jixing for a very long time, and this time, he was going to completely deal with Feng Jixing.

Being stared at by him like this, Feng Jixing couldn’t help but feel a chill rise up in his heart. Feng Shaolin’s battered and exhausted appearance was still in sight. Could it be that he had to follow in his footsteps, and would also be forced to burn his Celestial Core to survive?
“I’ve tolerated you for a long time. Today, I’ll let you suffer the consequences of your own actions!” Ling Han said coldly. Then, he charged out.
Boom!
Feng Jixing exchanged a blow with Ling Han, but his power was not inferior to Ling Han at all. In a situation when Ling Han did not use any powerful moves, he was naturally completely unafraid.
He kept his guard up. It should be known that it was not that he did not have a trump card up his sleeve.

“Ling Han, don’t push me too far. Worse come to worst, we’ll both be severely wounded!” Feng Jixing said. In the past six months, the coalition army had more or less cleaned up the Demon Abyss completely. Thus, even if he crushed his token and returned now, he wouldn’t have much regrets.
Ling Han smiled calmly, “Are you worthy of that?”
These words were filled with disdain.

Feng Jixing clenched his fists tightly. He had once been the number one elite of the Cauldron Forging Tier, so how proud and arrogant was he? It had always been him who treated others with a lofty attitude. How many people could be his equal?
But now? Ling Han was actually looking down on him to the core, which made him feel indignant.

But so what? Didn’t you see how a Core Formation Tier consummate level elite was forced to burn his Celestial Core by Ling Han? He was indeed strong. The moment he entered into the Core Formation Tier, he possessed the power of Third Heaven, but the gap between him and consummate level of Core Formation Tier was real.
Ling Han first used his murderous aura to suppress Feng Jixing. After battling for a while, he was finally able to use all of his powerful moves.
Good.
He raised his hand, and the Primal Chaos Divine Lightning was shot out.

This also came with an illusion effect. Feng Jixing was immediately hit, and fell into an illusion. Though he instinctively reacted to the attack, firstly, how fast was the speed at which the lightning was sent flying, and secondly, its might was too great, surpassing the Imperial Technique.

With Feng Jixing’s strength, he could only maintain his high-speed movement and not allow Ling Han to lock onto him. Otherwise, at such a close distance, there was absolutely no way he could dodge the Primal Chaos Divine Lightning.

This was an attack that even Core Formation Tier consummate level elites would be terrified of. It was a solid strike, and battle prowess as high as Eighth Heaven rolled over. How terrifying was that?
Pa, a brilliant light flashed over Feng Jixing’s body, but strangely, he was not teleported away, nor was he blasted into smithereens. Instead, he was standing there completely unscathed.
En, what was going on here?
Ling Han was curious, but Feng Jixing was both furious and shocked.

The reason why he was unscathed was because he had a talisman on him. It was a life-saving treasure that the elites of the Holy Land had bestowed on him, and could take a fatal attack on his behalf, and he could use it a total of five times.

Previously, when he had refined the celestial light, he had already used it once, and in this half a year’s time of battle in the abyss, he had used it again. It could be said that he had saved a lot. He had not thought that Ling Han would actually force him to use it again.
“This is the Substitution Seal, right?”
“That should be the case.”
“Who would’ve thought? Feng Jixing wasn’t even able to use his trump card before he was forced to use the Substitution Seal.”
“Sigh, is that guy really a Cauldron Forging Tier? He’s so strong that there’s no logic to it!”
The people around them discussed spiritedly, revealing the fact that Feng Jixing hadn’t been killed or teleported away.
Only now did realization dawn on Ling Han. Sigh, he really hadn’t seen the world. He actually didn’t know that there was a treasure like the Substitution Seal.
Feng Jixing finally came back to his senses. He clenched his fists, then drew out his trump
card.
This was a piece of yellow paper, and it was already very, very old. It exuded an incredibly ancient aura, but the moment it was taken out, it had an extremely terrifying aura that could
suppress eternity.
Feng Jixing revealed a reluctant expression. This was a treasure that he had obtained in
primitive ruins. It was very possible that it was a Talisman Weapon that had been refined by a Saint, but because it was really too old, the might of this Talisman Weapon was naturally
greatly reduced.
However, it should be more than enough to kill a Core Formation Tier cultivator.
He really couldn’t bear to. This was a trump card that he could use to intimidate the old monsters of the True Self Tier.
Something like a trump card let people know that its might was awesome, but it was best not to use it, because it could only be used once. After using it, the intimidation would naturally
cease to exist.
“Die!” Feng Jixing’s consciousness had already locked onto Ling Han, and he resolutely threw
out the talisman.
Boom! The yellow talisman instantly unleashed a boundless might as if it were the attack of
an ultimate elite.
Ling Han immediately realized that he wouldn’t be able to block this attack.
Without hesitation, he unleashed the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, then spat out
the Heavenly Dao Flames.
The talisman paper automatically combusted, turning into a sword that slashed towards Ling
Han.
This strike was enshrouded in Purple Qi, and it was as if heaven and earth could slice it apart.
The expressions of Song Lan and the others changed drastically. Who could escape from this
attack?
Even if he crushed the token, would he be able to escape in time?
Even if there was a Substitution Seal?
Hehe, once this attack was delivered, its power would soar to the heavens, enough to kill a
person a few dozen to over a hundred times. How many times would Substitution Seal be
effective?
No matter how one looked at it, Ling Han was definitely going to die.
Feng Jixing revealed a twisted expression. Being able to force him to use his trump card, Ling
Han could be considered to have died a worthy death.
Shua, the sword struck, its might unstoppable.
Boom, the Heavenly Dao Flames surged, covering heaven and earth.
The sword arrived, yet was forcibly melted by the flames, turning into pure heaven and earth
energy that dissipated.

It should be known that in prime condition, the Heavenly Dao Flames could even melt Origin Gold. The present Heavenly Dao Flames was indeed slightly inferior, but this Talisman Weapon from Feng Jixing was not left behind by a Great Emperor, and had experienced endless time, so its might had greatly decreased.

chapters.title: Chapter 3949 Defeat
paragraphs: 3949 Defeat

The Heavenly Dao Flames swept over, and the sword was instantly refined. However, the might of this Talisman Weapon was truly terrifying. The Divine Sword that it manifested also destroyed the Heavenly Dao Flames almost completely.
This!
Everyone was dumbfounded, unable to believe their eyes.
They knew very well how terrifying Feng Jixing’s Talisman Weapon was. The moment the Divine Sword appeared, it was as if their bodies were about to crack.
However, this powerful attack was easily melted by Ling Han’s flames.
Who could believe this?
Feng Jixing himself couldn’t accept this. He stared at Ling Han in a daze, his gaze extremely strange.
Meanwhile, Ling Han cracked a smile, and said, “Any more powerful moves? Come, I’ll oblige!”
He still had four Heavenly Dao Flames, and he refused to believe that Feng Jixing still had four Talisman Weapons.
Feng Jixing gritted his teeth, and all the muscles on his face were trembling. However, he was rendered speechless.

For a prodigy like him, he had always been the one to emerge victorious against his opponent with a superior cultivation level, but now, someone had defeated him with him having a superior cultivation level by a whole major tier. How could he accept this? His pride dropped all over the ground, and he felt indescribably terrible.
Why?
Why was there such a freak?
Had the heavens gone blind? They actually allowed such a freakish Cauldron Forging Tier cultivator to appear?
Ling Han released a battle cry, and charged towards Feng Jixing, his fists pounding furiously.

Feng Jixing hurriedly parried. The two of them exchanged blows, and under the condition that he did not use any powerful moves, Feng Jixing was indeed not inferior to Ling Han. However, once Ling Han used his murderous aura to attack, Feng Jixing would be outmatched.

The problem was that Ling Han still had the only Celestial Cauldron which could absorb all attacks within the gap of Sixth Heaven. This was too terrifying. Even if Ling Han stood there motionlessly, allowing Feng Jixing to attack him, Feng Jixing could beat him to the point of throwing up blood, and Ling Han would still be completely unscathed.
Which also meant that Ling Han was invincible by nature, so how was Feng Jixing supposed to fight him?
Could he still have fighting spirit?
After a while, Ling Han raised his hand, and lightning flashed. Pa, a brilliance immediately exploded on Feng Jixing’s body.
He used the Substitution Seal again.
Feng Jixing didn’t dare to continue fighting. If this continued, he would only exhaust his Substitution Seal for nothing. In the end, he would still die.
However, how could Ling Han allow him to leave?
He used the Imminent Skyline, and set off in pursuit of Feng Jixing. The murderous aura shot out, and Feng Jixing’s figure immediately stopped.
In the past, Feng Jixing’s speed was indeed faster than Ling Han’s. Because he had an advantage in power, no matter how brilliant a movement technique was, it was definitely linked to power.
However, now that their power levels were equal, and the movement techniques they had grasped were more or less the same, Feng Jixing still wanted to throw Ling Han off his tail?
That was impossible.
After exchanging a few moves, Ling Han used the Demonic Monkey Fists and the Celestial Cauldron Divine Beasts to attack Feng Jixing again, exhausting Feng Jixing’s Substitution Seal.
Feng Jixing finally did not have the slightest bit of hope left in him, and directly crushed the token. Otherwise, he would definitely have been killed by Ling Han.
In any case, he had already fished up enough here, so it was not a loss for him to leave now.𝒻𝘳ℯℯ𝑤ℯ𝒷𝘯ℴ𝓋ℯ𝘭.𝑐ℴ𝑚
Xiu, a streak of light wrapped around him, and Feng Jixing immediately disappeared without a trace.

Everyone was dumbfounded. What had they seen? The dignified Feng Jixing, the former top elite of Cauldron Forging Tier of North Heavenly Realm. After advancing into the Core Formation Tier, he was actually defeated by a Cauldron Forging Tier, to the point that he had to crush his token, and flee out of the Mystery Realm to save himself.
If they had not seen it with their own eyes, who would believe it?
Ling Han turned around and looked at everyone.
“Brother Ling, you are now undisputedly the number one elite of Cauldron Forging Tier. It is not North Heavenly Realm, but rather the whole world,” Song Lan said, her beautiful eyes shining.
Men loved beautiful women, and beautiful women also loved heroes. What woman wouldn’t admire an outstanding man like Ling Han?
So what if she was ranked ninth on the Exquisite Leaderboard? This battle was enough to make her heart flutter.
“Not too bad,” Ling Han casually replied.

This really wasn’t showing off, because he thought that freaks like Origin and Myriad Dao were very likely to form ten cauldrons, but whether they could reach the level of ten cauldrons becoming one wasn’t certain.
Thus, he was confident that he wouldn’t lose to anyone at the same cultivation level. However, he wasn’t arrogant enough to think that no one could rival him.

Such a freakish person was still so modest, which naturally made the few beauties present even more tempted. Even the Holy Daughterof the Buddhist Race, Prosperous Heaven, made an exception and took the initiative to speak with Ling Han. She even had the intention to extradite Ling Han into the Buddhist Sect.
Just forget about it.
Ling Han asked everyone about the situation. In the past half a year, the coalition army had more or less eliminated the entire abyss. Next, they were prepared to leave.
Was there any Mystery Realm or ancient site in the Demonic Origin Realm that could be explored?
It seemed to have disappeared as well.
Thus, the reason why Feng Jixing had called everyone over was actually to discuss when they would be returning.
In truth, after entering into the White Lotus Mystery Realm, there was no turning back. If one wanted to leave, there was only one way, and that was to crush the token.

“In this place, everyone’s cultivation speed is very fast. Even the old monsters of True Self Tier have entered into this cultivation level at around fifty years old. Because the heaven and earth here has a unique factor that can speed up the cultivation of cultivators.”
“However, this also has extremely great aftereffects. That is, though this kind of factor can speed up the cultivation of the human body, it would also combust one’s life force.”
“We’ve already been here for more than a year. Everyone’s cultivation level has improved rapidly, but our lifespan has also decreased greatly, by at least 1%.”
One percent, for a Core Formation Tier cultivator, that meant that their forty years of lifespan was gone.
Ling Han nodded. This was indeed a big problem. How could a rapid increase in cultivation level not come with a price?
Why were the people here only able to cultivate to the True Self Tier?

In fact, there were also high-level inheritances here, as well as prodigies. However, none of them were at the True Lord Tier or Sect Master Tier. This was because the life force was far too severely wounded. Thus, the True Self Tier was the end of the line.
If they stayed here for too long, the life force would also be affected. Even if they left in future, they would be limited to a certain cultivation level, and could not possibly advance further.
Thus, the White Lotus Mystery Realm would only open for three to five years, at most.
“We’ve decided to leave the Mystery Realm after eliminating the last two swarms of ants,” Song Lan said to Ling Han.
Right at this moment, everyone felt someone approach at practically the same time, so they all shut up.
In a short while, a young man swept over, and smiled slightly at everyone, “Everyone, the Ancestors have summoned us to discuss the matter of eradicating the ant nest.”

This was a native. At such a young age, he was already in the Core Formation Tier. In the outside world, he could also be called a prodigy, but this kind of prodigy had been cultivated at the cost of sacrificing his lifespan. His potential was limited.
“Brother Ling, let’s go together,” Song Lan invited Ling Han.
Ling Han pondered for a moment before nodding and saying, “Alright, let’s go take a look.”
He was also slightly interested in the divine fluid of the ant queen. With only one person’s power, it was extremely, extremely difficult to obtain.

The group returned, and saw that there was already a large number of people gathered on an empty piece of land here. Aside from outsiders, the native elites had also arrived one after another, and there were shockingly as many as five True Self Tier old monsters.

sentences.text: 3949 Defeat
The Heavenly Dao Flames swept over, and the sword was instantly refined.
However, the might of this Talisman Weapon was truly terrifying.
The Divine Sword that it manifested also destroyed the Heavenly Dao Flames almost completely.
This!
Everyone was dumbfounded, unable to believe their eyes.
They knew very well how terrifying Feng Jixing’s Talisman Weapon was.
The moment the Divine Sword appeared, it was as if their bodies were about to crack.
However, this powerful attack was easily melted by Ling Han’s flames.
Who could believe this?
Feng Jixing himself couldn’t accept this.
He stared at Ling Han in a daze, his gaze extremely strange.
Meanwhile, Ling Han cracked a smile, and said, “Any more powerful moves?
Come, I’ll oblige!”
He still had four Heavenly Dao Flames, and he refused to believe that Feng Jixing still had four Talisman Weapons.
Feng Jixing gritted his teeth, and all the muscles on his face were trembling.
However, he was rendered speechless.

For a prodigy like him, he had always been the one to emerge victorious against his opponent with a superior cultivation level, but now, someone had defeated him with him having a superior cultivation level by a whole major tier.
How could he accept this?
His pride dropped all over the ground, and he felt indescribably terrible.
Why?
Why was there such a freak?
Had the heavens gone blind?
They actually allowed such a freakish Cauldron Forging Tier cultivator to appear?
Ling Han released a battle cry, and charged towards Feng Jixing, his fists pounding furiously.
Feng Jixing hurriedly parried.
The two of them exchanged blows, and under the condition that he did not use any powerful moves, Feng Jixing was indeed not inferior to Ling Han.
However, once Ling Han used his murderous aura to attack, Feng Jixing would be outmatched.
The problem was that Ling Han still had the only Celestial Cauldron which could absorb all attacks within the gap of Sixth Heaven.
This was too terrifying.
Even if Ling Han stood there motionlessly, allowing Feng Jixing to attack him, Feng Jixing could beat him to the point of throwing up blood, and Ling Han would still be completely unscathed.
Which also meant that Ling Han was invincible by nature, so how was Feng Jixing supposed to fight him?
Could he still have fighting spirit?
After a while, Ling Han raised his hand, and lightning flashed.
Pa, a brilliance immediately exploded on Feng Jixing’s body.
He used the Substitution Seal again.
Feng Jixing didn’t dare to continue fighting.
If this continued, he would only exhaust his Substitution Seal for nothing.
In the end, he would still die.
However, how could Ling Han allow him to leave?
He used the Imminent Skyline, and set off in pursuit of Feng Jixing.
The murderous aura shot out, and Feng Jixing’s figure immediately stopped.
In the past, Feng Jixing’s speed was indeed faster than Ling Han’s.
Because he had an advantage in power, no matter how brilliant a movement technique was, it was definitely linked to power.
However, now that their power levels were equal, and the movement techniques they had grasped were more or less the same, Feng Jixing still wanted to throw Ling Han off his tail?
That was impossible.
After exchanging a few moves, Ling Han used the Demonic Monkey Fists and the Celestial Cauldron Divine Beasts to attack Feng Jixing again, exhausting Feng Jixing’s Substitution Seal.
Feng Jixing finally did not have the slightest bit of hope left in him, and directly crushed the token.
Otherwise, he would definitely have been killed by Ling Han.
In any case, he had already fished up enough here, so it was not a loss for him to leave now.𝒻𝘳ℯℯ𝑤ℯ𝒷𝘯ℴ𝓋ℯ𝘭.𝑐ℴ𝑚

chapters.title: Chapter 3950 Leaving
paragraphs: 3950 Leaving
This was quite a grand display.
Ling Han didn’t show off, and he followed them in a very low-key manner. He had always advocated making a fortune in secret .
“You!” However, the tree longs for peace but the wind will never cease. A person immediately jumped out, pointing angrily at Ling Han.
Li Shiming.
At that time, he had wanted to snatch Ling Han’s Celestial medicine, but in the end, he had been controlled by the black light of illusion, and had instead killed his two lackeys.
He naturally suppressed his anger, because he had never seen Ling Han again from now onwards.
Yet now, he had suddenly seen Ling Han appear, and all the old grudges and new grudges were borne in his heart. He immediately jumped out, wanting to settle accounts with Ling Han.
Ling Han thought for a moment, then said, “Oh, so it’s you.”
‘F*ck! Have you almost forgotten who I am?’
Li Shiming was even more enraged, and he was just about to unleash a palm strike at Ling Han.
He naturally didn’t pay any heed to a mere Cauldron Forging Tier cultivator. There was a large tier separating them, and the gap in strength was as wide as heaven and earth.
“Stop!” Song Lan shouted lightly.
Li Shiming dared to look down on Ling Han, but he definitely didn’t dare to scowl at Song Lan.

To say nothing of the fact that Song Lan was the seductive beauty who ranked ninth on the Exquisite Leaderboard, her natural talent in martial arts was also incredibly shocking. It was said that, just like Feng Jixing, she had also broken through to the Core Formation Tier with Nine Cauldrons.
Hence, the gap in strength between the two of them was extremely wide. If they fought, he would definitely lose.
Furthermore, he would have to be abrupt with the beauty. At that time, not only would he be beaten, he would also be looked down upon.
He was slightly defiant, and he said, “Celestial maiden Song, this person killed two of my subordinates. I can’t accept this!”
Song Lan looked at him pitifully. If he really made a move, it wouldn’t be that he couldn’t swallow his anger, but rather that he wouldn’t be able to breathe in future.
“There are Lords here, so stop mucking around!” she chided in a low voice.
Only then did Li Shiming reluctantly step aside. There were indeed five True Self Tier elites here. Even if he had an extremely powerful backer, he didn’t want to deliberately offend them.

“All right, everyone, let’s discuss some important matters,” one of the natives spoke up. He was a being of the consummate level of the Core Formation Tier. At present, though there were a considerable number of outsiders that had broken through to the Core Formation Tier, faced with the battle prowess of the consummate level of the Core Formation Tier, they still had to admit that they were impressed.
Everyone straightened their backs and sat upright.

“Everyone, before we discuss this matter, I would like to ask you a question.” Before they could get to the main topic, another Core Formation Tier consummate level native spoke up. He looked to be in his seventies, and even his brows and hair were beginning to turn gray.
“Elder Chen, please speak,” Prosperous Heaven said.

Originally, outsiders were all represented by Feng Jixing, but now, Feng Jixing had been beaten out of the Mystery Realm by Ling Han, so it felt like they had no leader. Thus, Prosperous Heaven, Song Lan, Nangong Hao, and Zhao Wuji could all stand up and speak.
The white-haired elder nodded, “I would like to know, how do you all plan to bring us out of the Mystery Realm?”
Nangong Hao frowned and said, “We’re obviously going back the way we came.”
“Hehe, why have I heard that there is no exit at all?” the white-haired old man continued.
F***, who had leaked the secret?
Nangong Hao’s expression remained unchanged, and he laughed loudly, “Who did Elder Chen hear this from? It’s completely a non-existent matter!”
“Then, young friend Nangong, how about you hand over your token to me?” the white-haired elder asked with a smile.
This time, Nangong Hao’s expression changed drastically. He frowned and said, “This is a life-saving trump card. Forgive me for not being able to hand it over.”

The white-haired old man laughed loudly, “Young friend, I can guarantee that in the upcoming sweep, there is no need for you to contribute in the slightest, but your share of the gains will not be overlooked. So, what about it even if you hand over your token?”
Nangong Hao was at a loss for words. He had spoken so beautifully, so what else could he say?
He paused for a moment before saying, “You have to guard against others. It’s best to keep this kind of life-saving item for yourself.”
Yet the white-haired elder shook his head, “As I see it, this is a complete lie. You are not willing to hand over the token, because this is the only way to leave!”
The outsiders exchanged looks, all of them surprised. Who had leaked this secret?
That was because the prerequisite for their cooperation with the natives was that when outsiders left, they would bring the natives with them.
However, since this could not be realized, would the natives still treat them kindly?
Furthermore, this concerned the lifespan of a few hundred, a few thousand, or even in fact, tens of thousands of years. What native would not risk their lives for this?𝚏𝕣𝐞𝗲𝐰𝕖𝐛𝐧𝕠𝕧𝚎𝚕.𝐜𝚘𝗺
…Snatch the token, and leave on their own!
“Hehe, no need to deny it,” the white-haired elder said. “I once captured one of you, and used torture to confess everything.”
With these words, everyone’s mouths that were still trying to quibble were completely silenced.
“Since that is the case, everyone should hand over your tokens,” the white-haired old man said with a smile. His expression was very gentle, but carried an incredibly baleful air.
This involved one’s own lifespan, so who wouldn’t put their lifespan on the line?
Ling Han sighed. Could it be that he was really a bringer of misfortune?
Becoming hostile as soon as he arrived?

The outsiders stood up one after another. They were naturally unwilling to hand over their tokens. Putting aside the fact that they would be trapped in this small place, in this special place, their lifespan would be exhausted at an extremely fast rate. Very few people would be able to live past a hundred years.
The natives wanted to live for a long time, so how could they want to have a short life?
All of a sudden, swords were drawn.

Originally, the natives were wary of the rare treasures in the hands of outsiders, and were unwilling to force them too far, but it was a different story now. For the sake of a few hundred or a few thousand years of lifespan, anyone would go all out.

Ling Han looked at the five True Self Tier old monsters, and shook his head internally. With these five people standing guard, outsiders naturally wouldn’t have the slightest chance of winning. Thus, there was only one choice now, and that was to immediately crush the tokens. Otherwise, if they were captured, the tokens would be found, and they could only be trapped here until death.
The prodigies naturally had no lack of decisiveness. They all crushed their tokens, and instantly, multiple streaks of light wrapped around them, dancing and moving, beginning the tide of return.

Ling Han didn’t hesitate either. He, a Cauldron Forging Tier, was indeed heaven-defying. After unleashing his ultimate move, he could even grind a consummate level Core Formation Tier elite to death. However, against a True Self Tier elite, he didn’t have the slightest chance of winning.
Sigh, he was really unlucky. Wasn’t it just hunting down a person? He had been led into this trap in a muddle-headed manner.
Thankfully, he had already reaped what he deserved. He no longer had any regrets.
If he left, he would be able to beat Feng Jixing up again.
Ling Han crushed the token. Wrapped in a ray of light, he immediately flew up, then sped up, instantly reaching a point where he couldn’t see what was happening outside.
Then, he realized that he had fallen down from the skies.
His reaction was extremely fast. Hurriedly, he straightened his body, and landed steadily on the ground.
He had come out.
Beside him, Song Lan, Prosperous Heaven, Nangong Hao, and the others all appeared.
“What’s going on?” Immediately, a mighty figure at the level of Venerate Tier flew over. This was too exaggerated, wasn’t it? Why had he fallen out like a dumpling?
Someone spoke quickly, and in a few words, related the entire sequence of events.
